格奥尔格·康托尔借助序数概念，越过无限继续计数。自然数 0、1、2、3、……是有限序数，但它们有一个最小上界 ω，即第一个超限序数。一种简洁的形式化方法，是令 ω 为集合 {0,1,2,3,……}。于是，在按属于关系排序的列表 0、1、2、3、……、ω 中，ω 就是有限序数之后的第一项。

Georg Cantor counted past infinity using the concept of ordinal numbers. The natural numbers 0, 1, 2, 3, …are the finite ordinal numbers, but they have a least upper bound ω—the first transfinite ordinal number. A neat way to formalize this is to let ω be the set {0, 1, 2, 3,.. .}.Then ω is the first term beyond the finite ordinals on the list 0, 1, 2, 3,…, ω, ordered by membership.

与有限序数一样，每个超限序数都有后继，因此存在 ω+1、ω+2、ω+3 等序数。

Like the finite ordinals, each transfinite ordinal has a successor, so there are ordinals ω + 1, ω + 2, ω + 3, and so on.

序数能够跟上对角线论证产生新对象的步伐，因为任意可数序数集都有最小上界。ω+1、ω+2、ω+3、……之后是 ω·2；ω·2、ω·3、ω·4、……之后是 ω²；ω²、ω³、ω⁴、……之后是 ω^ω。这些还只是所谓可数序数中的少数例子。

Ordinals keep pace with the production of new objects by the diagonal argument, because any countable set of ordinals has a least upper bound. Beyond ω + 1, ω + 2, ω + 3,… there is ω • 2. Beyond ω · 2, ω · 3, ω · 4,… there is ω2.Beyond ω2, ω3, ω4,… there is ωω .And these are merely a few of what we call the countable ordinals.

全体可数序数的最小上界，是第一个不可数序数，记为 ω₁。因此，序数提供了另一条通往不可数无限的道路。这条路较慢，但可以说，更有秩序。

The least upper bound of the countable ordinals is the first uncountable ordinal, called ω1. Thus ordinals offer a different road to uncountable infinity. The ordinal road is slower, but more—shall we say—orderly.

序数不仅有序，而且是良序的。任意非空序数集都有最小元素；等价地，不存在无限下降的序数序列。因此，虽然通往某个序数的道路可能很长，任何返回的旅程却都很短，因为它是有限的。正如第 2.7、2.8 节将展示的，这一事实在有限对象的世界中有令人惊讶的后果。

Not only are ordinals ordered, they are well-ordered. Any nonempty set of them has a least member; equivalently, there is no infinite descending sequence of ordinals. Thus, even though the road to an ordinal may be long, any return trip is short (because it is finite). This fact has surprising consequences in the world of finite objects, as we show in Sections 2.7 and 2.8.

2.1　越过无限继续计数

2.1 Counting Past Infinity

什么时候数“1、2、3、……、无限”是合理的？一种情形，是试图按增长速度为函数排序时。正如第 1.6 节所见，很容易找到一个整数函数序列 f₁、f₂、f₃、……，其中每个函数都比前一个增长得快。我们还看到，在这种情形下，对角线函数 f(n)=fₙ(n) 比所有 f₁(n)、f₂(n)、f₃(n)、……都增长得快。因此，自然应给对角线函数 f 加上一个下标“数”，它大于所有数 1、2、3、……。遵循康托尔，我们用符号 ω 表示这个“数”。于是，当 fₖ(n)=nᵏ 时，fω(n)=fₙ(n)=nⁿ。

When is it reasonable to count 1, 2, 3, … infinity? One such occasion is when we try to order functions according to their rate of growth. As we saw in Section 1.6, it is easy to find a sequence f1, f2, f3,… of integer functions, each of which grows faster than the one before. We also saw, in this situation, that the diagonal function f (n) = fn (n) grows faster than all of f1 (n), f2(n), f3(n), Thus it is natural to label the diagonal function f by a subscript “number” greater than all the numbers 1, 2, 3, …. Following Cantor, we use the symbol ω for this “number.” Thus fw (n) = fn (n) = nn when fk(n) = nk.

符号 ω 是希腊字母表的最后一个字母 omega，但它名不副实，因为它不是最后一个数。事实上，ω 是第一个超限序数，即大于所有 1、2、3、……的最小序数；这些数也称为有限序数。序数

The symbol ω is omega, the last letter of the Greek alphabet, but it belies its name because it is not the last number. In fact ω is the first transfinite ordinal, the least ordinal greater than all of 1, 2, 3, …, which are also known as the finite ordinals. The ordinal numbers

1,2,3,…,ω

有一个直接后继，称为 ω+1。它可以用整数函数

have an immediate successor, called ω + 1. It can be represented by the integer function

fω+1(n)=nn+1

表示，这个函数比 f₁、f₂、f₃、……、fω 中任意一个都增长得快。函数 fω₊₁ 的增长速度大于 fω，因为 n→∞ 时，fω₊₁(n)/fω(n)=n→∞。事实上，我们需要一整个无限的、越来越大的序数序列

which grows faster than any of f1, f2, f3,…, fω. The function fω+1 has greater growth rate than fω because fω+1)/ fω (n) = n → ∞ as n → ∞. In fact we need a whole infinite sequence of increasingly large ordinals

ω+1, ω+2, ω+3, …

来标记越来越快的函数

to label the increasingly fast-growing functions

fω+1(n)=nn+1, fω+2(n)=nn+2, fω+3(n)=nn+3, ….

And of course, the diagonal construction gives a function f that grows faster than any of the functions fω+1(n) = nn+1, fω+2(n)= nn+2, fω+3(n) = nn+3,…;namely,

f(n)=n2n

因此，我们需要用一个大于下面所有序数的序数来标记 f：

We therefore need to label f with an ordinal number greater than all of

1,2, 3,…, ω,ω+1, ω+2, ω+3,….

我们把这样的最小序数称为 ω·2。它本来也可以叫作 2·ω，但我们不这样做，因为序数有乘积的概念，而恰好 2·ω≠ω·2。

We call the least such ordinal ω · 2. (It could equally well be called 2 · ω, but we don’t, because there is a concept of product of ordinals and it so happens that 2 · ω ≠ ω · 2.)

我们知道，杜布瓦-雷蒙定理允许我们找到一个函数 g，比列表 g₁、g₂、g₃、……中的任意函数都增长得快。因此，要有条理地标记递增的增长速度，就需要任意序数集的最小上界，即大于或等于该集合所有元素的最小序数。到目前为止，我们有

As we know, du Bois-Reymond’s theorem allows us to find a function g that grows faster than any function on a list g1, g2, g3,… . To label increasing growth rates in an orderly manner we therefore need a least upper bound for any set of ordinal numbers—a least ordinal greater than or equal to all members of the set. So far we have

ω= least upper bound of {1,2,3,…}ω⋅2= least upper bound of {ω+1,ω+2,ω+3,…}. 

我们还知道，若 g(n) 是任意递增函数，那么 ng(n) 也是递增函数，而且增长得更快。因此，若 g(n) 以序数 α 标记，就需要一个后继序数 α+1 来标记 ng(n)。从目前最大的序数 ω·2 出发，后继运算给出

We also know that, if g(n) is any increasing function, then ng(n) is an increasing function with greater growth rate. Thus if g(n) is labelled by the ordinal α we need a successor ordinal α + 1 to label ng(n).Starting with our biggest ordinal so far, ω · 2, the successor operation gives

ω⋅2+1, ω⋅2+2, ω⋅2+3, …,

而最小上界运算给出一个大于其中所有序数的序数，自然称为 ω·3。这又开启另一个无限序列

and the least upper bound operation gives an ordinal greater than any of these, which is naturally called ω · 3. This kicks off another infinite sequence

ω⋅3+1, ω⋅3+2, ω⋅3+3, …,

其最小上界为 ω·4，接着又有序列

with least upper bound ω · 4, followed by the sequence

ω⋅4+1, ω⋅4+2, ω⋅4+3, …,

其最小上界为 ω·5，依此类推。反复这样做，还会得到 ω·6、ω·7、ω·8、……，又一个递增的无限序数序列。下面这个序列的最小上界

with least upper bound ω · 5, and so on. Doing this over and over we also get ω · 6, ω · 7, ω · 8,… —another increasing infinite sequence of ordinals. You will not be surprised to hear that the least upper bound of

ω, ω⋅2, ω⋅3, …

被称为 ω·ω=ω²，你大概不会感到惊讶。用我们产生函数的运算会得到 fω2(n)=nn2⋅ )，也同样不会令人惊讶。

is called ω · ω = ω2. (Or that our operations for producing functions give fω2(n)=nn2⋅ )

这一切将走向何方？

Where Is All This Going?

从序数 ω² 出发，我们可以越过

Starting with the ordinal ω2, we can climb past

ω2+1, ω2+2, ω2+3,… to ω2+ω,

类似地，还可以越过

and similarly past

ω2+ω⋅2, ω2+ω⋅3, ω2+ω⋅4, …, to  ω2+ω2=ω2⋅2. 

经过类似的漫长攀登，依次到达

Similar long climbs lead successively to

ω2⋅3, ω2⋅4, ω2⋅5, …,

它们的最小上界自然称为 ω³。继续攀登，依次到达 ω⁴、ω⁵、ω⁶、……，它们的最小上界自然称为 ω^ω。再往后，很久以后，我们会到达令人眩晕的高度：

whose least upper bound we naturally call ω3. Further climbs lead successively to ω4, ω5, ω6,…, whose least upper bound is naturally called ωω. After that (a long time after), we reach the dizzy heights of

ωωω, ωωωω,ωωωωω,…,

它们的最小上界也许可记为 ωωωωω′ 。此时我们已逼近标准数学记号的极限，因此把符号 ωωωωω′  缩写为 ε₀。“ε₀”，读作 epsilon zero，是康托尔选的名字，略带讽刺意味，因为数学家传统上用希腊字母 ε 表示一个“小”量。

whose least upper bound might be denoted ωωωωω′ . At this point we are reaching the limits of standard mathematical notation, so we abbreviate the symbol ωωωωω′  by ε0. The name ε0 (“epsilon zero”) was chosen by Cantor, and it is slightly ironic, because the Greek letter ε is traditionally used by mathematicians to denote a “small” quantity.

实际上，与它之后的序数相比，ε₀ 的确很小。显然，我们可以无限继续产生序数，只是在为它们命名、识别相应正整数函数时，也许会遇到困难。函数 fε0(n) 同样挑战着我们的记号能力，因为它是下面这些函数的对角线函数：

Actually, ε0 is small compared with what comes after it. We can clearly continue the process of generating ordinal numbers indefinitely, though perhaps with some difficulty in finding names for them and in identifying the corresponding positive integer functions. (The function fε0(n) also challenges our notational resources, because it is the diagonal function of the functions

fω(n)=nn, fωω(n)=nnn, fωω(n)=nnnn, … ,

你不妨验证一下。更根本的问题是：“无限继续”产生序数，究竟意味着什么？我们已不会再以为所有无限都相同，因此需要提出更精确的问题。至少有三个问题浮现在眼前：

as you might like to verify.) The more fundamental question is: what does it mean to “continue indefinitely” the process of generating ordinal numbers? We know better than to think that all infinities are the same, so we need to formulate a more precise question. At least three questions come to mind:

  1. 当前产生序数的过程，即取后继与取最小上界，能否一直继续到不可数那么远？
    Can the current process for generating ordinal numbers (taking successors and least upper bounds) be continued uncountably far?
  2. 如果可以，能否“展示”一个不可数的正整数函数集，按增长速度递增排列？
    If so, can we “exhibit” an uncountable set of positive integer functions, ordered by increasing growth rate?
  3. 相应的增长速度，最终是否会超过任意给定正整数函数的增长速度？
    Do the corresponding growth rates eventually exceed that of any given positive integer function?

这些问题仍有些模糊，但下一节将对问题 1 给出精确回答。问题 2、3 也有某种意义上的答案，但它们与集合论的深刻问题纠缠在一起，本书只能在第 2.3、2.4 节作简要讨论。

These questions are still a little vague, but we will give a precise answer to Question 1 in the next section. Questions 2 and 3 also have answers (sort of) but they are entangled with deep questions of set theory we are able to discuss only briefly in this book (Sections 2.3 and 2.4).

尽管如此，仅仅是试图理解这些问题，就已对逻辑与数学的发展产生了惊人的成果，后面各章将会看到。

Nevertheless, simply trying to understand these questions has been amazingly fruitful in the development of logic and mathematics, as we will see in later chapters.

2.2　可数序数

2.2 The Countable Ordinals

第 1 章讨论了基数，但不必精确定义基数是什么。只需知道两个集合 A、B 何时具有相同基数，即 A、B 的元素之间存在一一对应，就够了。类似地，也可以说明集合 A、B 具有相同序数意味着什么，不过这稍微复杂一些。

In Chapter 1 we discussed cardinal numbers, though we did not need to define precisely what a cardinal number is. It is enough to know when two sets A and B have the same cardinal number, namely, when there is a one-to-one correspondence between the elements of A and B. Likewise, it is possible to say what it means for sets A and B to have the same ordinal number, though this is somewhat more complicated.

首先，A、B 必须是良序的。若 A 中元素之间的关系 <ₐ 满足下列条件，就称它把 A 线性排序。

First, it is necessary for A and B to be well-ordered. A is said to be linearly ordered by a relation <A on its members if the following conditions hold.

  1. 对 A 中任意元素 a，都没有 a<ₐa。
    For any member a of A, a is not <A a.
  2. 对 A 中任意两个元素 a₁、a₂，要么 a₁<ₐa₂，要么 a₂<ₐa₁。
    For any two members a1 and a2 of A,either a1 <A a2 or a2 <A a1.
  3. For any members a1, a2, a3 of A, if a1 <A a2 and a2 <A a3 then a1 <A a3.

    线序集的例子包括实数集和正整数集，采用数的通常 < 关系。不过，只有正整数集在 < 关系下是良序的。若序关系 <ₐ 还满足下面的附加条件，就称它为集合 A 的一个良序：

    Examples of linearly ordered sets are the real numbers and the positive integers, under the usual < relation for numbers. However, only the positive integers are well-ordered by the < relation. An order relation <A is called a well-ordering of a set A if it satisfies the additional condition:

  4. A 的任意非空子集都有一个 <ₐ 最小元素，即某个元素 l，使得对其中任意不同于 l 的元素 a，都有 l<ₐa。这意味着 A 中不存在无限下降序列 a₁>ₐa₂>ₐa₃>ₐ⋯，否则子集 {a₁,a₂,a₃,……} 就没有 <ₐ 最小元素。
    Any nonempty subset of A has a <A-least element, that is, an element l such that l <A a for any a in A other than l. This implies that there is no infinite descending sequence a1 >A a2 >A a3 >A ⋯ of members of A, otherwise the subset {a1, a2, a3,… } of A has no <A-least member.

实数在 < 下不是良序的，因为例如大于 0 的数所组成的集合就没有最小元素。任意正整数集都有最小元素，这是显然的。稍加思考也能看出，上一节写下的序数，按我们书写时从左到右的次序，也是良序的。例如，考虑小于 ω·2 的序数：

The real numbers are not well-ordered by < because, for example, the set of numbers greater than 0 has no least member. It is obvious that any set of positive integers has a least member. With only a little more thought, one sees that the ordinal numbers we wrote down in the previous section are also well-ordered by the left-to-right order in which we wrote them down. For example, consider the ordinals less than ω 2:

1,     2, 3,…ω,   ω+1,    ω+2,…

显然，这些序数的任意非空子集 S 都有一个最靠左的元素。如果 S 包含正整数，其中最小的正整数就是最靠左的元素。如果 S 只包含形如 ω+m 的序数，其中 m 为普通整数，那么 m 最小的那个就是最靠左的元素。对截至此前提及的任意序数的集合，都可使用类似论证，当然，包含的序数越大，论证也越复杂。

It is clear that any nonempty subset S of these ordinals has a leftmost member. If S includes any positive integers, then the least of these is leftmost. If S includes only elements among the ordinals ω + m, for ordinary integers m, then the leftmost element is the one for which the integer m is least. A similar argument applies for the sets of ordinals up to any ordinal we mentioned so far, though naturally the argument becomes more complicated as larger ordinals are included.

下面给出全体正整数集的一个良序，它不同于通常的良序。我们作如下排列：

Here is an example of a well-ordering—different from the standard one—of the set of all positive integers. We make the following picture,

1,3,5,….2,4,6,…

规定若数 m 在图中比数 n 更靠左，就称 m“小于”n。也就是说，若 m 为奇数而 n 为偶数，或者二者同为偶数或同为奇数且在通常意义下 m<n，就称 m“小于”n。正整数的这个次序，实际上与小于 ω·2 的序数的次序相同，下面精确说明这一点。

and say that number m is “less than” number n if m is further to the left in the picture. That is, m is “less than” n if either m is odd and n is even, or if they are both even or both odd and m < n in the usual sense. This ordering of positive integers is in fact the same as the ordering of ordinals less than ω · 2, in a sense we now make precise.

若良序集 A、B 之间存在保持次序的一一对应 f，就称二者具有相同的序数。也就是说，A 中两个元素 a₁、a₂ 分别对应 B 中两个元素 f(a₁)、f(a₂)，B 中每个元素 b 都等于某个 a∈A 的 f(a)，并且

Two well-ordered sets A and B have the same ordinal number if there is a one-to-one correspondence f between A and B that preserves the ordering. That is, if a1 and a2 are two members of A then f(a1) and f(a2) are two members of B, any member b of B equals f(a) for some a in A, and

a1<Aa2 if and only if f(a1)<Bf(a2).

下面这两个次序

The two orderings

1,     2, 3,…ω,    ω+1,    ω+2,…

和

and

1,3,5,…2,4,6,…

显然在这个定义的意义下具有“相同的序数”，而且你大概已经想说，它们共同的序数是 ω·2。这是正确的，但完整说明需要定义“序数”概念，它比仅仅定义“与……具有相同序数”这一关系更复杂。不过，我们可以说明如何用第 1.8 节列出的 ZF 集合论公理为这一思想提供依据。

clearly have the “same ordinal number” in the sense of this definition, and indeed you probably have the urge to say the common ordinal number is ω · 2. This is correct, though a full explanation requires a definition of the concept “ordinal number,” which is more complicated than merely defining the relation “same ordinal number as.” However, we indicate how the idea may be justified by the axioms for ZF set theory listed in Section 1.8.

第一个序数是空集，我们写成 {}，以明确表示它没有元素。空集存在是集合论的一条公理。正如第 1.8 节所述，约翰·冯·诺伊曼的巧妙思想，是令 0 为空集，再把有限序数依次定义为如下集合：

The first ordinal is the empty set, which we write {} to make it plain that it has no members. It is an axiom of set theory that the empty set exists. As mentioned in Section 1.8, John von Neumann had the brilliant idea to let 0 be the empty set, and to define the finite ordinals successively as the following sets:

1={0}, 2={0,1}, 3={0,1,2}, ….

一般地，有限序数 n+1={0,1,2,……,n} 是 n+1 的所有前驱组成的集合，因此小于集合 n+1 的序数，恰好就是它的元素。反过来，序数 n 的后继 n+1 就是集合 n∪{n}，其元素为 n 以及 n 的所有元素。因此，只需把旧集合当作新集合的元素，就能从“无”，即空集，构造出所有有限序数，并用属于关系为它们排序。

In general, the finite ordinal n + 1 = {0, 1, 2,…, n} is the set of all predecessors of n + 1 , so the ordinals less than the set n + 1 are precisely its members. Conversely, the successor n + 1 of the ordinal n is simply the set n ⋃{n}, whose members are n and the members of n. Thus we can build all the finite ordinals from “nothing” (the empty set) by taking old sets as members of new sets, and we can order them by the membership relation.

事情并不止于此。集合论的另一条公理，即无穷公理，说明可以把所有有限序数收集到一个集合中：

It doesn’t stop there. Another axiom of set theory (the axiom of infinity) says that we can collect all the finite ordinals in a single set

ω={0,1,2,3,…}

因此，第一个无限序数 ω 的前驱，恰好就是它的元素。接着，后继运算给出

Thus the predecessors of the first infinite ordinal, ω, are precisely its members. Then the successor operation gives

ω+1=ω∪​{ω}={0,1,2,…,ω}ω+2=ω+1∪​{ω+1}={0,1,2,…,ω,ω+1}, ω+3=ω+2∪​{ω+2}={0,1,2,…,ω,ω+1,ω+2}         ⋯

借助替代公理，还可以把迄今所有序数收集成集合

And we can (with the help of the replacement axiom) collect all the ordinals so far into the set

ω⋅2={0,1,2,…,ω,ω+1,ω+2,…}.

因此，序数 ω·2 代表其元素从左到右的次序

Thus the ordinal ω · 2 represents the left-to-right ordering of its members

0, 1, 2, … ω, ω+1, ω+2, …

它与正整数从左到右的次序

which is the same as the left-to-right ordering of positive integers

1,    3,      5,   …    2,     4,       6,…, 

相同，正如上面所猜想的。上一节考虑的所有序数，都可以证明代表正整数的某种良序。另一个例子是 ω·3，它代表如下从左到右的次序：

as we surmised above. All of the ordinals considered in the previous section can be shown to represent well-orderings of the positive integers. Another example is ω · 3, which represents the left-to right ordering

1,4,7,…2,5,8,…3,6,9,….

反过来，正整数的任意良序，都由一个所谓可数序数表示，即一个可数集 α，它具有推广上述特定序数的性质：α 在属于关系下是良序的，而且 α 的元素的任意元素，也都是 α 的元素。

Conversely, any well-ordering of the positive integers is represented by what we call a countable ordinal—a countable set a with properties that generalize those of the particular ordinals mentioned above: a is well-ordered by the membership relation,and any member of a member of α is a member of a.

可数序数远远超出了上一节费力才到达的 ε₀，远到难以想象。任意可数序数 α 都有一个可数后继 α+1；任意可数的递增可数序数序列 α₁<α₂<α₃<⋯，也都有一个可数的最小上界，或称极限，它由 α₁、α₂、α₃、……的所有元素合并而成。要看出这个集合为何可数，回想第 1.2 节如何把可数多个可数集安排进希尔伯特旅馆即可。因此，全体可数序数的集合，集合论公理保证它存在，是不可数的。否则，若可数序数只有可数多个，它们最小上界的后继就会是一个大于所有可数序数的可数序数，产生矛盾。

The countable ordinals go inconceivably far beyond the ordinal ε0 that we struggled to reach in the last section. Any countable ordinal α has a countable successor α + 1, and any countable increasing sequence of countable ordinals a1 < a2 < a3 < ⋯ has a countable least upper bound, or limit, obtained by collecting all the members of α1, α2, α3,… . (To see why this collection is countable, recall how we packed countably many countable sets into Hilbert’s hotel, in Section 1.2.) It follows that the set of all countable ordinals (the axioms of set theory guarantee that such a set exists) is uncountable. Because if there were only countably many countable ordinals, the successor of their least upper bound would be a countable ordinal greater than all countable ordinals—which is a contradiction.

关于记号与实现的说明

Remarks on Notation and Realization

现在应该清楚，为什么不把已经用于第一个超限基数的符号 ℵ₀，也用于第一个超限序数。序数概念比基数概念更精细，因为集合的序数取决于集合的次序，而不仅是基数。事实上，刚才已经看到，可数序数有不可数多个，它们全都对应基数为 ℵ₀ 的集合的良序。

It should now be clear why we did not use the symbol ℵ0, already used for the first transfinite cardinal, for the first transfinite ordinal. The concept of ordinal is a refinement of the concept of cardinal, because the ordinal number of a set depends on the ordering of the set, not simply on its cardinality. Indeed, we have just seen that there are uncountably many countable ordinal numbers—all corresponding to well-orderings of a set of cardinality ℵ0.

遗憾的是，这意味着按通常对“名称”的理解，不存在可数序数的完整命名系统。实际中的“名称”是某个有限字母表上的字符串，而这样的字符串只有可数多个。先列出有限多个单字母串，再列有限多个双字母串、三字母串，依此类推，就能列出它们。因此，若想统一地命名所有可数序数，只能采用较理论化的方案，让每个序数本身，通常是一个无限集，充当自己的名称。

This means, unfortunately, that there is no complete system of names for countable ordinals, as we normally understand the concept of “name.” In practice, “names” are strings of letters in some finite alphabet, and there is only a countable infinity of such strings. We can list them by listing the finitely many one-letter strings first, then the finitely many two-letter strings, then the finitely many three-letter strings, and so on. Thus, if one wants to name all countable ordinals uniformly, one has to take the more theoretical option of letting each ordinal (generally, an infinite set) be its own name.

幸而，本书主要只需要直到 ε₀ 的序数名称，而这样的名称确实存在一个优美的统一系统。第 2.6 节将更详细地介绍它。

Fortunately, in this book we need names mainly for ordinals up to ε0, and a nice uniform system of such names exists. We describe this system more fully in Section 2.6.

实现可数序数最具体的方法，也许是使用按自然次序排列的有理数集。实际上，只用单位区间 (0,1) 内的有理数集就够了。例如，ω 是集合 { 12,34,78,… }. 的序数。图 2.1 画出了这个有理数集，各点以竖线标出，越接近 ω，竖线高度越趋近于零。

Perhaps the most concrete way to realize countable ordinals is by sets of rational numbers, with the natural ordering. Indeed, we can stick to sets of rational numbers in the unit interval (0,1). The ordinal ω, for example, is the ordinal number of the set { 12,34,78,… }.. Figure 2.1 shows a picture of this set of rationals, marked by vertical lines whose height decreases towards zero as we approach ω.

如果序数 α 能以这种方式表示，那么 α+1 也能：先把表示 α 的有理数集中的每个元素除以 2，映入 (0,1/2)；再插入点 1/2，便表示 α+1。如果序数 α₁<α₂<α₃<⋯ 都能表示，那么它们的最小上界也能：把表示 α₁ 的有理数映入 (0,1/2)，表示 α₂ 的映入 (1/2,3/4)，表示 α₃ 的映入 (3/4,7/8)，依此类推；然后插入点 1，实现 α₁、α₂、α₃、……的最小上界。最后再除以 2，使所有用到的有理数都位于 (0,1) 内。

If an ordinal α is representable in this way, so is α + 1: first map the set of rationals representing α into (0, 1/2) by dividing each member by 2; then insert the point 1/2 to represent α + 1. And if ordinals α1 < α2 < α3 < ⋯ are representable, then so is their least upper bound: map the rationals representing α1 into (0, 1/2), the rationals representing α2 into (1/2, 3/4), the rationals representing α3 into (3/4, 7/8),…, and then insert the point 1 to realize the least upper bound of α1, α2, α3,… . Finally, divide by 2 so that all the rationals used lie in (0, 1).

例如，图 2.2 展示了用有理数集表示 ω² 时的样子。

As an example, Figure 2.2 shows what ω2 looks like when represented by a set of rationals.

有理数集能够表示通过取后继和取可数最小上界得到的每个序数，而显然，每个可数序数都以这种方式产生。否则，考虑无法这样得到的最小可数序数：它不是极限就是后继，两种情形都会导致矛盾。

Sets of rationals represent every ordinal obtained by taking successors and countable least upper bounds, and it is clear that every countable ordinal arises in this way. (If not, consider the least countable ordinal not obtainable: it is either a limit or a successor, so we get a contradiction.)

2.3　选择公理

2.3 The Axiom of Choice

……即使对于无限多个集合组成的总体，也总存在某种映射，为每个集合指定其中的一个元素。

… even for an infinite totality of sets there are always mappings that associate with every set one of its elements.

——恩斯特·策梅洛（1904），第 516 页。

—Ernst Zermelo (1904), p. 516.

可数序数的总体，按大小排列时是良序的。取任意可数序数集 S，再选 S 中一个元素 α 即可看出这一点。要么 α 就是 S 的最小元素，要么 S 中有小于 α 的元素，而这些元素也都是 α 的元素。在后一部分 S 的元素中存在最小者，因为 α 是良序的。因此，无论哪种情形，可数序数集 S 都有最小元素。

The collection of countable ordinals, ordered by size, is well ordered. This can be seen by considering any set S of countable ordinals, and choosing a member α of S.Either α is the smallest member of S,or else there are members of S less than α, which are therefore members of a.Among the latter members of S there is a least, because α is well-ordered. Thus, in either case, the set S of countable ordinals has a least member.

因此，可数序数集本身也是一个序数，康托尔把它称为 ω₁。由于它有不可数多个元素，ω₁ 必然是不可数序数。事实上，ω₁ 是最小的不可数序数，因为小于它的任意序数都是可数的。因此，可数序数组成了最小可能的不可数集，康托尔把其基数称为 ℵ₁。产生不可数集 ℵ₁ 的思想，与最初产生不可数集的思想，即取正整数的所有 2ℵ0 个子集，形成鲜明对照。基数 ℵ₁ 按构造就是良序的，而若不为 ZF 增添新公理，就无法为具有 2ℵ0 个元素的集合建立良序。此外，ℵ₁ 是 ℵ₀ 之后的下一个大小，而 2ℵ0 的大小几乎完全是个谜。

It follows that the set of countable ordinals is itself an ordinal number, which Cantor called ω1. Since it has uncountably many members, ω1 is necessarily an uncountable ordinal. Indeed, ω1 is the least uncountable ordinal, since any ordinal less than it is countable. Thus the countable ordinals make up the smallest possible uncountable set, whose cardinality was called ℵ1 by Cantor. The idea that produces the uncountable set ℵ1 contrasts strongly with our first idea for producing an uncountable set— taking all 2ℵ0 subsets of the positive integers. The cardinal number ℵ1 is well-ordered by construction, whereas there is no way (short of adding a new axiom to ZF) to well-order a set with 2ℵ0 members. And the size of ℵ1 is the next size after ℵ0, whereas the size of 2ℵ0 is an almost complete mystery.

甚至 ℵ₁ 是否小于 2ℵ0 都不清楚，因为二者可能根本无法比较！不等式 ℵ₁≤2ℵ0 的意思是：某个大小为 ℵ₁ 的集合，例如可数序数集，与某个大小为 2ℵ0 的集合，例如正整数函数集，的一个子集之间存在一一对应。

It is not even clear that is less than 2ℵ0, because they may not even be comparable! The inequality ≤ 2ℵ0 means that there is a one-to-one correspondence between a set of size ℵ1 (say, the countable ordinals) and a subset of some set of size 2ℵ0 (say, the set of positive integer functions).

我们把可数序数与正整数函数联系起来的方案，看似正好能证明这一点，但其中有个陷阱。

Our scheme for associating countable ordinals with positive integer functions seems tailor-made to prove this fact, but there is a catch.

我们从下面用序数标记函数的方式开始：

We started with the following labelling of functions by ordinals—

f1(n)=nf2(n)=n2f3(n)=n3        ⋮fω(n)=nnfω+1(n)=nn+1fω+2(n)=nn+2        ⋮fω⋅2(n)=nn2        ⋮

可以顺利继续到 fε0(n)，大概还能更远。但假设对所有 β<α 都已定义 fβ(n)，当 α 是任意可数序数时，究竟如何定义 fα(n) 呢？

—and we can continue happily to fε0(n), and probably further. But exactly how do we define fα(n),where α is an arbitrary countable ordinal, assuming that fβ(n) has been defined for all ordinals β < α?

若 α 是后继序数，即对某个 β 有 α=β+1，就没有问题。这时令 fα(n)=n·fβ(n)。但若 α 是极限序数，即不是后继，就必须选择一个序数序列

There is no problem when α is a successor ordinal, that is, when α = β + 1 for some β. In this case we let fα(n) = nfß(n).But when α is a limit ordinal, that is, not a successor, we have to choose a sequence

β1<β2<β3<⋯

使其最小上界为 α，再用杜布瓦-雷蒙定理，令 fα(n) 为一个比序列

of ordinals with least upper bound α, and let fα(n) be a function that grows faster than any member of the sequence

fβ1(n), fβ2(n), fβ3(n), …,

中每个函数都增长得快的函数。所得函数 fα 取决于序列 β₁、β₂、β₃、……的选择，即使 α=ω 也不例外。

using du Bois-Reymond’s theorem. The resulting function fα depends on the choice of sequence β1, β2, β3,…, eveninthe case α = ω.

看起来，极限为 α 的序列总有一种自然选择。事实上，英国著名数学家 G. H. 哈代于 1904 年正是提出用这种方法构造 ℵ₁ 个正整数函数组成的集合。然而，不存在一个显式规则，能够被证明对每个可数极限序数 α 都选出以 α 为极限的递增序列。这个困境，以及其他必须在没有明显规则时作无限多次选择的困境，使数学家确信集合论需要一条新公理，即所谓选择公理。

It may seem that there is always a natural choice for the sequence with limit α, and indeed the famous English mathematician G. H. Hardy proposed exactly this method for constructing a set of ℵ1 positive integer functions in 1904. Yet there is no explicit rule for choosing an increasing sequence with limit α that can be proved to work for every countable limit ordinal α. This quandary, and others where it is necessary to make infinitely many choices in the absence of any apparent rule, convinced mathematicians that set theory needed a new axiom: the so-called axiom of choice.

选择公理的形式表述相当简单：

The formal statement of the axiom of choice is quite simple:

选择公理：对任意由非空集合 S 组成的集合 X，存在一个函数 choose(S)，称为 X 的选择函数，使得对 X 中每个集合 S，choose(S) 都属于 S。

Axiom of choice. For any set X of nonempty sets S, there is a function choose(S) (a “ choice function for X” ) such that choose(S) is in S for each set S in X.

第 2.9 节将介绍选择公理的一些经典应用。这里说明如何用它摆脱当前困境。对每个可数极限序数 α，令 xα 为所有以 α 为极限的递增序列组成的集合，再令 X 为所有这样的 xα 组成的集合。X 的选择函数 F 就为每个可数极限序数 α 给出一个以 α 为极限的递增序列 F(xα)。F 很难说是寻找这种序列的“规则”；不如说，它是在没有规则时所诉诸的东西。

Some classical applications of the axiom of choice are given in Section 2.9. Here is how we use the axiom of choice to get out of our present quandary. For each countable limit ordinal α, let xα be the set of all increasing sequences with limit α, and then let X be the set of all such xα. A choice function F for X gives an increasing sequence F(xα), with limit α, for each countable limit ordinal α. F is hardly a “rule” for finding a sequence with limit α. Rather, it is what one resorts to when no rule is available.

选择公理与良序

The Axiom of Choice and Well-Ordering

为节省篇幅，以下把“选择公理”缩写为 AC。AC 涉及许多关于不可数集的问题。其中最简单的问题也许是：如何从每个非空实数集中选择一个数？任何想到的规则，例如选最小元素，都很容易看出会失效，正如第 2.2 节所述。事实上，只有 AC 才能保证实数集的选择函数存在。

To save space we now abbreviate “the axiom of choice” by AC. AC is involved in many questions involving uncountable sets. Perhaps the simplest such question is the following: how does one choose a number from each nonempty set of real numbers? Any rule that comes to mind—such as choosing the least member—is easily seen to break down, as we mentioned in Section 2.2. In fact, only AC guarantees that a choice function for sets of real numbers even exists.

但 AC 不只是在想作无限多次选择时的最后手段。它确实为神秘的不可数集世界带来了秩序，因为它蕴含每个集合都可以良序化。恩斯特·策梅洛于 1904 年证明了这一点。特别地，AC 蕴含实数集可以良序化。当然，这个良序没有“规则”，但如果设想它已经“给定”，那么实数几乎就像可数集一样容易处理。特别是，从每个非空实数集中选择元素的问题立刻得到解决：选择它在这个良序意义下的“最小”元素即可。

But AC is more than just a last resort when one wants to make infinitely many choices. AC literally brings order to the mysterious world of uncountable sets, because it implies that every set can be well-ordered. This was proved by Ernst Zermelo in 1904. In particular, AC implies that the set of real numbers can be well-ordered. Naturally, there is no “rule” for this well-ordering, but if we imagine being “given” the well-ordering, the real numbers become almost as easy to handle as a countable set. In particular, we can immediately solve the problem of choosing an element from each nonempty set of reals; namely, choose its “least” element in the sense of the well-ordering.

类似论证表明，可以为任意良序集的子集定义选择函数。因此，AC 实际上等价于“每个集合都可以良序化”这一断言，即所谓良序定理。

A similar argument shows that a choice function can be defined for the subsets of any well-ordered set. Hence AC is in fact equivalent to the assertion that every set can be well-ordered, the so-called well-ordering theorem.

由良序定理可知，基数可以用特定序数表示。例如，ℵ₀ 可用 ω 表示，ℵ₁ 可用 ω₁ 表示；一般地，任意集合 S 的基数，都可用 S 的所有良序中最小的序数表示。由此又可知，任意两个基数都可以比较，即一个小于或等于另一个。比较代表它们的序数，就能比较基数。这是 AC 为不可数集世界带来秩序的一种方式。

It follows from the well-ordering theorem that cardinal numbers can be represented by particular ordinals. For example, ℵ0 can be represented by ω, ℵ1 by ω1, and in general the cardinal number of any set S can be represented by the least ordinal number of well-orderings of S. It follows in turn that any two cardinal numbers are comparable: that is, one is less than or equal to the other. We compare cardinal numbers by comparing the ordinals that represent them. This is one of the ways in which AC brings order into the world of uncountable sets.

2.4　连续统假设

2.4 The Continuum Hypothesis

ℵ₁ 是可数序数集，这不过是产生更高基数的一种特殊且最简单的方法。相比之下，［连续统］由一种全新且更强的原则产生，即幂集公理。

ℵ1 is the set of countable ordinals and this is merely a special and the simplest way of generating a higher cardinal. The [continuum] is, by contrast, generated by a totally new and more powerful principle, namely the Power Set Axiom.

——保罗·科恩（1966），第 151 页。

—Paul Cohen (1966), p. 151.

如果产生不可数集的两种基本方法，即取大小为 ℵ₀ 的集合的全部 2ℵ0 个子集，以及取大小为 ℵ₀ 的全部 ℵ₁ 个序数，能得到相同基数，那就很好。但是否如此并不清楚。判定是否 2ℵ0=ℵ1 的问题，称为连续统问题；自康托尔于 1883 年首次以这种形式提出以来，它一直悬而未决。¹ 断言 2ℵ0=ℵ1 称为连续统假设，简称 CH。

It would be nice if the two basic methods for producing an uncountable set—taking all 2ℵ0 subsets of the set of size ℵ0, and taking all ℵ1 ordinals of size ℵ0—led to the same cardinality. But it is not clear that they do. The problem of deciding whether 2ℵ0=ℵ1 is called the continuum problem, and it has been open since Cantor first raised the question in this form in 1883.1 The claim that 2ℵ0=ℵ1 is called the continuum hypothesis (CH).

20 世纪，我们对什么可以证明的理解取得了许多重大进展，本书后面将研究其中一些，但连续统问题仍是个谜。它似乎恰好处于人类理解无限的能力边界。不过，有两项突破至少有助于解释连续统问题为何困难。

The 20th century brought many dramatic advances in our understanding of what is provable—some of which we will study later in this book—but the continuum problem remains a mystery. It seems to lie at the very limit of the human capacity to understand the infinite. Nevertheless, there have been two breakthroughs that at least help to explain why the continuum problem is difficult.

1938 年，奥地利数学家库尔特·哥德尔证明，CH 与集合论的标准公理，即第 1.9 节列出的 ZF 公理，是相容的。也就是说，如果标准公理相容，那么把 CH 加入其中也不会导致矛盾。不过，这也不意味着 CH 能由标准公理证明。哥德尔在几年前还证明了标准公理系统是不完备的：假设标准公理相容，许多语句既不能证明，也不能反驳。后来发现 CH 正是其中之一，不过这并非由哥德尔最初的不完备性论证得到。

In 1938, the Austrian mathematician Kurt Gödel showed that CH is consistent with the standard axioms of set theory (the ZF axioms, listed in Section 1.9). That is, if the standard axioms are consistent, then they and CH together do not lead to a contradiction. However, this does not mean that CH can be proved from the standard axioms, either. Gödel also showed, a few years earlier, that the standard axiom system is incomplete: assuming that the standard axioms are consistent, many sentences can be neither proved nor disproved. It turned out that CH is one of them, though not by Gödel’s original argument for incompleteness.

CH 的不可证性由美国数学家保罗·科恩于 1963 年证明，本节开头引用了他的话。引文出自科恩 1966 年的一本书，该书阐述了他与哥德尔的结果。引文之前还有如下推测：

The unprovability of CH was shown in 1963 by the American mathematician Paul Cohen, whom we quoted at the beginning of this section. The quote is from a book that Cohen wrote in 1966, expounding his and Gödel’s results. It is preceded by the speculation that

作者认为，一种最终可能被接受的观点是：CH 显然是假的。

a point of view which the author feels may eventually come to be accepted is that CH is obviously false.

关于不可证语句的提醒

Warning about unprovable sentences

必须强调，只有在假设 ZF，或任何包含基本逻辑的其他系统，相容的前提下，才能证明某个语句在其中不可证。因为按照基本逻辑，从矛盾可以推出任何语句。我们会偶尔提醒这一点，但若每次声称语句不可证时都重申，就太冗长了。

It should be stressed that unprovability in ZF (or in any other system with basic logic) can only be demonstrated under the assumption that the system is consistent. This is because, by basic logic, all sentences are deducible from an inconsistency. We shall give occasional reminders of this point, but it would be tedious to mention it on every occasion when sentences are claimed to be unprovable.

这项提醒的要点是：ZF，或任何足够强的公理系统，的相容性确实是一项假设。后面会说明原因。

The point of this warning is that consistency of ZF (or of any reasonably strong axiom system) really is an assumption. We shall see later why this is so.

哥德尔也相信 CH 是假的，并猜想 2ℵ0=ℵ1 等于 ℵ₂，即所有基数为 ℵ₁ 的序数组成的集合的基数。

Gödel also believed that CH is false, and he conjectured that 2ℵ0=ℵ1 equals ℵ2, the cardinality of the set of all ordinals of cardinality ℵ1.

然而，迄今还没有提出能够解决 CH、又令人信服的新公理。也许不存在比 CH 本身更可信、却能判定 CH 的公理。但我们究竟怎样才能证明这一点呢？

However, no convincing new axioms that settle CH have yet been proposed. It is conceivable that CH cannot be settled by any axioms more plausible than itself. But how on earth would we prove that?

连续统假设与增长速度

The Continuum Hypothesis and Rates of Growth

连续统假设为增长速度问题提供了一个部分答案。²

The continuum hypothesis gives a partial answer to the questions 2 and 3 that were raised in Section 2.1: can we “exhibit” a sequence of integer functions,

f0,f1,…,fβ,…, where each β is a countable ordinal, 

是否存在这样的序列，使任意正整数函数 g 的增长速度，都被某个 fβ 超过？我们无法真正“展示”这样的序列，但 CH 蕴含存在一个长度为 ω₁、具有所需性质的良序序列。

such that each fβ grows faster than any of its predecessors, and such that the growth rate of any given integer function g is exceeded by that of some fβ? We cannot exactly “exhibit” such a sequence, but CH implies that there exists a well-ordered sequence of length ω1 with the required property.

由第 1.7 节可知，正整数函数有 2ℵ0 个，因此 CH 蕴含所有这些函数可以排列成序列

We know from Section 1.7 that there are 2ℵ0 positive integer functions, so CH implies that all such functions may be arranged in a sequence

f0,f1,…,fα,…, where α runs through all the countable ordinals. 

然后只需沿着这个序列，挑出适当的函数 fβ，使其比此前所有函数都增长得快。

It then suffices to run through this sequence, picking out a suitable functions fβ that grow faster than all their predecessors.

精确地说，先选 f₀。此后，设 α 为此前所选函数的指标的最小上界，选取每个比截至 fα 的所有函数都增长得快的 fβ。原序列中，截至指标 α 的函数只有可数多个，因此由杜布瓦-雷蒙定理，存在一个函数 h，比它们都增长得快。由于序列 f₀、f₁、……、fα、……包含所有正整数函数，第一个这样的 h 必定作为某个 fβ 出现并被选中，且 β>α。因此，对原序列中任意指标 α<ω₁，都还会选出指标 β 超过它的新函数 fβ。而且按构造，每个 fβ 的增长速度都超过全体整数函数序列中 fα 之前的任意函数。因此，任意给定整数函数 g 的增长速度，都会被某个 fβ 超过。

To be precise, first pick f0. After that, pick each fβ that grows faster than all functions up to fαwhere α is the least upper bound of the indices of functions previously picked. There are only countably many functions up to the index α in the original sequence, hence there is a function h that grows faster than them all, by du Bois-Reymond’s theorem. The first such h therefore occurs (and gets picked) as some fβ,with β > α, since the sequence f0, f1,…,fα,…, includes all positive integer functions. Consequently, new functions fβ will be picked for β beyond any index α < ω1 in the original sequence. And, by construction, the growth rate of each fβ exceeds that of any integer function preceding fα in the sequence of all integer functions. Thus the growth rate of any given integer function g is exceeded by that of some fβ.

像这些 fβ 一样的函数序列称为标度。它就像一把带有 ω₁ 个刻度的尺子，可用来度量任意正整数函数的增长速度。法国数学家埃米尔·博雷尔在 1898 年的《函数论讲义》第 118 页中，首次猜想标度存在，并未诉诸 CH。博雷尔依靠杜布瓦-雷蒙的对角线论证，也依靠一种模糊的信念：通过对角线化的“超限重复”，就能超过任意给定整数函数的增长速度。

A sequence of functions such as the fβ is called a scale. It is like a ruler (with a sequence of ω1 marks on it) that we can use to measure the growth rate of any positive integer function. The existence of scales was first conjectured by the French mathematician Émile Borel, in his book Ļecons sur la théorie des fonctions (Lectures on the Theory of Functions) of 1898, p. 118, without appealing to CH. Borel relied on du Bois-Reymond’s diagonal argument, but also on a vague belief that by “transfinite repetition” of diagonalization one could overtake the growth rate of any given integer function.

如第 2.3 节所述，即使对角线化的 ω₁ 次重复，也无法在没有 AC 的情况下完成。但 AC 不蕴含 CH，而事实上，标度存在性假设也不蕴含 CH。因此，CH 与增长速度之间的关系，仍有很大部分是个谜。

2.5 Induction

2.5　归纳法

The quantity a + (b + e) is the successor of the quantity a + b …

若想达到任何确定的目标，即使只限于有限整数，也必须采用一种新的“推理方式”。它实质上就在于承认一个命题：在整数之后，还存在一个大于所有整数的数。我们必须采用的正是这种推理方式，因为没有它就无法作任何事情；它就是所谓归纳法。

—Hermann Grassmann (1861), §2, Section 16.

——昂利·庞加莱（1906），第 294 页。

We can give a precise account of ordinal symbols such as ω + ω, ω2, and ωω by defining the sum, product, and exponential functions for countable ordinals. Our definitions extend the so-called inductive definitions of these functions for finite ordinals to ω and beyond, using the fact that every ordinal is either 0, a successor, or the least upper bound of its predecessors.

算术基本函数的归纳定义，由德国数学家赫尔曼·格拉斯曼于 1861 年首先提出。格拉斯曼认识到，自然数 0、1、2、3、4、5、……的关键性质，是它们从 0 出发，反复施行加 1 运算，他用 e 表示 1，而得到。自然数的这种归纳性质，使我们可以先给出 f(0)，再用已经定义的 f(n) 给出 f(n+1)，从而为所有自然数 n 定义函数 f(n)。

Inductive definitions of basic functions of arithmetic were first proposed by the German mathematician Hermann Grassmann in 1861. Grassmann recognized that the key property of the natural numbers 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, … is that they originate from 0 by repeating the operation of adding 1 (which he denoted by e). This inductive property of natural numbers allows a function f(n) to be defined for all natural numbers n by first giving the value f(0), then giving f(n + 1) in terms of the value f(n) already defined.

当然，说“用 f(n) 给出”，是指应当使用某种已经知道的运算，由 f(n) 计算 f(n+1)。起初，唯一“已知”的运算是加 1，即后继

Of course, when we say “in terms of f(n)” we mean that f(n + 1) should be computed from f(n) using some operation already known. In the beginning, the only “known” operation is adding 1—the successor

函数，因此对 f(n) 唯一能做的就是加 1。但这已经足以对任意固定数 m，用下面一对等式定义和函数 f(n)=m+n：

function—so all we can do to f(n) is add 1. This is enough to define the sum function f(n) = m + n, for any fixed number m, by the following pair of equations:

m+0=m,m+(n+1)=(m+n)+1.

第一个等式规定 f(0)=m，称为定义的基础步骤。第二个等式规定 f(n+1)=f(n)+1，即 f(n) 的后继，称为归纳步骤。

The first equation, which declares that f (0) = m, is called the base step of the definition. The second equation, which declares that f(n + 1) = f(n) + 1 (the successor of f(n)) is called the induction step.

既然已对任意自然数 n 定义了加 n 运算，就可以用它通过下面两个等式定义积函数 g(n)=m·n：

Now that we have defined the operation of adding n, for any natural number n, we can use the operation to define the product function g(n) = m·n by the following two equations:

m⋅0=0,m⋅(n+1)=m⋅n+m.

然后用下列等式定义指数函数 mⁿ：

And then we define the exponential function mn by the equations:

m0=1,mn+1=mn⋅m.

这些定义中的归纳步骤，为所有能从 0 通过后继运算到达的数定义了函数，这些数就是自然数，也称有限序数。要到达 ω 这样的极限序数，需要在每个定义中插入一个最小上界步骤。这个步骤用所有小于极限序数 β 的 γ 所对应的 f(γ)，给出 f(β)。规则很简单：

The induction step in each of these definitions defines the function for all numbers that can be reached from 0 by the successor operation— the natural numbers, also known as the finite ordinals. To reach limit ordinals such as ω we need to insert a least upper bound step into each definition. The least upper bound step gives f(β) in terms of the values f (γ),for γ less than the limit ordinal β. The rule is simply that

f（各 γ 的最小上界）= 各函数值 f(γ) 的最小上界。

f (least upper bound of the γ) = least upper bound of the values f (γ).

对于上面的函数，用 lub 表示最小上界，就有

For the functions above we have, writing lub for least upper bound,

α+β=lubγ<β(α+γ), α⋅β=lubγ<βα⋅γ, αβ=lubγ<βαγ.

现在用 α 代替 m，表示任意可数序数。初始等式 m+0=m 等，也应把 m 改写为 α。

We now write α to denote any countable ordinal instead of m. The initial equations m+ 0 = m, and so on, should also be written with α in place of m.

这些定义表明，序数的和、积与指数函数，自然地推广了自然数上的相应函数。特别地，它们说明了为什么用 ω+1 表示 ω 的后继，为什么把序列 ω+1、ω+2、ω+3、……的极限写作 ω+ω，为什么 ω·2=ω+ω，以及为什么把序列 ω、ω²、ω³、……的极限写作 ω^ω。

These definitions show that the sum, product, and exponential functions for ordinals naturally extend the corresponding functions on natural numbers. In particular, they show why we use the notation ω + 1 for the successor of ω, why we write ω + ω for the limit of the sequence ω + 1, ω + 2, ω + 3,why ω · 2 = ω + ω, and why we write ωω for the limit of the sequence ω, ω2, ω3,… .

归纳证明

Proof By Induction

有限数领域中从 n 到 n+1 的归纳法，现在由如下原则取代：关于序数 α 的命题 f(α)，若 f(0) 为真，并且从所有 ξ<α 的 f(ξ) 为真能够推出 f(α) 为真，那么它对每个 α 都为真。

Induction from n to n + 1 in the domain of finite numbers is now replaced by the following: A statement f (α) concerning an ordinal number α is true for every α if f (0) is true and if the truth of f (α) follows from the truth of f (ξ) for all ξ < α.

——费利克斯·豪斯多夫（1937/1957），第 72 页。

—Felix Hausdorff (1937/1957), p. 72.

通过归纳定义函数 f，会为每个可数序数 α 给出唯一的值 f(α)。证明这一事实，就是归纳证明的一个例子，它是归纳定义的自然伴随。例如，如何知道下面的定义

Defining a function f by induction gives a unique value f (α) for each countable ordinal α. Proving this fact is an example of proof by induction— the natural accompaniment to definition by induction. For example, how do we know that the definition

m+0=m, m+(n+1)=(m+n)+1,

对 m、n 的所有自然数取值，都赋予 m+n 唯一的值？把“对所有 m，m+n 都唯一”看作关于自然数 n 的命题。n=0 时它成立，因为 m+0 的唯一值是 m。若它对 n=k 成立，即 m+k 有唯一值，那么对 n=k+1 也成立，因为 m+(k+1) 的值为 (m+k)+1，即 m+k 的唯一后继。因此，这个命题对所有 n 成立，因为每个 n 都能从 0 反复取后继而得到。

gives a unique value to m + n for all natural number values of m and n? Think of “m + n is unique for all m” as a proposition about the natural number n. This proposition is true for n = 0, because m + 0 has the unique value m. And if the proposition is true for a value n = k − that is, if m + k has a unique value—then it is true for n = k + 1, since m + (k +1) has the value (m + k) + 1, the unique successor of m + k. Thus the proposition is true for all n, because any n can be reached from 0 by repeating the successor operation.

m+n 的唯一性归结为后继的唯一性。

The uniqueness of m + n comes down to the uniqueness of successor.

由于最小上界也是唯一的，证明任意序数 α、β 的 α+β 唯一，并不困难多少。把“对所有 α，α+β 都唯一”看作关于序数 β 的命题。它对 β=0 同样成立。现假设对所有小于某个 δ 的 β 都成立。若 δ 是后继序数，则由后继的唯一性，命题对 β=δ 也成立；否则，由最小上界的唯一性，α+δ=lubβ<δ(α+β) 也唯一。因此 α+β 对所有 β 都唯一，因为任意序数 β 都可以作为更小序数的后继或最小上界得到。

It is not much harder to prove that α + β is unique for all ordinals α and β, thanks to the uniqueness of least upper bounds. Think of “α + β is unique for all α” as a proposition about the ordinal β. Again, this proposition is true for β = 0. Now we suppose that the proposition is true for all β less than some δ. It follows that the proposition is true for β = δ—that is, α + δ is unique—by the uniqueness of successor if δ is a successor and otherwise by the uniqueness of least upper bounds, because α + δ = lub β<δ(α + β). Thus α + β is unique for all β, because any ordinal β can be reached as either the successor or the least upper bound of smaller ordinals.

因此，α+β 的唯一性，以及类似地，任意通过超限归纳定义的函数的唯一性，都推广到了所有序数。

Thus the uniqueness of α + β (and, similarly, any function defined by transfinite induction) extends to all ordinals.

不过，虽然这些函数的定义能够推广到超限情形，它们的性质却并非都能推广。例如，对任意有限序数 m、n，都有 m+n=n+m。格拉斯曼直接从归纳定义证明了这一点。然而，由和的定义中的极限情形可得

But while the definitions of these functions extend into the transfinite, not all of their properties do. For example, m + n = n + m for any finite ordinals m and n. This was proved by Grassmann directly from the inductive definition. Yet it follows from the limit case in the definition of sum that

1+ω=lubγ<ω(1+i)=ω,

因此 1+ω≠ω+1。另一方面，自然数的和、积与幂的一些有用性质，确实能推广到序数。例如加法结合律：l+(m+n)=(l+m)+n。

so 1 + ω = ω + 1. On the other hand, some useful properties of sum, product, and exponential that we know for natural numbers do extend to ordinals. An example is the associative law for addition: l + (m + n) = (l + m)+ n.

有限序数的结合律

The associative law for finite ordinals

把 l+(m+n)=(l+m)+n 看作关于 n 的命题。由和的定义，它对 n=0、1 成立。若 n=k+1，假设 l+(m+k)=(l+m)+k，则有

Think of l + (m + n) = (l + m) + n as a proposition about n. This proposition is true for n = 0, 1 from the definition of sum. And if n = k + 1 we have, assuming l + (m + k) = (l + m)+ k,

l+(m+(k+1))=l+((m+k)+1)  by definition of sum  =(l+(m+k))+1 by induction hypothesis  =(((l+m)+k)+1) by induction hypothesis  =(l+m)+(k+1) by definition of sum. 

因此，由归纳法，这个命题对所有有限 n 都成立。

Thus the proposition is true for all finite n,by induction.

这个证明实质上与格拉斯曼 1861 年对有限序数的证明相同。要把论证推广到所有序数，只需处理极限情形。

This proof is essentially the same as Grassmann’s 1861 proof for finite ordinals. To extend his argument to all ordinals we need only deal with the limit case.

乘法和幂运算的左分配律 α(β+γ)=αβ+αγ 与 α^(β+γ)=α^β·α^γ，也有类似证明。建议读者亲自试一试，并证明 (β+γ)α 并不总等于 βα+γα。

There are similar proofs for the left distributive laws (for multiplication and exponentiation) α(β + γ) = αβ + αγ and αβ+γ = αβ. I recommend that readers try their hand at them, and also show that (β + γ)α is not always equal to βα + γα.

所有序数的结合律

The associative law for all ordinals

要证明 α+(β+γ)=(α+β)+γ，把它看作关于 γ 的命题。由上面的论证，对 γ=0、1，以及任意序数 α、β，这个命题成立。

To prove α + (β + γ) = (α + β)+ γ, think of this as a proposition about γ. The proposition is true for γ = 0,1 (and all ordinals α and β), by the argument above.

现假设对所有小于某个极限序数 δ 的 γ，以及任意 α、β，都有 α+(β+γ)=(α+β)+γ。那么命题对 γ=δ 也成立，因为

Now suppose that α + (β + γ) = (α + β) + γ holds for all γ less than some limit ordinal δ (and all α and β). Then the proposition also holds for γ = δ because

α+(β+δ)=α+(β+lubγ<δγ) =lubγ<δ[α+(β+γ)] by definition of sum  =lubγ<δ[(α+β)+γ] by induction hypothesis  =(α+β)+δ by definition of sum.  

因此，α+(β+γ)=(α+β)+γ 对所有序数 γ 都成立。

Thus α + (β + γ) = (α + β) + γ holds for all ordinals γ.

2.6　康托尔标准形

2.6 Cantor Normal Form

例子 1+ω=ω≠ω+1 表明，对可数序数求和时，必须小心各项的次序。

The example 1 + ω = ω ≠ ω + 1 shows that one has to be careful about the order of terms in a sum of countable ordinals.

等式 1+ω=ω 表明，在一个序数右边加上一个“大得多”的序数时，前者会被吸收。因此，和式中位于“大得多”的项左边的序数可以省略。乘积也有类似现象。正如上一节所述，对序数 α、β、γ，有 α^β·α^γ=α^(β+γ)，因此

The equation 1 + ω = ω shows that an ordinal gets absorbed when a “much larger” ordinal is added on its right. So we can omit ordinals in sums to the left of “much larger” ones. A similar thing happens with products. Since αβ · αγ = αβ+γ for ordinals α, β,and γ (as mentioned in the previous section), we have

ω⋅ωω=ω1⋅ωω=ω1+ω=ωω.

所以，乘积中位于“大得多”的 ω 的幂左边的 ω 的幂，也可以省略。

Thus we can omit powers of ω in products to the left of “much larger” powers.

删去和式与乘积中的冗余项，就得到一种称为康托尔标准形的序数记法。这种记法只需用于小于 ε₀ 的序数，即小于下面序列中某一项的序数：

Omitting redundant terms in sums and products leads to a notation for ordinals known as the Cantor normal form. This notation is needed only for ordinals less than ε0, that is, ordinals less than some member of the sequence

ω, ωω, ωωω, ωωωω,….

这样的序数 α 必然位于这个序列的两项之间。举一个例子，就足以说明如何得到它的记法。

Such an ordinal α necessarily falls between two terms of this sequence, and example will suffice to show how we obtain its notation.

  • Suppose that ωω < α < 2N0. It follows that α falls between two terms of the following sequence with limit 2ℵ0:

    ωω, ωω2, ωω3,….

  • Suppose ωωω < α < ωωω: . It follows that α falls between two terms of the following sequence with limit ωω2:

    ωω2, ωω2⋅2, ωω2⋅3,….

  • Suppose that ωω3 < α < ωω3:. It follows that α falls between two terms of the following sequence with limit ωω2⋅7:

    ωω2⋅7, ωω2⋅7+ω, ωω2⋅7+ω⋅2, ωω2⋅7+ω⋅3,…

  • Suppose that ωω2⋅8. It follows that α falls between two terms of the following sequence with limit ωω2⋅7+ω2=ωω2⋅8::

    ωω2⋅7+ω⋅4, ωω2⋅7+ω⋅4+1, ωω2⋅7+ω⋅4+2,…

  • Suppose that ωω2⋅7+ω⋅4<α<ωω2⋅7+ω⋅5. This means that α is a term in the following sequence with limit ωω2⋅7+ω⋅4+ω=ωω2⋅7+ω⋅5::

    ωω2⋅7+ω⋅4+11, ωω2⋅7+ω⋅4+11+1, ωω2⋅7+ω⋅4+11+2, ….

例如，我们可能得到 ωω2⋅7+ω⋅4+11<α<ωω2⋅7+ω⋅4+12，这就是这个特定 α 的康托尔标准形。

So we could have, for example, ωω2⋅7+ω⋅4+11<α<ωω2⋅7+ω⋅4+12, which is the Cantor normal form for this particular α.

一般地，每个序数 α<ε₀ 都可以写成

In general, each ordinal α < ε0 can be written in the form

ωα1⋅n1+ωα2⋅n2+⋯+ωαk⋅nk,

其中 α₁>α₂>⋯>αₖ 是小于 α 的序数，称为 α 的指数；n₁、n₂、……、nₖ 为正整数。α=ε₀ 时不成立，因为 ωω2⋅7+ω⋅4+11+ω=ωω2⋅7+ω⋅4+12:。由于 α₁、α₂、……都小于 ε₀，它们也能写成这种形式，依此类推。又因为每个序数的指数都小于它本身，把指数写成 ω 的幂之和的过程最终必定终止，否则就会出现无限下降的序数序列，与良序性矛盾。最终得到的符号称为 α 的康托尔标准形。

where α1 > α2 > ⋯ > are ordinals less than α—call them the exponents of α—and n1, n2,…, nk are positive integers. (This does not hold for α = ε0,because ωω2⋅7+ω⋅4+11+ω=ωω2⋅7+ω⋅4+12:). Since α1,α2,…, are less than ε0, they too can be expressed in this form, and so on. And since the exponents of each ordinal are less than it, this process of writing exponents as sums of powers of ω eventually terminates—otherwise we would have an infinite descending sequence of ordinals, contrary to well-ordering. The symbol ultimately obtained is called the Cantor normal form of α.

2.7　古德斯坦定理

2.7 Goodstein’s Theorem

下面是一个较复杂的康托尔标准形序数：

A more elaborate example of an ordinal in Cantor normal form is

α=ωωω+ω+ωωω+ωω+ω+1.

普通正整数也有类似康托尔标准形的标准形，只需把 ω 替换为固定整数 b≥2。b=2 时，得到以 2 为底的康托尔标准形，其依据是每个正整数 n 都能唯一表示为若干个 2 的幂之和。例如，

Ordinary positive integers also have normal forms like the Cantor normal form, obtained by replacing ω by a fixed integer b ≥ 2. With b = 2 we get the base 2 Cantor normal form, which stems from the fact that each positive integer n can be uniquely expressed as a sum of powers of 2. For example,

87=64+16+4+2+1=26+24+22+21+1. 

这些 2 的幂可以唯一确定：先写出不超过给定数的最大 2 的幂，再写出

The powers of 2 are found, uniquely, by first writing down the largest power of 2 not greater than the given number, then the largest power of 2

不超过给定数减去刚才那个最大幂所得余数的最大 2 的幂，依此类推。这样得到一列指数，对 87 而言是 6、4、2、1；这些指数也能写成 2 的幂之和，依此类推。在本例中，最终得到

not greater than the given number minus the largest power of 2, and so on. This gives a series of exponents (for 87 they are 6, 4, 2, 1) which can also be written as sums of powers of 2, and so on. In this case we obtain, in the end,

87=222+21+222+22+21+1.

因此，87 是上面序数 α 的某种“以 2 为底的对应物”。

Thus 87 is a kind of “base 2 analogue” of the ordinal number α above.

整数也有以 b=3、4、5 等为底的类似“康托尔标准形”，因为每个正整数都能唯一表示为 b 的幂之和。一般结论的论证相同：减去最大的 b 的幂，然后重复。当 b>2 时，同一个最大幂可能最多被减去 b−1 次，但这只意味着“以 b 为底的康托尔标准形”中可以出现正整数系数，就像把 b 替换为 ω 后得到的序数康托尔标准形一样。例如，以 5 为底时，

There are similar “Cantor normal forms” for integers to base b = 3, 4, 5, and so on, because each positive integer is a unique sum of powers of b. We arrive at the general result by the same argument: subtract the largest power of b, and repeat. When b > 2 it may be possible to subtract the largest power of b up to b − 1 times, but this means only that there can be positive integer coefficients in the “base b Cantor normal form”— as in the Cantor normal form ordinals obtained by replacing b by ω. For example, in base 5,

87=52⋅3+51⋅2+2

它对应序数 ω²·3+ω·2+2。底为 b 时，每个系数至多为 b−1。

which corresponds to the ordinal ω2 · 3 + ω · 2 + 2. When the base is b, each coefficient is at most b − 1.

1944 年，英国数学家 R. L. 古德斯坦注意到，序数与以 b 为底的数之间的这种对应，导出了正整数的一个惊人性质：对任意正整数 m₁，下述过程都会终止于数 0。

In 1944, the English mathematician R. L. Goodstein noticed that this correspondence between ordinals and numbers to base b leads to a surprising property of positive integers. Namely, the following process terminates at the number 0 for any positive integer m1:

古德斯坦过程。给定正整数 m₁，把它写成以 2 为底的康托尔标准形。把其中每个 2 都替换为 3，所得数记为 n₁，再令 m₂=n₁−1。

Goodstein process. Given a positive integer m1,write m1 in base 2 Cantor normal form. Let n1 be the number that results from replacing each 2 in the base 2 Cantor normal form of m1 by 3, and let m2 = n1 − 1.

现在把 m₂ 写成以 3 为底的康托尔标准形，把每个 3 替换为 4，得到新数 n₂，再令 m₃=n₂−1。

Now write m2 in base 3 Cantor normal form, replace each 3 by a 4 to get a new number n2, and let m3 = n2 − 1.

再把 m₃ 写成以 4 为底的康托尔标准形，把每个 4 替换为 5，得到 n₃，再令 m₄=n₃−1。

Now write m3 in base 4 Cantor normal form, replace each 4 by a 5 to get n3, and let m4 = n3 − 1.

接着把 m₄ 写成以 5 为底的康托尔标准形，依此类推。

Now write m4 in base 5 Cantor normal form, and so on.

把底从 b 改为 b+1，往往会产生大得多的数，减去 1 似乎几乎无助于缩小它。但只有当康托尔标准形中确实出现 b 时，才能把 b 替换为 b+1。实际情况是，经过一段时间，通常是极其漫长的时间，所有 b 都会消失。后面会看到，这种消失源于序数康托尔标准形的行为，后者控制着以 b 为底的标准形的行为。归根结底，古德斯坦过程的有限性，来自任意下降序数序列都是有限的这一事实。

Changing the base from b to b + 1 tends to create a much larger number, and subtracting 1 would seem to be of almost no help in reducing its size. But replacement of b by b + 1 can only take place when the Cantor normal form actually contains occurrences of b. It so happens that after a time (usually a very long time) all occurrences of b disappear. As we will see, this disappearance is due to the behavior of the Cantor normal form for ordinals, which controls the behavior of the base b normal form. Ultimately, the finiteness of the Goodstein process is due to the fact that any descending sequence of ordinals is finite.

很难给出有启发性的古德斯坦过程数值例子，因为 m₁ 从 3 变为 4 时，过程会突然从平凡变得难以处理。不过还是试一试。至少可以用 m₁=3，说明稍后尝试描述 m₁=4 时所用的列表方式。m₁=3 时最值得注意的是，标准形表示的数值并不总下降，而相应序数却始终下降。表 2.1 中这个例子有一个令人失望的平凡之处：除了 m₁=2+1，所有标准形都只有一项。

It is hard to give helpful numerical examples of the Goodstein process, because there is a sudden leap from trivial to intractable as m1 changes from 3 to 4. But let us try. We can at least use the case m1 = 3 to illustrate the style of tabulation we will use in our attempt to describe the case m1 = 4. The main thing to notice for m1 = 3 is that, while the values of the normal form numbers do not always decrease, the corresponding ordinals always do. One of the disappointing trivial aspects of this example, shown in Table 2.1, is that the normal forms have only one term except for m1 = 2 + 1.

表 2.1　m₁=3 时的古德斯坦过程。

Table 2.1 The Goodstein process for m1 = 3.

现在在表 2.2 中考察 m₁=4=2² 的情形。

Now we try the case m1 = 4 = 22 in Table 2.2.

到 m₂ 的这一步已经有点棘手。先把 m₁ 中每个 2 改成 3，得到 n₁=3³，再减去 1，以 3 为底的标准形便是 m₂=3²·2+3·2+2。除了这种减 1 会使标准形形状发生剧变的步骤外，还有很长的区段只发生显而易见的变化，因此我们用点号表示大量跳步。即便如此，当序数降到 ω²·2 以下时，也只能粗略说明其变化。根据 Kirby 和 Paris（1982），过程在底为 3·2⁴⁰²⁶⁵³²¹¹−1 时到达 0。² 注意，我们依次到达

The step to m2 is already a little tricky. First, we change each 2 to a 3 in m1 to get n1 = 33, then subtract 1, which gives (in base 3 normal form) m2 = 32 · 2 + 3·2 + 2. Apart from such steps, where subtraction of 1 causes a drastic change in the shape of the normal form, there are long stretches where only obvious things happen, so we do a lot of skipping (indicated by dots). Even so, we can only roughly indicate what happens when the ordinals fall below the value ω2 · 2. (According to Kirby and Paris (1982), the process reaches 0 at base 3 · 2402653211 − 1.2) Notice that we reach

 ordinal ω2+ω⋅23 at base 47,  ordinal ω2+ω⋅22 at base 95=47⋅2+1,  ordinal ω2+ω⋅21 at base 191=95⋅2+1, 

依此类推，每次把底加倍再加 1。要降到 ω²，还得再把底增至两倍多，重复 20 次。之后，下降到某个形如 ω·m+n 的序数，再以类似方式减小正整数 m，直到达到 ω。下一步会降到某个有限但极其巨大的序数 k；此时康托尔标准形中不再出现底的符号，终于可以通过 k−1 次减 1，平稳地下降到 0。

and so on—doubling the base and adding 1 each time. To get down to ω2 we need to more than double the base another 20 times. After that, we drop to some ordinal of the form ω · m + n, and similarly reduce the positive integer m until we reach ω. The next step drops us to some finite (though enormous) ordinal k, at which point there is no symbol for the base in the Cantor normal form, so we can finally descend gracefully to 0, by k − 1 subtractions of 1.

古德斯坦过程终止的关键，不仅对 m₁=4，而且对任意 m₁ 都如此，在于它对应一个下降的序数序列，而良序性保证这种序列必定有限。但为什么每一步都会得到更小的序数？这取决于康托尔标准形的本性：

The key to the termination of the Goodstein process (not only for m1 = 4, but any value of m1) is its correlation with a descending sequence of ordinals, which is necessarily finite by well-ordering. But why does each step in the process lead to a smaller ordinal? This lies in the nature of the Cantor normal form

f(ω)=ωα1⋅n1+ωα2⋅n2+⋯+ωαk⋅nk,  where  α1>α2>⋯>αk.

把每个 ω 替换为 b，转到相应整数形式 f(b)，再减去 1，会发生什么？f(b) 中幂次最小的项 α=ωω2⋅7+ω⋅4+11+17·nₖ，会被一个通常由更小幂次组成的和替换；替换结果中若仍出现幂 ε0=ωε0，其系数也会更小。因此，相应序数中的项 f(b),bαk·nₖ 被一个更小的幂之和替换，于是得到更小的序数。

When we go to the corresponding integer form f(b) by replacing each ω by b, and subtract 1, what happens? The smallest-powered term in f(b), α=ωω2⋅7+ω⋅4+11+17 · nk, is replaced by a sum of generally smaller powers, and any power ε0=ωε0 in the replacement has a smaller coefficient. Consequently, the term f(b),bαk · nk in the corresponding ordinal is replaced by a smaller sum of powers—and thus we get a smaller ordinal.

古德斯坦过程对任意正整数 m₁ 都终止这一事实，称为古德斯坦定理。它是关于正整数及其基本运算，即加法、乘法和幂运算的定理。然而，这些运算的相互作用如此复杂，以至于普通算术的方法似乎无力证明它。看来必须诉诸小于 ε₀ 的序数算术。后面我们将说明，整数算术本身的复杂性由 ε₀“度量”，从而确认并澄清这种神秘的状况。

The fact that the Goodstein process terminates for any positive integer m1 is called Goodstein’s theorem. It is a theorem about positive integers and the basic operations on them: addition, multiplication, and exponentiation. Yet the interaction of these operations is so complex that the methods of ordinary arithmetic seem powerless to prove Goodstein’s theorem. Apparently, we have to resort to the arithmetic of ordinals less than ε0. This mysterious state of affairs will be confirmed and clarified later, when we show that the complexity of integer arithmetic itself is “measured” by ε0.

2.8　赫拉克勒斯与九头蛇

2.8 Hercules and the Hydra

希腊神话中，赫拉克勒斯完成了十二项“功业”，即英雄任务。第一项是杀死涅墨亚狮并带回狮皮，第二项是消灭勒耳那九头蛇。杀狮子相对容易，虽然它的皮刀枪不入，赫拉克勒斯还是把它扼死了。在雅典娜提示后，他用狮子自己的爪子割下狮皮。九头蛇更难对付，因为这头多首怪兽每被砍掉一个头，就会长出新头。赫拉克勒斯最后是在侄子伊俄拉俄斯的帮助下才完成任务：每砍掉一个头，伊俄拉俄斯就用火把烧灼伤口，阻止新头长出。

In Greek mythology, Hercules performed twelve “labors,” or heroic tasks. The first of these was to kill the Nemean lion and bring back its skin; the second was to destroy the Lernaean hydra. Killing the lion was relatively easy—even though it had impenetrable skin—and Hercules succeeded by strangulation. After receiving a hint from Athena, he removed the skin by cutting it with the lion’s own claws. The hydra proved more difficult, because it was a multi-headed beast with the ability to grow new heads in place of each head that was cut off. Hercules succeeded in this task only with the help of his nephew Iolaus, who used a fire brand to cauterize the wound each time a head was removed, thus preventing new heads from growing.

安东尼奥·波拉尤奥洛描绘赫拉克勒斯斩杀九头蛇的画作，见图 2.3，也许戏剧性多于准确性：他怎样砍下蛇头？伊俄拉俄斯又在哪里？不过必须承认，赫拉克勒斯穿着涅墨亚狮皮，确实是一副准备大开杀戒的装束。

The painting of Hercules slaying the hydra by Antonio Pollaiuolo (Figure 2.3) tells the story with perhaps more drama than accuracy—how does he cut off its head? where is Iolaus?—though we must admit that Hercules is dressed to kill in his Nemean lion-skin suit.

英国数学家劳里·柯比和杰夫·帕里斯于 1982 年提出了九头蛇故事的新变体。在他们的版本中，九头蛇形如一棵树，例如图 2.4。树有一个根顶点 R，以及有限多个通过称为边的线段与它相连的顶点。从根到任意其他顶点的边序列，或称分支，都是唯一的。每个末端顶点都是九头蛇的一个头。因此，图 2.4 是一条有五个头的九头蛇。在这个例子中，H 是一个头，经由顶点 V、U 的分支与 R 相连。

A new variation on the hydra story was proposed by the English mathematicians Laurie Kirby and Jeff Paris in 1982. In their version, the hydra is shaped like a tree, such as the one in Figure 2.4. The tree has root vertex R and finitely many vertices connected to it by lines called edges. The sequence of edges, or branch, connecting the root vertex to any other vertex is unique. Each end vertex is a head of the hydra. Thus Figure 2.4 is a hydra with five heads. In this example, H is a head, and H is connected to R by the branch through the vertices V and U.

砍掉头 H，就是删去 H 以及连接 H 与相邻顶点 V 的边。与原故事一样，九头蛇立刻长出新头，但遵循以下规则：

A head H is cut off by removing it, together with the edge connecting H to the neighboring vertex V. As in the original story, the hydra immediately grows new heads, but according to the following rules:

  1. 新头只从顶点 U 长出；沿着向根 R 下降的路径，U 位于 V 下方一条边处。
    New heads grow only from the vertex U one edge below V on the path from U down to R.
  2. 若 H 是第 n 个被砍掉的头，就从 U 长出 n 份副本，每份都是砍头后仍留在 U 上方的那一部分九头蛇。
    If H is the nth head removed, n new copies of the decapitated portion of the hydra that remains above U grow from U.

图 2.5 表示第一次砍头的效果，其中被砍掉的头 H，就是图 2.4 中标出的那个。

Figure 2.5 shows the effect of the first decapitation, in the case where the head H removed is the one shown in Figure 2.4.

这个例子说明，砍头之后的新生长很容易增加头的总数。尽管如此，无论赫拉克勒斯怎样砍头，最终都不会剩下任何头。

As this example shows, decapitation followed by new growth can easily increase the total number of heads. Nevertheless, no matter how Hercules proceeds to cut off heads, eventually no heads remain.

为证明这一点，我们为每棵树指定一个序数 α<ε₀，并证明每次砍头都会得到序数更小的树。成功的关键仍是康托尔标准形。

To prove this, we assign an ordinal α < ε0 to each tree, and show that each decapitation leads to a tree with smaller ordinal. The key to success is again the Cantor normal form.

树的序数按如下方式得到：先给每个头指定 0，再把序数

The ordinal of a tree is obtained by assigning 0 to each head, then assigning the ordinal

ωα1+ωα2+⋯+ωαk

指定给位于序数为 α₁、α₂、……、αₖ 的顶点下方的那个顶点。通过这一过程指定给 R 的序数，就是这棵树的序数。例如，图 2.6 显示了图 2.4 中那棵树的每个顶点所获的序数，而树本身被指定的序数为 bαk。

to the vertex below the vertices with ordinals α1,α2,…,αk. The ordinal assigned to R by this process is the ordinal of the tree. For example, Figure 2.6 shows the ordinals assigned to each vertex of the tree in Figure 2.4, with the tree itself assigned the ordinal bαk.

图 2.7 显示了砍掉头 H 后的序数，假定 H 是第一个被砍掉的头。

Figure 2.7 shows the ordinals after removal of the head H, assuming that H is the first head removed.

如果 H 是第二个被砍掉的头，那么顶点 U 会长出两棵新子树，而不是一棵，U 所获的序数就是 ω²·3。但即使 U 所获的序数是 ω²·k，也就是说，H 是第 k−1 个被砍掉的头，树的序数仍小于砍掉 H 之前。这是因为对任意有限序数 k，都有 ω²·k<ω³。

If H were the second head removed, two new subtrees would grow from the vertex U instead of one, and the ordinal assigned to U would be ω2 · 3. But even if the ordinal assigned to U were ω2 · k (that is, if H were the (k − 1)st head removed), the ordinal of the tree would be less than it was before removal of H.This is because ω2 · k < ω3 for any finite ordinal k.

读者大概能看出，类似论证使我们能够断定：每砍掉一个头，树的序数总会减小，这里不再详述。关键仍然是，任意下降序数序列都是有限的。因此，有限次砍头之后，就不再剩下任何头。赫拉克勒斯总能消灭九头蛇，无须烧灼伤口！

The reader can probably see that a similar argument allows us to conclude that the ordinal of the tree is always decreased when a head is removed, but we will not go into more detail. The point is, as usual, that any decreasing sequence of ordinals is finite. Therefore, after finitely many decapitations, no heads remain. Hercules can always destroy the hydra, with no cauterization necessary!

2.9　历史背景

2.9 Historical Background

“奇怪的”集合与函数

“Strange”Sets and Functions

……从逻辑的观点看，恰恰是这些奇怪的函数才是最一般的；那些不经寻找便遇到的函数，如今不过是特殊情形，留给它们的角落已经很小了。

… from the point of view of logic, it is these strange functions that are most general; those that are met without being looked for no longer appear as more than a special case, and they have quite a little corner left them.

——昂利·庞加莱

—Henri Poincaré

《科学与方法》第 II 章，第 5 节。

Science and Method, Chapter II, Section 5.

直到 19 世纪，大多数数学家对无限集和无限过程都感到不安，这一点在当时最有影响力的数学家卡尔·弗里德里希·高斯于 1831 年 7 月 12 日致天文学家海因里希·舒马赫的一封信中，表达得很清楚：

Cantor introduced ordinal numbers in 1872 in a study of Fourier series, the representation of functions as infinite sums of waves. This idea originated in the mid-18th century, when it was realized that the motion of a vibrating string is a sum of so-called “simple modes,” each in the shape of the sine or cosine wave. Since the string can be set vibrating from a virtually arbitrary shape, it seems to follow that a virtually arbitrary function can be expressed as an infinite sum of sine or cosine functions. In 1808, Joseph Fourier developed an extensive theory of such sums— hence the name “Fourier series”—and gave specific examples, even for discontinuous functions.

至于你的证明，我必须首先提出抗议：你把一个无限量当作某种已经完成的东西来使用；这在数学中从来不被允许。无限只是一种说话方式。

One of Fourier’s examples is the “square wave” shown in Figure 2.8, which takes the constant value π/4 over the interval —π/2 < x < π/2, and alternates this value with — π/4 over successive intervals of length π.

在这种观念氛围下，康托尔的工作起初不受欢迎，并不奇怪。令人惊讶的倒是他竟然能完成这项工作。康托尔是在 19 世纪 70 年代研究无穷级数时，对无限产生兴趣的。具体说，他想知道，哪些函数可以表示为如下形式的三角级数，即傅里叶级数：

Fourier showed that this function is the sum of the infinite series3

f(x)=cosx−13cos3x+15cos5x−17cos7x+⋯,

傅里叶级数以 19 世纪初的法国数学家约瑟夫·傅里叶命名。傅里叶用它们解决热传导问题，但没有给出严格的理论。事实上，严格的傅里叶级数理论，必须等到人们对实数有严格理解之后才可能建立；而这一理解在很大程度上正是由康托尔提供的。

and hence it is the limit (as n → ∞) of the continuous functions

fn(x)=cosx−13cos3x+15cos5x−⋯+(−1)n12n+1cos(2n+1)x.

当 n→∞ 时，这个函数趋于

Figure 2.9 shows how well fn approximates the square wave when n = 20.

其中 y=f(x) 的图像有无限多个不连续点，如图 2.8。图 2.9 显示了把前 n 个正弦项相加时，如何逐渐得到方波。

Fourier’s example shows that a function with points of discontinuity may nevertheless have a Fourier series. Cantor wanted to know “how badly” discontinuous a function could be, and still have a Fourier series. First, he needed to know how bad a set of potential points of discontinuity could be.

比傅里叶的例子“更糟”的情形，是不连续点本身有极限点。例如，不连续点位于 x=1/2、3/4、7/8、15/16、……时就会如此，这些点的极限是 x=1。更糟的是，还可能出现“极限点的极限点”，因为我们可以在序列 1/2、3/4、7/8、15/16、……的每一项之前插入一个无限序列。例如，插入

A case “worse” than Fourier’s example is where the points of discontinuity have a limit point. This happens, for example, when there are points of discontinuity at x = 1/2, 3/4, 7/8, 15/16,…, a set of points with limit x = 1. Worse still, there can be a “limit point of limit points,” because we can insert an infinite sequence in front of each term in the sequence 1/2, 3/4, 7/8, 15/16,…. For example, insert

π4=1−13+15−17+⋯.

显然，这种插入过程，即使集合中的任意一点成为新集合的极限点，可以重复一次、两次、……、任意有限多次。因此，若反过来进行，删去所有不是极限点的点，那么在集合变空之前，这个删除过程可能发生任意有限多次。再把插入过程重复一次、两次、……所得的结果串接起来，就能构造一个只有无限次重复删除过程后才会变空的集合。

Clearly, this insertion process—making any point of a set a limit point of a new set—may be repeated once, twice, …, any finite number of times. So, if we take the reverse process of removing all points that are not limit points, the removal process may occur any finite number of times before the set is emptied. Then, by stringing together the results of one, two, …repetitions of the insertion process, we can create a set that is emptied only by infinitely many repetitions of the removal process.

而这仍不是最糟的情形。无限次重复删除过程之后，还可能剩下 1/2、3/4、7/8、15/16；此时还需再删除一次非极限点，集合才会变空。康托尔就是这样认识到，必须能够“越过无限继续计数”。这就是他发明超限序数的背景。

And this is still not the worst that can happen. After infinitely many repetitions of the removal process we may be left with 1/2, 3/4, 7/8, 15/16, in which case we need one more removal of non-limit points to empty the set. This is how Cantor came to realize that it is necessary to be able to “count past infinity.” It was the setting for his invention of transfinite ordinal numbers.

沿着这一思路，康托尔瞥见了集合与函数的广阔新世界；此时，傅里叶级数问题似乎不那么重要了。既然绝大多数函数都不连续，如何以自然方式分类函数，反而成为一个有趣的问题。这个问题同样通向超限序数。

Once Cantor glimpsed the vast new world of sets and functions brought to light by this train of thought, the question of Fourier series seemed less important. Instead, given that the overwhelming majority of functions are not continuous, it became an interesting question to classify functions in a natural way. This question, too, leads to transfinite ordinals.

1900 年前后，在法国数学家勒内-路易·贝尔、埃米尔·博雷尔和昂利·勒贝格的引领下，从分析学通往超限序数的道路变得人来人往。他们都在 19 世纪 90 年代成长为数学家。与本节开头引用的年长同胞昂利·庞加莱不同，他们欢迎极限过程产生的“奇怪”函数。

The road from analysis to transfinite ordinals became well-traveled around 1900, following the lead of the French mathematicians René-Louis Baire, Émile Borel, and Henri Lebesgue, all of whom came of age in the 1890s. Unlike their older compatriot Henri Poincaré, quoted at the beginning of this section, they welcomed the “strange” functions generated by the limit process.

他们认为，既然分析学建立在极限与连续函数之上，就应该研究从连续函数出发、通过取极限所能得到的一切函数。贝尔于 1898 年提出这种理解函数概念的方式。从他的观点看，许多此前被视为“奇怪”的函数，都显得相当简单自然。例如所谓狄利克雷函数，贝尔本人就考虑过它：

They felt, since analysis is based on limits and continuous functions, that analysis should study all functions obtainable from continuous functions by taking limits. Baire suggested this approach to the function concept in 1898. From his point of view, many functions previously considered “strange” look quite simple and natural. Take, for example, the so-called Dirichlet function (as Baire himself did),

1/4,3/8,7/16,… in front of 1/2, 5/8,11/16,23/32,… in front of 3/4, 13/16,27/32,55/64,… in front of 7/8,     and so on. 

狄利克雷函数在每一点 x 都不连续。然而，d 是一列仅有“轻微”不连续性的函数的极限。若把有理数枚举为 r₁、r₂、r₃，那么 d(x) 就是下列函数在 n→∞ 时的极限：

The Dirichlet function is discontinuous at every point x. However, d is the limit of functions that are only “slightly” discontinuous. If we enumerate the rational numbers as r1, r2, r3,then d(x) is the limit as n → ∞ of the functions

d(x)={ 1 if x is rational 0 otherwise. 

其中每个函数都只在有限多个点 r₁、r₂、……、rₙ 处不连续。而每个 dₙ 又都是一列连续函数的极限。图 2.10 说明了 n=2 时的情形。

each of which is discontinuous only at the finitely many points r1, r2, …,rn.And each dn, in turn, is the limit of a sequence of continuous functions. Figure 2.10 shows why, in the case n = 2.

函数 d₂(x) 在 x=r₁、r₂ 时取值 1，其余各处取值 0；它是 m→∞ 时具有以下性质的“双尖峰”函数 d₂ₘ(x) 的极限：

The function d2(x), which has value 1 for x = r1, r2 and 0 otherwise, is the limit as m → ∞ of “double-spike” functions d2m(x),with the properties

  • d₂ₘ(x) 在 x=r₁、r₂ 时等于 1。
    d2m(x) = 1 for x = r1, r2.
  • d2m(x) = 0 outside the intervals

    dn(x)={ 1 if x=r1,r2,…,rn0 otherwise, 

  • 当 x 从 ωαk 增加到 r₁，以及从 ωω3+ω2. 增加到 r₂ 时，d₂ₘ(x) 从 0 连续增加到 1；当 x 从 r₁ 增加到 r1−1m，以及从 r₂ 增加到 r2−1m 时，d₂ₘ(x) 从 1 连续减小到 0。
    d2m(x) increases continuously from 0 to 1 as x increases from ωαk to r1 and from ωω3+ω2. to r2, and d2m(x) decreases continuously from 1 to 0 as x increases from r1 to r1−1m and from r2 to r2−1m.

当 m→∞ 时，“尖峰”的宽度缩小到零，只留下 x=r₁、r₂ 处 d₂(x)=1，其余各处的值均为 0。类似地，dₙ 是连续的“n 重尖峰”函数的极限。

The “spikes” shrink to zero width as m → ∞,leaving the values d2(x) = 1 for x = r1, r2, and value 0 everywhere else. Similarly, dn is the limit of continuous “n-tuple-spike” functions.

因此，在一个可能具有无限多个层级的函数层级结构中，狄利克雷函数距离连续函数只有两层。事实上，勒贝格于 1905 年证明，贝尔函数层级对每个可数序数 α 都有一个 α 层。第零层由连续函数组成，α+1 层由 α 层函数的极限组成。一个对角线论证表明，α+1 层包含不在 α 层中的函数。若 λ 为极限序数，则 λ 层的函数是所有低于 λ 层的函数。

Thus the Dirichlet function is only two levels away from the continuous functions, in a hierarchy of functions that probably has infinitely many levels. In fact, Lebesgue showed in 1905 that the Baire hierarchy of functions has a level α for each countable ordinal α.Level zero consists of the continuous functions, and level α + 1 consists of the limits of functions at level α. A diagonal argument shows that level α + 1 includes functions not at level α. If λ is a limit ordinal, then the functions at level λ are all those at levels less than λ.

与此同时，从 1898 年的《函数论讲义》开始，博雷尔一直在研究如何度量实数集的问题。最简单的实数集是开区间

Meanwhile, starting in his Leçons sur la théorie des fonctions of 1898, Borel had been studying the problem of measuring sets of real numbers. The simplest sets of real numbers are the open intervals

[ r1−1m,r1+1m ] and [ r2−1m,r2+1m ]. 

这些区间，以及相应的闭区间 [a,b]={x:a≤x≤b}，其测度为 b−a，也称为长度。端点相同的开区间和闭区间长度相同，因为一个点的长度为零。现在可以用下面的规则，为许多其他实数集定义长度：

These, and the corresponding closed intervals [a, b] = {x : a ≤ x ≤ b}, have measure b − a (also called their length). Open and closed intervals with the same endpoints have the same length because a point has length zero. Length can now be defined for many other sets of reals by the following rules:

  • 可数可加性：若 S₁、S₂、S₃、……是两两不交的集合，长度分别为 l₁、l₂、l₃、……，则 S₁∪S₂∪S₃∪⋯ 的长度为 l₁+l₂+l₃+⋯。
    Countable additivity: If S1, S2, S3,… are disjoint sets of length l1, l2, l3,… respectively, then the length of S1 ⋃ S2 ⋃ S3 ⋃ ⋯ is l1 + l2 + l3 + ⋯.
  • Difference: If sets S1 and S2 have lengths l1 and l2 respectively, and S2 is a subset of S1, then the length of the set difference

    S1−S2={ x:x is in S1 but not in S2 }

    为 l₁−l₂，前提是 l₁ 不等于 ∞。

    is l1 − l2 (provided l1 is not ∞).

可数可加性蕴含，任意可数点集的长度为 0+0+0+⋯=0；这与第 1.5 节中用来说明实数不止可数多个的论证一致。

Countable additivity implies that the length of any countable set of points is 0 + 0 + 0 + ⋯ = 0, which agrees with the argument we used in Section 1.5 to show that there are more than countably many reals.

这两条规则确定了一个极大的集合族的测度，这些集合如今称为实数的博雷尔集。事实上，博雷尔集就是从开区间通过可数并与集合差所能得到的所有集合。可数并不必互不相交，因为博雷尔集的任意可数并，都等于一些仍为博雷尔集的集合的不交可数并。同样，差集总可以相对于全体实数集 ℝ 来取，因为 ℝ 是开区间的可数并。

The two rules determine measure for a very large collection of sets, now known as the Borel sets (of reals). The Borel sets in fact are all sets obtainable from open intervals by countable unions and set difference. The countable unions need not be disjoint, because any countable union of Borel sets equals a disjoint countable union of sets that are also Borel. Likewise, difference can always be taken relative to the set R of all real numbers, because R is a countable union of open intervals.

正如贝尔函数的低层级中会出现某些“奇怪的函数”，博雷尔集的低层级中也会出现某些“奇怪的集合”。例如，有理数集是点的可数并，而一个点可以写成 ℝ 减去开区间的某个可数并。在勒贝格 1905 年证明贝尔函数形成层级的论文中，他也证明了博雷尔集形成类似层级，每个可数序数层级上都有成员。勒贝格还证明，博雷尔集恰好就是那些特征函数

Just as some “strange functions” turn up at low levels among the Baire functions, some “strange sets” turn up at low levels in the Borel sets. The set of rational numbers, for example, is a countable union of points, and a point is ℝ minus a countable union of open intervals. In Lebesgue’s 1905 paper in which the Baire functions are shown to form a hierarchy, the Borel sets are shown to form a similar hierarchy with members at all countable ordinal levels. Lebesgue also showed that the Borel sets are precisely the sets S of reals for which the characteristic function of S,

charS(x)={ 1 if x is in S,0 if x is not in S,

为贝尔函数的实数集 S。我们已经见过博雷尔集与贝尔函数之间这种对应的例子：狄利克雷函数就是有理数集的特征函数。

is a Baire function. We have already seen an example of this correspondence between Borel sets and Baire functions: the Dirichlet function is the characteristic function of the set of rational numbers.

选择公理

The Axiom of Choice

我将在以后的一篇文章中讨论这样一条思维法则：任何定义明确的集合，总能被整理为良序集的形式。在我看来，这条法则是根本性的、意义重大的，而且其普遍有效性十分惊人。

In a later article I shall discuss the law of thought that says that it is always possible to bring any well-defined set into the form of a well-ordered set—a law which seems to me fundamental and momentous and quite astonishing by reason of its general validity.

——格奥尔格·康托尔（1883），见 Ewald（1996），第 881 页。

— Georg Cantor (1883),

康托尔从未发表过承诺中的良序定理证明，也许因为他意识到自己有一个重要但无法证实的假设，即选择公理。无论如何，19 世纪 90 年代，人们已清楚认识到需要作出选择；在证明一个特别简单的良序性结论时，选择公理也浮现出来。这个结论是：任意无限集 S 都有一个可数子集。

in Ewald (1996), volume II, p. 886.

康托尔于 1892 年证明了这一点，未明确提及选择公理。他的想法是先从 S 选出一个元素 a₁，再从 S−{a₁} 选出一个 a₂，再从 S−{a₁,a₂} 选出一个 a₃，依此类推。结果是 S 的可数子集 {a₁,a₂,a₃,……}，但它依赖于作出无限多次选择的能力。

The axiom of choice concerns the ability to make infinitely many choices, which was often assumed to be possible in the early days of set theory. For example, Cantor in 1895 offered the following argument in support of the claim that every infinite set has a countable subset.

看起来，任何涉及无限的论证都不能幸免于 AC。甚至序列的极限也不例外，尽管它在 19 世纪已被澄清。1872 年，德国数学家爱德华·海涅指出，函数 f(x) 的连续性，可以通过收敛到 x 的序列 x₁、x₂、x₃、……来定义：f 在 x 处连续，当且仅当对任意这样的序列，函数值序列 f(x₁)、f(x₂)、f(x₃)、……都收敛到 f(x)。然而，要证明这个定义与通常的连续性定义等价，竟然需要 AC。

Suppose that X is an infinite set. Choose a member x1 of X.Then X − {x1} is also infinite, so we can choose one of its members, x2. Likewise, X − {x1, x2} is infinite, so we can choose one of its members, x3,.. .and so on. Thus X has a countable subset {x1, x2, x3,…}.

证明中需要 AC 的地方如下。假设 f(x) 按通常定义在 x=a 处不连续。这意味着存在 ε>0，使得任意接近 a 的某些 x，都有 f(x) 与 f(a) 相差至少 ε。也就是说，对每个正整数 n，都有某个 xₙ 满足 |xₙ−a|<1/n，且 |f(xₙ)−f(a)|≥ε。因此，xₙ 收敛到 a，但 f(xₙ) 不收敛到 f(a)，这就证明 f 按序列定义也不连续。但请注意：要得到这样一个序列，必须为每个 n 选取一个 xₙ。

Few people doubt that “and so on” makes sense here, even though no rule for choosing has been given. However, the idea of making infinitely many choices is harder to accept when uncountably many choices are required—as when Hardy assumed the possibility of choosing an increasing sequence β1 < β2 < β3 < with limit α for each countable limit ordinal α (Section 2.3). And it becomes a real article of faith that there is afunction F that chooses a real number F(X) from each nonempty set X of real numbers.4

这样的例子使恩斯特·策梅洛于 1904 年认识到，需要一条选择公理。集合论学家和逻辑学家尝试过各种等价表述，最后确定为第 2.3 节给出的表述：对任意由集合 S 组成的集合 X，存在一个函数 F，使每个非空 S 的 F(S) 都属于 S。策梅洛（1904）证明选择公理蕴含每个集合都可以良序化，引起轰动。康托尔于 1883 年就提出任意集合都存在良序，但只把它视为一条希望日后再讨论的“思维法则”。他并未做到。策梅洛的证明却把良序化归结为一条更“显然”，或至少更简单的公理，彻底改变了集合论的面貌。

Examples like these brought Ernst Zermelo to the realization, in 1904, that an axiom of choice was needed. Set theorists and logicians experimented with various equivalent statements of the axiom, before settling on the statement given in Section 2.3: for any set X of sets S, there is a function F such that F(S) belongs to S for each nonempty S. Zermelo (1904) created a sensation by showing that the axiom of choice implies that every set can be well ordered. The existence of a well-ordering for any set had been proposed by Cantor in 1883, but only as a “law of thought” that he hoped to return to later. This did not happen. Instead, Zermelo’s proof completely changed the complexion of set theory by reducing well-ordering to a more “obvious,” or at least more simple, axiom.

借助第 1.8 节描述的策梅洛–弗兰克尔公理，良序定理本身的证明几乎可以变得显然。事实上，策梅洛提出公理，不仅为了避免悖论，也为了澄清良序定理的证明。假设要把集合 X 良序化。这相当于依次把序数 0、1、2、……分配给 X 的元素，直到耗尽 X。事实上，这基本上就是证明！再说一遍：把序数分配给 X 的元素，直到耗尽 X。稍详细地说，我们用归纳定义的函数 f，把序数 0、1、2、……、α、……“分配”给 X 的元素：

With the help of the Zermelo-Fraenkel axioms described in Section 1.8, the proof of the well-ordering theorem itself can be made almost obvious. (Indeed, Zermelo’s axioms were intended not only to avoid paradoxes, but also to clarify the proof of well-ordering.) Suppose we want to wellorder a set X. This amounts to assigning ordinals 0,1,2,… to members of X, until X is exhausted. In fact, that is basically the proof! I repeat: assign ordinals to members of X until X is exhausted. In a little more detail, we “assign” ordinals 0,1,2,…, α,… to members of X by a function f defined inductively by

f(0)=choose(X)f(β)= choose (X−{ values f(α) for α<β})

其中 choose(S) 是 X 的子集 S 的一个选择函数。这样 X 就会被“耗尽”，因为若 β 是所有使 f(α) 有定义的序数 α 的最小上界，那么 X−{f(α) 的值：α<β} 必定为空。

where choose(S) is a choice function for the subsets S of X.Then X is “exhausted” because, if β is the least upper bound of the ordinals α for which f (α) is defined, then X − {values f (α) for α < β} is necessarily empty.

因此，选择公理确实给数学带来了秩序：它保证集合可以良序化，也保证序列连续的函数是连续的。然而，在某些特殊地方，选择公理反而带来了无序。测度论就是一例。

Today, most mathematicians have embraced the axiom of choice because of the order and simplicity it brings to mathematics in general. For example, the theorems that every vector space has a basis and every field has an algebraic closure hold only by virtue of the axiom of choice. Likewise, for the theorem that every sequentially continuous function is continuous. However, there are special places where the axiom of choice actually brings disorder. One is the theory of measure.

如上一小节所述，博雷尔（1898）把长度概念从直线上的区间推广到庞大的博雷尔集族。1902 年，勒贝格把这个概念推广到了尽可能广的范围，即所谓勒贝格可测集。从某种意义上说，这一推广很小，因为每个勒贝格可测集都只与某个博雷尔集相差一个零测集。另一方面，博雷尔集的数量只与实数一样多，而勒贝格可测集的数量却与实数的子集一样多。取决于愿意在 ZF 之外接受哪些假设，勒贝格测度事实上可能推广到所有实数集。但若选择公理成立，就存在非勒贝格可测的实数集。

As mentioned in the previous subsection, Borel (1898) extended the concept of length from intervals of the line to the vast collection of Borel sets. In 1902, Lebesgue extended the concept as far as it can go, to what are called the Lebesgue measurable sets. In one sense, the extension is small, because every Lebesgue measurable set differs from a Borel set by a set of measure zero. On the other hand, the Borel sets are only as numerous as the real numbers, whereas the Lebesgue measurable sets are as numerous as the sets of real numbers. Depending on what one is willing to assume beyond ZF, Lebesgue measure may in fact extend to all sets of real numbers. But if the axiom of choice holds there are sets of reals that are not Lebesgue measurable.

意大利数学家朱塞佩·维塔利于 1905 年发现了这一点，令博雷尔、贝尔、勒贝格以及过去一些其他杰出分析学家开始怀疑选择公理。关于选择公理引发的分析学危机，详见 Moore（1982）。

This was discovered by the Italian mathematician Giuseppe Vitali in 1905, and it led to doubts about the axiom of choice on the part of Borel, Baire, Lebesgue, and some other distinguished analysts of the past. (For more on the crisis in analysis precipitated by the axiom of choice, see Moore (1982).)

维塔利不可测集

Vitali’s nonmeasurable set

最好把这个集合看作圆周的一个子集 X，它具有以下两个性质：

This set is best viewed as a subset X of the circle with the following two properties:

  • 把 X 旋转角度 2πr，其中 r 为有理数，所得集合 Xᵣ 与 X 不相交，或者等于 X。
    When X is rotated by an angle 2πr,where r is rational, the resulting set Xr is disjoint from X or equal to X.
  • 这些无限多个集合 Xᵣ 填满整个圆周。
    The (infinitely many) sets Xr fill the circle.

由这些性质可知，X 不可能有测度 m>0。否则，每个旋转后的集合 Xᵣ 都有相同测度 m，由可数可加性，圆周的测度将是 m+m+m+⋯=∞。但 X 同样不可能有零测度，否则圆周的测度就是 0+0+0+⋯=0。因此，具有这两个性质的集合不可测。借助选择公理可以找到这样的集合。最简单的方法，是把圆周看作 0 到 2π 的角度集，并把它分成形如下式的集合：

It follows from these properties that X cannot have measure m > 0.
