If it did, each rotated set Xr would then have the same measure m,and the measure of the circle would be m + m + m + ⋯ = ∞ by countable additivity. But X likewise cannot have measure zero, otherwise the measure of the circle would be 0 + 0 + 0 + ⋯= 0. Thus a set with these two properties is not measurable. We find such a set with the help of the axiom of choice. The simplest way is to view the circle as the set of angles from 0 to 2π and to partition it into sets of the form

Sθ={ angles θ+2πr, where r is rational }.

然后从每个不同的 Sθ 中选取一个元素，就得到合适的 X。注意，不能简单地从 Sθ 中选 θ！无限多个不同的 θ 值会给出同一个 Sθ，而其中只能选一个值放入 X。

Then a suitable X is obtained by choosing one member from each distinct Sθ. (Beware of simply choosing θ from Sθ !The sets Sθ are the same for infinitely many values of θ, and just one of these values must be chosen to go in X.)

维塔利的结果，是一系列利用选择公理得到的、越来越违反测度直觉的结果中的第一个；这一系列最终达到巴拿赫和塔尔斯基（1924）所谓的“悖论”。后者把单位球分解成有限多个集合，移动这些集合的位置后，就能填满两个实心球。分解所得的集合，只有凭借选择公理才存在。即使采用有限可加测度，也无法“度量”它们，否则就会推出 1=2。Wagon（1993）对巴拿赫–塔尔斯基悖论有精彩的现代介绍。

Vitali’s result was the first in a series of increasingly counterintuitive results on measure obtained by use of the axiom of choice, culminating in the so-called “paradox” of Banach and Tarski (1924). The latter result is a decomposition of the unit ball into finitely many sets which, when moved to different positions, fill two solid balls. The sets into which the ball is decomposed exist only by virtue of the axiom of choice. They cannot be “measured” even by a finitely additive measure, as this would imply 1 = 2. There is an excellent modern account of the Banach-Tarski paradox in Wagon (1993).

因此，使用选择公理也有代价。如果愿意放弃它，那么事实上可以相容地假设所有实数集都是勒贝格可测的，前提是假设 ZF 加上一个“不可达基数”相容，参见第 7 章。美国数学家罗伯特·索洛维于 20 世纪 60 年代证明了这个惊人结果。它属于集合论新一波浪潮的一部分，揭示了实数究竟有多么深奥神秘。

Thus, there is a downside to using the axiom of choice. If one is willing to abandon the axiom, then in fact it is consistent to assume that all sets of real numbers are Lebesgue measurable (assuming the consistency of ZF plus an “inaccessible cardinal”—see Chapter 7). This astonishing result was proved by the American mathematician Robert Solovay in the 1960s. It was part of a new wave of set theory that revealed just how deeply mysterious the real numbers are.

连续统假设

The Continuum Hypothesis

由这个定理将立刻推出，连续统的基数是可数集基数之后的下一个基数；因此，这个定理的证明将在可数集与连续统之间架起一座新的桥梁。

From this theorem it would follow at once that the continuum has the next cardinal number beyond that of the countable set; the proof of this theorem would, therefore, form a new bridge between the countable set and the continuum.

——大卫·希尔伯特，1900 年《数学问题》演讲，见 Ewald（1996），第 II 卷，第 1103 页。

—David Hilbert, Address on Mathematical Problems, 1900, in Ewald (1996), volume II, p. 1103.

康托尔发现实数集 ℝ 不可数后，很快就想到：ℝ 是否是“下一个更大”的无限集？换句话说，每个实数集是否要么可数，要么与 ℝ 具有相同基数？这是他于 1878 年提出的连续统假设第一个版本：每个不可数实数集都具有相同基数。1883 年，康托尔发现最小的不可数集，即可数序数集，随后提出第二个版本：ℝ 与可数序数集具有相同基数。用符号表示为：r1 to r1+1m。

After Cantor discovered that the set R of real numbers is uncountable, it soon occurred to him to ask: is R the “next largest” infinite set? In other words, is every set of real numbers either countable or of the same cardinality as R? This conjecture was his first version of the continuum hypothesis, proposed in 1878: every uncountable set of reals has the same cardinality. Then, in 1883, Cantor discovered the smallest uncountable set, the set of countable ordinals, and proposed the second version: ℝ has the same cardinality as the set of countable ordinals. In symbols: r1 to r1+1m.

连续统假设的后一个版本，即 CH，要强得多，因为它蕴含 ℝ 可以良序化。正如所见，康托尔于 1883 年相信任意集合都可以良序化，但尚未意识到需要选择公理。

The latter version of the continuum hypothesis (CH) is much stronger, because it implies that ℝ can be well-ordered. As we have seen, Cantor in 1883 believed that any set can be well-ordered, but he was not yet aware of the need for the axiom of choice.

直到 1891 年发现一般的对角线论证，康托尔才意识到存在比 ℝ 更大的集合。因此，他把 CH 视为集合论的终极问题，是可以理解的。即使发现了更高的无限，CH 仍居首位。1900 年，德国数学家大卫·希尔伯特为 20 世纪数学家提出 23 个问题时，CH 排在第一。策梅洛于 1904 年证明良序定理，在一定程度上缓解了人们对 ℝ 能否良序化的担忧，但似乎无助于解决连续统问题。贝尔、博雷尔和勒贝格发起的对实数集的细致研究与分类，也没有解决它。最后，希尔伯特本人在 1926 年题为《论无限》的论文中提出了一个想法。

Until he discovered the general diagonal argument, in 1891, Cantor did not realize that there were sets larger than R. So he understandably viewed CH as the ultimate question in set theory. It remained on top even after Cantor’s discovery of higher infinities. In 1900, when the German mathematician David Hilbert proposed 23 problems for the mathematicians of the 20th century, CH was number one on his list. Zermelo’s proof of the well-ordering theorem, in 1904, eased the concern about well-ordering R to some extent, but it did not seem to help settle the continuum problem. Nor did the detailed investigation and classification of sets of real numbers initiated by Baire, Borel, and Lebesgue. Finally, Hilbert himself put forward an idea in a 1926 paper entitled Über das Unendliche (“On the Infinite”).

希尔伯特（1926）的想法，是把可数序数与正整数函数联系起来。正如第 1.7 节所见，这些函数与实数一一对应。但他并未把序数与函数本身对应，而是与某种语言中描述函数的公式对应。那种语言本身没有解释清楚；函数通过序数定义，而序数又通过函数定义，似乎陷入循环。因此，希尔伯特的“证明”不能令人信服。不过，其中包含一个好得多的思想的萌芽，库尔特·哥德尔于 1938 年成功运用了它，详见 Gödel（1939）或 Cohen（1966），第 87–99 页。

The idea of Hilbert (1926) was to correlate countable ordinals with positive integer functions (which, as we saw in Section 1.7, are in one-to-one correspondence with the real numbers). However, he did not correlate ordinals with functions but rather with formulas describing functions in a certain language. The language itself is not clearly explained; functions are defined in terms of ordinals which are defined in terms of functions, in seemingly circular fashion. So Hilbert’s “proof” is unconvincing. Nevertheless, it contains the germ of a much better idea, used successfully by Kurt Gödel in 1938 (see Gödel (1939) or Cohen (1966), p. 87–99, for details).

哥德尔的思想，是构造一个集合论模型，由包含所有序数、并满足第 1.8 节列出的策梅洛–弗兰克尔集合公理的最小集合总体 L 组成。因此，L 包含空集；只要 X、Y 属于 L，无序对 {X,Y} 也属于 L；依此类推。不过，稍微呼应希尔伯特的思想，若集合 X 属于 L，那么 L 中 X 的子集，只限于那些能用某种语言定义的子集。哥德尔与希尔伯特的关键区别，是他不试图给序数命名，从而避免循环。他把序数视为给定，在以序数编号的各阶段，从空集开始，用先前已定义的集合定义新集合。L 称为可构造集的类。

Gödel’s idea is to build a model of set theory consisting of the smallest collection L of sets that includes all the ordinals and satisfies the Zermelo-Fraenkel axioms for sets enumerated in Section 1.8. Thus, L includes the empty set; along with any two members X and Y, L includes the unordered pair {X, Y}; and so on. However, in a faint echo of Hilbert, the only subsets in L of a set X in L are those definable in a certain language. The key difference between Hilbert and Gödel is that Gödel avoids circularity by not attempting to name the ordinals. Instead, he takes the ordinals as given and defines sets in terms of previously-defined sets (starting with the empty set) in ordinal-numbered stages. L is called the class of constructible sets.

L 是对所有序数 α 的集合 Lα 取并所得：L₀ 为空集；Lα₊₁ 由 Lα 的所有可定义子集组成，定义使用 ZF 语言，并允许用名称指称 Lα 的元素；对极限序数 β，Lβ 是所有 α<β 的 Lα 的并。这一构造得到如下结果。

L is the union of sets L0, for all ordinals α: L0 is empty, L0+1 consists of all subsets of L0 definable in the language of ZF with names for members of Lα, and (for limit β) Lβ is the union of all Lα for α < β.The result of this construction is the following.

  • L satisfies all the Zermelo-Fraenkel axioms (ZF). Also, L is well-ordered, via a well-ordering of definitions.

    这一点是可信的，因为 ZF 语言中的公式只有可数多个，参见第 2.2 节关于列举字母串的说明，因此 ZF 公式可以良序化。诚然，可以把序数以及 Lβ 中的其他集合代入 ZF 公式，以定义 Lα 中的集合，但 Lα 的归纳构造保证所得定义也能良序化。因此，L 中每个集合都由公式的良序得到良序。更微妙的是，这个良序本身也是 L 中的集合。正因为如此，L 满足良序定理，从而满足选择公理。

    This is plausible because there are only countably many formulas in the language of ZF (by the remark on listing strings of letters in Section 2.2), hence ZF formulas can be well-ordered. Admittedly, the ZF formulas can get ordinals (and other sets in Lβ) plugged into them to make definitions of sets in L0, but the inductive construction of L0 ensures that the resulting definitions can also be wellordered. Thus each set in L is well-ordered by the well-ordering of formulas. More subtly, the well-ordering is itself a set in L.Because of this, L satisfies the well-ordering theorem and hence the axiom of choice.

  • L 也满足 CH。这一点不那么明显。它依赖数理逻辑的方法，这些方法表明，L 中任意整数集都出现在某个 Lα 中，其中 α 可数。由于 ZF 公式可数，每个这样的 Lα 中只有 ℵ₀ 个集合，因此总共只有 ℵ₁ 个集合。
    L also satisfies CH. This is less obvious. It depends on techniques of mathematical logic which show that any set of integers in L occurs in some Lα, where α is countable. There are only ⁝0 sets in each such Lα, because of the countability of ZF formulas, hence ℵ1 sets altogether.

L 的这些性质并不证明 CH 对一般的集合为真。但它们表明 CH 不能被反驳，因为 L 同时满足 ZF 与 CH。更精确地说，如果一般的集合满足 ZF，那么 L 中这些特定集合就满足 ZF 加 CH。换句话说，如果 ZF 相容，那么 ZF 加 CH 也相容。这就是哥德尔如何得到第 2.4 节提到的证明：CH 不能被通常的集合论公理反驳。

These properties of L do not prove that CH is true for sets in general. But they show that CH cannot be disproved,because L satisfies both ZF and CH. More precisely, if sets in general satisfy ZF, then the particular sets in L satisfy ZF plus CH. Or again, if ZF is consistent, then so is ZF plus CH. This is how Gödel came up with his proof, mentioned in Section 2.4, that CH cannot be disproved by the usual axioms of set theory.

第 2.4 节也提到，科恩证明 CH 不可证，使用的是一个 CH 为假的 ZF 模型。他借助称为力迫法的卓越创新构造这种模型，力迫法允许构造极其多样的 ZF 模型。为构造 CH 为假的模型，他先把哥德尔的 L 缩减为一个可数模型 M；L 包含所有序数，因此高度不可数。这之所以能做到，实质上是因为 ZF 语言只有可数多个公式。由于 M 只包含可数多个整数集，就有空间把许多新的整数集 S₁、S₂、……重新加入 M。若极其巧妙地操作，就能得到一个满足 ZF，也满足 AC，却不满足 CH 的模型 M(S₁,S₂,……)。因此，即使加入 AC，连续统假设也不能从 ZF 公理证明，除非 ZF 本身不相容。

Cohen’s proof that CH cannot be proved, also mentioned in Section 2.4, involves a model of ZF in which CH is false. Cohen built such a model with the help of his brilliant innovation called forcing, that allows the construction of extremely varied models of ZF. To build a model in which CH is false he first cut down Gödel’s L, which includes all the ordinals and hence is highly uncountable, to a countable model M. This can be done, essentially, because there are only countably many formulas in the language of ZF. Since M includes only countably many sets of integers, there is room for many new sets of integers S1, S2,… to be put back into M. When this is done very cleverly, one can obtain a model M(S1, S2,…) of ZF (and also AC) that does not satisfy CH. Thus the continuum hypothesis cannot be proved from the ZF axioms, even when AC is added (unless ZF itself is inconsistent).

力迫法

Forcing

力迫法过于专门，无法在这里描述，但不能忽视它的重要性。20 世纪 60 年代集合论的大多数新发现都由它促成，例如索洛维关于“所有实数集都可测”这一假设的相容性定理。力迫法彻底改变了集合论的面貌：它表明，ZF 中大多数有趣的未证语句，若不增加新公理，就既不能证明，也不能反驳。

The technique of forcing is too technical to describe here, but we cannot ignore how important it has been. It led to most of the 1960s revelations in set theory, such as Solovay’s theorem on the consistency of assuming that all sets of real numbers are measurable. Forcing completely changed the face of set theory by showing that most of the interesting unproved sentences of ZF can be neither proved nor disproved without new axioms.

索洛维的结果是许多结果之一，它们表明，假设 ZF 相容，就可以相容地假设 AC 为假。因此，虽然由哥德尔关于 L 的结果可知，AC 不能从 ZF 公理反驳，但它同样不能被证明。ZF 的不可判定语句，不仅包括完整的选择公理，也包括本章前面涉及的许多特殊情形。特别是，力迫法可以得到具有以下性质的 ZF 模型，因此这些性质在 ZF 中不可反驳：

Solovay’s result is one of many showing that it is consistent to assume that AC is false, assuming that ZF is consistent. Thus, while AC cannot be disproved from the ZF axioms (by Gödel’s result about L), it cannot be proved either. The undecidable sentences of ZF include not only the full axiom of choice, but also many special cases of it that we touched on earlier in this chapter. In particular, forcing can be used to obtain models of ZF with the following properties, which are therefore not disprovable in ZF:

  • 存在一个没有可数子集的无限集。
    There is an infinite set with no countable subset.
  • 存在一个序列连续却不连续的函数。
    There is a sequentially continuous function that is not continuous.
  • ℝ 是可数多个可数集的并。
    R is a countable union of countable sets.

这些性质都与 AC 矛盾，因此它们在 ZF 中也不可证。

These properties all contradict AC, so they are not provable in ZF either.

2007 年 9 月 29 日，斯坦福大学举行纪念保罗·科恩的会议。休·伍丁这样描述科恩的发现：这确实是集合论的终结，或者确实是它的开端，而我们还不知道究竟是哪一个。随后，伍丁展示了一张异星景观照片，即 NASA 拍摄的火星照片，见图 2.11；其中太阳似乎正在落下，也可能正在升起，无法分辨。

At a conference in memory of Paul Cohen at Stanford on September 29, 2007, Hugh Woodin described Cohen’s discovery by saying: It is really the end of set theory, or else really the beginning—and we do not yet know which. Woodin then displayed a photo of an alien landscape (a NASA photo of Mars, Figure 2.11) in which the sun appears to set, or rise—and one cannot tell which.

我们也许永远无法理解连续统；也许能够理解，但必须借助新公理，伍丁持乐观态度。无论如何，康托尔的两大思想，即对角线论证与序数，即使在正整数层面，也为数学带来了新的光明。在那里，通常的公理同样不足以解决所有问题。本书余下各章将转向这些发展。

It may be that we can never understand the continuum; it may also be that we can understand the continuum, but only by new axioms (Woodin takes the optimistic view). Be that as it may, the two great ideas of Cantor—the diagonal argument and the ordinals—have thrown new light on mathematics even at the level of positive integers. There too, the usual axioms are not sufficient to settle all questions. We turn to these developments in the remaining chapters of the book.

1 由于 ℵ₁ 是良序集，这个等式蕴含实数可以良序化。正如所见，单是这一点就是一个微妙的问题。康托尔于 1878 年首次表述连续统问题时，避免了必须判定实数能否良序化的问题。他只是问：每个无限实数集，是否都能与 ℵ₀ 或连续统建立一一对应。
1Since ℵ1 is a well-ordered set, the equation r2+1m. implies that the real numbers can be well-ordered. This alone is a subtle question, as we have already seen. Cantor’s first formulation of the continuum problem, in 1878, avoided having to decide whether the real numbers can be well-ordered. He simply asked whether each infinite set of real numbers can be put in one-to-one correspondence with either ℵ0 or 2ℵ0=ℵ1. .
2 此外，402653211=3·2²⁷+27。这是我从 2007 年 Mathcamp 的两位学生 David Field 和 Jeremiah Siochi 那里得知的，他们计算了古德斯坦过程的这一情形。
2Also, 402653211 = 3 · 227 + 27. I learned this from two students at Mathcamp 2007, David Field and Jeremiah Siochi, who worked out this case of the Goodstein process.
3 他还指出，当 x=0 时，或
3He also pointed out that, when x = 0, or
4 尽管难以想象这样的函数，分析学在集合论出现之前就已经使用了等价假设。例如，1872 年康托尔曾证明，若函数 f 是序列连续的，它就是连续的。所谓 f 在 x=a 处序列连续，是指对任意趋于 a 的序列 a₁、a₂、……，f(aₙ) 都趋于 f(a)。这个证明又一次无意识地使用了选择公理。
4Notwithstanding the difficulty in imagining such a function, equivalent assumptions were made in analysis before the emergence of set theory. For example, in 1872, Cantor offered a proof that a function f is continuous if it is sequentially continuous. One says that f is sequentially continuous at x = a if f (an) tends to f (a) for any sequence a1, a2,… that tends to a. The proof involves another unconscious use of the axiom of choice.

第 3 章　可计算性与证明

- Chapter 3 - Computability and Proof

概览

Preview

数学中的可计算性概念源于证明概念。1900 年前后，数学基础中的困难促使人们要求建立形式化的证明概念：按照完全明确的推理规则，从公理推导定理。这些规则应当直接作用于符号串，无须有意识的干预，因此，形式系统就是通过计算来证明定理的一种过程。

The concept of computability emerged in mathematics from the concept of proof. Around 1900, difficulties in the foundations of mathematics led to the demand for a formal concept of proof, in which theorems are derived from axioms by completely explicit rules of inference. The rules are supposed to operate on strings of symbols without the need for conscious intervention, so a formal system is a process for proving theorems by computation.

这意味着形式系统本身也是数学结构，我们可以证明关于它们的定理。这类定理中最著名的是哥德尔第一不完备性定理：任何一致的算术形式系统，都有某些真语句无法证明。一个非凡而令人震惊的推论是哥德尔第二不完备性定理：一个“足够强”的算术形式系统能够表达自身的一致性，却不能证明这种一致性，除非该系统本身不一致。

This means that formal systems are themselves mathematical structures, about which theorems can be proved. The most famous theorem of this type is Gödel’s first incompleteness theorem, stating that any consistent formal system for arithmetic fails to prove some true sentences. A remarkable (and shocking) consequence is Gödel’s second incompleteness theorem, according to which a “sufficiently strong” formal system for arithmetic can express its own consistency, but cannot prove it (unless the system is inconsistent).

哥德尔于 1930 年证明了这些定理，当时他并不知道，埃米尔·波斯特早已发现形式系统的一般定义及相应的一般不完备性定理。直到 20 世纪 30 年代丘奇和图灵重新发现可计算性之后，它在逻辑中的作用才变得清楚并得到普遍接受。

Gödel proved his theorems in 1930, unaware that a general definition of formal system, and a corresponding general incompleteness theorem, had already been discovered by Emil Post. The role of computability in logic did not become clear, or generally accepted, until it was rediscovered by Church and Turing in the 1930s.

可计算性的一般定义还使我们能够讨论任意算法，并证明某些问题不存在求解算法。这些不可解问题包括：判定哪些计算机程序最终会停机，以及判定哪些算术或逻辑语句为真。所有这些结果的基础出奇简单，就是第 1 章对角线构造的一种可计算变式。

The general definition of computability also makes it possible to speak of arbitrary algorithms, and to prove that no algorithm exists for solving certain problems. Among these unsolvable problems are the problem of deciding which computer programs ultimately halt, and of deciding which sentences of arithmetic or logic are true. The basis of all these results is surprisingly simple—a computable variant of the diagonal construction from Chapter 1.

3.1　形式系统

3.1 Formal Systems

……魏尔斯特拉斯及同一学派其他人的研究表明，即使在数学思维的普通论题中，所需的细节也远比前几代数学家预料的更多。

… the investigations of Weierstrass and others of the same school have shown that, even in the common topics of mathematical thought, much more detail is necessary than previous generations of mathematicians had anticipated.

——怀特海与罗素（1910），第 3 页。

—Whitehead and Russell (1910), p. 3.

19 世纪末，代数、几何与分析的基础问题催生了几个新的数学分支。新的代数系统和非欧几何的兴起，以及随之而来的为分析建立新基础的需要，要求数学的研究对象和方法都更加清晰。这导致了：

In the late 19th century several new branches of mathematics emerged from problems in the foundations of algebra, geometry, and analysis. The rise of new algebraic systems, non-Euclidean geometry, and with them the need for new foundations of analysis, created the demand for greater clarity in both the subject matter and methods of mathematics. This led to:

  1. 符号逻辑：用符号表达逻辑概念，把演绎化归为应用推理规则的过程；

    symbolic logic, in which concepts of logic were expressed by symbols and deduction was reduced to the process of applying rules of inference,

  2. 集合论：用集合以及隶属关系和相等关系定义一切数学概念；

    set theory, in which all mathematical concepts were defined in terms of sets and the relations of membership and equality,

  3. 公理化方法：用某些公理定义每个数学分支，公理的逻辑后果就是该分支的定理。

    axiomatics, in which each branch of mathematics is defined by certain axioms, the logical consequences of which are its theorems.

1900 年前后，这些思想汇合成形式系统的概念：一种能够表达一切数学概念的符号语言，加上一组命题，即公理，可以按照特定推理规则从中推导定理。20 世纪初最具代表性的形式系统，是怀特海与罗素的《数学原理》（1910—1913）。

Around 1900 these ideas were merged in the concept of a formal system, a symbolic language capable of expressing all mathematical concepts, together with a set of propositions (axioms) from which theorems could be derived by specific rules of inference. The definitive formal system of the early 20th century was the Principia Mathematica of Whitehead and Russell (1910–1913).

《数学原理》的主要目标是严格性和完备性。符号语言与对所有推理规则的明确陈述相结合，保证只有公理的逻辑后果才能被推导为定理。未经察觉的假设不可能凭借看似“显然”而混入其中。事实上，由于推理规则纯粹是符号操作，原则上，即使不知道符号的含义，也能完成《数学原理》系统中的全部演绎。这种演绎可以由机器执行，不过这并非该书的初衷，因为写作时尚不存在合适的机器。其初衷是通过排除未经察觉的假设来确保严格性；就此而言，《数学原理》完全成功了。

The main aims of Principia Mathematica were rigor and completeness. The symbolic language, together with an explicit statement of all rules of inference, allows theorems to be derived only if they are logical consequences of the axioms. It is impossible for unconscious assumptions to sneak in by seeming “obvious”. In fact, all deductions in the Principia system can in principle be carried out without knowing the meaning of the symbols, since the rules of inference are pure symbol manipulations. Such deductions can be carried out by a machine, although this was not the intention of Principia, since suitable machines did not exist when it was written. The intention was to ensure rigor by keeping out unconscious assumptions, and in these terms Principia was a complete success.

至于完备性，《数学原理》厚重的三卷本以一种“威慑式证明”表明，当时已有的一切数学都能从其公理推导出来，但也仅此而已。人们实际上甚至不知道它是否在逻辑上完备，也就是能否推导所有有效的逻辑原理。1929 年，哥德尔证明了它的逻辑完备性，但不久之后又证明了它的数学不完备性。我们有些超前了，不过这里可以先说明哥德尔不完备性定理的根本原因：《数学原理》及一切类似系统的弱点，恰恰是其客观性。由于它能够被完全精确地描述，它本身就是一个可以推理研究的数学结构。一个简单而巧妙的论证随即表明，它无法证明关于自身的全部事实，因此在数学上是不完备的。

As for completeness, the three massive volumes of Principia were a “proof by intimidation” that all the mathematics then in existence was deducible from the Principia axioms, but no more than that. It was not actually known whether Principia was even logically complete, that is, capable of deriving all valid principles of logic. In 1929 Gödel proved its logical completeness, but soon after that he proved its mathematical incompleteness. We are now getting ahead of our story, but the underlying reason for Gödel’s incompleteness theorem can be stated here: the weakness of Principia (and all similar systems) is its very objectivity. Since Principia can be described with complete precision, it is itself a mathematical structure, which can be reasoned about. A simple but ingenious argument then shows that Principia cannot prove all facts about itself, and hence it is mathematically incomplete.

从《数学原理》到波斯特的正规系统

From Principia Mathematica to Post’s Normal Systems

可以说，符号逻辑就是产生了自我意识的数学。

Symbolic Logic may be said to be Mathematics become self-conscious.

——波斯特（1941），载于 Davis（2004），第 345 页。

—Post (1941), in Davis (2004), p. 345.

1920 年，23 岁的美国数学家埃米尔·L. 波斯特通过证明命题逻辑的完备性与一致性，进入了数理逻辑领域。顾名思义，命题逻辑研究以变量 P、Q、R、……表示的命题及其间的逻辑关系。它不分析命题的内部结构，只考察用“且”“或”“非”等词连接命题的效果。这些词称为联结词，如今“且”“或”“非”分别用符号 ∧、∨、¬ 表示。因此 P∨Q 表示“P 或 Q”，而 (¬P)∨Q 表示“（非 P）或 Q”。后者通常简写为 P⇒Q，因为它等价于“P 蕴涵 Q”。

In 1920 the 23-year-old American mathematician Emil L. Post entered the field of mathematical logic by proving the completeness and consistency of propositional logic. As its name suggests, propositional logic concerns propositions, which are denoted by variables P, Q, R,… , and the logical relations between them. The internal structure of propositions is not analyzed, only the effect of connecting them by words such as “and,” “or,” and “not.” Such words are called connectives, and today the connectives “and,” “or,” and “not” are denoted by symbols ∧, ∨,and — respectively. Thus P ∨ Q denotes “P or Q,” and (⌝P) ∨ Q denotes “(not P)or Q.” The latter is commonly abbreviated P ⇒ Q because it is equivalent to”P implies Q.”

《数学原理》给出了命题逻辑的某些公理，例如 (P∨P)=P，以及某些推理规则，例如经典的分离规则：由 P 和 P⇒Q 推出 Q。波斯特证明，命题逻辑的一切有效公式都可以借助这些规则从公理推出，因此就命题逻辑而言，《数学原理》是完备的。

Principia Mathematica gave certain axioms for propositional logic, such as (P ∨ P) = P, and certain rules of inference such as the classical rule of modus ponens:from P and P ⇒ Q,infer Q. Post proved that all valid formulas of propositional logic follow from the axioms by means of these rules, so Principia is complete as far as propositional logic is concerned.

波斯特还通过引入如今已很熟悉的真值表方法，证明了命题逻辑的一致性。真值表赋予每条公理“真”值，每条推理规则又保持“真”值，因此所有定理都具有“真”值，从而在直观意义上为真。命题逻辑的这一性质，即所有定理都为真，称为可靠性。同一思想还说明命题逻辑具有一种可能更弱的性质，即一致性。也就是说，它不会同时证明命题 P 及其否定 ¬P，因为两者之一取“真”值时，另一个就取“假”值。

Post also showed that propositional logic is consistent, by introducing the now familiar device of truth tables. Truth tables assign to each axiom the value “true,” and each rule of inference preserves the value “true,” so all theorems have the value “true” and hence are true in the intuitive sense. This property of propositional logic—that all its theorems are true—is called soundness. The same idea also shows that propositional logic has the (possibly weaker) property of consistency. That is, it does not prove any proposition P together with its negation ⌝ P, since if one of these has the value “true” the other has the value “false.”

完备性与一致性共同解决了命题逻辑的可推导性问题：给出一种算法，判定任意给定命题是否为定理。

Completeness and consistency together solve the deducibility problem for propositional logic: to give an algorithm that determines, for any given proposition, whether it is a theorem.

我们现在知道，命题逻辑远比完整的《数学原理》简单。事实上，德国逻辑学家保罗·贝尔奈斯早在 1918 年就得到了波斯特的结果，只是没有发表。然而有趣的是，波斯特继续向前，试图分析任意推理规则，从而描述任意形式系统。在这个过程中，他发现了可计算性概念，因为事实证明，波斯特的形式系统能生成一切可以用计算方式列举的集合。波斯特把一条“推理规则”理解为由有限多个前提组成：

We now know that propositional logic is far easier than the full Principia. Indeed Post’s results had already been obtained, though not published, by the German logician Paul Bernays in 1918. However, what is interesting is that Post went straight ahead, attempting to analyze arbitrary rules of inference, and hence to describe arbitrary formal systems. In doing so, he hit upon the concept of computability, because it turns out that Post’s formal system generate all sets that can be computably listed. Post took a “rule of inference” to consist of a finite set of premises:

g11Pi11g12Pi12…g1m1Pi1m1g1(m1+1)g21Pi21g22Pi22⋯g2m2Pi2m2g2(m2+1)                         ⋯gk1Pik1gk2Pik2…gkmkPikmgk(mk+1)

这些前提共同产生一个结论：

which together produce a conclusion

g1Pi1g2Pi2…gmPimgm+1.

其中 gij 是某些特定的符号或符号串，例如分离规则中的 ⇒ 符号；Pij 则是任意符号串，例如分离规则中的 P 和 Q。结论中的每个 Pi 都至少出现在一个前提中。这类“规则”包括《数学原理》的全部规则；波斯特认为，它也包括任何以确定方式从前提得出结论的其他规则。

The gij are certain specific symbols or strings of symbols, such as the ⇒ symbol in modus ponens, and the are arbitrary strings (such as the P and Q in modus ponens). Each in the conclusion is in at least one of the premises. Such “rules” include all the rules of Principia and, Post thought, any other rules that draw conclusions from premises in a determinate way.

因此，任意形式系统 F 都是由有限条公理和上述形式的规则组成的集合。F 中的一个证明是一个有限的符号串序列，称为证明的各行；每一行都由前面的行按照 F 的某条规则得到。F 的一个定理就是某个证明的最后一行。

Thus any formal system F is a finite set of axioms and rules of the above form. A proof in F is a finite sequence of strings, called the lines of the proof, each of which follows from preceding lines by one of the rules of F. A theorem of F is the last line of a proof.

解决一般规则系统的可推导性问题，等于理解全部数学，这似乎是毫无希望的任务。但波斯特最初取得了惊人的进展。到 1921 年年中，他已证明：任何形式系统的定理，都能由他所谓的正规系统产生。这种系统只含一条公理，以及如下简单形式的规则：

Solving the deducibility problem for general systems of rules amounts to understanding all of mathematics, a seemingly hopeless task. But Post made surprising progress in the beginning. By mid-1921 he had proved that the theorems of any formal system can be produced by what he called a normal system, consisting of a single axiom and rules of the simple form

gP 产生 Pg′ .

gP produces Pg′. 

换句话说，任何以符号串 g 开头的串，都可以替换为这样一个串：删去开头的 g，并在另一端附加 g′。¹

In other words, any string beginning with the string g may be replaced by the string in which g is removed and g is attached at the other end.1

起初，这似乎是重大进展。理解全部数学，看来只需理解正规系统即可。但在未能分析某些非常简单的正规系统之后（见下文），波斯特意识到，实际情况与最初的想法恰好相反：他并没有简化《数学原理》，而只是把它的复杂性浓缩到了更小的系统中。

At first this looked like a great step forward. Apparently, understanding all mathematics reduces to understanding normal systems. But after failing to analyze some very simple normal systems (see below), Post realized that the situation was the opposite of what he had first thought: instead of simplifying Principia, he had merely distilled its complexity into a smaller system.

一个标签系统

A tag system

正规系统包含一类更简单的系统，波斯特称之为“标签”系统。在其中，每个 g′ 只取决于 g 的首字母，且所有 g 的长度都相同。有一个这样的系统只使用字母 0 和 1，每个 g 的长度为 3。若 g 以 0 开头，则 g′=00；若以 1 开头，则 g′=1101。因此，符号串的左端每步前进三格，试图“追上”每步前进两格或四格的右端。例如，初始串为 1010 时，变化如下：

Normal systems include an even simpler class of systems that Post called “tag” systems, in which each g depends only on the initial letter of g and all g have the same length. One such system uses only the letters 0 and 1, and each g has length 3. If g begins with 0, then g′ = 00, and if g begins with 1 then g′ = 1101. The left-hand end of the string therefore advances by three places at each step, trying to “tag” the right-hand end which advances by two or four places. For example, here is what happens when the initial string is 1010:

1010 01101 0100 000 00 0

随后符号串变为空串。在波斯特试过的所有情形中，结果不是终止（如本例），就是出现周期性，但至今仍不知道是否总是如此。

and then the string becomes empty. In all cases that Post tried, the result was either termination (as here) or periodicity, but it is still not known whether this is always the case.

定理确实可以由简单规则产生，但这只是因为任何计算都能化归为简单步骤。预测简单规则的结果，并不比判定任意数学语句是否为定理更容易。² 这一认识使波斯特的研究纲领发生了逆转。

Theorems can indeed be produced by simple rules, but only because any computation can be reduced to simple steps. Predicting the outcome of simple rules is no easier than deciding whether arbitrary sentences of mathematics are theorems.2 This realization led to a reversal of Post’s program.

逆转后的纲领，比他最初给自己设定的任务更容易。最初的任务实质上是：

The reverse program was easier than the one he had set himself initially, which was essentially the following:

  1. 描述所有可能的形式系统。

    Describe all possible formal systems.

  2. 简化它们。

    Simplify them.

  3. 由此解决所有这些系统的可推导性问题。

    Hence solve the deducibility problem for all of them.

在把复杂规则化归为简单规则的过程中，波斯特确信：对于任何生成符号串的系统，都有一个正规系统生成完全相同的符号串。但所有正规系统都可以列举，因为每个系统都由有限字母表上的有限多个符号串组成。因此，所有生成定理的系统也都可以列举。这自然引出下文将介绍的对角线论证。结果是：某些形式系统的可推导性问题不可解。

In reducing complicated rules to simple ones, Post became convinced that, for any system generating strings of symbols, there is a normal system that generates the same strings. But it is possible to list all normal systems, since each consists of finitely many strings of symbols on a finite alphabet. Hence it is possible to list all systems for generating theorems. This invites an application of the diagonal argument, described below. The outcome is that for certain formal systems the deducibility problem is unsolvable.

经历这次戏剧性的转向后，波斯特认为正确道路应当是：

After this dramatic change of direction Post saw the true path as follows:

  1. 描述所有可能的形式系统。

    Describe all possible formal systems.

  2. 对它们施行对角线构造。

    Diagonalize against them.

  3. 证明其中某些系统的可推导性问题不可解。

    Show that some of them have unsolvable deducibility problem.

    他还进一步看到了不完备性定理，因为：

    And he also saw one step further—the incompleteness theorem—because:

  4. 任何可靠的形式系统，都无法得到一个不可解问题的全部答案。

    No sound formal system obtains all answers to an unsolvable problem.

3.2　波斯特通向不完备性的途径

3.2 Post’s Approach to Incompleteness

……我最多只能说：假如我是哥德尔，我就会在 1921 年证明哥德尔定理。

… the best I can say is that I would have proved Gödel’s theorem in 1921—had I been Gödel.

——埃米尔·波斯特，

—Emil Post,

1938 年 10 月 29 日致哥德尔的明信片，载于 Gödel（2003），第 169 页。

postcard to Gödel, 29 October 1938 in Gödel (2003), p. 169.

我们先讨论波斯特纲领的最后一步，以消除“不完备性是一个困难概念”的误解。把一个算法问题，简称问题，定义为一个可计算的问题列表：P=〈Q1,Q2,Q3,…〉。例如，识别素数的问题就是以下列表：

We deal with the last step of Post’s program first, to dispel the myth that incompleteness is a difficult concept. Let us define an algorithmic problem, or simply problem, to be a computable list of questions: P = 〈Q1, Q2, Q3,…〉. For example, the problem of recognizing primes is the list

〈 "是否 1 是素数？", "是否 2 是素数？", "是否 3 是素数？", ... ) .

 〈"Is 1 prime?", "Is 2 prime?", "Is 3 prime?", ...). 

如果答案列表不可计算，就称这个问题不可解。识别素数的问题当然是可解的。

A problem is said to be unsolvable if the list of answers is not computable. The problem of recognizing primes is of course solvable.

现在假设存在一个不可解问题 P=〈Q1,Q2,Q3,…〉。那么，任何可靠的形式系统 F 都不可能证明以下形式的所有真语句：

Now suppose that an unsolvable P = 〈Q1, Q2, Q3,… 〉 exists. Then no sound formal system F proves all true sentences of the form

"以下问题的答案： Qi 是 Ai. ",

 "The answer to Qi is Ai. ", 

因为通过系统地列举 F 的全部定理，我们就能计算出问题 P 的答案列表。一种概念上简单、尽管效率极低的定理列举方法如下：

since by systematically listing all the theorems of F we could compute a list of answers to problem P. A conceptually simple, though highly inefficient, way to list theorems is the following:

  1. 列出 F 的语言中的所有符号串，包括用来分隔行的符号，不论该符号是什么。例如，先列单字母串，再列双字母串，依此类推，同一长度内按字母顺序排列。

    List all strings of symbols in the language of F (including the line separation symbol, whatever it is), say in alphabetical order, with the one-letter strings first, then the two-letter strings, and so on.

  2. 把每个符号串中相邻两次行分隔符之间的片段逐一写出，从而把该串分成若干行。

    Separate each string into lines by writing down the segments of it that fall between successive occurrences of the line-separating symbols.

  3. 将每一行与此前各行比较，以此判定每个符号串是否构成一个证明。

    By comparing each line with the preceding lines, decide, for each string, whether it is a proof.

  4. 在第二个列表上，写下每个证明的最后一行，条件是它具有“Qi 的答案是 Ai”的形式。

    On a second list, write down each last line of each proof, provided it has the form “The answer to Qi is Ai.”

因此，任何可靠的形式系统 F，对于“Qi 的答案是 Ai”这一形式的语句都是不完备的：存在这种形式的真语句，F 无法证明。

Thus any sound formal system F is incomplete with respect to sentences of the form “The answer to Qi is Ai”: there are some true sentences of this form that F does not prove.

诚然，这一论证还引出了若干问题。可靠性或一致性有什么意义？能否找出具体的不可证明语句？主流数学中是否存在不可证明语句？这些问题都值得进一步研究。但对波斯特来说，最重要的信息是：不完备性是不可解性的直接后果。他还看到，不可解性又是对角线论证的一个简单后果，见下文“可计算的对角线构造”小节。

It is true that there are several matters arising from this argument. What is the significance of soundness, or consistency? Can we find specific unprovable sentences? Are there unprovable sentences in mainstream mathematics? All of these questions repay further attention. But for Post the most important message was that incompleteness is an immediate consequence of unsolvability. He also saw that unsolvability is a simple consequence of the diagonal argument (see the subsection below on computable diagonalization).

形式系统都是正规系统

Furmal Systems Are Normal Systems

在波斯特看来，真正重大的问题，是说明一切计算都能在正规系统中得到体现。如果没有计算的精确定义，不可解问题的概念就没有意义，也不会有形式系统的一般概念。波斯特意识到，在定义计算之前，他关于不完备性的论证还不能算真正的数学。同时，他预见到，可计算性的定义将成为一种科学假说，需要不断接受检验和确认。因此，他没有发表这些结果，而被库尔特·哥德尔抢先。哥德尔于 1931 年发表了一个一般性较弱、但证明严格的不完备性定理。从此，这一结果就被称为哥德尔不完备性定理。

The really big problem, in Post’s view, was to show that all computation is reflected in normal systems. Without a precise definition of computation, the concept of unsolvable problem is meaningless, and there is no general concept of formal system. Post realized that his argument for incompleteness was not really mathematics until computation was defined. At the same time he foresaw that the definition of computability would become a kind of scientific hypothesis, requiring eternal testing and confirmation. For this reason, he did not publish his results, and was scooped by Kurt Gödel, who published a less general, but rigorously proved, incompleteness theorem in 1931. Ever since, the result has been known as Gödel’s incompleteness theorem.

可以说，在通向一般不完备性定理的道路上，波斯特比哥德尔走得更远；但正因为走得如此之远，他陷入了僵局。在 20 世纪 20 年代，逻辑学家尚未准备好接受形式系统的一般定义。

It could be said that Post travelled further than Gödel along the road to a general incompleteness theorem, but, in traveling so far, he reached an impasse. In the 1920s, logicians were not ready for a general definition of formal system.

哥德尔的证明，是把对角线论证专门应用于《数学原理》系统。他相信，对“相关系统”也能证明不完备性，但避免尝试给形式系统下一个一般定义。此外，他没有把不完备性视为不可解性的后果。他认为，不完备性的“真正原因”，是能够构造比自然数更高类型的对象，例如自然数集。正如第 7 章将看到的，更高类型的思想，或者按今天的说法，更高秩的思想，确实是构造不完备性证明的有力工具。然而，如今看来，哥德尔 1931 年的证明，与其说是高阶类型的应用，不如说是丘奇于 1935 年、图灵于 1936 年首次发表的不可解性证明的先驱，见第 3.5—3.7 节。

Gödel’s proof was a specialization of the diagonal argument to the Principia Mathematica system. He believed that incompleteness would be provable for “related systems,” but he avoided trying to define formal systems in general. Also, he did not see incompleteness as a consequence of unsolvability. He thought that the “true reason” for incompleteness was the ability to form objects of higher type than the natural numbers, such as the set of natural numbers. The idea of higher types (or higher ranks as we now call them) turns out to be a powerful ingredient for cooking up incompleteness proofs, as we will see in Chapter 7. However, Gödel’s 1931 incompleteness proof now looks less like an application of higher types and more like a precursor of the first published unsolvability proofs, by Church in 1935 and Turing in 1936 (see Sections 3.5 to 3.7).

1931 年，阅读哥德尔证明的人看不到不可解性概念，因为可计算性概念尚不为人普遍了解，直到 1936 年仍是如此。哥德尔本人也不相信可计算性，因而也不相信不可解性，能够被精确定义；直到读了 1936 年那篇定义图灵机概念的论文，他才改变看法，见第 3.5 节。但过了一段时间，人们逐渐认识到，包括波斯特正规系统在内的许多计算途径，定义的恰好是同一个概念，也就是今天电子计算机所实现的概念。³

In 1931, the concept of unsolvability was invisible to readers of Gödel’s proof, because the concept of computability was generally unknown, and it remained so until 1936. Gödel did not himself believe that computability (and hence unsolvability) could be precisely defined until he read the 1936 paper in which the Turing machine concept was defined (see Section 3.5). But after some time it became clear that many approaches to computation, including Post normal systems, define exactly the same concept—which is the concept realized by the electronic computers of today.3

可计算的对角线构造

Computable Diagonalization

波斯特定义了一个正整数集 D，它的隶属问题不可解：

Post defined a set D of positive integers with unsolvable membership problem,

〈"Is1 属于 D ?", "是否 2 属于 D ?", "是否 3 属于 D?",…〉 ,

〈"Is1 in D ?", "Is 2 in D ?", "Is 3 in D?",…〉, 

他使用的是康托尔对角线论证的一种变式。他注意到，若正整数集 S 的隶属问题可解，就能计算出 S 的元素列表，因此 S 是我们如今所谓的可计算可枚举集，简称 c.e. 集。假定一切计算都能由正规系统实现，就可以列出所有 c.e. 集 S1、S2、S3、……。具体地，可以把 Sn与第 n 个正规系统对应起来：当且仅当由 m 个 1 组成的符号串是第 n 个正规系统的一个“定理”时，令 m 属于 Sn。例如，可先按大小、再按字母顺序列举正规系统。

by a variation of Cantor’s diagonal argument. He observed that if S is a set of positive integers with solvable membership problem then one can compute a list of the members of S, so S is what we now call computably enumerable (c.e.). Assuming that all computation can be realized by normal systems, we can list all c.e. sets S1, S2, S3, To be specific, Sn can be associated with the nth normal system by letting m be in Sn if the string of m 1s is a “theorem” of the nth normal system (in the listing by size and alphabetical order, say).

对角线论证告诉我们，集合

The diagonal argument tells us that the set

D={ n:n 不属于 Sn }

D={ n:n is not in Sn }

不同于每个 Sn，因此它不是 c.e. 集，从而其隶属问题不可解。由本节开头的论证可知，任何可靠的形式系统都不可能证明“n 属于 D”这一形式的全部真语句。

differs from each set Sn, hence it is not c.e., and hence its membership problem is unsolvable. It follows, as we saw at the beginning of this section, that no sound formal system can prove all true sentences of the form “n is in D.”

这是不完备性定理的一个简单版本，波斯特在 1921 年就已预见到，但首先由哥德尔于 1930—1931 年严格证明。如前所述，哥德尔并未试图定义所有可计算可枚举集；尽管如此，他的论证在技术上非常相似，研究的是《数学原理》中可证明的隶属语句。

This is an easy version of the incompleteness theorem, foreseen by Post in 1921, but first proved rigorously by Gödel in 1930–1931. (As mentioned above, Gödel did not attempt to define all computably enumerable sets; nevertheless his argument is technically rather similar, concerning membership statements provable in Principia Mathematica.)

波斯特还给出了一个更强的版本：对任何可靠的形式系统 F，都能找到一个具体的真语句“n(F) 不属于 Sn(F)”，而 F 无法证明它。考虑集合

Post also gave a stronger version: for any sound formal system F, we can find a specific true sentence “n(F) is not in Sn(F)” not proved by F.Consider the set

D(F)={ n:F 证明 " n 不属于 Sn" },

D(F)={ n:F proves " n is not in Sn" },

这是一个 c.e. 集。我们可以写出一个具体的正规系统，从形式系统 F 产生的“n 不属于 Sn”形式的定理中提取数 n，从而找到该集合的一个指标 n(F)。因此，

This is a c.e. set,an index n(F) of which we can find by writing down a specific normal system that harvests the numbers n from the theorems of the form “n is not in Sn” produced by the formal system F.Thus

Sn(F)={ n:F 证明 " n 不属于 Sn′′ }.

Sn(F)={ n:F proves " n is not in Sn′′ }.

为什么 n(F) 不属于 Sn(F) 是真的呢？如果作相反假设，就会得到如下矛盾：

Why is it true that n(F) is not in Sn(F)? Well, if we assume the contrary we get a contradiction as follows:

n(F) 属于 Sn(F)⇒F 不能证明 " n(F) 不属于 Sn(F) " 因为 F 是可靠的 ⇒n(F) 不属于 Sn(F) 根据其定义： Sn(F) .

n(F) in Sn(F)⇒F does not prove " n(F) is not in Sn(F) " because F is sound  ⇒n(F) is not in Sn(F) by definition of Sn(F). 

因此，n(F) 确实不属于 Sn(F)。但由 Sn(F) 的定义可知，n(F) 不是那些使 F 能证明“n 不属于 Sn”的数 n 之一。也就是说，F 不能证明 n(F) 不属于 Sn(F)。

Thus it is true that n(F) is not in Sn(F). But then it follows, by definition of Sn(F),that n(F) is not one of the numbers n for which F proves n is not in Sn(F).That is, F does not prove that n(F) is not in Sn(F).

哥德尔也以这种更明确的形式证明了不完备性：他找到了一个《数学原理》系统无法证明的具体真语句。而且，哥德尔的方法还在一个经典数学领域中给出了不可证明语句。

Gödel also proved incompleteness in this more explicit form, by finding a specific true sentence that the Principia Mathematica system does not prove. Moreover, Gödel’s approach gives an unprovable sentence in a classical area of mathematics.

3.3　哥德尔第一不完备性定理

3.3 GÖdel’s First Incompleteness Theorem

我认为，我的结果的关键不在于人们能够以某种方式超出任何形式系统，这一点从对角线方法就已经可以推出；关键在于，对于每个数学形式系统，都存在一些可以在该系统内部表达、却无法由其公理判定的陈述，而且这些陈述甚至属于一种相对简单的类型，即正整数理论。

I see the essential point of my result not in that one can somehow go outside any formal system (that follows already according to the diagonal procedure), but that for every formal system of mathematics there are statements which are expressible within the system but which may not be decided from the axioms of that system, and that those statements are even of a relatively simple kind, namely, belonging to the theory of the positive whole numbers.

——库尔特·哥德尔，

—Kurt Gödel,

1931 年 10 月 12 日致策梅洛的信，载于 Gödel（2003），第 429 页。

Letter to Zermelo, 12 October 1931 in Gödel (2003), p. 429.

波斯特关于不可解性与不完备性的例子属于形式系统理论。这个领域即使不能证明几乎所有数学陈述，也能表达它们，只是所用语言并非我们通常见到的语言。哥德尔在 1930—1931 年的伟大贡献，是通过证明不完备性存在于算术，即正整数在加法和乘法下的理论中，使它变得切实具体。他的方法是将形式系统理论，尤其是《数学原理》，加以“算术化”。

Post’s examples of unsolvability and incompleteness are in the theory of formal systems, a field that can express (if not prove) virtually all mathematical statements, though not in the language in which we usually see them. The great contribution of Gödel in 1930–1931 was to bring incompleteness down to earth by showing its existence in arithmetic—the theory of positive integers under addition and multiplication. He did this by “arithmetizing” the theory of formal systems, Principia Mathematica in particular.

算术化的细节基本上并不复杂，但十分繁琐，因此这里只作概述。⁴ 无论如何，在深入细节之前，最好先了解算术化的整体图景。

The details of arithmetization are basically straightforward but tedious, so I will only sketch them here.4 In any case, it is better to see the big picture of arithmetization before zooming in on the details.

首先，显然，形式系统 F 中的一个符号串可以解释为一个正整数。这是因为，如果按实际方式计算符号，F 只有有限多个符号。例如，考虑在计算机键盘上输入所需的按键，“符号”x147 实际上就是由几个符号组成的串。如果 F 有 k 个符号，就可以把它们解释为 k+1 进位制中的非零数字。于是，F 的每个符号串都是一个 k+1 进制数码，表示唯一的正整数。此时不使用数字 0，不仅是为了避免开头出现零，从而避免不同数码表示同一个数，也是为了把 0 留作以后讨论符号串序列，例如证明时使用的分隔符。

First, it is clear that a string of symbols in a formal system F may be interpreted as a positive integer. This is because F has only finitely many symbols, when symbols are realistically counted. For example, a “symbol” such as x147 is really a string of several symbols when one takes into account the keystrokes needed to produce it with a computer keyboard. If F has k symbols we can interpret them as the nonzero digits in base k + 1 notation. Then each string of symbols of F is a base k + 1 numeral that represents a unique positive integer. (We avoid using the digit 0 at this stage, not only to ensure that there are no initial zeros—which would give rise to different numerals representing the same number—but also to save 0 as a separator when we come to consider sequences of strings, such as proofs.)

其次，考虑形式系统的规则，它们涉及识别、移动和改变符号串的某些部分。既然每个符号串都能解释为一个数，符号串上的操作想必也能解释为数上的运算。但如何用数的通常运算，例如求和或求积，描述数码上的典型操作，例如删除或附加数字，并不显然。这一点需要强调，因为我们通常在两种意义上解释数码，有时视为符号串，有时视为符号串所表示的数，却没有意识到这是两件不同的事。例如，说“121 是一个三位数”时，我们把 121 解释为符号串；说“121 是一个平方数”时，则把它解释为数。

Next, consider the rules of a formal system, which involve recognizing, moving, and changing parts of a string of symbols. Now that we can interpret each string as a number, operations on strings can presumably be interpreted as operations on numbers. But it is not obvious how to describe the typical operations on a numeral (such as removing or attaching digits) in terms of the usual operations on the number it denotes (such as sum or product). This point needs to be emphasized, because we normally interpret numerals in two ways—sometimes as strings of symbols, sometimes as the numbers these strings denote—without noticing that we are doing two different things. For example, when we say “121 is a three-digit number” we interpret 121 as a string; when we say “121 is a square” we interpret 121 as a number.

我们接下来要做的，就是重新区分数码世界与数的世界，并在两者之间建立精确的对应。特别是，我们将找出数上的运算，使之对应于形式系统中数码上的操作，或者用我们有时采用的说法，“诱导”这些操作。

What we are about to do is restore the distinction between the world of numerals and the world of numbers, and establish a precise correspondence between the two. In particular, we will find operations on numbers that correspond to (or “induce,” as we will sometimes say) the operations on numerals that occur in formal systems.

真正严格地处理数码时，应当为数码 n 所表示的数使用单独的记号，例如带横线的 n，这样，数码 121 有三位，而它表示的数是平方数。不过，我们相信读者有区分数码与数的经验，并希望上下文能清楚表明所用的是哪种解释。为便于理解，我们假定数码都采用十进制。不过，b 进制完全相同，只需把 10 换成 b。

A really strict treatment of numerals would use a separate notation, say n, for the number denoted by numeral n, (so 121 has three digits, while 121 is a square). But we will trust the reader’s experience in distinguishing between numeral and number, and hope that it is clear from context which interpretation is intended. For the sake of familiarity we assume that numerals are in base 10. (However, base b is exactly the same, except that 10 is replaced by b.)

数函数与数码函数

Number Functions and Numeral Functions

在数的世界中，我们将使用以下基本函数和关系。

In the world of numbers, the basic functions and relations we will use are the following.

  • 函数：求和、求积、指数、最小数算子；

    functions: sum, product, exponential, least number operator,

  • 关系：小于、等于。

    relations: less than, equals.

数的和函数与积函数 m+n 和 mn，不容易描述为 m 与 n 的数码上的函数。正如小学时的经历所示，学习如何由 m 与 n 的数码计算 m+n 与 mn 的数码，需要好几年。令人惊讶的是，反方向反而更容易！

The sum and product functions m + n and mn of numbers are not easily described as functions of the numerals for m and n. As you will remember from elementary school, it takes some years to learn how to compute the numerals for m + n and mn from the numerals for m and n. Surprisingly, it is easier to go in the opposite direction!

找出诱导数码上自然操作的数函数，其实相当简单。最简单的例子是函数 length(n)，它计算 n 的数码中的数字位数。在所有数码都采用十进制的假定下，有

It is quite simple to find number functions that induce natural operations on numerals. The simplest example is the function length(n),which counts the number of digits in the numeral for n. Under our assumption that all numerals are written in base 10, we have

 length (n)= 最小的 m 使得 10m>n .

 length (n)= least m such that 10m>n. 

另一个重要例子是 m 与 n 的连接函数 m⌢n，它把 n 的数字附加到 m 的数字右边。这个关于 m 与 n 的函数为

Another important example is the concatenation function m ⌒ n of m and n, which attaches the digits of n to the right of those of m. This function of m and n is

m⌢n=m⋅10length (n)+n.

m⌢n=m⋅10length (n)+n.

例如，27⌢431=27·103+431=27431。连接函数 ⌢ 使我们能够通过数上的算术运算，诱导出许多数码上的操作。

For example, 27 ⌒ 431 = 27 – 103 + 431 = 27431. The concatenation function ⌒ enables us to induce many operations on numerals by arithmetic operations on numbers.

形式系统的算术化

Arithmetization of Formal Systems

我们需要的操作，是把数码视为波斯特正规系统中的符号串时的操作；其产生规则形如

The kind of operations we need are those where the numerals are strings in a Post normal system, where production rules are of the type

gP 产生 Pg′ .

gP produces Pg′. 

这是一种数码操作，因为它假定 gP 与 Pg′ 是符号串。对每条产生规则“gP 产生 Pg′”，都有一个数运算来诱导它。这就是由下式定义的“m 产生 n”运算：

This is a numeral operation, because it assumes that gP and Pg′ are strings of symbols. For each production rule “gP produces Pg “we have a number operation that induces it. This is the operation “m produces n”defined by

m=g⌢P 且 n=P⌢g′ 对某个 P .

m=g⌢P and n=P⌢g′ for some P. 

一般而言，波斯特正规系统有有限条产生规则，记作 produces1、produces2、……、producesk。若 m 按某条产生规则产生 n，就称数码 n 是数码 m 的直接后果。这个数码关系由以下数关系诱导：

In general, a Post normal system will have finitely many production rules, call them produces1, produces2,…, producesk. A numeral n is an immediate consequence of numeral m if m produces n by one of the production rules. This numeral relation is induced by the number relation

m 产生 1n 或 m 产生 2n 或 ⋯ 或 m 产生 kn ,

m produces 1n or m produces 2n or ⋯ or m produces kn, 

我们也把这个数关系称为直接后果关系。

which we also call immediate consequence (for numbers).

这就引出了证明的概念。在波斯特正规系统中，证明是一个有限符号串序列 s1、s2、……、sl。第一个串 s1 是公理，其他每个串 si₊₁ 都是 si 的直接后果。所有符号串都是不含零的数码，因此可以从下面这个单一数码恢复整个序列：

This brings us to the concept of proof. In a Post normal system, a proof is a finite sequence of strings, s1, s2, …,sl. The first string s1 is the axiom, and every other string si+1 is an immediate consequence of si.All our strings are zero-free numerals, so we can recover the sequence from the single numeral

s10s20…0sl. 

那么，相应的数

Now, what arithmetic properties of the corresponding number

s1⌢0⌢s2⌢0⌢…⌢0⌢sl

具有什么算术性质，才能把它识别为一个证明呢？为描述这些性质，我们定义数 m 的一个性质，表示 m 的数码中不含零。这个性质 NoZerosIn(m) 定义为

identify it as a proof? To describe these properties we define a property of number m which says that the numeral for m contains no zeros. This property, NoZerosIn(m),is defined by

m≠p⌢0⌢q 且 m≠p⌢0 对任意 p 且 q.

m≠p⌢0⌢q and m≠p⌢0 for any p and q.

性质 NoZerosIn(m) 使我们能够从任意正整数 n 的数码中，提取第一个零之前的片段 s1，以及相邻零之间的片段 si 和 si₊₁。具体而言，第一个零之前的片段定义为

The property NoZerosIn(m) allows us to extract the segment s1 before the first zero in the numeral for any positive integer n,and also the segments si and si+1 between successive zeros. Namely, the segment before the first zero is defined by

s1= (最小的 p 使得 n=p⌢0⌢q 对某个 q ),

s1= (least p such that n=p⌢0⌢q for some q ), 

而 si 与 si₊₁ 是零之间相邻的两个片段，当且仅当

and si and si+1 are successive segments between zeros if and only if

n=p⌢0⌢si⌢0⌢si+1⌢0⌢q 对某个 p 且 q 且 NoZerosIn (si) 且 NoZerosIn (si+1) .

n=p⌢0⌢si⌢0⌢si+1⌢0⌢q for some p and q and   NoZerosIn (si) and NoZerosIn (si+1). 

因此，如果 n 的初始片段 s1 等于形式系统 F 的公理 A，而且对 n 的任意两个相邻片段 si 与 si₊₁，后者都是前者在 F 中的直接后果，那么 n 的数码就是 F 中的一个证明。

Thus the numeral for n is a proof in the formal system F if the initial segment s1 of n equals the axiom A of F and, for any two successive segments si and si+1 of n, si+1 is an immediate consequence of si in F.

根据上面建立的结果，n 的这一性质可以用算术定义。

This property of n is arithmetically definable by what we have established above.

最后，q 的数码是 F 的定理，当且仅当它是某个证明的最后一行，也就是某个构成证明的数码的最后一个片段。数 n 的最后一个片段 q 当然定义为

Finally, the numeral for q is a theorem of F if and only if the numeral for q is the last line of a proof, that is, the last segment of a numeral that is a proof. The last segment q of a number n is of course defined by

最小的 q 使得 n=p⌢0⌢q ,

 least q such that n=p⌢0⌢q, 

因此，q 的数码是 F 的定理，当且仅当存在一个正整数 n，使 n 的数码是 F 中的一个证明，且 q 是 n 的最后一个片段。

so the numeral for q is a theorem of F if and only if there is a positive integer n such that the numeral for n is a proof in F and q is the last segment of n.

重新审视波斯特的论证

Post’s Argument Revisited

上述结果表明，在一个包含少量算术和逻辑的形式系统 G 中，可以为任意形式系统 F 建立一个“可运作的模型”。为纪念哥德尔，我们将这样的系统记作 G；稍后会选定一个更具体的系统。特别是，G 能用算术语言表达“m 属于 Sn”形式的每个语句，而且当语句为真时还能证明它。由第 3.2 节使用的对角线论证可知：若 G 可靠，就存在一个 G 无法证明的真算术语句，即“n(G) 不属于 Sn(G)”的算术等价式。这是哥德尔第一不完备性定理的一种形式。

The results above show that, in a formal system G with a small amount of arithmetic and logic, it is possible to build a “working model” of any formal system F. (We call such a system G in honor of Gödel; later we will settle on a more specific system.) In particular, G can express each sentence of the form “m is in S”n in the language of arithmetic (and prove the sentence if it is true). It follows, by the diagonal argument used in Section 3.2, that if G is sound then there is a true arithmetical sentence that G does not prove—namely, the arithmetical equivalent of “ n(G) is not in Sn(G).” This is one form of Gödel’s first incompleteness theorem.

假定 G 可靠是自然的，但这个假定并不方便，因为我们不能用 G 自身的语言表达 G 的可靠性。假如能够这样做，就可以把 G 的语言中所有可定义的集合列为 T1、T2、T3、……，而集合

The assumption that G is sound is natural, but it turns out to be inconvenient because we cannot express the soundness of G in the language of G itself. If we could, we could enumerate all the sets definable in the language of G as T1, T2, T3,… and the set

E={ n:n 不属于 Tn }

E={ n:n is not in Tn }

也能在 G 中定义，譬如记作 Tk。这会导致以下矛盾：

would also be definable in G, as, say, Tk. This leads to the contradictions

k 属于 Tk⇒k 不属于 Tk 且 k 不属于 Tk⇒k 属于 Tk .

k in Tk⇒k not in Tk and k not in Tk⇒k in Tk. 

这称为真理的不可定义性，本身就是一个非凡的结果。它首先由波兰数学家、后来成为美国数学家的阿尔弗雷德·塔尔斯基于 1934 年发表，不过上面引用的哥德尔 1931 年致策梅洛的信中已经提到它。

This is called the undefinability of truth, a remarkable result in itself. It was first published by the Polish (later American) mathematician Alfred Tarski in 1934, though it is mentioned in the 1931 letter from Gödel to Zermelo quoted above.

回头来看，哥德尔第一定理的证明通过使用可定义的可证明性概念，恰好避开了矛盾。可证明性与真理之间的间隙，使我们能够证明这个间隙确实存在。

Looking back, we see that the proof of Gödel’s first theorem narrowly avoids contradiction by using the definable concept of provability. The gap between provability and truth enables us to prove that there is a gap.

哥德尔还注意到，可以从比 G 的可靠性更弱的假定，推出 G 中存在真而不可证明的语句；他把这一假定称为 G 的 ω-一致性。对于我们考虑的 G，只需假定普通的一致性即可，即不存在语句 σ，使 G 同时证明 σ 和 ¬σ。如第 3.1 节所述，¬ 表示“非”。

Gödel also noticed that the presence of true but unprovable sentences in G could be derived from a weaker assumption than the soundness of G—what he called the ω-consistency of G.For the G we have in mind it is enough to assume simple consistency, which means that there is no sentence σ such that G proves both σ and —σ (as mentioned in Section 3.1, — stands for “not”).

回顾第 3.2 节证明“n(G) 不属于 Sn(G)”不可证明的论证，可以看到，只假定 G 一致，论证就能成立。和以前一样，我们先假定 n(G) 属于 Sn(G)，其中

If we review the argument in Section 3.2 that shows “n(G) is not in Sn(G)” is not provable, we see that it goes through assuming only that G is consistent. We start, as before, by assuming that n(G) is in Sn(G), where

Sn(G)={ n:G 证明 " n 不属于 Sn′′ } .

Sn(G)={ n:G proves " n is not in Sn′′ }. 

根据 Sn(G) 的定义，这个假定意味着 G 证明了假语句“n(G) 不属于 Sn(G)”。另一方面，由于 n(G) 属于 c.e. 集 Sn(G)，而 G 能证明关于 c.e. 集的所有真隶属语句，因此 G 也证明“n(G) 属于 Sn(G)”。这与 G 的一致性矛盾，所以实际上 n(G) 不属于 Sn(G)。再次根据 Sn(G) 的定义，G 不能证明语句“n(G) 不属于 Sn(G)”。

This assumption means, by the definition of Sn(G),that G proves the false sentence “n(G) is not in Sn(G)”. On the other hand, since n(G) is in the c.e. set Sn(G), G also proves the sentence “n(G) is in Sn(G)”, thanks to its ability to prove all true membership sentences for c.e. sets. This contradicts the consistency of G,so in fact n(G) is not in Sn(G). It follows, by the definition of Sn(G) again, that G does not prove the sentence “n(G) is not in Sn(G)”.

因此，对于任何包含一定量算术与逻辑的形式系统 G，G 的一致性蕴涵语句“n(G) 不属于 Sn(G)”为真但不可证明。我们不具体说明“一定量”的算术和逻辑究竟是什么，只指出其中必须同时包含加法和乘法。

Thus, for any formal system G containing a certain amount of arithmetic and logic, the consistency of G implies that the sentence “n(G) is not in Sn(G)” is true but not provable. We will not specify what the “certain amount” of arithmetic and logic is, except to say that both addition and multiplication must be present.

3.4　哥德尔第二不完备性定理

3.4 Gödel’s Second Incompleteness Theorem

最近我再次研究逻辑，运用您如此成功地使用过的方法来展示不可判定命题。在此过程中，我得到了一个在我看来值得注意的结果：我能够证明，数学的一致性是不可证明的。

I have recently concerned myself again with logic, using the methods you have employed so successfully in order to exhibit undecidable propositions. In doing so I have achieved a result that seems to me remarkable. Namely, I was able to show that the consistency of mathematics is unprovable.

——约翰·冯·诺伊曼，

—John von Neumann,

1930 年 11 月 20 日致哥德尔的信，载于 Gödel（2003），第 337 页。

Letter to Gödel, 20 November 1930, in Gödel (2003), p. 337.

1930 年 8 月 26 日，哥德尔在柯尼斯堡的一次会议上宣布了他的第一不完备性定理。当时该地属于德国，如今是俄罗斯一块飞地上的加里宁格勒市。最早认识到其重要性的人，很可能是约翰·冯·诺伊曼。他于 1930 年 11 月 20 日写信给哥德尔，指出该证明的一个非凡后果：G 的一致性不能在 G 中证明。碰巧哥德尔自己已经注意到这个后果，因此它如今称为哥德尔第二不完备性定理。

Gödel announced his first incompleteness theorem on August 26 1930, at a conference in Königsberg (then in Germany, now the city of Kaliningrad in an isolated part of Russia). Probably the first person to realize its importance was John von Neumann, who wrote to Gödel on November 20,1930, to point out an extraordinary consequence of Gödel’s proof: the consistency of G is not provable in G. As it happens, Gödel had already noticed this consequence himself, so it is now known as Gödel’s second incompleteness theorem.

冯·诺伊曼和哥德尔都想到了下面的论证，把第一不完备性证明中的“自我意识”又推进了一步。顺便说，正如波斯特对第一不完备性定理的证明一样，哥德尔对第二不完备性定理的证明，也只给出了关于符号操作的直观论证。

Both von Neumann and Gödel had come up with the following argument, which takes the “self-consciousness” of his first incompleteness proof a step further. (Incidentally, like Post’s proof of the first incompleteness theorem, Gödel’s proof of the second incompleteness theorem was given only as an intuitive argument about manipulations with symbols.)

  • “G 是一致的”这一陈述，可以用 G 的语言中的语句 Con(G) 表达。这是因为，G 的可证明语句集 P 是 c.e. 集，G 能表达任意 c.e. 集的隶属关系，而语句 σ 与 ¬σ 的可证明性，可以用两个具有某种算术关系的数属于 P 来表达。

    The statement that G is consistent can be expressed as a sentence Con(G) in the language of G. This is because the set P of provable sentences of G is c.e., G can express membership of any c.e. set, and provability of sentences σ and ⌝σ can be expressed as membership in P by two numbers with a certain arithmetic relationship.

  • 语句“G 不能证明语句‘n(G) 不属于 Sn(G)’”也能在 G 中表达，而且实际上等价于语句“n(G) 不属于 Sn(G)”。这是由以下定义得到的：

    The sentence “G does not prove the sentence ‘n(G) is not in Sn(G)’“ can also be expressed in G, and it is in fact equivalent to the sentence “n(G) is not in Sn(G).” This follows from the definition

    Sn(G)={ n:G 证明 " n 不属于 Sn′′ } .

    Sn(G)={ n:G proves " n is not in Sn′′ }. 

    通常说，语句“n(G) 不属于 Sn(G)”表达了它自身的不可证明性。

    (It is commonly said that the sentence “n(G) is not in Sn(G)” expresses its own unprovability.)

  • 因此，“Con(G) 蕴涵 G 不能证明‘n(G) 不属于 Sn(G)’”这一陈述等价于：

    Therefore, the statement that Con(G) implies that G does not prove “n(G) is not in Sn(G) “is equivalent to

    Con(G)⇒"n(G) 不属于 Sn(G) "

    Con(G)⇒"n(G) is not in Sn(G) " 

    这个蕴涵不仅能在 G 中表达，还能在 G 中证明，因为从 G 的一致性推出 G 中的不可证明性的论证，是关于形式系统中所发生之事的论证，而这一切都能在 G 中表达。

    This implication is not only expressible in G but provable in G,since the argument from consistency of G to unprovability in G is an argument about what happens in formal systems, all of which is expressible in G.

  • 但这样一来，如果 Con(G) 能在 G 中证明，那么由分离规则，即从 P 与 P⇒Q 推出 Q，就能推出语句“n(G) 不属于 Sn(G)”。我们已经证明，这个语句不能在 G 中证明，因此 Con(G) 也不能在 G 中证明。

    But then, if Con(G) is provable in G, the sentence “n(G) is not in Sn(G)” will follow, by the modus ponens rule that Q follows from P and P ⇒ Q. We have established that “n(G) is not in Sn(G)”is not provable in G, so neither is Con(G).

语句“n(G) 不属于 Sn(G)”之所以有趣，仅仅因为它不可证明；与之不同，Con(G) 本身就具有重大的数学与逻辑意义。早在哥德尔之前三十年，伟大的德国数学家戴维·希尔伯特就提出了证明数学形式系统、尤其是算术形式系统一致性的问题。他的担忧源于集合论中的悖论，例如“所有集合组成的集合”。希尔伯特建议，为数学建立一个形式系统，并用他所谓的“有穷”方法证明其一致性，从而排除进一步出现悖论的危险。

Unlike the sentence “n(G) is not in Sn(G),” which is interesting only because it is unprovable, Con(G) is of great mathematical and logical interest. Thirty years before Gödel, the great German mathematician David Hilbert had posed the problem of proving the consistency of formal systems for mathematics, and arithmetic in particular. His concern was prompted by the paradoxes in set theory, such as the “set of all sets.” Hilbert proposed to eliminate the danger of further paradoxes by establishing a formal system for mathematics and proving its consistency by methods he called “finitary.”

20 世纪 20 年代初，希尔伯特和他的学生，包括冯·诺伊曼，在这个目标上取得了一些进展，得到了算术某些部分的有穷一致性证明。他们没有意识到，完整算术的致命弱点，恰恰是它能够模拟一切形式系统；这注定使它不完备，也无法证明自身的一致性。哥德尔第二不完备性定理实际上终结了希尔伯特纲领，却没有终结人们对一致性证明的探索。相反，它使人们开始理解某些数学语句的相对强度或复杂性。

In the early 1920s, Hilbert and his students (von Neumann among them) made some progress towards this goal, obtaining finitary consistency proofs for some parts of arithmetic. They did not realize that the Achilles heel of full arithmetic was its ability to model all formal systems—dooming it to incompleteness and inability to prove its own consistency. Gödel’s second incompleteness theorem was virtually the end of Hilbert’s program, but it did not end the search for consistency proofs. Rather, it led to an understanding of the relative strength or complexity of certain sentences of mathematics.

如果 G 是一个标准算术系统，第 5 章将详细介绍，那么 Con(G) 就比 G 的任何定理都“更强”或“更复杂”。1936 年，希尔伯特的助手格哈德·根岑发现，度量 Con(G) 复杂性的，正是第 2 章研究过的序数 ε0。标准算术有一条归纳公理，实质上说的是直到序数 ω 的归纳有效；而且可以证明，这条“ω-归纳”公理蕴涵任意 α<ε0 的“α-归纳”。根岑证明，Con(G) 可以用 ε0-归纳证明，由此说明 ε0-归纳不能在 G 中证明，因而 ε0 是 G 的强度的精确度量。同时可知，任何蕴涵 ε0-归纳的语句，都不能在 G 中证明。

If G is a standard system for arithmetic (which we describe in detail in Chapter 5), then Con(G) is “stronger” or “more complex” than any theorem of G. In 1936 it was discovered by an assistant of Hilbert, Gerhard Gentzen, that the complexity of Con(G) is measured by none other than the ordinal ε0 that we studied in Chapter 2. Standard arithmetic has an induction axiom saying essentially that induction up to the ordinal ω is valid, and it can be proved that this “ω-induction” axiom implies “α-induction” for any α < ε0. Gentzen proved that Con(G) can be proved by ε0-induction, thus showing that ε0-induction is not provable in G,and hence that ε0 is a precise measure of the strength of G. It follows, also, that any sentence that implies ε0-induction is not provable in G.

第 2.7 节讨论的古德斯坦定理的一种推广，就是这样的语句。第 6 章将解释，为什么推广的古德斯坦定理蕴涵 ε0-归纳。第 2.7 节的方法还表明，ε0-归纳也蕴涵推广的古德斯坦定理，因此两者等价，并蕴涵 Con(G)。所以，推广的古德斯坦定理是一个真语句，却不能在 G 这样的标准算术系统中证明。事实上，普通古德斯坦定理也不能在标准算术中证明。这个定理早在 1944 年就已出现，当时人们已知道 ε0 度量算术的复杂性。然而，直到 20 世纪 70 年代末，首次发现算术中不可证明语句的“自然”例子时，才知道古德斯坦定理不能在标准算术中证明。所有这些例子都是沿着经由序数的“第二条通向无穷之路”找到的，而不是通过对角线论证。

One such sentence is a generalization of the Goodstein theorem discussed in Section 2.7. We explain why the generalized Goodstein theorem implies ε0-induction in Chapter 6. The method of Section 2.7 shows that ε0-induction also implies the generalized Goodstein theorem, so this theorem is equivalent to ε0-induction, which implies Con(G).Thus, the generalized Goodstein theorem is a true sentence not provable in standard systems of arithmetic, such as G. In fact, the ordinary Goodstein theorem is also not provable in standard arithmetic. The latter theorem dates back to 1944, when ε0 was known to measure the complexity of arithmetic. However, it was not known that Goodstein’s theorem is not provable in standard arithmetic until the late 1970s, when “natural” examples of sentences unprovable in arithmetic were first discovered. All of them were found by taking the “second road to infinity,” via ordinals, rather than by the diagonal argument.

3.5　可计算性的形式化

3.5 Formalization of Computability

因此，“可计算”概念在某种意义上是“绝对的”，而几乎所有其他已知的元数学概念，例如可证明、可定义等等，都本质上依赖于所采用的系统。

Thus the notion ‘computable’ is in a certain sense ‘absolute,’ while almost all metamathematical notions otherwise known (for example, provable, definable, and so on) quite essentially depend upon the system adopted.

——哥德尔（1936），载于 Gödel（1986），第 399 页。

—Gödel (1936) in Gödel (1986), p. 399.

到目前为止，本章一直使用正规系统作为计算模型，部分出于历史原因，部分因为它们以非常简单的方式展示了形式系统的基本特征：公理、规则、证明和定理。然而，当讨论计算的其他方面，例如计算实数或函数时，最容易理解的模型是图灵机。图灵机在历史上也极其重要，因此本节和下一节将作简要讨论。

So far in this chapter we have used normal systems as our model of computation, partly for historical reasons and partly because they exhibit the basic features of formal systems (axioms, rules, proofs, theorems) in a very simple way. However, when it comes to other aspects of computation—such as computing real numbers or functions—the easiest model to understand is the Turing machine concept. Turing machines are also of great historical importance, so we include a brief discussion of them in this section and the next.

哥德尔针对“《数学原理》及相关系统”证明了第一不完备性定理，因为当时尚无形式系统的一般定义。波斯特尚未发表正规系统，部分原因是他不确定它们是否完全把握了计算概念。而哥德尔在动摇了证明的绝对性观念之后，也怀疑计算是否可能有绝对的定义。美国逻辑学家阿隆佐·丘奇于 1933 年作出的首次尝试，并未使他信服。⁵

Gödel proved his first incompleteness theorem for “Principia Mathematica and related systems,” because a general definition of formal system was not yet available. Post had not published his normal systems, partly because he was unsure that they completely captured the notion of computation. And Gödel, having undermined the idea that proof was absolute, doubted that there could be an absolute definition of computation. The first attempt, by the American logician Alonzo Church in 1933, did not convince him.5

最终使他信服的，是英国数学家艾伦·图灵于 1936 年提出的非常直观的计算机器概念，如今称为图灵机。几乎同一时间，波斯特也独立提出了实质上相同的概念。波斯特之所以终于决定发表，很可能是因为他看到了丘奇对计算的定义，认识到需要一个他所谓具有更高“心理忠实度”的定义。遗憾的是，波斯特用三页篇幅提炼计算概念，过于简短，无法与图灵论文中充分展开的心理忠实度相匹敌。

He was finally convinced by the very intuitive concept of computing machine introduced by the English mathematician Alan Turing in 1936, and now called a Turing machine. Virtually the same concept was introduced independently by Post, at almost the same time. Post was probably moved to publish, at last, because he had seen Church’s definition of computation and realized that a definition of greater “psychological fidelity” (as he called it) was needed. Unfortunately, Post’s three-page distillation of the concept of computation was too brief to match the psychological fidelity developed at length in Turing’s paper.

图灵机

Turing Machines

我们可以把正在计算一个实数的人，比作一台只能处于有限多个状态 q1、q2、……的机器。机器配有一条穿过其中的“纸带”，相当于纸张，纸带分成若干段，称为“方格”，每格都能承载一个“符号”。

We may compare a man in the process of computing a real number to a machine which is only capable of a finite number of conditions q1, q2,… The machine is supplied with a “tape” (the analogue of paper) running through it, and divided into sections (called “squares”) each capable of bearing a “symbol.”

——艾伦·图灵（1936），第 261 页。

—Alan Turing (1936), p. 261.

图灵和波斯特于 1936 年提出的计算机器概念，是从人类的计算方式中抽象出来的。确实值得记住，“computer”一词最初指的就是进行计算的人。图灵把人类计算过程剥离到最基本的要素：扫描并识别符号的眼睛、书写的手，以及指挥眼睛和手的动作的心理状态。假定足够相似的符号或心理状态不会被区分，图灵得出结论：计算只需要有限多个心理状态和一个有限符号表。此外，可以把符号放在独立方格中，每次扫描一个，因为任何有限组符号，都能由记录各符号及其相对位置的心理状态“记住”。类似地，扫描运动可以分解为从一格到相邻一格的步骤。最后，可以把方格排成一维，使眼睛只能左右移动，因为任何阵列中的方格都能赋予整数地址，就像它们排列在一条直线上一样。

The concept of computing machine introduced by Turing and Post in 1936 is abstracted from the way that human beings compute. (Indeed, it is worth remembering that the word “computer” originally meant a human being who computes.) Turing arrived at his concept by stripping the process of human computation down to its bare essentials: the eye that scans and recognizes symbols, the hand that writes, and the mental states that direct the actions of eye and hand. Assuming that sufficiently similar symbols or mental states will not be distinguished, Turing concludes that computation requires only a finite number of mental states and a finite alphabet of symbols. Further, the symbols can be placed in individual cells and scanned one at a time, because any finite group of symbols can be “remembered” by a mental state that records the individual symbols and their relative positions. Similarly, scanning movements can be broken down into steps from cell to adjacent cell. Finally, the cells can be arranged one-dimensionally—so that the only eye movements are to left and right—since the cells in any array can be given integer addresses, just as if they lay along a line.

今天，我们不仅能看到它与纸笔计算的类比，也能看到它与计算机器运行的类比。这样的机器，以下称为图灵机，由两部分组成：

Today, we can see an analogy not only with pencil-and-paper computation but with the operation of computing machines. A machine, henceforth called a Turing machine, consists of two parts:

  1. 一条分成方格的无限纸带，每格都能承载有限字母表 {S0,S1,S2,…,Sn} 中的一个符号。符号 S0 表示空白方格；计算开始时，除有限多个方格外，其余全部为空白。

    An infinite tape divided into squares, each of which can carry one symbol from a finite alphabet {S0, S1, S2,…,Sn}.The symbol S0 is the blank square, and at the beginning of a computation all but finitely many squares are blank.

  2. 一个控制机构，或称读写头，处于有限多个内部状态 q1、q2、……、qm 之一。读写头每次扫描纸带上的一个方格，并根据当前内部状态和扫描到的符号执行一个计算步骤。一个计算步骤包括：

    A control mechanism, or head, that is in one of finitely many internal states q1, q2,…, qm. The head scans one square of tape at a time and executes a step of computation that depends on the current internal state and the scanned symbol. A step of computation consists of

    • 把扫描到的符号替换为另一个符号；

      replacement of the scanned symbol by another symbol,

    • 移动到相邻方格，向左或向右；

      move to a neighboring square (left or right),

    • 转入一个新状态。

      change to a new state.

因此，可以用一个五元组列表描述图灵机，每个五元组形如

Thus we can describe a Turing machine by a list of quintuples of the form

qiSjSkDql '

其中

where

qi= 当前状态 Sj= 扫描到的符号 Sk= 替换符号 D= 移动方向 ( L 或 R )q1= 下一状态 .

qi= current state Sj= scanned symbol Sk= replacement symbol D= direction of movement (L or R)q1= next state. 

不必为每对 (qi,Sj) 都设置一个五元组。如果机器 M 到达某个状态 qi，扫描到符号 Sj，而没有规定相应动作，那么 M 就停机。

It is not necessary to have a quintuple for each pair (qi, Sj).If the machine M reaches a state qi and symbol Sj for which no action is specified, then M halts.

纸带抽象了传统计算中用来书写的纸张。把它设为一维，是为了使机器概念尽可能简单；在二维上计算也许更容易，但并不会增加一般性。想一想，如果被迫只在一行上工作，你会怎样计算 1277+4123+5239。

The tape abstracts the paper on which computations were traditionally written. It is made one-dimensional so as to make the concept of machine as simple as possible—it may be easier to compute in two dimensions but there is no gain in generality. (Think how you would evaluate 1277 + 4123 + 5239 if forced to work on one line.)

内部状态抽象了计算者的心理状态。在波斯特的版本中，内部状态由指令编号代替，而五元组

The internal states abstract the mental states of the person doing the computation. In Post’s version, internal states are replaced by instruction numbers and the quintuple

qiSjSkDq1

则替换为以下指令：

is replaced by the instruction

i . 如果扫描到的符号是 Sj , 将其替换为 Sk , 沿以下方向移动一格： D , 然后转到指令 l .

i. If the scanned symbol is Sj, replace it by Sk,       move one square in direction D,       and go to instruction l. 

因此，在波斯特的表述中，图灵机实质上是用一种完全依靠“转到”命令控制流程的语言编写的程序。这并非最易读的程序设计语言，却把计算化归为极其简单的要素。由此不难理解，为什么波斯特一度以为自己即将解决所有数学问题。

Thus in Post’s formulation, a Turing machine is essentially a program in a language that directs the flow entirely by “go to” commands. This is not the most readable programming language, but it reduces computation to remarkably simple ingredients. One can see why Post once thought he was on the brink of solving all mathematical problems.

我们如今知道，实际情况并非所有问题都能解决，而是描述简单的问题也可能不可解。特别是，一般无法预先知道一个给定程序运行后最终会发生什么。

As we now know, the reality is not that all problems can be solved, but that simply-described problems can be unsolvable. In particular, it is generally not possible to know in advance what ultimately happens when a given program is run.

3.6　停机问题

3.6 The Halting Problem

任何人过桥之前，都必须宣誓说明自己去哪里、去做什么。若所言属实，就准许通过；若说谎，就处以绞刑……有一次，他们让一个人宣誓，而那人发誓说，他正要到那里的绞刑架上去受死。

Before anyone crosses this bridge, he must state on oath where he is going and for what purpose. If he swears truly, he may be allowed to pass; but if he tell a lie, he shall suffer death by hanging …Now it happened that they once put a man on oath, and he swore that he was going to die on the gallows there.

——米格尔·德·塞万提斯，

—Miguel de Cervantes

《堂吉诃德》，第二部，第 51 章。J. M. Cohen 译。

Don Quixote, Part 2, 51. Translated by J. M. Cohen.

由于每台图灵机 T 只有有限多个状态和符号，因此可以用一个有限符号串描述 T，即列出 T 的全部五元组。而且，可以用固定的有限字母表 {q,S,′,R,L} 写出描述：把 qi 编码为 q 后接 i 个撇号，把 Sj 编码为 S 后接 j 个撇号。把 T 的五元组的这种编码称为 T 的标准描述，记作 ⌈T⌉。类似地，输入纸带序列 I 也可以编码为字母表 {S,′} 上的一个词 ⌈I⌉。

Since each Turing machine T has finitely many states and symbols, T can be described by a finite string of symbols, consisting of a list of the quintuples of T. Moreover, the description can be written in a fixed finite alphabet {q, S, ′, R, L} by encoding each qi as q followed by i primes, and each Sj as S followed by j primes. Let us call this encoding of the quintuples of T the standard description ⌈T ⌉ of T. We can similarly encode an input tape sequence I by a word ⌈I ⌉ on the alphabet {S, ′}.

有了固定有限字母表上的标准描述，就能构造一台通用图灵机 U，尽管过程繁琐。给 U 一条纸带，上面写着图灵机 T 的标准描述 ⌈T⌉ 和 T 的输入 I 的编码 ⌈I⌉，U 就开始“模拟”T 对 I 的计算。模拟自然相当缓慢，因为 U 必须在编码 T 的纸带部分与编码 I 的部分之间来回移动，前者用于寻找下一条指令，后者用于执行指令。图灵在 1936 年的论文中首次描述了通用机器。如今，大多数人的桌上都有一台，因为只要假定外部存储可以无限供应，我们熟悉的计算机就能模拟任何计算。

Given standard descriptions in a fixed finite alphabet, it is possible (but tedious) to build a universal Turing machine U. Given a tape carrying the standard description ⌈T ⌉ of a Turing machine T, and the encoding ⌈I ⌉ of the input I for T, U proceeds to “simulate” the computation of T on I. Naturally, the simulation is rather slow, because U has to shuttle back and forth between the part of the tape that encodes T (to find its next instruction) and the part that encodes I (to execute the instruction). In his 1936 paper, Turing gave the first description of a universal machine. Today, most people have one on their desk, because the computers we are familiar with can simulate any computation, assuming an indefinite supply of external storage.

乍看之下，通用机器 U 似乎能回答关于计算的一切问题。它当然能通过足够长时间地模拟 M，查明机器 M 在输入 I 上计算到第 t 步时会发生什么。但 U 能否判定 M 是否会在某个阶段停机，例如停在空白方格上？仅仅观看 U 模拟 M 对 I 的计算，未必能回答这个问题，因为我们不知道什么时候该停止观看。如果前十亿步计算都没有停在空白格上，并不意味着以后也不会。

At first glance, it seems as though a universal machine U can answer all questions about computation. It can certainly find out what happens at step t of the computation of machine M on input I, simply by simulating M long enough. But can U decide whether M halts at some stage,say, on a blank square? Simply watching U simulate the computation of M on input I may not answer this question because we do not know when to give up watching. If halting on a blank square does not occur in the first billion steps of computation, this does not mean it will not occur later.

事实上，不存在一台图灵机，能够在 M 与 I 任意变化时，正确回答以下所有问题：

In fact, there is no Turing machine that correctly answers all of the following questions (as M and I vary).

给定输入 I，图灵机 M 最终会停在一个空白方格上吗？

Does Turing machine M, given input I, ultimately halt on a blank square?

为说明原因，先统一图灵机 T 回答一系列问题的方式。为简单起见，假定问题都只有“是”或“否”两种答案。我们约定：

To see why, let us standardize the way in which a Turing machine T may be expected to answer a series of questions. Suppose, for the sake of simplicity, that the questions have yes/no answers. We make the conventions:

  1. 若问题涉及输入为 I 的机器 M，就给 T 一条写有 ⌈M⌉ 和 ⌈I⌉ 的纸带。

    If the question concerns machine M with input I then T is given a tape with ⌈M ⌉ and ⌈I ⌉ on it.

  2. T 停在非空白方格上表示回答“是”，停在空白方格上表示回答“否”。

    T answers yes by halting on a non-blank square, and no by halting on a blank square.

我想大家会同意，这些约定是合理的。如果愿意，也可以尝试其他约定。注意，机器必须停机才能给出答案，因此需要一种停机方式表示“是”，另一种表示“否”。很快就会看到，任何合理的输入问题、输出答案的约定，都能被一个关于图灵机的简单问题击败。实质上，我们是用这些约定来反过来对付本应使用它们的机器。

I think it will be agreed that these are reasonable conventions. Try some other conventions if you prefer. (Note that the machine must halt in order to give an answer, so we need one kind of halting to signal yes,and another kind of halting to signal no.) It will soon become clear that any reasonable conventions for inputting questions and outputting answers can be defeated by a simple problem about Turing machines. In effect, we turn the conventions against the machine that is supposed to use them.

考虑由以下问题组成的问题集。这些问题可能让你想起第 1 章的对角线论证，以及《堂吉诃德》引文中描述的困境。

Consider the problem that consists of the following questions (which may remind you of the diagonal arguments in Chapter 1, and also of the predicament described in the quote from Don Quixote).

Qm：图灵机 M 以自身的描述 ⌈M⌉ 为输入时，最终会停在空白方格上吗？

QM : Does Turing machine M, given its own description ⌈M ⌉ as input, ultimately halt on a blank square?

这些问题中唯一的参数是 M，因此可以要求回答它们的机器 T，把输入 ⌈M⌉ 当作问题 Qm，并以停在非空白方格上回答“是”，以停在空白方格上回答“否”。但如果如此，T 怎样回答问题 Qt 呢？

The only parameter in these questions is M, so a machine T that answers them can be expected to take input ⌈M ⌉ as the question QM and give answer YES by halting on a non-blank square, No by halting on a blank square. But if so, how does T answer the question QT?

如果 T 在输入 ⌈T⌉ 后，最终并不停在空白方格上，那么 Qt 的答案就是“否”。但 T 本应通过停在空白方格上来说“否”！反过来，如果 T 最终停在空白方格上，那么 Qt 的答案就是“是”，而 T 本应通过停在非空白方格上来说“是”。显然，T 陷入了困境，无法正确回答问题 Qt。

If T, given input ⌈T ⌉, does not ultimately halt on a blank square, then the answer to QT is No. But then T is supposed to say No by halting on a blank square! And if T ultimately halts on a blank square then the answer to QT is YES, and T is supposed to say YES by halting not on a blank square. Clearly, T is stymied. It cannot correctly answer the question QT.

因此，不存在能正确回答全部问题 Qm 的图灵机。我们说，由这些 Qm 组成的问题，即所谓停机问题的一种版本，是不可解的。

Thus there is no Turing machine that correctly answers all of the questions QM. We say that the problem consisting of the questions QM (one version of the so-called halting problem) is unsolvable.

3.7　判定问题（Entscheidungsproblem）

3.7 The Entscheidungsproblem

我们必须知道，我们终将知道。

Wir müssen wissen,

wir werden wissen

(We must know, we shall know).

——戴维·希尔伯特，

—David Hilbert,

1930 年 11 月 28 日的广播演说。

Radio address, November 28, 1930.

从第 3.2 节我们知道，波斯特在 1921 年就预见到不可解问题的存在，以及数学形式系统不完备性等后果。但他也认识到，这些结果必须等待人们就可计算性的定义达成共识；而这种共识直到图灵 1936 年的论文发表后才稳固下来。等价性证明也提供了支持：凡图灵机可计算的，在其他计算形式化中，例如波斯特和丘奇的形式化中，也都可计算，反之亦然。人们发现图灵机有许多等价形式，却始终未能发现更强的概念，于是确信：

As we know from Section 3.2, Post foresaw the existence of unsolvable problems in 1921, along with certain consequences such as the incompleteness of formal systems for mathematics. But Post also recognized that these results had to wait for agreement on the definition of computability—and agreement did not solidify until the publication of Turing’s 1936 paper. Reinforcements also arrived in the form of equivalence proofs, showing that anything computable by a Turing machine was computable in other formalizations of computation (such as those of Post and Church) and vice versa. The discovery that the Turing machine had many equivalents—and the failure to discover any stronger notion—led to the conviction that

可计算性 = 图灵机可计算性 .

 computability = Turing machine computability. 

由于最先由丘奇提出，这一论题被称为丘奇论题。

This became known as Church’s thesis, since it was first proposed by Church.

每当人们声称某个由无限多个问题组成的问题不可解时，都默认采用丘奇论题。因为实际证明的，总是该问题不能由图灵机或其某种等价形式求解。

Church’s thesis is assumed whenever one claims that a certain problem (of the type consisting of an infinite set of questions) is unsolvable. This is because one always proves that the problem is unsolvable by Turing machine (or one of its equivalents).

最早的不可解性证明，基于可计算性某种形式化中的“对角线”或“自指”论证。停机问题的论证就是很好的例子。紧接着，算术或逻辑中的不可解问题几乎立即出现，因为人们已经知道，如何把关于符号操作的问题翻译为算术或逻辑问题。例如，第 3.3 节概述的算术化技术，可以把停机问题归约为判定某些算术语句是否为真的问题。由停机问题的不可解性可知，判定算术真理的问题也不可解。丘奇于 1936 年首次发表了这个结果。

The first unsolvability proofs were based on “diagonal” or “self-referential” arguments in some formalization of computability. The argument for the halting problem is a good example. They were followed almost immediately by unsolvable problems in arithmetic or logic, since it was already known how to translate problems about symbol manipulation into arithmetic or logic. The technique of arithmetization sketched in Section 3.3, for example, can be used to reduce the halting problem to the problem of deciding whether certain sentences of arithmetic are true. It follows, by the unsolvability of the halting problem, that the problem of deciding truth in arithmetic is also unsolvable. This result was first published by Church in 1936.

另一个已具备不可解性证明条件的问题，是希尔伯特于 1928 年提出的 Entscheidungsproblem，德语意为“判定问题”。它要求在一种称为谓词逻辑的符号语言中判定有效性。谓词逻辑既是表达逻辑与数学的语言，也是证明定理的系统。下一章将讨论其运作方式，这里先列出基本组成：

Another problem ripe for an unsolvability proof was the so-called Entscheidungsproblem (German for “decision problem”), proposed by Hilbert in 1928. The problem is to decide validity in a symbolic language called predicate logic. Predicate logic is both a language for expressing logic and mathematics, and a system for proving theorems. We discuss how it works in the next chapter, but its bare bones are the following:

  • 变量 x、y、z、……和常量 a、b、c、……的符号；

    symbols for variables x, y, z,… and constants a, b, c,…,

  • 任意多个变量的关系，即“谓词”的符号；

    symbols for relations (“predicates”) in any number of variables,

  • 任意多个变量的函数的符号；

    symbols for functions of any number of variables.

  • 表示“且”“或”“非”“蕴涵”“对所有 x”和“存在一个 x”的符号。

    symbols for “and,” “or,” “not,” “implies,” “for all x,” and “there is an x.”

所有标准数学理论的公理，都能用谓词逻辑表达；而定理 T 从公理 A1、A2、……、Ak 推出，当且仅当语句

All the standard mathematical theories have axioms that can be expressed in predicate logic, and a theorem T follows from axioms A1,A2,…,Ak just in case the sentence

(A1 且 A2 且 … 且 Ak) 蕴涵 T

(A1 and A2 and … and Ak) implies T

在谓词逻辑中有效。

is valid in predicate logic.

因此，判定问题可谓一切数学问题之母：若能解决它，就能判定任意有限公理系统中任意语句的可证明性，其中包括 ZF 集合论这样涵盖其他一切标准数学理论的系统。希尔伯特认识到，这个问题的重要性就在于其包罗万象；他也相信，一切数学问题都是可解的。他曾在 1930 年一次至今仍可在互联网上听到的广播演说中说：“我们必须知道，我们终将知道。”⁶

Thus the Entscheidungsproblem is the mother of all mathematical problems, in the sense that a solution of the Entscheidungsproblem would decide the provability of any sentence in any finite axiom system (which includes systems like ZF set theory that encompass all other standard mathematical theories). Hilbert realized the Entscheidungsproblem was important because of its all-embracing nature—and he also believed that all mathematical problems are solvable. He once said, in a 1930 radio address that can still be heard on the Internet,6”We must know, we shall know.”

当然，不可解问题一经发现，希尔伯特的希望就受到了打击。事实上，丘奇和图灵都把各自的不可解问题归约为谓词逻辑，从而明确证明了判定问题不可解。不过，这并不意味着某个特定语句的真伪永远无法知道。不可解性意味着，不能以机械方式判定无限多个语句的真伪。迟早需要新的思想。只有在这种更含糊的意义上，“我们终将知道”才有可能。
