Of course, Hilbert’s hopes were dented as soon as unsolvable problems were discovered. In fact, both Church and Turing reduced their unsolvable problems to predicate logic, thus explicitly proving the unsolvability of the Entscheidungsproblem. However, this does not imply that the truth of any particular sentence can never be known. Unsolvability means, rather, that the truth of infinitely many sentences cannot be decided in a mechanical manner. Sooner or later, new ideas will be needed. Only in this vaguer sense is it possible that “we shall know.”

3.8　历史背景

3.8 Historical Background

符号逻辑

Symbolic Logic

显然，如果我们能找到合适的字符或符号，像算术表达数、几何表达线那样清楚而精确地表达我们的一切思想，那么，对于一切可以推理的事情，我们就能做到在算术和几何中所能做到的一切。

It is obvious that if we could find characters or signs suited for expressing all our thoughts as clearly and as exactly as arithmetic expresses numbers or geometry expresses lines, we could do in all matters, insofar as they are subject to reasoning, all that we can do in arithmetic and geometry.

——戈特弗里德·威廉·莱布尼茨，

—Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz

《普遍科学》序言，1677 年。

Preface to the General Science, 1677.

莱布尼茨在 17 世纪就预见了符号逻辑，但始终没有时间完成细节。他只留下了一些开创性的组合学研究，以及最早的计算机之一，一台能够进行加、减、乘、除的机器。直到 19 世纪，随着布尔与弗雷格的工作，这门学科才蓬勃发展。

Symbolic logic was foreseen by Leibniz in the 17th century, though he never found time to work out the details. He left only some pioneering investigations in combinatorics, and one of the first computers—a machine that could add, subtract, multiply and divide. The subject did not flourish until the 19th century, with the works of Boole and Frege.

乔治·布尔是一位爱尔兰数学家，他继承了莱布尼茨的思想：用类似代数的符号语言表达“思想”，并通过计算判定这些“思想”的真假。他在 1847 年的《逻辑的数学分析》中发展了这些观念，又在 1854 年的《思维规律》中作了更从容的阐述。他的工作涉及如今所谓的命题逻辑或布尔代数，即逻辑中最接近普通代数的部分。它有取值为“真”和“假”的“变量”，以及布尔称为“逻辑和”“逻辑积”的运算，与普通加法和乘法十分相似。在这部分逻辑中，确实可以用代数计算命题的真值。

George Boole was an Irish mathematician who took up Leibniz’s idea of expressing “thoughts” in a symbolic language, like algebra, and determining the truth of these “thoughts” by computation. He developed his ideas in The Mathematical Analysis of Logic in 1847 and, in more leisurely fashion, in his Laws of Thought of 1854. His work concerns what we now call propositional logic, or Boolean algebra: the part of logic that most closely resembles ordinary algebra. It has “variables” (which take the values “true” and “false”), and operations Boole called “logical sum” and “logical product” quite similar to ordinary sum and product. In this part of logic, it is indeed possible to compute the value (true or false) of a proposition by algebra.

戈特洛布·弗雷格是一位德国哲学家，关注数学的逻辑与概念。布尔寻求的是尽可能接近已知数学的“逻辑的数学”；弗雷格则不同，他寻求的是足以涵盖一切数学推理的“数学的逻辑”。弗雷格的逻辑如今称为谓词逻辑，因为其中既有表示谓词，即性质或关系的符号，也有表示个别数学对象的符号，还包含远超布尔“和”“积”的一系列逻辑运算。判定布尔代数中的一个命题是否恒真，是有限问题，因为可以代入变量的一切可能取值，逐一计算命题真值。但判定谓词逻辑中公式的真值，可能是无限问题，因为谓词可能有无限多个实例。例如，“n 是素数”对无限多个 n 为真，也对无限多个 n 为假。

Gottlob Frege was a German philosopher interested in the logic and concepts of mathematics. Unlike Boole, who sought a “mathematics of logic,” as close as possible to known mathematics, Frege sought a “logic of mathematics” broad enough to capture all mathematical reasoning. Frege’s logic is now called predicate logic because it contains symbols for predicates (properties or relations) as well as symbols for individual mathematical objects, along with an array of logical operations that go far beyond Boole’s “sum” and “product.” Deciding whether a proposition in Boolean algebra is always true is a finite problem, because one can substitute all possible values of the variables, and compute the truth value of the proposition for each. But deciding the truth value of a formula in predicate logic is potentially an infinite problem, because a predicate may have infinitely many instances. (For example, the predicate “n is prime” is true for infinitely many n and false for infinitely many n.)

由于范围广泛，谓词逻辑并不像代数。事实上，它最像的就是数学本身。谓词逻辑的真理作为定理，由逻辑公理按照推理规则推导出来。弗雷格在 1879 年的《概念文字》中建立了这一切，尽管采用了一套从未流行起来的古怪符号。他以某些显然的一般命题为公理，以某些显然的从旧命题推出新命题的方式为推理规则。弗雷格的逻辑与通常实践中的数学的区别，在于它完全形式化。其规则纯粹是操作符号的规则，即使不知道符号含义也能应用。从这个意义上说，弗雷格的逻辑也达到了莱布尼茨的目标，即“做到我们在算术中所能做到的一切”，在算术中，连机器都能进行加法和乘法。

Because of its wide scope, predicate logic does not resemble algebra. In fact, it resembles nothing so much as mathematics itself. One finds truths of predicate logic as theorems, derived from axioms of logic by rules of inference. Frege established all this (albeit with an eccentric symbolism that never caught on) in his 1879 book Begriffsschrifft (Concept Writing). He took as axioms certain obvious general propositions, and as rules of inference certain obvious ways of deriving new propositions from old. Where Frege’s logic differs from mathematics (as normally practised) is in being completely formal. His rules are purely rules for the manipulation of symbols, and they can be applied without knowing what the symbols mean. In this sense, Frege’s logic also meets Leibniz’s goal of “doing all that we can do in arithmetic,” where even a machine can add and multiply.

弗雷格及怀特海、罗素等后继者，希望使一切数学推理都像初等算术一样精确可靠。他们为数学引入符号语言和明确的推理规则，以消除证明中的缺口与未经察觉的假设。如第 3.1 节所述，怀特海与罗素的《数学原理》旨在表达并严格证明数学的一切定理。我们如今知道，它失败了。不过，值得指出的是，弗雷格的系统达到了一个几乎同样宏大的目标：证明所有逻辑有效公式，即在谓词符号的一切解释下都为真的公式。哥德尔于 1929 年证明了这一事实，也就是谓词逻辑的完备性；第 4.6 节将解释其原因。

Frege, and his successors such as Whitehead and Russell, wished to make all mathematical reasoning as precise and reliable as elementary arithmetic. They introduced symbolic languages for mathematics and explicit rules of inference to eliminate gaps and unconscious assumptions in proofs. As mentioned in Section 3.1, the Principia Mathematica of Whitehead and Russell was a system that aimed to express and rigorously prove all the theorems of mathematics. As we now know, it failed. However, it should be mentioned that Frege’s system achieves a goal almost as grandiose. It proves all logically valid formulas, that is, the formulas that are true under all interpretations of the predicate symbols. This fact—the completeness of predicate logic—was shown by Gödel in 1929, and in Section 4.6 we explain how it comes about.

希尔伯特纲领

Hilbert’s Program

为了达到我们的目标，即证明一致性，我们必须把证明本身作为研究对象；因此，我们不得不建立一种证明论，研究对证明本身所作的操作。

To reach our goal [of proving consistency], we must make the proofs as such the object of our investigation; we are thus compelled to a sort of proof theory which studies operations with the proofs themselves.

——戴维·希尔伯特（1922），引自 Ewald（1996）的译文，第二卷，第 1127 页。

—David Hilbert (1922) in the translation of Ewald (1996), vol. II, p. 1127

希尔伯特于 1900 年提出的 23 个数学问题中，第二个是“算术公理的相容性”问题；他指的是实数公理。希尔伯特并不怀疑自然数公理的一致性，但担忧数学中使用无限对象，例如实数集 ℝ。如第 1.8 节所述，集合论已经表明，某些无限对象，例如“所有集合组成的集合”，确实会导致矛盾，因此一切无限对象都受到怀疑。然而，随着符号逻辑的发展，希尔伯特看到了一条用有限手段为无限对象的使用辩护的道路。他希望，通过分析符号操作，能够说明使用这些对象不会导致矛盾。⁷

Second on the list of Hilbert’s 23 mathematical problems, posed in 1900, was the problem of the “compatibility of the arithmetical axioms,” by which he meant axioms for real numbers. Hilbert did not doubt that the axioms for natural numbers were consistent, but he was concerned about the use of infinite objects in mathematics, such as the set R of real numbers. As we know from Section 1.8, set theory had shown that certain infinite objects, such as the “set of all sets,” are definitely contradictory, so all infinite objects were suspect. With the development of symbolic logic, however, Hilbert saw a way to justify the use of infinite objects by finite means. He hoped that their use could be shown to be free of contradiction by analysis of symbol manipulation.7

这条思路引出了所谓希尔伯特纲领，旨在证明数学理论的一致性。它大致设想了以下通向成功的道路：

This train of thought led to the so-called Hilbert program for proving the consistency of mathematical theories. It envisioned roughly the following path to glory:

  1. 在精确定义的形式语言中，把关于无限对象的陈述表达为有限符号串。

    Express statements about infinite objects as finite strings of symbols in a precisely-defined formal language.

  2. 把推理规则表达为符号串上精确定义的操作。

    Express rules of inference as precisely-defined operations on symbol strings.

  3. 有限次应用推理规则，从公理符号串推导定理。

    Derive theorems from the axiom strings by finitely many applications of rules of inference.

  4. 通过关于符号串的纯粹有限推理，证明推理规则不会产生矛盾语句。

    Prove that the rules of inference produce no contradictory sentence, by purely finite reasoning about strings of symbols.

当然，第 1 至第 3 步已经由弗雷格、罗素等逻辑学家完成。第 4 步看起来像是自然数理论的任务，因为符号串类似于数码，而自然数的简单函数就能实现基本操作。希尔伯特忽略的是，即使数码上的简单操作，其结果也可能难以预见。在对有限推理作合理解释的情况下，哥德尔定理注定了希尔伯特纲领无法成功。

Of course, steps 1 to 3 were carried out by logicians such as Frege and Russell. Step 4 looked like a job for the theory of natural numbers, since strings of symbols are like numerals and simple functions of natural numbers realize basic operations. What Hilbert overlooked was that the outcome of even simple operations on numerals can be hard to foresee. Hilbert’s program, under a reasonable interpretation of finite reasoning, is doomed by Gödel’s theorems.

不过，这并不意味着形式化是在浪费时间，也不意味着一致性证明毫无内容。希尔伯特纲领至少有两个积极成果。

This does not mean, however, that formalization is a waste of time or that consistency proofs are vacuous. The Hilbert program has at least two positive outcomes.

  • 形式证明与数值计算一样，可以由机器检查。因此，如果某些定理的非形式证明难以理解，而我们能生成它们的形式证明，就能保证这些定理正确。最近，人们已对一些著名难定理做到这一点，例如 Jeremy Avigad 对素数定理的工作，以及 Georges Gonthier 对四色定理的工作。未来，我们也许能得到某些定理的机器可检查证明，而其证明实际上几乎不可能由任何一个人全部掌握，例如有限单群分类定理。

    Formal proofs, like numerical calculations, can be checked by machine. Therefore, if we can generate formal proofs of theorems whose informal proofs are hard to follow, we can guarantee that these theorems are correct. This has recently been done for some famous hard theorems, such as the prime number theorem (by Jeremy Avigad) and the four-color theorem (by Georges Gonthier). In the future, we may obtain machine-checkable proofs of theorems whose proofs are virtually impossible for any one person to grasp, such as the classification theorem for finite simple groups.

  • 一致性证明即使涉及无限推理，也可能揭示关于无穷的有趣陈述。根岑对皮亚诺算术，即 PA 的一致性证明就是如此，见第 5 章；它揭示了 ε0-归纳原理。由于 ε0-归纳蕴涵 Con(PA)，根据哥德尔第二定理，它不是 PA 的定理。仅这一点就使 ε0-归纳成为有趣的陈述。它还因为能够推出其他陈述，例如第 2.7 节的古德斯坦定理，而同样引人关注。

    Consistency proofs, even though they involve infinite reasoning, may bring to light interesting statements about infinity. This is the case with Gentzen’s consistency proof for Peano arithmetic, or PA (see Chapter 5), which brings to light the principle of ε0-induction. Since ε0-induction implies Con(PA), it is not a theorem of PA, by Gödel’s second theorem. This in itself makes ε0-induction an interesting statement. It is also interesting because of other statements it implies, such as the Goodstein theorem of Section 2.7.

哥德尔的先驱与后继者

Precursors and Successors of Gödel

波斯特是哥德尔和图灵最重要的先驱，因为他清楚把握了不完备性与不可解性的核心思想，以及两者之间的联系。诚然，对此我们只有波斯特本人的说法，但他后来的论文证实了其洞察力与独创性。我们知道，他于 1936 年独立于图灵发表了图灵机概念。他还于 1944 年发表了一篇关于可计算可枚举集的里程碑式论文，并于 1947 年发现了代数中第一个不可解问题，即半群的字问题，A. A. 马尔可夫也独立发现了它。波斯特为何能独立发现哥德尔不完备性，一个合理解释是：对角线论证已流传数十年，迟早会被应用于形式系统。波斯特关于不完备性和不可解性的著作，收录于马丁·戴维斯编辑的文集中，见 Post（1994）。

Post is the most important precursor of Gödel (and Turing) because he clearly grasped the essential ideas of incompleteness and unsolvability, and the connection between them. It is true that we only have Post’s word for this, but his later publications confirm his insight and originality. As we know, he published the Turing machine concept independently of Turing in 1936. He also published a watershed paper on computably enumerable sets in 1944, and in 1947 discovered the first example of an unsolvable problem in algebra (the word problem for semigroups, also discovered independently by A.A. Markov). A plausible explanation for Post’s independent discovery of Gödel incompleteness is that the diagonal argument had been in the air for decades, and it was bound to be applied in the setting of formal systems sooner or later. Post’s works on incompleteness and unsolvability are collected in the volume edited by Martin Davis (Post (1994)).

有证据表明，伟大的拓扑学家、也是特立独行的逻辑学家 L. E. J. 布劳威尔，早在 1907 年就预见了形式系统的不完备性。布劳威尔把对角线论证视为实数集永远“未完成”的证明，而不是不可数性的证明。他进一步在笔记中写道：“数学定理的全体，除其他性质外，也是一个可数但永远不会完成的集合。”然而，他从中得出的结论是：直觉才是数学唯一恰当的基础，任何东西都不能完全形式化，包括计算概念。关于布劳威尔早期与不完备性的接触，以及它甚至可能对哥德尔产生的影响，参见 van Atten 与 Kennedy（2009），第 498—499 页。如前所述，哥德尔本人起初也不愿相信计算能够形式化，但后来改变了立场。

There is evidence that the great topologist (and maverick logician) L. E. J. Brouwer anticipated the incompleteness of formal systems as early as 1907. Brouwer saw the diagonal argument as proof, not of uncountability, but rather of the eternally “unfinished” nature of the set of the real numbers. Carrying this idea further, he wrote in one of his notebooks that “The totality of mathematical theorems is, among other things, also a set which is denumerable but never finished.” However, the lesson Brouwer drew from this is that intuition is the only proper basis for mathematics, and nothing can be completely formalized, including the concept of computation. (For more on Brouwer’s early brush with incompleteness, which may even have influenced Gödel, see van Atten and Kennedy (2009), pp. 498-499.) As we have seen, Gödel himself was at first reluctant to believe that computation could be formalized, but later he reversed his position.

保罗·芬斯勒于 1926 年提出并发表了另一个有缺陷的哥德尔不完备性先声。芬斯勒关心的不是相对于特定形式系统的不完备性，而是绝对不可证明的结果。然而，哥德尔不完备性给我们的教训，恰恰是不存在绝对的证明概念，因此很难赋予芬斯勒的主张明确意义。为公平起见，应当指出，伟大的逻辑学家格哈德·根岑曾引用芬斯勒的论文，第 5 章将讨论根岑的工作。根岑似乎把芬斯勒视为不完备性的发现者。

Another flawed anticipation of Gödel incompleteness was made, and published, by Paul Finsler in 1926. Finsler was not interested in incompleteness relative to particular formal systems, but in absolutely unprovable results. However, the lesson of Gödel incompleteness is that there is no absolute notion of proof, so it is difficult to make sense of Finsler’s claims. (In fairness to Finsler, it should be mentioned that his paper was cited by the great logician Gerhard Gentzen, whose work we will discuss in Chapter 5. Gentzen seems to have viewed Finsler as the discoverer of incompleteness.)

哥德尔与图灵之后，不完备性研究一度停滞，但不可解性研究却蓬勃发展。波斯特 1944 年和 1947 年的论文，激发了大量关于不可解问题精细结构的研究，并推动人们在数学各领域寻找这类问题。继 1947 年半群理论的突破之后，由 A. A. 马尔可夫、P. S. 诺维科夫和 S. I. 阿江组成的俄罗斯学派，证明了群论与拓扑学中某些基本问题的不可解性，例如识别两个群是否同构，或两个流形是否同胚。这个故事的高潮，也许是尤里·马季亚谢维奇于 1970 年发现希尔伯特第十问题不可解。希尔伯特 1900 年问题表中的第十问题，要求找出一种算法，对任意整系数多项式 p(x1,x2,…,xn)，判定方程 p(x1,x2,…,xn)=0 是否有整数解。马季亚谢维奇证明，不存在这样的算法；根据波斯特的论证，任何一致的数学形式系统，都有某个以下形式的定理无法证明：

After Gödel and Turing, research on incompleteness stagnated for some time, but research on unsolvability flourished. The papers of Post in 1944 and 1947 launched a thousand investigations into the fine structure of unsolvable problems and a search for them in all parts of mathematics. Following the 1947 breakthrough into semigroup theory, the Russian school of A.A. Markov, P.S. Novikov, and S.I. Adian showed the unsolvability of some fundamental problems in group theory and topology (such as recognizing whether two groups are isomorphic, or whether two manifolds are homeomorphic). Perhaps the climax of this story was the discovery by Yuri Matiyasevich in 1970 that Hilbert’s tenth problem is unsolvable. The tenth problem on Hilbert’s list in 1900 was to find an algorithm which decides, for any polynomial p(x1, x2, xn) with integer coefficients, whether the equation p(x1, x2,…, xn ) = 0 has an integer solution. Matiyasevich showed that there is no such algorithm, and it follows, by Post’s argument, that any consistent formal system for mathematics fails to prove some theorem of the form

" p(x1,x2,…,xn)=0 没有解 ."

 " p(x1,x2,…,xn)=0 has no solution." 

20 世纪 60 至 70 年代，随着算术中新的不可证明语句类型被发现，哥德尔不完备性重新受到关注。⁸ 第 6 章将讨论 70 年代及以后的例子。这里仅介绍一个 60 年代的例子。

In the 1960s and 1970s, Gödel incompleteness made a comeback, with the discovery of new types of unprovable sentences in arithmetic.8 The examples from the 1970s (and later) will be discussed in Chapter 6. Here we mention only an example from the 1960s.

20 世纪 60 年代，几位数学家独立发现，计算与有限符号串的“随机性”或“不可压缩性”之间存在有趣联系。如今，许多人熟悉“压缩”的概念，因为计算机文件常被“压缩”以便存储。人们也熟悉，文件越“随机”，就越难压缩。例如，人群的数码照片所产生的文件，会比一面空白墙壁的照片更大。人们预期，真正随机的文件完全无法压缩。举一个简单例子，由连续 1,000,000 个零组成的串显然可以压缩，因为我们刚刚用大约 20 个英文符号描述了它，而生成它的图灵机程序也不会长得多，也许只需几百个符号。但随机序列，例如连续抛硬币 1,000,000 次的结果，将无法用比自身更短的序列描述。

In the 1960s, several mathematicians independently discovered that there is an interesting connection between computation and the “randomness” or “incompressibility” of finite strings of symbols. Today, the idea of “compression” is familiar to many people, since computer files are often “compressed” for easier storage. It is also familiar that the more “random” the file, the less it can be compressed—a digital photo of a crowd of people, for example, will yield a larger file than a photo of a blank wall. One expects that a truly random file will not be compressible at all. To take a simple example, a string of 1,000,000 consecutive zeros is surely compressible, because we have just described it (in English) in about 20 symbols, and a Turing machine program that generates it will not be vastly longer (maybe a few hundred symbols). But a random sequence—say, 1,000,000 consecutive coin tosses—will not be describable by any sequence shorter than itself.

这一基本思想可以如下形式化。考虑所有由 0 和 1 组成的有限符号串，以及某种通用程序设计语言中的所有程序，例如图灵机程序。若一个长为 n 的符号串 S，不是任何长度小于 n 的程序的输出，就称 S 不可压缩。为公平比较程序及其输出串，假定程序本身也编码为 0、1 串。于是，仅由以下事实就能推出不可压缩串存在：

The general idea may be formalized as follows. Consider all finite strings of 0s and 1s, and all programs in some universal programming language, such as Turing machine programs. We call a string S of n symbols incompressible if it is not the output of a program of length less than n. To make a fair comparison between programs and their output strings, let us assume that the programs themselves are encoded as strings of 0s and 1s. Then it follows that incompressible strings exist, simply because

  • 长度为 n 的符号串有 2n 个；

    there are 2n strings of length n,and

  • 长度小于 n 的程序至多有 2n-1+2n-2+…+2+1=2n−1 个。

    there are at most 2n−1 + 2n−2 + + 2 + 1 = 2n − 1 programs of length < n.

因此，不可压缩串有无限多个，每个长度 n 至少有一个。尽管如此，任何可靠的形式系统都只能证明有限多个“符号串 S 不可压缩”形式的定理。这种令人震惊的不完备性形式由格雷戈里·蔡廷于 1970 年发现；此前，他于 1965 年在纽约求学时发现了不可压缩串。其证明出奇简单，见前页。

Thus there are infinitely many incompressible strings—at least one of each length n. Despite this, no sound formal system can prove more than finitely many theorems of the form “string S is incompressible.” This startling form of incompleteness was discovered by Gregory Chaitin in 1970, following his discovery of incompressible strings in 1965 as a student in New York. The proof is surprisingly easy (see previous page).

蔡廷不完备性定理

Chaitin’s incompleteness theorem

任何可靠的形式系统，都只能证明有限多个“符号串 S 不可压缩”形式的定理。

Any sound formal system proves only finitely many theorems of the form “string S is incompressible.”

反设 M 是一个可靠的形式系统，能产生无限多个“符号串 S 不可压缩”形式的定理。可以把 M 视为一个图灵机程序，假设其编码长度为 106 个符号。由于 M 能找到无限多个不可压缩串，我们可以把它修改为机器 M′，在 M 证明不可压缩的串中搜索，直到找到一个长度至少为 109 的串 S′。显然，M′ 的编码不会比 M 长多少。但这样，串 S′ 就由比它自身更短的程序 M′ 生成，与 S′ 的不可压缩性矛盾。

Suppose, on the contrary, that M is a sound formal system that produces infinitely many theorems of the form “string S is incompressible.” We may take M to be a Turing machine program, whose encoded form has length, say, 106 symbols. Since M finds infinitely many incompressible strings, we can modify it to a machine M′ that searches through the strings proved incompressible by M until it finds one, S′, of length at least 109. Clearly, the encoded form of M′ is not much longer than that of M. But then the string S′ is generated by the program M′ shorter than S′,contrary to the incompressibility of S′.

蔡廷不完备性与哥德尔或波斯特的不完备性不同：不能从形式系统 M 出发，以统一方式计算出一个“符号串 S 不可压缩”形式的不可证明语句。假如能够，就可以反复进行这一计算，生成无限多个这样的语句，从而像蔡廷定理本身的证明那样，与不可压缩性矛盾。

Chaitin’s incompleteness differs from that of Gödel (or Post) in that we cannot uniformly compute an unprovable sentence of the form “string S is incompressible” from the formal system M. If we could, then we could iterate the computation to generate infinitely many such sentences—contradicting incompressibility as in the proof of Chaitin’s theorem itself.

蔡廷的论证还给出了一个奇特的不可解问题：判定哪些 0、1 串能被图灵机程序压缩。这个问题有一个非凡特征：我们能机械地找出所有答案为“是”的实例，方法是运行所有图灵机程序，收集那些比程序自身更长的 0、1 输出串；但对于答案为“否”的实例，只能找到有限多个。波斯特在 1944 年的论文中设计过这类问题，但蔡廷的例子是第一个其待判定性质本身就具有独立意义的例子。

Chaitin’s argument also yields a curious unsolvable problem: deciding which strings of 0s and 1s are compressible by Turing machine programs.This problem has the remarkable feature that we can mechanically find all of the “yes” instances (by running all Turing machine programs and harvesting the outputs that are 0−1 strings longer than the programs themselves), but only finitely many of the “no” instances. Post devised such problems in his 1944 paper, but Chaitin’s was the first example for which the property to be decided has independent interest.

Davis（2004）是查阅哥德尔、丘奇、波斯特和图灵大多数基础论文的便利来源，其中包括未发表的 Post（1941），该文描述了波斯特如何先于哥德尔和图灵预见相关结果。van Heijenoort（1967）则收录了颇为不同的一组论文，包括芬斯勒那篇有缺陷的论文。

A convenient source for most of the basic papers of Gödel, Church, Post and Turing, including the unpublished paper Post (1941) that describes his anticipation of Gödel and Turing, is Davis (2004). A rather different selection, including the flawed paper of Finsler, is in van Heijenoort (1967).

注释

Notes

1　波斯特的大部分工作当时没有发表，原因见 Urquhart（2009）。他向正规形式的归约首次见于 Post（1943）。把一个典型符号逻辑系统归约为正规系统的例子，可参见 Rosenbloom（1950）的附录。

1Most of Post’s work was not published at the time, for reasons that are explained in Urquhart (2009). His reduction to normal form first appeared in Post (1943). A reduction of a typical system of symbolic logic to a normal system may be seen in the appendix of Rosenbloom (1950).

2　De Mol（2008）最近给出了简单系统难以处理的一个漂亮例子：她证明，著名的“3n+1 问题”等价于一个使用三个字母、且符号串 g 长度为 2 的标签系统。

2A nice example of the intractability of simple systems was given recently by De Mol (2008), when she showed that the notorious “3n + 1 problem” is equivalent to a tag system on three letters in which the strings g have length 2.

3　回顾起来，可以说波斯特版本的《数学原理》是第一台通用计算机，尽管当时无人知道这一点。事实上，那还是“计算机”一词指进行计算的人的年代。

3In retrospect, we can say that Post’s version of Principia Mathematica was the first universal computer, though no one knew it at the time. In fact, those were the days in which “computers” were people who did computations.

4　似乎不存在完全自然的算术化方法。我所知道最简单的方法是 Smullyan（1961），它只使用数码及其连接的思想。这里的算术化概述采用了类似思想。第 7.1 节将讨论一种实质上与算术相同的有限集合论。集合论提供了更容易的形式系统“算术化”方式，尽管它可能只在集合论研究者看来才容易。

4There seems to be no completely natural way to carry out arithmetization. The simplest I know of, which uses only the ideas of numerals and their concatenation, is Smullyan (1961). My sketch of arithmetization uses similar ideas. In Section 7.1 we will discuss a finite set theory that is essentially the same as arithmetic. Set theory offers an easier way to “arithmetize” formal systems, though it probably seems easy only to set theorists.

5　丘奇的可计算性概念称为 λ 演算，同样源于对证明概念的分析；具体而言，丘奇试图以函数概念为基础，构造一个用于逻辑与数学的形式系统。如今，计算机科学界已认识到 λ 演算是理论计算机科学中的有力概念。不过，对初学者而言，它仍然不太友好。

5Church’s computability concept, called lambda calculus, also arose from an analysis of the concept of proof—in Church’s case from an attempt to construct a formal system for logic and mathematics based on the concept of function. Lambda calculus has been recognized by the computer science community today as a powerful concept in theoretical computer science. However, it remains a rather unfriendly concept for beginners.

6　在许多网站上都可以阅读或收听希尔伯特的演说。不过，由于网站有时会失效，寻找它的最佳方式是在搜索引擎中输入“hilbert”“radio”和“address”。

6Hilbert’s address can be read or heard at various web sites. But since web sites sometimes expire, the best way to find it is to enter the words “hilbert,” “radio,” and “address” in a search engine.

7　人们通常认为，希尔伯特是一个“形式主义者”，希望从数学中清除直觉，代之以纯粹的符号操作。实际上，希尔伯特十分相信直觉，但他认识到，符号操作是每个人都具有相同直觉的领域，至少所有能阅读的人都是如此，而数学的读者想必都在此列！因此，如果希望所有人都接受我们的结论，就应当把一切证明化归为符号操作。在上引 Hilbert（1922）论文的第 1122 页，希尔伯特用一句口号表达了这一观点：太初有符号。

7It is commonly thought that Hilbert was a “formalist” who wished to purge intuition from mathematics in favor of pure symbol manipulation. Actually, Hilbert was a great believer in intuition, but he recognized that symbol manipulation is the area where everyone has the same intuition. (Or, at least, everyone who can read—which presumably covers the audience for mathematics!) All proofs should, therefore, be reduced to symbol manipulations if we want everyone to accept our conclusions. In the Hilbert (1922) paper quoted above, p. 1122, Hilbert expressed this view by the slogan: In the beginning was the sign.

8　在另一条发展线上，人们在集合论中发现了不完备性。第 2 章已经提到选择公理和连续统假设的例子。我们称这些语句“不可判定”，而不是“不可证明”，因为尚不确定究竟是这些语句还是它们的否定为真。第 7 章将讨论其他一些集合论语句，其不可证明性相当容易展示。

8In a separate development, incompleteness was discovered in set theory. We have mentioned the examples of the axiom of choice and the continuum hypothesis in Chapter 2. We call these sentences “undecidable,” rather than “unprovable,” because we are unsure what is true—the sentences or their negations. Other sentences of set theory, whose unprovability is quite easy to show, will be discussed in Chapter 7.

第 4 章　逻辑

- Chapter 4 - Logic

概览

Preview

哥德尔第二不完备性定理似乎告诉我们，试图证明算术的一致性是徒劳的。但为什么不试试看呢？也许会发生有趣的事情，而事实确实如此。为说明这一点，我们需要精确描述形式逻辑及其向形式算术的扩展。本章将形式化表达逻辑与算术所需的语言，以及在相应语言中生成证明所需的规则，然后重新考察完备性与一致性问题。

Gödel’s second incompleteness theorem seems to tell us that it is futile to try to prove the consistency of arithmetic. But why not try anyway? Something interesting may happen, and it does. To explain what, we need to give a precise description of formal logic and its extension to formal arithmetic. In this chapter we formalize the languages needed to express logic and arithmetic, and the rules needed to generate proofs in the relevant languages, then reconsider the questions of completeness and consistency.

从历史上看，最重要的逻辑规则是分离规则，即古老的规则：若 A 成立，且 A 蕴涵 B，就可以推出 B。分离规则的现代版本称为切割，因为前提中的语句 A 被从结论中切除了。尽管历史悠久，切割规则实际上却是进行逻辑推演的“错误”方式，因为不用它，纯逻辑反而可以处理得更简单。第 4.3 和 4.4 节将说明如何做到这一点。

Historically, the most important rule of logic is modus ponens, the ancient rule that if A holds, and A implies B,then we may infer B.The modern version of modus ponens is called cut, because the sentence A in the premises is cut out of the conclusion. Despite its pedigree, the cut rule is actually the “wrong” way to do logic, because pure logic can be done more simply without it. We explain how in Sections 4.3 and 4.4.

我们把逻辑分为命题逻辑，即“且”“或”“非”的逻辑，以及谓词逻辑，即个体 x、y、z、……之间的关系以及量词“对所有 x”和“存在一个 x”的逻辑。命题逻辑在某种意义上是谓词逻辑的“有限部分”，因此自然应先研究它。随后，谓词逻辑的关键性质，即完备性，就可以看作命题逻辑完备性的自然推广。

We separate logic into propositional logic (the logic of “and,” “or,” and “not”), and predieate logic (the logic of relations between individuals x, y, z,… and the quantifiers “for all x” and “there exists an x”). Propositional logic is in some sense the “finite part” of predicate logic, so it is natural to study it first. Then the key property of predicate logic— its completeness—can be seen as a natural extension of completeness for propositional logic.

逻辑是完备的，意思是存在一个一致的形式系统，能够证明所有有效语句，也就是在一切解释下都为真的语句。逻辑的一致性相对容易证明，但完备性却相当非凡，当然也与算术的情形形成鲜明对照。

Logic is complete in the sense that we have a consistent formal system that proves all sentences that are valid, that is, true under all interpretations. Consistency of logic is relatively trivial, but completeness is quite remarkable (and of course in sharp contrast to the case of arithmetic).

4.1　命题逻辑

4.1 Propositional Logic

最简单的逻辑是关于命题的逻辑，即命题逻辑。命题，也称语句，是具有确定真值，即真或假的陈述。因此，“1+1=3”是命题，但问题“1+1=3 吗？”不是，命令“令 1+1=3”也不是。在命题逻辑中，不分析命题的内部结构，而用 P、Q、R、……这样的变量表示命题，其唯一特征是可以取“真”与“假”两个值。这种二值变量称为布尔变量，以纪念布尔；他在 1847 年的《逻辑的数学分析》中引入了这种研究命题逻辑的方法。

The simplest kind of logic is the logic of propositions, or propositional logic. Propositions (also known as sentences) are utterances that have a definite truth value,true or false. Thus “1 + 1 = 3” is a proposition, but the question “Is 1 + 1 = 3?” is not, and neither is the command “Let 1 + 1 = 3.” In propositional logic, the internal structure of propositions is not analyzed, so they are denoted by variables such as P, Q, R,… whose only characteristic is that they can take the values “true” and “false.” Such two-valued variables are known as Boolean variables,after Boole, who introduced this approach to propositional logic in his book The Mathematical Analysis of Logic in 1847.

由于每个变量只能取两个值，布尔变量的布尔值函数 f 可以用一张有限表来指定：对变量的有限多种取值组合，逐一给出 f 的值。下面是几个重要布尔函数的表：用 ¬P 表示的一元函数，以及用 P∨Q 和 P∧Q 表示的二元函数。我们分别用 T 和 F 表示“真”与“假”。

Since each variable can take only two values, a Boolean-valued function f of Boolean variables can be specified by a finite table, giving the value of f for each of the finitely many combinations of values of its variables. Here are the tables for some important Boolean functions: a function of one variable denoted by ¬P, and functions of two variables denoted by P ∨ Q and P ∧ Q. We denote the values “true” and “false” by T and F respectively.

P ¬P
F T
T F
P Q P∨Q
F F F
F T T
T F T
T T T
P Q P∧Q
F F F
F T F
T F F
T T T

函数 ¬P 当然就是第 3.1 节介绍的否定函数“非 P”。函数 P∨Q 表示“P 或 Q”，其中“或”采用数学中通常使用的相容意义：“P 或 Q，或两者都成立。”P∨Q 也称为 P 与 Q 的析取。函数 P∧Q 表示“P 且 Q”，也称为 P 与 Q 的合取。这些表称为真值表。函数 ∧、∨ 和 ¬ 赋予命题逻辑日常语言中的解释；利用这种解释，可以说明任何布尔函数都能用“且”“或”“非”表达。

The function ¬P is of course the negation function “not P”that we introduced in Section 3.1. The function P ∨ Q is the function “P or Q,” where “or” is understood in the inclusive sense that is usual in mathematics: “ P or Q or both.” P ∨ Q is also called the disjunction of P and Q. The function P ∧ Q is the function “P and Q,” also called the conjunction of P and Q. The tables are called truth tables. The functions ∧, ∨, and ¬ nterpret propositional logic in ordinary speech, and we can take advantage of this interpretation to show that any Boolean function can be expressed in terms of “and,” “or,” and “not.”

举一个例子就足以说明原因。考虑由下列真值表给出的函数 f(P,Q)。

One example should suffice to explain why this is so. Consider the function f (P, Q) given by the following truth table.

P Q f(P,Q)
F F F
F T T
T F F
T T T

这张表说明，f(P,Q) 为真，当且仅当

This table says that f (P, Q) is true if and only if

（P 不为真且 Q 为真）或（P 为真且 Q 为真）。

(P is not true and Q is true) or (P is true and Q is true).

因此，f(P,Q) 与函数 ((¬P)∧Q)∨(P∧Q) 相同。显然，任何真值表都能类似地用 ∧、∨ 和 ¬ 表达：对每一条取值为 T 的行，写出相应变量与否定变量的合取，再把这些合取作析取即可。

Thus f (P, Q) is the same as the function ((¬P) ∧ Q) ∨ (P ∧ Q). Clearly, any truth table can be similarly expressed in terms of A, V,and ¬:just write down the conjunction of variables and negated variables for each line that gives the value T, then take the disjunction of these conjunctions.

对数学特别重要的一个布尔函数是 P⇒Q，在日常语言中表达为“若 P 则 Q”或“P 蕴涵 Q”。其真值表如下。

A particularly important Boolean function for mathematics is the function P ⇒ Q, expressed by “If P then Q”or “P implies Q”in ordinary speech. Its truth table is

P Q P ⇒ Q
F F T
F T T
T F F
T T T

它恰好与 (¬P)∨Q 的真值表相同。事实上，每个布尔函数都能用 ¬ 和 ∨ 表达。我们已经知道，每个布尔函数都能用 ∧、∨ 和 ¬ 表达。此外，∧ 也能用 ¬ 和 ∨ 表达，因为“P 且 Q”成立，当且仅当“P 为假或 Q 为假”这一陈述为假，即：

which happens to be the same as the truth table for (¬P) ∨ Q.In fact, every Boolean function can be expressed in terms of ¬ and ∨. We already know that every Boolean function can be expressed in terms of ∧, ∨,and ¬.Also, ∧ can be expressed in terms of ¬ and ∨ because “P and Q” holds if and only if “it is false that P is false or Q is false,” that is:

P∧Q=¬((¬P)∨(¬Q)).

因此，所有布尔函数都能仅用 ¬ 和 ∨ 表达。实际上，也可以用单个二元函数表达所有布尔函数，例如“或非”函数 (¬P)∧(¬Q)，但这样做的好处并不多。函数对 {¬,∨} 能为命题逻辑给出一个特别漂亮的形式系统，下一节就会看到。

Thus all Boolean functions can be expressed in terms of ¬ and ∨ alone. It is in fact possible to express all Boolean functions in terms of a single function of two variables (for example the “nor” function (¬P) ∧ ¬ (Q)), but there are not many benefits in doing so. The pair of functions {¬, ∨} gives a particularly nice formal system for propositional logic, as we will see in the next section.

命题逻辑的主要问题是什么？一个显然的候选是：判定用变量 P1、P2、……、Pn 以及函数 ∧、∨ 和 ¬ 写成的给定语句是否有效，即在变量的一切解释下是否都为真。由于 n 个变量 P1、P2、……、Pn 共有 2×2×⋯×2=2n 种赋予 T 或 F 的方式，只需对每种赋值利用 ∧、∨ 和 ¬ 的真值表计算语句的值，就能解决有效性问题。例如，下面的计算表明，无论变量 P 取何值，P∨(¬P) 的值都是 T，因此 P∨(¬P) 有效。

What is the main problem of propositional logic? An obvious candidate is the problem of deciding whether a given sentence, written in terms of variables P1, P2,…, Pn and the functions ∧, ∨,and ¬ is valid, that is, true under all interpretations of the variables. Since the n variables P1, P2,…, Pn can be assigned values T or F in 2 × 2 ×⋯2 = 2n different ways, the validity problem can be solved by computing the value of the sentence (using the truth tables for ∧, ∨,and—) for each assignment of values. For example, here is a computation showing that P ∨ ¬ (P) has value T for each value of the variable P,so P ∨ (¬P) is valid.

P ¬P P∨(¬P)
F T T
T F T

这种方法也解决了可满足性问题，即判定是否存在一种变量赋值，使语句的值为 T。能以有限过程解决这两个问题当然很好，但这并不是一般逻辑或数学中的典型情形，因为其中的求值过程通常是无限的。

This method also solves the satisfiability problem, which is to decide whether a sentence has the value T for some assignment of value to the variables. It is certainly nice to have a finite solution to both of these problems, though it is not typical of logic or mathematics in general, where the process of evaluation is usually infinite.

为了理解一般逻辑，更好的做法是为命题逻辑找出一个形式系统，以有效语句为其定理。下面两节将考察这样的形式系统。

For an understanding of logic in general it is better to find a formal system for propositional logic, which produces the valid sentences as theorems. We look at such formal systems in the next two sections.

4.2　一个经典系统

4.2 A Classical System

读者……也许会指出，所提出的这个定理不仅显然，而且比任何一条公理都更显然。

The reader …may be led to remark that this proposed theorem is not only obvious but more obvious than any of the axioms.

——阿隆佐·丘奇（1956），第 81 页。

—Alonzo Church (1956), p. 81.

如上所述，经典的命题逻辑形式系统高度依赖分离规则，也就是切割规则，

As mentioned above, classical formal systems for propositional logic rely heavily on the modus ponens or cut rule,

由 P⇒Q 和 P 推出 Q,

 from P⇒Q and P infer Q, 

来证明定理。这类系统起源于 19 世纪 80 年代弗雷格的工作，后来因怀特海与罗素的巨著《数学原理》而广为流传，该书第一卷出版于 1910 年。

to prove theorems. Such systems originated in the 1880s with Frege, and they were popularized in the monumental Principia Mathematica of Whitehead and Russell, the first volume of which appeared in 1910.

丘奇的《数理逻辑导论》（1956）给出了这类系统的一个典型例子。它有以下三条公理：

A typical system of this type appears in the Introduction to Mathematical Logic of Church (1956). It has the following three axioms:

P⇒(Q⇒P) (后件肯定) ((S⇒(P⇒Q))⇒((S⇒P)⇒(S⇒Q))) (蕴涵的自分配律)¬¬P⇒P (double negation)

P⇒(Q⇒P)  (affirmation of the consequent) ((S⇒(P⇒Q))⇒((S⇒P)⇒(S⇒Q)))        (self-distribution of implication)¬¬P⇒P         (double negation)

正如丘奇在上面的引文中所暗示的，这些公理并非完全显然。不过，可以用真值表检验其有效性。于是显然，通过切割规则以及一条代入规则推出的结果也有效；代入规则允许把 P、Q 或 S 的所有出现位置，都替换为任意由变量以及 ¬、⇒ 符号构成的语句。

As Church suggests in the quotation above, these axioms are not entirely obvious. However, it is possible to check their validity by truth tables. It is then clear that we have validity of their consequences by the cut rule and a rule of substitution that allows P, Q,or S to be replaced (everywhere it occurs) by any sentence built from variables and the ¬ and ⇒ symbols.

到这里都很好。但不妨试着证明一个命题，例如“显然”的语句 P⇒P。其证明不仅难找，即使别人替你找到了，也很难读懂：

So far, so good. But try proving something, say, the “obvious” sentence P ⇒ P. A proof is not just hard to find—it is hard to read, even if someone finds it for you:

(P⇒(Q⇒P))⇒((P⇒Q)⇒(P⇒P))P⇒(Q⇒P)         (P⇒Q)⇒(P⇒P)              (P⇒(Q⇒P))⇒(P⇒P)       P⇒P

下面作些说明，省略的一些代入步骤留给读者。

Here is an explanation (minus some substitutions we leave to the reader).

  • 第 1 行是第二条公理的一个代入实例。

    Line 1 is a substitution instance of the second axiom.

  • 第 2 行是第一条公理。

    Line 2 is the first axiom.

  • 第 3 行由第 2 行和第 1 行通过切割得到。

    Line 3 comes from lines 2 and 1 by cut.

  • 第 4 行是第 3 行的一个代入实例。

    Line 4 is a substitution instance of line 3.

  • 第 5 行由第 2 行和第 4 行通过切割得到。

    Line 5 comes from lines 2 and 4 by cut.

熟悉数学的读者，也许不会惊讶于为了证明一个短语句而绕道经过一系列长语句。毕竟，在数学中，短语句具有长证明相当常见，例如“对正整数 x、y、z 和 n>2，有 xn+yn≠zn”。这也许就是逻辑学家长期容忍这种形式系统，而且至今仍在使用它的原因。但既然有直路，为什么还要绕道呢？我们已经知道判定有效性的直接方法，即真值表；事实上，也有直接证明有效语句的方法。

Mathematical readers may not be surprised at making a detour through a series of long sentences in order to prove a short one. After all, it is quite common in mathematics for a short sentence to have a long proof. (For example, the sentence “xn + yn = zn for positive integers x, y, z and n > 2.”) This may be why logicians tolerated this formal system for so long (and still do). But why take a detour when there is a direct route? We already know a direct method for deciding validity (truth tables), and in fact there is also a direct method for proving valid sentences.

使证明更直接的关键，是不用切割规则。从上面的证明可以看到，允许切割时，定理 S 的证明可能涉及很长的中间语句，而这些语句与 S 的关系并不显然。理想情况下，S 的证明应当经过比 S 简单的语句，逐步走向 S。特别是，公理应当是尽可能简单的有效语句，即形如 P⇒P 的语句。

The key to making proofs more direct is to do without the cut rule. As we can see from the proof above, when cuts are allowed the proof of a theorem S may involve long intermediate sentences not obviously related to S. Ideally, the proof of S should move towards S through sentences simpler than S .In particular, the axioms should be the simplest possible valid sentences, namely, sentences of the form P ⇒ P.

事实上，命题逻辑确实有一个无切割形式系统，以 P⇒P 为公理；用 ¬ 和 ∨ 写，就是 P∨¬P，或 ¬P∨P，因为顺序无关紧要。我们选择用 ¬ 和 ∨ 表达所有布尔函数，并非因为非如此不可，而是因为这样能得到一个特别简单的系统，下一节将看到这一点。认识到证明的自然形状不是线性的，而是树形的，这种简单性就会显现出来。

There is in fact a cut-free formal system for propositional logic based on the axioms P ⇒ P,which we write in terms of ¬ and ∨ as P ∨ P (or ¬ P ∨P, since the order does not matter). We choose ¬ and ∨ to express all Boolean functions not because it is essential, but because it gives a particularly simple system, as we will see in the next section. The simplicity emerges when one realizes that proofs are not naturally linear, but, rather, tree-shaped.

参见图 4.1，这是卡斯帕·大卫·弗里德里希的《乌鸦树》。在逻辑中，树形结构来自尝试一切可能方式来证伪语句 S；事实证明，这比直接尝试证明 S 更好。

(See Figure 4.1, which is Caspar David Friedrich’s Tree of Crows.) In logic, the tree shape arises from trying all possible ways to falsify the sentence S, which turns out to be a better idea than trying to prove S directly.

4.3　命题逻辑的一个无切割系统

4.3 A Cut-Free System for Propositional Logic

也许我们可以这样表达正规证明的本质特征：它不绕弯路。

Perhaps we may express the essential properties of a normal proof by saying: it is not roundabout.

——格哈德·根岑（1935）

—Gerhard Gentzen (1935)

M. E. Szabo 英译，载于 Gentzen（1969），第 69 页。

Translation by M.E. Szabo in Gentzen (1969), p. 69.

第 4.1 节中我们看到，可以从命题逻辑的任意有效语句出发，经过一个过程，最终得到一组非常简单的东西，即该语句在每种变量赋值下的值 T，从而识别其有效性。反过来，如何从某些简单的东西，例如公理出发，最终得到任意有效语句，正如形式系统应当做到的那样，就不那么容易看清。倒过来从语句走向公理，似乎更容易，因此我们就这样做。

In Section 4.1 we saw that any valid sentence of propositional logic can be recognized by a process that begins with the sentence and ends with a collection of very simple things—the values T of the sentence under each assignment of values to its variables. It is harder to see how one might begin with some simple things (such as axioms) and end up with an arbitrary valid sentence, as is supposed to happen in a formal system. It appears easier to work backwards, from sentence to axioms, so that is what we will do.

给定一个由 ¬、∨ 和变量 P1、P2、……构成的语言中的语句 S，我们尝试证伪 S，寻找 S 中的某些部分，使这些部分在某种变量赋值下为假时，S 也为假。如果最终到达显然无法证伪的公式，也就是公理，从而尝试失败，就能断定 S 有效。然后，把这次证伪尝试反过来，就得到 S 的一个证明。

Given a sentence S in the language with ¬, ∨ and variables P1, P2,…, we try to falsify S by finding parts of S whose falseness (for some values to the variables) would make S false. If we fail, by reaching formulas that obviously cannot be falsified—namely, axioms—then we can conclude that S is valid. Then, by reversing the attempted falsification, we obtain a proof of S.

由于所有语句都是由 ¬ 和 ∨ 构成的布尔函数，任意语句 S 要么是一个变量，要么形如 A∨ℬ，要么形如 ¬C。

Given that all sentences are Boolean functions built from ¬ and ∨ any sentence S is either a variable, of the form A∨ℬ, or of the form ¬C.

只有同时证伪 A 和 ℬ，才能证伪 A∨ℬ；此时我们把这两部分放在一起，考察其内部。同样，为判定 ¬C 是否可证伪，要考察 C 的内部，并根据 C 是 ¬A 还是 A1∨A2，分别采取以下步骤。

A∨ℬ can be falsified onlybyfalsifying both A and ℬ, in which case we keep these two parts together and look inside them. Likewise, to decide whether ¬C can be falsified, we look inside C and act as follows, according as C is ¬A or A1∨A2.

  1. 通过证伪 A，可以证伪形如 ¬¬A 的语句。

    A sentence of the form ¬¬A is falsified by falsifying A.

    因为若 A=F，则 ¬¬A=¬¬F=F。

    (Because if A=F then ¬¬A=¬¬F=F.)

  2. 通过证伪 ¬A1 或 ¬A2，可以证伪形如 ¬(A1∨A2) 的语句。

    A sentence of the form ¬(A1∨A2) is falsified by falsifying ¬A1 or ¬A2.

    因为例如若 ¬A1=F，则 ¬(A1∨A2)=¬(T∨A2)=¬T=F。

    (Because if, say, ¬A1=F  then ¬(A1∨A2)=¬(T∨A2)=¬T=F.)

更一般地，可以把与任意语句 ℬ 的析取一并带上，并把可证伪性表述为双向关系，即：

More generally, we can carry along the disjunction with any sentence ℬ, and state falsifiability in both directions, namely:

¬¬-证伪。一种赋值使 ¬¬A∨ℬ 为假，当且仅当它使 A∨ℬ 为假。

¬¬-falsification. An assignment makes ¬¬A∨ℬ false if and only if it makes A∨ℬ false.

¬∨-证伪。一种赋值使 ¬(A1∨A2)∨ℬ 为假，当且仅当它使 ¬A1∨ℬ 或 ¬A2∨ℬ 中至少一个为假。

¬∨-falsification. An assignment makes ¬(A1∨A2)∨ℬ false if and only if it makes at least one of ¬A1∨ℬ or ¬A2∨ℬ false.

我们按图 4.2 所示的图式应用规则：顶行语句可证伪，当且仅当其下方某个语句可证伪。对任意语句 S 应用这些规则，会得到一棵以 S 为根、分支向下的树，各分支终止于不含 ¬¬A 或 ¬(A1∨A2) 的语句。这意味着，每个分支末端的语句只是变量或否定变量的析取；而 S 可证伪，当且仅当某个分支末端的语句可证伪。

We apply the rules diagrammatically as shown in Figure 4.2: the sentence in the top line is falsifiable if and only if one of the sentences below it is falsifiable. Applying these rules to any sentence S gives a tree with root S and downward branches, ending in sentences with no occurrence of ¬¬A or ¬(A1∨A2). This means that the sentence at the end of each branch is simply a disjunction of variables or negated variables, and we can falsify S if and only if we can falsify some sentence at the end of a branch.

例。S=(P⇒Q)⇒(¬Q⇒¬P)。

Example. S=(P⇒Q)⇒(¬Q⇒¬P)

把每个 A⇒B 改写为 (¬A)∨B，并尽可能省略括号，得到

Rewriting each A⇒B as (¬A)∨B, and omitting parentheses where possible, we obtain

S=¬(¬P∨Q)∨(¬¬Q∨¬P)=¬(¬P∨Q)∨¬¬Q∨¬P

随后，对后一个语句应用 ¬¬-证伪和 ¬∨-证伪，得到图 4.3 的树，其根为 S=¬(¬P∨Q)∨¬¬Q∨¬P。分支末端的语句是 P∨Q∨¬P 和 ¬Q∨Q∨¬P。两者都不能被证伪，因为各自都包含某个变量的两种形式，即带否定号与不带否定号。因此，原语句 S 有效。

Then, applying ¬¬and¬ ∨-falsification to the latter sentence, we obtain the tree shown in Figure 4.3, with root S =¬ (¬P ∨ Q) ∨¬¬Q ∨¬P. The sentences at the ends of the branches are P ∨ Q ∨¬P and ¬Q ∨ Q ∨¬P. Neither of these can be falsified, because each contains a variable in both forms—with and without a negation sign. Thus the original sentence S is valid.

显然，变量和否定变量的析取，只有在每个变量都仅以一种形式出现时，才可能被证伪。例如，赋值 P=F、Q=T 可以证伪 P∨¬Q∨P。因此，语句 S 有效，当且仅当通过 ¬¬-证伪和 ¬∨-证伪产生的每个分支，都终止于一个包含某个变量的带否定号与不带否定号两种形式的语句。

Clearly, a disjunction of variables and negated variables can be falsified only if each variable occurs in only one form. For example, P ∨¬Q ∨ P can be falsified by assigning the values P = F, Q = T.Thus a sentence S is valid if and only if each branch produced by¬¬-and ¬∨-falsification ends in a sentence in which some variable appears both with and without a negation sign.

现在考虑把这个过程反过来。我们取：

Now consider the reverse of this process. We take as:

公理。变量与否定变量的一切析取，其中某个变量同时以带否定号和不带否定号的形式出现。

Axioms. All disjunctions of variables and negated variables in which some variable appears both with and without a negation sign.

规则。¬¬-证伪和 ¬∨-证伪的定向版本，即：

Rules. Directed versions of ¬¬and ¬∨-falsification, namely:

¬¬ −规则.由 A∨ℬ 推出 ¬¬A∨ℬ . ¬∨ −规则.由 ¬A1∨ℬ 和 ¬A2∨ℬ 推出 ¬(A1∨A2)∨ℬ .

¬¬ −rule.From A∨ℬ infer ¬¬A∨ℬ . ¬∨ −rule.From ¬A1∨ℬ and ¬A2∨ℬ infer ¬(A1∨A2)∨ℬ .

若对有效语句 S 应用 ¬¬-证伪和 ¬∨-证伪，消去所有 ¬¬A 与 ¬(A1∨A2)，结果就是一棵各分支终止于公理的树。因此，从下往上阅读证伪树，就得到一个使用 ¬¬ 规则和 ¬∨ 规则的 S 的证明。所以，我们的公理和规则对命题逻辑是完备的：它们能证明由函数 ¬ 和 ∨ 构成的所有有效语句；而我们已经看到，这两个函数足以表达一切布尔函数。

If we apply ¬¬and ¬∨-falsification to a valid sentence S so as to remove all occurrences of ¬¬A and ¬(A1∨A2), the result is a tree whose branches end in axioms. Therefore, if we read the falsification tree from bottom to top, the result is a proof of S by the ¬¬and ¬∨-rules. Our axioms and rules are therefore complete for propositional logic: they prove all valid sentences built from the functions ¬ and ¬∨, which, as we have seen, suffice to express all Boolean functions.

必须承认，这套公理与规则并未完全明确。我们悄悄假定，可以忽略析取中的括号和各项的顺序。这些假定可以用额外规则形式化：

It must be admitted that this system of axioms and rules is not completely explicit. We have quietly assumed that it is permissible to ignore parentheses and the order of terms in a disjunction. These assumptions can be formalized by extra rules:

重新分组。由 A∨(ℬ∨C) 推出 (A∨ℬ)∨C，反之亦然。

Regrouping. From A∨(ℬ∨C) infer (A∨ℬ)∨C,and vice versa.

交换。由 A∨ℬ 推出 ℬ∨A。

Exchange. From A∨ℬ infer ℬ∨A.

此外，若加入所谓的弱化规则，就能把公理简化为形如 Pi∨¬Pi 的一切语句：

Also, we can simplify the axioms to be all sentences of the form Pi ∨¬Pi if we include the so-called dilution rule:

弱化。由 A 推出 A∨ℬ。

Dilution. From A infer A∨ℬ.

最后，借助收缩规则，可以忽略重复：

Finally, we can ignore repetitions by the consolidation rule:

收缩。由 A∨A∨ℬ 推出 A∨ℬ。

Consolidation. From A∨A∨ℬ infer A∨ℬ.

这些推理规则有一个理想性质：前提在某种意义上“包含于”结论中。与使用切割规则的证明不同，这里不会绕道经过比待证语句更复杂的语句。

These rules of inference have the desirable property that the premises are in some sense “contained in” the conclusion. Unlike proofs using the cut rule, there are no “detours” through sentences more complicated than the sentence we are trying to prove.

4.4　圆满的结尾

4.4 Happy Endings

只需把证伪过程反向运行，就能生成证明，这使我们在一定程度上可以为定理量身安排证明。特别是，可以保证证明的最后一步是一个“圆满的结尾”，以最自然的方式得到目标定理。具体而言，

Generating proofs simply by running the falsification procedure backwards enables us to tailor proofs to theorems to some extent. In particular, we can guarantee that the last step of a proof is a “happy ending” that yields the target theorem in the most natural way. Namely,

  1. 若目标定理形如 ¬¬A∨ℬ，则最后一步是

    If the target theorem is of the form ¬¬A∨ℬ, then the last step is

    由 A∨ℬ 推出 ¬¬A∨ℬ.

     from A∨ℬ infer ¬¬A∨ℬ. 

  2. 若目标定理形如 ¬(A1∨A2)∨ℬ，则最后一步是

    If the target theorem is of the form ¬(A1∨A2)∨ℬ, then the last step is

    由 ¬A1∨ℬ 和 ¬A2∨ℬ 推出 ¬(A1∨A2)∨ℬ.

     from ¬A1∨ℬ and ¬A2∨ℬ infer ¬(A1∨A2)∨ℬ. 

只需把希望采用的最后一步反过来，作为证伪定理 S 的第一次尝试，就能保证 S 的证明以这一步结束。由于 S 是定理，任何证伪尝试都会得到一棵各分支终止于不可证伪公式的树。反向阅读这棵树，就得到一个具有所需结尾的 S 的证明。

We can guarantee the last step in the proof of a theorem S by choosing its reverse as the first step in an attempt to falsify S .Since S is a theorem, any attempt to falsify it yields a tree whose branches end in unfalsifiable formulas. Reading this tree backwards gives a proof of S with the desired ending.

对于含有额外成分，例如切割规则的系统，这一性质很重要。下一章将研究树中切割规则的首次出现，并为此前的无切割证明安排“圆满的结尾”，从而找出可以消去切割的情形。

This property becomes important in systems with extra ingredients, such as the cut rule. In the next chapter we will find circumstances in which cuts may be eliminated by studying the first occurrence of the cut rule and arranging “happy endings” for the cut-free proofs down to that point in the tree.

命题逻辑的一致性

Consistency of Propositional Logic

以 Pi∨¬Pi 为公理、以上述规则构成的形式系统，并未完全取代真值表求值方法。形式系统把所有有效语句都给出为定理，但现在还需要知道所有定理都有效，也就是系统的可靠性。求值恰好能用来证明，命题逻辑的这个公理系统是可靠的，因而也是一致的。

The method of evaluation by truth tables is not entirely superseded by the formal system described by the axioms Pi¬∨Pi and the rules above. The formal system gives us all the valid sentences as theorems, but now we need to know that all theorems are valid; that is, the soundness of the system. Evaluation is just what we need to prove that the axiom system for propositional logic is sound (and hence consistent).

证明：首先，显然每条公理都恒取值 T。这正是前面给出的求值例子。其次，可以检验：若一条规则的前提都恒取值 T，其结论也恒取值 T。因此，每个定理都恒取值 T，所以系统可靠，即它只能证明有效语句。□

Proof: First, it is clear that each axiom has the constant value T.This was our example of evaluation in the previous section. Second, it can be checked that, if the premises of a rule have the constant value T,then so has the conclusion. Thus each theorem has the constant value T,and hence the system is sound—it proves only valid sentences. □

命题逻辑的表达能力大概不足以使哥德尔第二不完备性定理的证明适用于它。尽管如此，刚才的一致性证明，确实依赖于一个超出命题逻辑自身所含内容的数学原理，即有限序数的归纳原理。

Propositional logic is presumably not expressive enough for the proof of Gödel’s second incompleteness theorem to apply to it. Nevertheless, the consistency proof just described does depend on a mathematical principle beyond those present in propositional logic itself; namely, induction for finite ordinals.

为证明给定定理 S 有效，我们实质上假定所有更短的定理都有效；在这种情况下，S 也有效，因为它必定由更短的前提推出。对于重新分组和交换规则，需要退回到应用这些规则之前使用的那条规则。因此，一致性证明依赖于以下原理：有限序数的任何下降序列都是有限的，也就是有限序数的归纳原理。

To prove that a given theorem S is valid we essentially assume that all shorter theorems are valid, in which case S is valid because it is necessarily inferred from shorter premises. (In the case of the regrouping and exchange rules we have to step back to the rule used before regrouping or exchange was applied.) Thus the consistency proof depends on the principle that any descending sequence of finite ordinals is finite, that is, induction for finite ordinals.

这种情形与稍后将看到的算术情形大致类似。算术形式系统包含有限序数的归纳原理，而要证明它的一致性，就需要更强的归纳原理，即小于 ε0 的序数的归纳原理。

This situation is roughly analogous to what we will later see for arithmetic. The formal system for arithmetic includes induction for finite ordinals, and to prove its consistency we need a stronger induction principle—induction for ordinals less than ε0.

4.5　谓词逻辑

4.5 Predicate Logic

要像算术或集合论那样讨论个别对象、性质与函数，就需要包含这些内容的语言与逻辑。足以用于数学的最简单逻辑称为谓词逻辑。¹ 它有通常的命题函数，也有个体的名称，包括常量和变量，以及任意有限元的关系和函数。此外，对任意变量 x，都有量词 ∀x“对所有 x”和 ∃x“存在一个 x”，也可简称“有一个 x”。谓词逻辑也称一阶逻辑，因为它只允许对个体量化，而不允许对关系或函数量化，后者会得到二阶逻辑。这听起来像是严重限制，但一阶逻辑足以满足大多数数学目的，而且比二阶逻辑具有更好的性质。

To discuss individual objects, properties, and functions, as we do in arithmetic or set theory, we need a language and logic that includes these things. The simplest logic that suffices for mathematics is called predicate logic.1 It has the usual propositional functions, but it also has names for individuals (both constants and variables), relations (between any finite number of variables), and functions (also of any finite number of variables). Also, for any variable x we have the quantifiers ∀x “for all x”and ∃x “there exists an x” or simply “there is an x.” Predicate logic is also called first order logic because it permits only quantification over individuals, not over relations or functions (which would give second order logic). This sounds like a severe restriction, but first order logic is adequate for most mathematical purposes, and it has better properties than second order logic.

例：一种算术语言

Example: A Language for Arithmetic

若所考虑的个体是正整数，通常有：

If the intended individuals are the positive integers we usually have:

常量：1、2、3、4、……

Constants: 1, 2, 3, 4,…

变量：i、j、k、l、m、n、……

Variables: i, j, k, l, m, n,…

函数：S(n)，后继，是变量 n 的一元函数；m+n，和，是变量 m、n 的二元函数；m·n，积，也是变量 m、n 的二元函数。

Functions: S(n) (successor, a function of one variable n), m + n (sum, a function of two variables m and n), m · n (product, a function of two variables m and n).

关系：m=n，是变量 m、n 的二元关系；m<n，也是变量 m、n 的二元关系。

Relations: m = n (a relation of two variables m and n), m < n (a relation of two variables m and n).

用这种语言，可以表达数论中通常考虑的正整数的一切性质。例如，“n 是素数”就是性质

In this language we can express all the properties of positive integers usually considered in number theory. For example, “n is prime” is the property

(n>1)∧¬(∃l)(∃m)(l>1∧m>1∧n=m⋅l).

不能把这个表达“n 是素数”的式子称为语句，因为它既不真也不假。我们称它为具有自由变量 n 的公式。具有自由变量 m、n、……的公式，在变量被量词约束后，就成为语句。例如，公式

We cannot call this expression for “n is prime” a sentence, because it is neither true nor false. We call it a formula with free variable n. A formula with free variables m, n, … becomes a sentence when the variables are bound by quantifiers. For example, the formula

n<m∧ " m 是素数"

n<m∧ " m is prime" 

是一个具有自由变量 m 和 n 的公式。当我们如下约束这些变量时，

is a formula with free variables m and n. When we bind the variables like so—

(∀n)(∃m)(n<m∧ " m 是素数" )

(∀n)(∃m)(n<m∧ " m is prime" )

就得到一个等价于“有无限多个素数”的语句。

—we have a sentence equivalent to “There are infinitely many primes.”

若确实想把具有自由变量的公式解释为语句，就把它看作对自由变量的一切取值所作的断言。这在数学中很常见。例如，写下 m+n=n+m 时，默认其意思是“对所有 m，对所有 n”。

If we really want to interpret a formula with free variables as a sentence, then we do so by taking the formula as an assertion for all values of its free variables. This is commonly done in mathematics. For example, when we write m + n = n + m itis understood to mean “for all m, for all n.”

谓词逻辑的一个形式系统

A Formal System for Predicate Logic

为适应一切可能情况，谓词逻辑的语言应包含无限多个常量，即表示尚未确定的特定对象的符号；无限多个变量，即可以说“对所有 x”或“存在一个 x”的符号 x；无限多个函数符号；无限多个关系符号；以及等号。不过，把等号和函数也纳入关系之中，就可以使用更少的成分，本节余下部分将这样处理。

To be prepared for all eventualities, the language for predicate logic should contain infinitely many constants (symbols to denote specific objects, as yet undetermined), infinitely many variables (symbols x for which we can say “for all x”or “there is an x”), infinitely many function symbols, infinitely many relation symbols, and the equality sign. However, we can manage with less than this, by including equality and functions among the relations, and we will do so for the rest of this section.

一个令人惊讶的事实是，谓词逻辑是完备的；哥德尔在发现算术不完备性之前不久发现了它。也就是说，存在一个形式系统，其定理恰好是谓词逻辑的有效语句。与命题逻辑一样，“有效”意为“在一切解释下都为真”。谓词逻辑中的某些语句，出于命题逻辑的原因而有效，例如 P(a)∨¬P(a)；另一些则本质上涉及变量和量词，例如 (∀x)P(x)∨(∃x)¬P(x)。后一个语句有效，因为无论变量 x 遍历哪个论域，无论性质 P 在该论域上如何解释，它都为真。

A surprising fact, discovered by Gödel shortly before he discovered the incompleteness of arithmetic, is that predicate logic is complete.That is, there is a formal system whose theorems are precisely the valid sentences of predicate logic. As in propositional logic, “valid” means “true under all interpretations.” There are some sentences of predicate logic that are valid for propositional reasons—for example P(a) ∨¬P(a)—but others involve variables and quantifiers in an essential way, for example (∀x)P(x) ∨ (∃x) ¬P(x). The latter sentence is valid because it is true for all domains the variable x may range over, and for all interpretations of the property P on that domain.

我们采用与命题逻辑相同的策略，为谓词逻辑寻找完备形式系统：通过证伪更简单的语句来尝试证伪给定语句，然后把证伪规则反过来写成推理规则。与前面一样，假定所有布尔函数都已用 ¬ 和 ∨ 写出，因此，反向使用 ¬¬ 规则和 ¬∨ 规则，再加上通常默认的重新分组与交换，就足以简化语句的布尔部分。还可以假定所有量词 ∃x 都已用 ∀x 改写，因为

We find a complete formal system for predicate logic by the same strategy as for propositional logic: seeking to falsify sentences by falsifying simpler sentences, then writing the falsification rules backward as rules of inference. As before, we suppose that all Boolean functions have been written in terms of ¬ and ∨, so the reverse -and¬∨-rules (together with regrouping and exchange, which we usually take for granted) suffice to simplify the Boolean part of a sentence. We can also assume that all quantifiers ∃x have been rewritten in terms of ∀x,because

(∃x)A(x) 等价于 ¬(∀x)¬A(x).

(∃x)A(x)  is equivalent to  ¬(∀x)¬A(x).

接下来只需寻找涉及 ∀x 的证伪规则，图 4.4 所示的两条规则就足够了。与第 4.3 节一样，把证伪规则对应于树中向下的有向边，目标是通过证伪下方语句来证伪上方语句。

It then remains to find falsification rules involving ∀x, and the two shown in Figure 4.4 suffice. As in Section 4.3, we associate falsification rules with downward directed edges of a tree. The aim is to falsify the upper sentence by falsifying the lower one.

可以检验，一个解释证伪上方语句，当且仅当它证伪下方语句。左边规则要求a 不在 ℬ 中自由出现，是为了避免得到不可证伪的语句 A(a)∨¬A(a)；当 ℬ=¬A(a) 时就会出现这种情况。右边规则并没有真正简化语句，因为公式 ¬(∀x)A(x) 仍然保留，因此某些分支可能不会终止。

It can be checked that an interpretation falsifies the upper sentence if and only if it falsifies the lower sentence. The reason for the restriction to a not free in ℬ in the rule on the left is to avoid getting the unfalsifiable sentence A(a)∨¬A(a), which happens if ℬ=¬A(a).The rule on the right does not really simplify the sentence, since the formula ¬(∀x)A(x) persists, and hence some branches may not end.

不过，如果在构造树时，保证每个分支上的常量 a1、a2、a3、……按顺序引入，并应用所有适用规则，那么任意无限分支都会具有下面的性质。为简洁表述这些性质，把树中每个语句分解为尽可能多的语句 A1、A2、……、Ak 的析取 A1∨A2∨⋯∨Ak，这些语句称为其析取项。

However, if the construction of the tree is managed so that the constants a1, a2, a3,… are introduced in order on each branch, and all applicable rules are applied, any infinite branch will have the properties below. To state these properties concisely we decompose each sentence in the tree as a disjunction, A1∨A2∨⋯∨Ak, of the maximal number of sentences A1,A2,…,Ak (called its disjuncts).

  • 若 ¬¬A 作为析取项出现在分支上，则 A 也会出现。

    If ¬¬A occurs as a disjunct on the branch, so does A.

  • 若 ¬(A1∨A2) 作为析取项出现在分支上，则 ¬A1 或 ¬A2 也会出现。

    If ¬(A1∨A2) occurs as a disjunct on the branch, so does ¬A1 or ¬A2.

  • 若 (∀x)A(x) 作为析取项出现在分支上，则对某个常量 ai，A(ai) 也会出现。

    If (∀x)A(x) occurs as a disjunct on the branch, so does A(ai) for some constant ai.

  • 若 ¬(∀x)A(x) 作为析取项出现在分支上，则对每个常量 ai，¬A(ai) 都会出现。

    If ¬(∀x)A(x) occurs as a disjunct on the branch, so does ¬A(ai) for every constant ai.

由此可知，在无限分支上，每个语句最终都会分解为原子，即形如 R(ai,aj,…) 或 ¬R(ai,aj,…) 的项，其中 R 是关系符号。² 每个原子只以一种形式出现，要么带否定号，要么不带，因为若两种形式都出现，包含它们的析取就无法证伪，分支便会终止。因此，可以自由地给每个这样的原子赋值 F，结果分支上的每个语句都取值 F，包括树根处的语句 S。

It follows that, on an infinite branch, every sentence is ultimately broken down to atoms: terms of the form R(ai,aj,…) or ¬R(ai,aj,…) where R is a relation symbol.2 Each atom occurs in only one form, either with the negation sign or without, because if both forms occur the disjunction containing them cannot be falsified and the branch will end. Thus we are free to assign each atom the value F,and every sentence in the branch gets the value F as a result, including the sentence S at the root of the tree.

反过来，若谓词逻辑的语句 S 有效，则树的每个分支都终止，而且必定终止于一个包含同一原子的带否定号与不带否定号两种形式的析取。

Conversely, if a sentence S of predicate logic is valid, every branch in the tree terminates, necessarily in a disjunction of terms that includes the same atom, both with and without a negation sign.

因此，取形如 R(ai,aj,…)∨¬R(ai,aj,…) 的语句为公理，并把证伪规则反过来作为推理规则，就得到谓词逻辑的一个完备形式系统。

Therefore, by taking the sentences of the form R(ai, aj,…) ∨¬R(ai, aj,…) as axioms, and the reverses of the falsification rules as rules of inference, we get a complete formal system for predicate logic.

谓词逻辑新增的两条规则如下。

The two new rules in predicate logic are the following.

∀ 规则。由 A(x)∨ℬ，其中 x 是自由变量，推出 (∀x)A(x)∨ℬ。

∀-rule. From A(x)∨ℬ for a free variable x infer (∀x)A(x)∨ℬ.

¬∀ 规则。由 ¬A(a)∨ℬ 推出 ¬(∀x)A(x)∨ℬ。

¬∀-rule. From ¬A(a)∨ℬ infer ¬(∀x)A(x)∨ℬ.

这个形式系统没有把第二条证伪规则的逆向形式作为原始规则，即

This formal system does not contain a primitive rule that is the reverse of the second falsification rule, namely,

由 ¬A(a)∨¬(∀x)A(x)∨ℬ 推出 ¬(∀x)A(x)∨ℬ.

 from ¬A(a)∨¬(∀x)A(x)∨ℬ infer ¬(∀x)A(x)∨ℬ. 

不过，可以把后一条规则推导为 ¬∀ 规则与收缩规则的组合：

However, we can derive the latter rule as a combination of the ¬∀ rule and consolidation,

由 ¬A(a)∨¬(∀x)A(x)∨ℬ 推出 ¬(∀x)A(x)∨¬(∀x)A(x)∨ℬ (根据 ¬∀-规则), 由 ¬(∀x)A(x)∨¬(∀x)A(x)∨ℬ 推出 ¬(∀x)A(x)∨ℬ (根据 收缩规则).

 from ¬A(a)∨¬(∀x)A(x)∨ℬ infer ¬(∀x)A(x)∨¬(∀x)A(x)∨ℬ (by ¬∀-rule),  from ¬(∀x)A(x)∨¬(∀x)A(x)∨ℬ infer ¬(∀x)A(x)∨ℬ (by consolidation). 

由此可知，若语句 S 无法被证伪，则在命题逻辑规则加上 ∀ 规则和 ¬∀ 规则构成的系统中，S 有一个证明。这就是谓词逻辑完备性定理的一个版本。

It follows that if a sentence S cannot be falsified, then it has a proof in the system with the rules of propositional logic, plus the ∀-and ¬∀-rules. This is (one version of) the completeness theorem for predicate logic.

哥德尔的版本采用的谓词逻辑公理系统，实质上源于弗雷格 1879 年的工作，并把切割规则作为推理规则之一。1934 年，根岑证明切割可以消去，从而说明无切割系统的完备性。不过，直到 20 世纪 50 年代，才出现沿上述思路进行的完备性证明。通过反转自然的证伪过程来寻找所需推理规则的想法，似乎在 1955 年前后由几位逻辑学家分别想到，包括 Beth、Hintikka、Lis、Smullyan 和 van Heijenoort，参见 Annellis（1990）。

Gödel’s version used an axiom system for predicate logic essentially due to Frege in 1879, with the cut rule as one of the rules of inference. In 1934 Gentzen showed that cut could be eliminated, thus showing the completeness of cut-free systems. However, it was only in the 1950s that completeness proofs were given along the above lines. The idea of finding the necessary rules of inference by reversing a natural falsification procedure seems to have occurred to several logicians around 1955 (Beth, Hintikka, Lis, Smullyan, and van Heijenoort—see Annellis (1990)).

4.6　完备性、一致性与圆满的结尾

4.6 Completeness, Consistency, Happy Endings

如果赋予一个概念相互矛盾的属性，我就说，这个概念在数学上不存在。……但如果能够证明，通过有限次逻辑推理，赋予该概念的属性永远不会导致矛盾，我就说，该概念的数学存在性……由此得到了证明。

If contradictory attributes be assigned to a concept, I say that mathematically the concept does not exist. … But if it can be proved that the attributes assigned to the concept can never lead to a contradiction by the application of a finite number of logical inferences, I say that the mathematical existence of the concept … is thereby proved.

——戴维·希尔伯特

—David Hilbert

1900 年《关于数学问题的演讲》，载于 Ewald（1996），第二卷，第 1105 页。

Address on Mathematical Problems, 1900, in Ewald (1996), volume II, p. 1105.

谓词逻辑的完备性证明，为希尔伯特关于数学存在性的观念提供了非凡的支持。在希尔伯特之前，数学中已经出现许多“虚构”或“理想”对象，除了看起来一致且有用之外，并没有显然的理由认为它们存在。

The completeness proof for predicate logic is a remarkable vindication of Hilbert’s concept of mathematical existence. Before Hilbert’s time, mathematics had seen many examples of “imaginary” or “ideal” objects with no obvious reason to exist, other than their apparent consistency and usefulness.

一个典型例子是 −1，这个神秘而有用的对象，在人们理解其含义之前，已经用于计算数百年。法国数学家奥古斯丁·路易·柯西于 1847 年提出，也许最终的解释在于：−1 的意义就在于它作为代数符号的行为。也就是说，可以一致地引入一个满足规则 i2=−1 的符号 i，而这就是所需知道的全部内容。我们已经习惯于这样的想法：用一个遵守与数相同规则的字母进行计算是一致的；而且可以证明，加上额外条件 i2=−1 后，相同规则仍然成立。用现代代数语言说，就是“关于 i 的多项式模 i2+1 构成一个域”。

A typical example is −1, a mysteriously useful object that was used in calculations for several centuries before anyone understood what it meant. Perhaps the ultimate explanation, proposed by the French mathematician Augustin-Louis Cauchy in 1847, is that the meaning of −1 resides in its behavior as an algebraic symbol. That is, we can consistently introduce a symbol i that obeys the rule i2 = −1, and that is all we need to know. We are already used to the idea that it is consistent to calculate with a letter that obeys the same rules as numbers, and it can be proved that the same rules continue to hold when we impose the extra condition that i2 = −1. (In modern algebraic language, “polynomials in i,mod i2 + 1, form a field.”)

完备性定理的证明，以一般得多的方式，通过符号赋予数学概念意义。简言之，其思想如下。

The proof of the completeness theorem gives meaning to mathematical concepts via symbols in a much more general way. Briefly, the idea is this.

设 S 是一个不会导致矛盾的语句。那么 ¬S 可以被证伪，因为若 ¬S 不能被证伪，由完备性定理就能证明 ¬S，而这显然与 S 矛盾。证伪过程给出一个具体解释，使 ¬S 为假，从而使 S 为真。这个解释对某些常量，为 S 中的关系符号赋予 T 或 F。因此，S 中隐含的“概念”，在某个符号世界中获得了意义；在这个世界中，“个体”a、b、c、……是常量符号，而关系 R(x,y) 则由以常量替换变量时所赋予的真值决定。

Suppose S is a sentence that does not lead to a contradiction. Then ¬S can be falsified, because if ¬S cannot be falsified we can prove¬S, by the completeness theorem, and this certainly contradicts S .The falsification procedure gives a specific interpretation that falsifies¬ S,and hence makes S true. The interpretation in question assigns the values T or F to the relation symbols in S for certain constants. Thus the “concepts” implicit in S have meaning in a certain symbolic world, where the “individuals” a, b, c,… are constant symbols and relations R(x,y) are determined by the truth values assigned to them when constants are substituted for their variables.

因此，希尔伯特关于一致概念具有存在性的梦想，至少对可用谓词逻辑语言表达的概念而言，由完备性定理实现了。可以说，哥德尔实现了希尔伯特的一个梦想，尽管他又以算术的不完备性定理，粉碎了另一个梦想，即为数学给出有穷一致性证明。

Hilbert’s dream of existence for consistent concepts is therefore realized (at least for concepts expressible in the language of predicate logic) by the completeness theorem. We can say that Gödel made one of Hilbert’s dreams come true, even though he crushed the other dream (of a finitary consistency proof for mathematics) with his incompleteness theorems for arithmetic.

事实上，不完备性定理还为希尔伯特的数学存在性观念增添了有趣的转折。某个特定公理系统 𝒜 不完备，意味着存在语句 S，使 S 与 ¬S 都分别与 𝒜 相容。于是，上述论证导出两个符号世界：一个世界中 𝒜 与 S 为真，另一个世界中 𝒜 与 ¬S 为真。其实，早在哥德尔之前，人们就在平面几何的平行公理上知道了这种情况。19 世纪的几何学家构造了各种几何世界，其中一些满足平行公理，另一些不满足。

Indeed, the incompleteness theorems add an interesting twist to Hilbert’s concept of mathematical existence. Incompleteness of a particular axiom system 𝒜 means that there is a sentence S such that both S and ¬S are consistent with 𝒜. The argument above then leads to two symbolic worlds: one in which 𝒜 and S are true, and one in which 𝒜 and ¬S are true. Actually, this situation was already known long before Gödel, in the case of the parallel axiom in plane geometry. In the 19th century, geometers constructed various geometric worlds, some in which the parallel axiom is true, and some in which it is false.

证明与圆满的结尾

Proofs and Happy Endings

从失败的证伪尝试中得到谓词逻辑证明，带有命题逻辑中没有的不确定性。具体说，证伪过程可能是无限的，因此，即使给定语句 S 确实有效，一般也无法预先知道证明它需要多久。这是不可避免的。如果总能预先知道要搜索多久才能找到证明，就有了判定有效性的算法，这与判定问题不可解相矛盾，见第 3.7 节。因此，不能总是预见证伪过程会持续多久，或它是否会无限进行。

Obtaining proofs in predicate logic from failed falsification attempts has an element of uncertainty not present in propositional logic. Namely, the falsification procedure is potentially infinite, so we cannot in general tell how long it will take to prove a given sentence S, if S is in fact valid. This is unavoidable. If we always knew in advance how long to search for a proof, then we would have an algorithm for deciding validity, contrary to the unsolvability of the Entscheidungsproblem (Section 3.7). Thus we cannot always foresee how long falsification will take, or whether the process will be infinite.

另一方面，由于每个有效语句都有有限证明，可以采用与命题逻辑中基本相同的求值论证，说明形式系统可靠。实质上，先忽略量词，像命题逻辑那样把所有语句求值为 T 或 F，并说明 T 值从公理传递到定理。因此，不可能证明假语句。

On the other hand, since each valid sentence has a finite proof, it is possible to show that the formal system is sound by much the same evaluation argument that we used for propositional logic. Essentially one ignores quantifiers, evaluating all sentences T or F as in propositional logic, and showing that the value T propagates from axioms to theorems. Thus no false sentence is provable.

还可以说明，谓词逻辑的每个定理都有一个在以下意义上具有“圆满结尾”的证明：

We can also show that each theorem of predicate logic has a “happy ending” proof in the following sense:

  1. 若目标定理形如 ¬¬A∨ℬ，则最后一步是

    If the target theorem is of the form ¬¬A∨ℬ, then the last step is

    由 A∨ℬ 推出 ¬¬A∨ℬ.

     from A∨ℬ infer ¬¬A∨ℬ. 

  2. 若目标定理形如 ¬(A1∨A2)∨ℬ，则最后一步是

    If the target theorem is of the form ¬(A1∨A2)∨ℬ, then the last step is

    由 ¬A1∨ℬ 和 ¬A2∨ℬ 推出 ¬(A1∨A2)∨ℬ.

     from ¬A1∨ℬ and ¬A2∨ℬ infer ¬(A1∨A2)∨ℬ. 

  3. 若目标定理形如 (∀x)A(x)∨ℬ，则最后一步是

    If the target theorem is of the form (∀x)A(x)∨ℬ, then the last step is

    由 A(x)∨ℬ 推出 (∀x)A(x)∨ℬ.

     from A(x)∨ℬ infer (∀x)A(x)∨ℬ.

  4. 若目标定理形如 ¬(∀x)A(x)∨ℬ，则最后一步是

    If the target theorem is of the form ¬(∀x)A(x)∨ℬ, then the last step is

    由 ¬A(a)∨ℬ 推出 ¬(∀x)A(x)∨ℬ.

     from ¬A(a)∨ℬ infer ¬(∀x)A(x)∨ℬ. 

情形 1 和 2 的论证与第 4.3 节命题逻辑中的相同。情形 3 和 4 也类似，只需使用谓词逻辑的证伪过程。

Cases 1 and 2 follow as they did for propositional logic in Section 4.3. Cases 3 and 4 are similar, using the falsification procedure for predicate logic.

例如，给定形如 (∀x)A(x)∨ℬ 的定理，必定有一个实例 A(x)∨ℬ，其中 x 是自由变量，且 A(x)∨ℬ 有效。因此，任何证伪 A(x)∨ℬ 的尝试都会失败；把这种尝试反向运行，就得到 A(x)∨ℬ 的一个证明，再由 ∀ 规则立即推出 (∀x)A(x)∨ℬ。

For example, given a theorem of the form (∀x)A(x)∨ℬ, there must be an instance A(x)∨ℬ for a free variable x for which A(x)∨ℬ is valid. Therefore, any attempt to falsify A(x)∨ℬ will fail, and running this attempt backwards yields a proof of A(x)∨ℬ, from which (∀x)A(x)∨ℬ follows immediately by the ∀-rule.

4.7　历史背景

4.7 Historical Background

命题逻辑与计算

Propositional Logic and Computation

……数学家针对是非问题所做的脑力工作，可以完全由机器取代。

… the mental work of a mathematician concerning Yes-or-No questions could be completely replaced by a machine.

——库尔特·哥德尔

—Kurt Gödel

1956 年 3 月 20 日致约翰·冯·诺伊曼的信，载于 Gödel（2003），第 375 页。

Letter to John von Neumann, 20 March 1956, in Gödel (2003), p. 375.

波斯特于 1921 年发表真值表方法时，命题逻辑的所有基本问题似乎都已解决。真值表能够判定以下问题。

When Post published the truth table method in 1921, it appeared that all the basic questions about propositional logic had been settled. Truth tables decide the following.

  • 有效性：公式有效，当且仅当无论变量取何值，公式的值都为“真”；而公式的值可通过真值表计算。

    Validity: a formula is valid if and only if it has value “true” for all values of its variables (and the value of the formula is computable by truth tables).

  • 一致性：通常的命题逻辑形式系统是一致的，因为其公理的值为“真”，而推理规则保持真值。

    Consistency: the usual formal systems for propositional logic are consistent because their axioms have value “true,” and the rules of inference preserve truth.

  • 可满足性：公式可满足，当且仅当存在一种变量真值赋值，使公式的值为“真”。

    Satisfiability: a formula is satisfiable if and only if it has value “true” for some assignment of truth values to its variables.

特别是，有效性和可满足性都能在预先有界的有限时间内检验。由于 n 个变量共有 2n 种真值赋值方式，检验一个含 n 个变量的公式所需时间，大约是 2n 步。在 20 世纪初，这已经满足了人们对有限性的全部要求。但到了 20 世纪 50 年代，首批检验逻辑有效性的计算机程序开发出来后，逻辑学家开始认识到，2n 步其实是很长的时间。

In particular, validity and satisfiability are testable in a finite time that can be bounded in advance. Since there are 2n ways to assign truth values to n variables, the time required to test a formula with n variables is of the order of 2n steps. In the early 20th century, this was as finite as anyone wanted. But in the 1950s, when the first computer programs for testing logical validity were developed, logicians began to realize that 2n steps is a long time.

同一时期，哥德尔以其典型的先见之明，在上引致约翰·冯·诺伊曼的信中写道：

In the same period, Gödel, with typical prescience, wrote the following to John von Neumann: in the letter quoted above.

请容许我写信向您请教一个数学问题，我非常希望知道您的看法：显然，可以很容易地构造一台图灵机，对于一阶谓词逻辑的每个公式 F 和每个自然数 n，判定 F 是否存在长度为 n 的证明，其中长度指符号数。设 ψ(F,n) 为机器完成这一任务所需的步数，令 φ(n)=maxFψ(F,n)。问题是，对最优机器而言，φ(n) 的增长速度有多快。可以证明 φ(n)≥k·n。如果真的存在一台机器，使 φ(n)～k·n，甚至～k·n2，那将产生极其重要的后果。具体说，这显然意味着，尽管判定问题不可判定，数学家针对是非问题所做的脑力工作，仍可以完全由机器取代。毕竟，只需把自然数 n 取得足够大，使得机器若没有给出结果，就不值得再继续思考该问题。

I would like to allow myself to write you about a mathematical problem, of which your opinion would very much interest me: One can obviously easily construct a Turing machine, which for every formula F in first order predicate logic and every natural number n, allows one to decide if there is a proof of F of length n (length = number of symbols). Let ψ(F,n) be the number of steps the machine requires for this and let φ(n) = maxFψ(F, n).The question is how fast φ(n) grows for an optimal machine. One can show that φ >(nI ≥ k · n. If there really were a machine with φ (n) ~ k · n (or even ~ k · n2), this would have consequences of the greatest importance. Namely, it would obviously mean that in spite of the undecidability of the Entscheidungsproblem, the mental work of a mathematician concerning Yes-or-No questions could be completely replaced by a machine. After all, one would simply have to choose the natural number n so large that when the machine does not deliver a result, it makes no sense to think more about the problem.

哥德尔提出的问题表面上更一般，涉及谓词逻辑中的有效性判定，但实际上与命题逻辑中的可满足性判定很相似。两种情况下，都必须在大约包含 2n 个候选对象的空间中，寻找一个具有易于识别性质的对象；这些候选对象分别是谓词逻辑符号序列，以及 n 个命题变量的真值赋值：

Gödel is asking an apparently more general question—about deciding validity in predicate logic—but actually the issue is much the same as deciding satisfiability in propositional logic. In both cases one has to search through a space of size roughly 2n candidates (sequences of predicate logic symbols, assignments of truth values to n propositional variables) for an object with an easily recognizable property:

  • 把给定的 n 个符号组成的序列分成公式，并检验每个公式是否由前面的公式按照给定推理规则之一得到，就能容易地判断它是否为谓词逻辑的一个证明。

    We can easily tell whether a given sequence of n symbols is a proof in predicate logic by breaking it into formulas and checking whether each follows from preceding formulas by one of the given rules of inference.

  • 对于 n 个变量的命题公式，给定变量的值后，利用真值表计算公式的值，就能容易地判断它是否得到满足。

    We can easily tell whether a propositional formula in n variables is satisfied, for given values of the variables, by computing its value by truth tables.

这两项任务之所以“容易”，是因为大约 n2 步就能完成；相比之下，枚举候选空间中的所有对象，需要大约 2n 步。因此，“困难”的部分，也就是我们似乎需要数学家的部分，在于从指数规模的空间中找到一个验证对象。

These two tasks are “easy” in the sense that they can be done in around n2 steps, in contrast to the approximately 2n steps it takes to enumerate all objects in the space of candidates. Thus the “hard” part—the part for which we seem to need mathematicians—is finding a validating object in an exponentially large space.

这样比较这两个问题时，命题逻辑的可满足性问题，仿佛就是整个数学的缩影。在某种意义上确实如此。哥德尔的问题，即对给定 n，判定给定语句是否有长度至多为 n 的证明，可以归约为判定一个大约含 n 个变量的命题公式是否可满足。这里“大约”意为“由 n 的某个多项式函数所界定”。这来自斯蒂芬·库克（1971）关于非确定性图灵机的一个更一般结果。

When the two problems are compared in this way, it looks as though the satisfiability problem of propositional logic is all mathematics, in microcosm. In a sense, this is correct. Gödel’s problem of deciding, for given n, whether a given sentence has a proof of length at most n reduces to deciding satisfiability of a propositional formula with roughly n variables. “Roughly” means “bounded by some polynomial function of n.” This follows from a more general result of Stephen Cook (1971) about nondeterministic Turing machines.

非确定性图灵机与第 3.5 节描述的普通图灵机相同，区别只在于，给定的“状态、符号”对 (qi,Sj) 可以出现在不止一个五元组中。因此，对给定输入纸带，可能存在不止一种计算。这当然不是我们希望真实机器具有的行为，但对于假想机器却非常有用，因为它允许机器先猜测，再检验。例如，设机器中包含以下五元组

A nondeterministic Turing machine is the same as an ordinary Turing machine (described in Section 3.5), except that a given (state, symbol) pair (qi, Sj) may occur in more than one quintuple. Thus, more than one computation is possible on a given input tape. This of course is not how we want real machines to behave, but it is great for a hypothetical machine, because it allows the machine to make a guess and then test it. For example, suppose we include the quintuples

q1B0Rq1, q1B1Rq1, q1BBRq2

其中 B 表示纸带上的空白方格。那么，从空白纸带上的状态 q1 开始，机器就能写出一个随机的 0、1 序列，再跳转到状态 q2。进入 q2 后，机器可以把这个 0、1 序列，视为输入的命题公式 F 的一种真值赋值；例如，F 可写在起始方格的左边。通过实现真值表方法，机器就能针对随机生成的变量取值序列，计算 F 的真值。

in the machine, where B denotes the blank square of tape. Then, when started in state q1 on a blank tape, the machine can write a random sequence of 0s and 1s and jump into state q2. Once in state q2,the machine can treat the sequence of 0s and 1s as an assignment of truth values to a propositional formula F given as input (say, to the left of the starting square). By implementing the truth table method, the machine can compute the truth value of F for the sequence of values of the variables that it has randomly generated.

显然，若长度为 n 的命题公式 F 可满足，就有一个大约 n 步的非确定性图灵机计算展示这一事实。类似地，若谓词逻辑的一个语句有长度至多为 n 的证明，也有一个大约 n 步的非确定性图灵机计算展示这一事实。库克通过用“且”“或”“非”描述图灵机的动作，证明了以下结果，列昂尼德·列文也独立发现了它：

Clearly, if the propositional formula F of length n is satisfiable, then this fact is shown by a nondeterministic Turing machine computation of roughly n steps. By a similar argument, if a sentence of predicate logic has a proof of length at most n, this fact is also shown by a nondeterministic Turing machine computation of roughly n steps. Cook proved the following (it was also discovered independently by Leonid Levin) by describing the actions of a Turing machine in terms of “and,” “or,” and “not”:

库克定理。对每台非确定性图灵机 M、输入 I 和时间 T，都存在一个命题公式 ℱM,I,T，其长度大约为 M、I、T 的规模，使得：

Cook’s theorem. For each nondeterministic Turing machine M, input I, and time T, there is a propositional formula ℱm,i,t, of length roughly the size of M, I, T, such that:

M 对输入 I 在至多 T 步内停机，当且仅当 ℱM,I,T 可满足。

M halts, for input I, in at most T steps if and only if ℱm,i,t is satisfiable.

如前所述，“大约为……的规模”意为“由……的多项式函数所界定”。因此，这个定理涉及所谓 NP 类，即“可在多项式时间内非确定性求解”的问题类。若存在非确定性图灵机 M 和多项式 p，使 M 对问题 𝒫 中每个长度为 n 的问题，都能通过某个至多 p(n) 步的计算给出答案，则 𝒫 属于 NP。库克定理说明，相对于可满足性问题，NP 中的任何问题都是“容易”的。如果奇迹般地存在可满足性问题的确定性多项式时间解法，那么 NP 中每个问题都有确定性多项式时间解法。

As I said, “roughly the size of” means “bounded by a polynomial function of.” So the theorem is about the so-called class NP of problems “solvable nondeterministically in polynomial time.” A problem Ƥ is in NP if there is a nondeterministic Turing machine M and a polynomial p such that M answers each question in Ƥ of length n by some computation of at most p(n) steps. Cook’s theorem says that any problem in NP is “easy,” relative to the satisfiability problem. If (by some miracle) there is a deterministic polynomial-time solution of the satisfiability problem, then there is a deterministic polynomial-time solution of every problem in NP.

能够在多项式时间内确定性求解的问题，构成称为 P 的类。哥德尔在致冯·诺伊曼的信中，询问的是 kn 或 kn2 步的确定性解法。但若把步数上界放宽为任意多项式 p(n)，他就是在问：P 类是否包含以下问题，即判定谓词逻辑公式是否存在长度为 n 的证明。后一个问题包含可满足性问题，因此哥德尔实际上隐含地在问，NP 是否等于 P。这已成为当今逻辑与计算机科学中最重要的未解决问题。正如他所说，这关系到数学家能否被机器取代。

The problems solvable deterministically in polynomial time make up a class called P. In his letter to von Neumann, Gödel asked about deterministic solution in kn or kn2 steps. But if we relax his step bound to an arbitrary polynomial p(n), then he is asking whether class P includes the problem of deciding the existence of proofs of length n for formulas of predicate logic. The latter problem includes the satisfiability problem, so Gödel is implicitly asking whether NP equals P. This has become the most important open question in logic (and computer science) today. As he says, it is the question of whether mathematicians can be replaced by machines.

命题逻辑与谓词逻辑之间

Between Propositional Logic and Predicate Logic

我仍然完全确信，不愿使用非有穷概念……是其他人在我的工作之前未能给出完备性定理的首要原因。

I am still perfectly convinced that reluctance to use non-finitary concepts …was the primary reason why the completeness theorem was not given by… anyone else before my work

——库尔特·哥德尔

—Kurt Gödel

1968 年 3 月 7 日致王浩的信，载于 Gödel（2003），第 403 页。

Letter to Hao Wang, 7 March 1968, in Gödel (2003), p. 403.

第 4.5 节谓词逻辑的完备性证明，使用了一个关于无穷的温和假定：若证明树不是有限的，它就有一条无限分支。这一假定是以下结果的特殊情形。匈牙利数学家德奈什·柯尼希于 1926 年发表了这个结果，后来通过其著作 König（1936/1990）使之更广为人知：

In the completeness proof for predicate logic in Section 4.5 there is a mild assumption about infinity. We assumed that the proof tree, if it is not finite, has an infinite branch. This assumption is a special case of the following result, which was published by the Hungarian mathematician Dénes König in 1926 and made more widely known by his book König (1936/1990):

柯尼希无穷引理

The König infinity lemma

若 T 是一棵无限树，且每个顶点只与有限多条边相接，则 T 包含一条无限分支。

If T is an infinite tree in which each vertex meets only finitely many edges, then T contains an infinite branch.

从 T 中任意一个顶点出发，考察从它引出的有限多条边。其中至少有一条边 e 通向一棵同样无限的子树 T′。于是，沿 e 移动到另一端的顶点，重复这一论证。无限继续这个过程，就得到一条无限分支。

Start at any vertex in T, and consider its finitely many outgoing edges. At least one of these edges, e, leads into a subtree T’ which is also infinite. So, move to the vertex at the other end of e and repeat the argument. Continuing the process indefinitely, we obtain an infinite branch.

柯尼希无穷引理含有某些无限性内容，因此不符合希尔伯特纲领对有穷证明的要求。例如，可以定义一棵无限的可计算树，却没有任何可计算的无限分支。事实上，哥德尔相信，自己之所以能在他人失败之处成功证明谓词逻辑的完备性，是因为愿意走出希尔伯特纲领。请记住，哥德尔对谓词逻辑的完备性证明，比其不完备性定理实质上终结希尔伯特纲领早一年。

The König infinity lemma has some infinite content which disqualifies it from the Hilbert program of finitary proofs. For example, it is possible to define an infinite computable tree with no computable infinite branch. In fact, Gödel believed that he succeeded in proving the completeness of predicate logic, where others had failed, because of his willingness to step outside the Hilbert program. (Bear in mind that Gödel’s completeness proof for predicate logic came a year before his incompleteness theorems effectively ended the Hilbert program.)

命题逻辑中的一个无限定理

We now know that the König infinity lemma is needed for any proof that predicate logic is complete. A whole subject, called reverse mathematics, has sprung up to study the assumptions on which key theorems depend. The König infinity lemma also underlies some classical theorems of analysis, such as the Heine-Borel theorem stating that any covering of [0,1] by open intervals includes a finite subcover. For more on this, see Simpson (1999).

紧致性定理

König (1936/1990) said that his lemma “furnishes a useful method of carrying over certain results from the finite to the infinite,” and illustrated the method by the Heine-Borel theorem and some theorems of combinatorics. Today, the property of [0,1] expressed by the Heine-Borel theorem is called compactness, and other properties derived from the König infinity lemma are also called “compactness.” An important example is:

若 S 是命题逻辑的一个公式集，且其任意有限子集都可满足，则整个集合 S 可满足。

Compactness theorem for propositional logic. If S is an infinite set of formulas of propositional logic, any finite subset of which is satisfiable, then the whole set S is satisfiable.

证明：首先，令 P1、P2、P3、……为 S 中公式出现的所有命题变量，并考虑对 P1、P2、P3、……的一切真值赋值所构成的树。必要时重新命名变量，可以保证变量有无限多个，因此这是一棵无限树。最初几层如图 4.5 所示。第 n 层的 2n 个顶点，每个都代表对 P1、P2、……、Pn 的一种赋值。例如，沿“左、右、左”分支到达的顶点 A，代表赋值

Proof: To launch the proof of this theorem, we let P1, P2, P3,… be all the propositional variables occurring in formulas in S, and consider the tree of all assignments of truth values to P1, P2, P3, . . . .
