By renaming variables, if necessary, we can ensure that there are infinitely many of them, so this is an infinite tree. The first few levels are shown in Figure 4.5. Each of the 2n vertices at level n represents an assignment of values to P1, P2,…,Pn. For example, the vertex A at the end of the branch that goes left, right, left represents the assignment

P1= false , P2= true , P3= false

P1= false , P2= true , P3= false 

现在对这棵树剪枝：若某个顶点对应的赋值，使 S 中某个公式为假，就删去该顶点。剩下的仍是一棵无限树 T。否则，所有分支都会在某一层 n 之前终止。此时，对 P1、P2、……、Pn 的每种真值赋值 A，都使 S 中某个公式 FA 为假。但这样一来，由这些公式 FA 组成的有限集合就不可满足，与假设矛盾。

Now we prune this tree by deleting each vertex for which the corresponding assignment falsifies some formula in S. What remains is still an infinite tree, T. If not, then all branches terminate by some level n.In that case, each assignment A of truth values to P1, P2,…, Pn falsifies some formula FA in S. But then the finite set of formulas FA is unsatisfiable, contrary to assumption.

因此，由柯尼希无穷引理，T 有一条无限分支。沿此分支赋予 P1、P2、P3、……的值，必定满足 S 中所有公式，否则这条分支就不可能在剪枝过程中保留下来。□

Thus, by the König infinity lemma, T has an infinite branch. The values assigned to P1, P2, P3, … along this branch necessarily satisfy all formulas in S, otherwise the branch would not have survived the pruning process. □

命题逻辑的紧致性定理，带有某种谓词逻辑的意味，而且不只是证明风格如此。借助一个把每个谓词逻辑公式替换为一组通常为无限的命题逻辑公式的技巧，它确实蕴涵谓词逻辑中相应的紧致性定理。

The compactness theorem for propositional logic has a certain smell of predicate logic about it, and not only in the style of proof. It really implies the corresponding compactness theorem for predicate logic, thanks to a trick that replaces each formula of predicate logic by a (usually infinite) set of formulas of propositional logic.

实际上，谓词逻辑的紧致性定理发现得更早。它是哥德尔 1929 年完备性定理证明中的一个步骤。正如经常发生的那样，其本质，即命题逻辑中的形式，最终归结为柯尼希无穷引理，是后来才提炼出来的。

The compactness theorem for predicate logic was actually discovered first. It was one of the steps in Gödel’s proof of the completeness theorem in 1929. As is often the case, its essence—in propositional logic and ultimately in the König infinity lemma—was distilled out only later.

注释

Notes

1　“谓词”就是如今所说的性质，它是关系的特殊情形，即一元关系。使用“关系逻辑”这个名称也许更好，但除了 19 世纪有一段时期逻辑学家曾谈论“关系项的逻辑”之外，这个名称始终没有流行起来。

1“Predicates” are what we nowadays call properties, which are a special case of relations (the one-variable case). It would be better to use the term “relation logic,” but this has never caught on, outside a period in the 19th century when logicians spoke of the “logic of relatives.”

2　必须承认，形如 ¬(∀x)A(x)∨ℬ 的语句会沿分支一直保留下去，但它们会产生形如 ¬A(a) 的析取项，而这些析取项可以继续分解。

2 Admittedly, sentences of the form ¬(∀x)A(x)∨ℬ are carried all the way down the branch, but they spawn disjuncts of the form ¬A(a), which can be broken down.

第 5 章　算术

- Chapter 5 - Arithmetic

概览

Preview

上一章说明，逻辑是“简单的”：其有效语句可以用直接的方式证明。证明遵循自然的规则，由较简单的语句构造目标语句，实质上是把一种穷尽式证伪尝试反过来；这种尝试通过把目标语句分解为较简单的部分来进行。

In the previous chapter we showed that logic is “simple” in the sense that its valid sentences can be proved in a straightforward way. Proofs proceed by natural rules that build up the target sentence from simpler sentences, essentially by reversing an exhaustive attempt to falsify the target sentence by breaking it down to simpler parts.

无切割逻辑的简单性，使我们能够用形式算术中已有的初等方法证明其一致性。根据哥德尔第二定理，算术本身的一致性不能用这些方法证明，但对它们作一种自然扩展就足够了。

The simplicity of logic without cuts allows its consistency to be proved by elementary means, available in formal arithmetic. The consistency of arithmetic itself cannot be proved by these means—by Gödel’s second theorem—but a natural extension of them suffices.

形式算术的关键成分，是对正整数，也就是小于 ω 的序数的归纳。有限序数上的归纳足以证明逻辑的一致性，根本原因在于，逻辑有效语句可以通过有限过程识别。由于算术包含有限序数上的归纳，算术真理涉及对无限过程的考察。归纳还迫使我们使用切割规则。因此，算术的逻辑相当复杂，其一致性只能通过超限归纳证明。适当的归纳一直达到序数 ε0。

The essential ingredient of formal arithmetic is induction over the positive integers, that is, ordinals less than ω. Induction over finite ordinals suffices to prove the consistency of logic, basically because logically valid sentences can be recognized by finite processes. Truth in arithmetic involves consideration of infinite processes, since arithmetic contains induction over finite ordinals. Induction also forces us to use the cut rule. As a result, the logic of arithmetic is quite complex, and its consistency can only be proved only by transfinite induction. The appropriate induction goes up to the ordinal ε0.

我们将描述标准公理系统 PA（“皮亚诺算术”）中的证明，以及把它们翻译到在某些方面更简单的系统 PAω 的方法，从而概述算术的一致性证明。问题在于，PAω 中的证明可能是无限的，必须消去其中的切割，才能使它们简单到足以保证 PA 的一致性。这需要为 PAω 中的证明赋予小于 ε0 的序数，并用 ε0-归纳消去切割。

We outline a consistency proof for arithmetic by describing proofs in a standard axiom system PA (“Peano arithmetic”) and their translations into a system PAω, which is in some ways simpler. The catch is that proofs in PAω may be infinite, and it is necessary to eliminate cuts from them before they become simple enough to ensure the consistency of PA. This involves assigning ordinals < ε0 to proofs in PAω, and using ε0-induction to eliminate cuts.

5.1　我们可以怎样证明一致性？

5.1 How Might We Prove Consistency?

下面几节将给出“算术”或“初等数论”的一个形式系统，并概述其一致性的证明。由哥德尔第二不完备性定理可知，这样的证明必须使用一条超出算术本身的公理。如第 3.4 节所暗示的，一个自然选择是 ε0-归纳，其中 ε0 是第 2.1 节介绍的可数序数。不过，在解释为什么 ε0 恰好能描述算术的复杂性之前，先听听发现序数与一致性之间联系的格哈德⋅根岑的说法。下面这段文字出自他在一致性证明发表后不久，于 1936 年面向普通读者撰写的《数学中的无穷概念》，参见 Gentzen（1969），第 231–232 页。

In the sections below we will give a formal system for “arithmetic” or “elementary number theory,” and outline a proof that it is consistent. As we know from Gödel’s second incompleteness theorem, such a proof must involve an axiom that goes beyond arithmetic itself. And as we have intimated in Section 3.4, a natural axiom to choose is ε0-induction, where ε0 is the countable ordinal introduced in Section 2.1. But before we explain why ε0 is the right ordinal to describe the complexity of arithmetic, let us hear from Gerhard Gentzen, who discovered the connection between ordinals and consistency. The following passage is from a piece he wrote for a general audience in 1936, Der Unendlichkeitsbegriff in der Mathematik (The concept of infinity in mathematics), shortly after the publication of his consistency proof. (See Gentzen (1969), pp. 231-232.)

现在我要解释，超限序数概念和超限归纳规则如何进入一致性证明。这种联系十分自然，也很简单。在证明初等数论的一致性时，必须考察一切可以设想的数论证明，并说明每个证明在某种将予以形式定义的意义上都给出“正确”的结果，尤其不会给出矛盾。一个证明的“正确性”，取决于包含在其中、作为特殊情形或组成部分的某些较简单证明的正确性。因此，我们把证明排成线性次序，使一个证明所依赖的那些证明，在序列中位于它之前。具体做法是为每个证明对应一个超限序数：排在给定证明之前的，恰好是序数小于该证明序数的那些证明……需要超限序数的原因如下：一个证明的正确性，可能取决于无限多个较简单证明的正确性。例如，假设在证明中，通过完全归纳证明了一个命题对所有自然数成立。那么，这个证明的正确性，显然取决于对每个特定自然数作特化所得到的无限多个个别证明的正确性。此时，自然数不足以充当这个证明的序数，因为在自然次序中，每个自然数之前只有有限多个其他数。因此，为了按照复杂性表示证明的自然次序，我们需要超限序数。

I shall explain now how the concepts of the transfinite ordinal numbers and the rule of transfinite induction enter into the consistency proof. The connection is quite natural and simple. In carrying out a consistency proof for elementary number theory we must consider all conceivable number-theoretical proofs and must show that in a certain sense, to be formally defined, each individual proof yields a ‘correct’ result, in particular, no contradiction. The ‘correctness’ of the proof depends on the correctness of certain other simpler proofs contained in it as special cases or constituent parts. This fact has motivated the arrangement of proofs in linear order in such a way that those proofs on whose correctness the correctness of another depends precede the latter proof in the sequence. This arrangement of proofs is brought about by correlating with each proof a certain transfinite ordinal number; the proofs preceding a given proof are precisely those proofs whose ordinal numbers precede the ordinal number of the given proof … we need the transfinite ordinal numbers for the following reason: It may happen that the correctness of a proof depends on the correctness of infinitely many simpler proofs. An example: Suppose that in the proof a proposition is proved for all natural numbers by complete induction. In that case the correctness of the proof obviously depends on the correctness of every single one of the infinitely many individual proofs obtained by specializing to a particular natural number. Here a natural number is insufficient as an ordinal number for the proof, since each natural number is preceded by only finitely many other numbers in the natural ordering. We therefore need the transfinite ordinal numbers in order to represent the natural ordering of the proofs according to their complexity.

根岑忠实地描述了其证明的主要思想，但其中两个说法，可能令有数论证明经验的读者感到困惑。

Gentzen faithfully describes the main ideas of his proof, but there are two claims that may seem puzzling to anyone with some experience of proofs in number theory.

  1. 其一是说，任何证明都可以建立在“包含于其中的较简单证明”之上。数学中常常从复杂前提得出简单结论。这通常是由于分离规则，或按根岑的说法，切割规则：由 P⇒Q 和 P 推出 Q。结论 Q 不再含有可能更复杂的命题 P 的任何痕迹，却似乎依赖于它。根岑在较早的工作中证明，标准逻辑中的任何证明都能重新组织，消去所有切割，从而解决这个问题；我们在第 4 章也做到了这一点。
  2. The claim that any proof may be based on “simpler proofs contained in it.” It often happens in mathematics that a simple conclusion is drawn from complicated premises. This is typically due to the modus ponens, or cut rule (as Gentzen called it): from P ⇒ Q and P, infer Q. The conclusion Q contains no trace of the (possibly more complicated) proposition P, yet it seems to depend on it. Gentzen got around this problem in an earlier work (and we did in Chapter 4) by showing that any proof in standard logic may be reorganized to eliminate all cuts.
  3. 其二是说，归纳证明依赖于“对特定自然数作特化所得到的无限多个证明”。证明关于正整数 n 的语句 S(n) 时，并不真的证明无限多个命题 S(1)、S(2)、S(3)、……，而是先证明特殊命题 S(1)，再证明一般命题“对所有 k，有 S(k)⇒S(k+1)”。尽管如此，一般命题“对所有 n，S(n) 成立”的序数层级，自然应当放在所有特殊命题 S(1)、S(2)、S(3)、……的层级之上。
  4. The claim that a proof by induction depends on the “infinitely many proofs obtained by specializing to particular natural numbers.” In proving a sentence S (n) about a positive integer n one does not literally prove the infinitely many propositions S(1), S(2), S(3),…. Instead, one proves the special proposition S(1) and then the general proposition “S(k) ⇒S(k + 1) for all k.” Nevertheless, the ordinal level of the general proposition “S(n) holds for all n”is naturally placed above the levels of all the special propositions S(1), S(2), S(3),….

这两个说法指出了初等数论一致性证明中的两个不同问题：一个是纯逻辑中就已出现的切割消去问题，另一个是数论特有的归纳问题。第 4.3 和 4.5 节已经给出逻辑的无切割处理，因此现在只需讨论归纳。

These two claims point to two separate issues in the consistency proof for elementary number theory: the issue of cut elimination, which already arises in pure logic, and the issue of induction, which is specific to number theory. Since we have given a cut-free approach to logic in Sections 4.3 and 4.5, it remains to discuss induction.

5.2　形式算术

5.2 Formal Arithmetic

算术的语言采用第 4 章介绍的语言，但去掉关系 m<n，因为它可以定义为

We take the language of arithmetic to be that in Section 4.4, except that we drop the relation m < n, since it can be defined by

(∃l)(l+m=n).

这里假定变量遍历正整数，因此第 2.5 节中加法与乘法的定义也要相应调整。这种语言适用的逻辑是谓词逻辑。如果可以直接使用谓词逻辑的推理规则，并把 1+1=2 这样的显然数事实作为算术公理，那就很好了。然而，这个想法并不完全可行，因为归纳至关重要。要证明语句 (∀n)Ƥ(n)，其中 Ƥ 表示用形式语言写出的某个性质，通常必须证明语句 Ƥ(1) 和 (∀n)(Ƥ(n)⇒Ƥ(n+1))。

(This assumes that our variables range over positive integers, so the definitions of plus and times from Section 2.5 will be adjusted accordingly.) The appropriate logic for this language is predicate logic. It would be nice if we could use the rules of inference for predicate logic, and take the axioms of arithmetic to be obvious facts about numbers, such as 1+1=2. This idea does not quite work, however, because induction is crucial. To prove a sentence (∀n)Ƥ(n), where Ƥ denotes some property written in our formal language, we generally have to prove the sentences Ƥ(1) and (∀n)(Ƥ (n) = Ƥ(n + 1)).

这相当于使用无限多条如下形式的归纳公理：

This amounts to using infinitely many induction axioms of the form

[Ƥ(1)∧(∀n)(Ƥ(n)⇒Ƥ(n+1))]⇒(∀n)Ƥ(n)　(n→n+1)

对于算术语言中每个可表达的性质 Ƥ，都有一条这样的公理。几乎任何关于正整数的一般语句都依赖于归纳，因此，为证明 (∀n)(1+n=n+1) 这样简单的语句，可能需要复杂的公理。典型情形是，复杂前提 A 通过切割规则给出简单结论：

one for each property Ƥ expressible in the language of arithmetic. Almost any general sentence about positive integers depends on induction, so one may need a complicated axiom to prove a simple sentence like (∀n)(1 + n = n + 1). Typically, a complicated premise A yields a simple conclusion by the cut rule,

由 A⇒B 和 A 推出 B。

 from A⇒B and A infer B. 

事实上，根岑的算术一致性证明，就是以从含切割规则的形式系统中消去切割为基础的；两年前，他已在谓词逻辑中引入这一思想。不过，我们现在知道，谓词逻辑的一切有效语句，都能像第 4 章那样，在完全不考虑切割规则的情况下证明，因此很自然地想对算术也这样做。

Indeed Gentzen’s consistency proof for arithmetic is based on eliminating cuts from a formal system with the cut rule, an idea he had introduced two years earlier for predicate logic. However, we now know that all valid sentences of predicate logic can be proved without even thinking about the cut rule—as in Section 4.4—so it is tempting to try to do the same for arithmetic.

避免切割和复杂归纳公理的一种办法，是使用德国数学家库尔特⋅许特于 1951 年引入的思想：把普通算术“嵌入”一个具有所谓 ω-规则的系统：

One way to avoid cuts and the complicated induction axioms is to use an idea introduced by the German mathematician Kurt Schütte in 1951. We “embed” ordinary arithmetic in a system with the so-called ω-rule,

由 Ƥ(1)、Ƥ(2)、Ƥ(3)、……推出 (∀n)Ƥ(n)。（ω）

from Ƥ(1)、Ƥ(2)、Ƥ(3)、…… infer (∀n)Ƥ(n) (ω)

这条规则有无限多个前提，看起来也许像是在作弊，因为人或计算机实际上无法执行它。然而，ω-规则的逻辑后果构成一个数学上定义良好的集合，我们能够证明其中只包含真的算术语句。因此，若能证明归纳规则 (n→n+1) 的所有后果都可以由 ω-规则得到，就能推出形式算术也是一致的。

This rule, with its infinitely many premises, may seem like cheating— because a human being (or a computer) cannot actually execute it. However, the logical consequences of the ω-rule are a mathematically welldefined set, which we can prove contains only true sentences of arithmetic. Therefore, if we prove that all consequences of the induction rules (n → n + 1) can be obtained by the ω-rule, it will follow that formal arithmetic is also consistent.

问题在于，乍看之下，要把归纳证明搬过来，似乎只能同时使用切割规则和 ω-规则。随后必须证明所有切割都能消去，从而回到一致的无切割系统。

The catch is that, at first sight, the only way to carry over induction proofs is to include the cut rule along with the ω-rule. We then have to show that all cuts can be eliminated, thus getting back to the consistent cut-free system.

第 5.4 节将概述，普通归纳公理 (n→n+1) 的任何后果如何用 ω-规则推出。最后，第 5.5 节将通过超限归纳，从具有 ω-规则的系统中消去切割。事实表明，使用直到序数 ε0 的归纳既必要又充分。

In Section 5.4 we sketch how any consequence of the ordinary induction axioms (n → n + 1) can be derived using the ω-rule. Finally, in Section 5.5 we eliminate cuts from the ω-rule system by transfinite induction. It turns out to be necessary and sufficient to use induction up to the ordinal ε0.

5.3　系统 PA 与 PAω

5.3 The Systems PA and PAω

为解释普通算术的形式系统如何嵌入一个具有 ω-规则的系统，需要更精确地描述这两个系统。普通算术通常称为皮亚诺算术，记作 PA。

To explain how the formal system of ordinary arithmetic can be embedded in a system with the ω-rule, we need to describe both systems more precisely. Ordinary arithmetic is a system commonly known as Peano arithmetic, and denoted by PA.

其公理以意大利数学家朱塞佩⋅皮亚诺命名，他于 1889 年陈述了这些公理。戴德金此前已经研究过实质相同的公理，而皮亚诺也承认戴德金和格拉斯曼对自己工作的影响。这三位数学家都认识到归纳的关键作用；如今，归纳通常以前一节给出的 (n→n+1) 形式表达。1 因此，下面就是今天通常所说的“皮亚诺算术”。

Its axioms get their name from the Italian mathematician Giuseppe Peano, who stated them in 1889. Essentially the same axioms had already been studied by Dedekind, and Peano acknowledged the influence of both Dedekind and Grassmann on his work. All three mathematicians recognized the crucial role of induction, which is usually expressed today in the form (n → n + 1) given in the previous section.1 Thus, the following is what we usually mean by “Peano Arithmetic” today.

PA 的公理

Axioms of PA

PA 的公理陈述正整数的一些显然性质。与普通数学一样，把不等关系 ¬(m=n) 简写为 m≠n，并把含自由变量 m、n、……的陈述，解释为对所有 m、所有 n、……都为真。

The axioms of PA state some obvious properties of the positive integers. As in ordinary mathematics, we abbreviate the inequation (m = n) by m = n, and interpret statements with free variables m, n,… as true for all m,all n,…

  1. 数 1 不是任何数的后继：1≠S(n)。
  2. The number 1 is not a successor: 1 = S(n).
  3. 后继相同的数相等：S(m)=S(n)⇒m=n。
  4. Numbers with the same successor are equal: S(m) = S(n) ⇒ m = n

  5. 加法的归纳定义：

    Inductive definition of sum:

    m+1=S(m), m+S(n)=S(m+n).

  6. 乘法的归纳定义：

    Inductive definition of product:

    m⋅1=m, m⋅S(n)=m⋅n+m.

  7. 归纳：对语言中可表达的所有性质 Ƥ，

    Induction: for all properties Ƥ expressible in the language,

    [Ƥ(1)∧(∀n)(Ƥ(n)⇒Ƥ(n+1))]⇒(∀n)Ƥ(n)　(n→n+1)

    由于 Ƥ 有无限多个实例，更准确地说，这叫作公理模式。

    (Since there are infinitely many instances of Ƥ, thisismore properly called an axiom schema.)

PA 的推理规则

Rules of inference of PA

推理规则采用第 4 章给出的谓词逻辑规则，并加上切割规则：

As rules of inference we take the rules for predicate logic given in Sections 4.3 and 4.4, together with the cut rule:

切割。由 ℬ∨A 和 ¬A∨C 推出 ℬ∨C。

Cut.From ℬ∨A and ¬A∨C infer ℬ∨C.

把 ¬A∨C 翻译为 A⇒C，就能看出切割规则实质上是分离规则的对称形式。分离规则说，由 A 和 A⇒C 可以推出 C。因此，由 ℬ∨A 和 A⇒C 可以推出 ℬ∨C。

The cut rule is essentially a symmetric form of modus ponens, as one sees by translating ¬A∨C into A⇒C. Modus ponens says that from A and A⇒C we can infer C. Therefore, from ℬ∨A and A⇒C we can infer ℬ∨C.

具有 ω-规则的算术，其公理非常简单，推理规则类似谓词逻辑，只是用 ω-规则代替通常的 ∀ 规则。我们把这个系统称为 PAω，因为它能证明 PA 的所有定理。如前一节所述，PAω 中包含切割规则，只是为了便于从 PA 转移证明。事实上，去掉切割规则后的 PAω 是一个完备系统，其定理恰好是 PA 语言中的真语句。

Arithmetic with the ω-rule is a system with very simple axioms, and rules of inference like those of predicate logic, except that the ω-rule replaces the usual ∀-rule. We call the system PAω because it turns out to prove all theorems of PAω As mentioned in the previous section, the cut rule is in PAω only to facilitate the transfer of proofs from PA. PAω minus the cut rule is in fact a complete system; its theorems are precisely the true sentences of PA.

PAω 的公理

Axioms of PAω

PAω 的公理，基本上就是小学里所谓的“算术”，即关于数的和与积的一切真事实。准确地说，把只涉及常量的一切真等式，例如 1+1=2，以及只涉及常量的一切假等式的否定，例如 ¬(2⋅2=3)，都取为公理。

The axioms of PAω, are basically what we called “arithmetic” in elementary school, namely, all true facts about sums and products of numbers. To be precise, we take as axioms all true equations involving only constants (such as 1 + 1 = 2), and the negations of all false equations involving only constants (such as 2 · 2 = 3).

PAω 的推理规则

Rules of inference of PAω

PAω 的推理规则包括切割规则、第 4.3 节的命题逻辑规则、第 4.5 节谓词逻辑的 ¬∀ 规则，以及用来代替 ∀ 规则的第 5.2 节的 ω-规则。

As rules of inference for PAω we take the cut rule, the propositional rules of Section 4.3, the ∀-rule for predicate logic of Section 4.5, and (in place of the ∀-rule) the ω-rule of Section 5.2.

5.4　把 PA 嵌入 PAω

5.4 Embedding PA in PAω

PAω 包含命题逻辑的全部推理规则，但其公理并不包含逻辑公理 A∨¬A。因此，PAω 是否能证明 PA 语言中在命题逻辑上有效的所有语句，并不立即显然。

PAω includes all the rules of inference of propositional logic, but its axioms do not include the logic axioms A∨¬A. So it is not immediately clear that PAω proves all sentences of PA valid in propositional logic.

为说明形如 A∨¬A 的任何语句都是 PAω 的定理，对 A 中逻辑符号的个数，即 A 的度，作归纳。

To show that any sentence of the form A∨¬A is a theorem of PAω we use induction on the number of logical symbols in A (called the degree of A).

基础步骤。若 A 不含逻辑符号，则 A 或 ¬A 是 PAω 的公理，因此由弱化规则可得 A∨¬A。

Base step. If A has no logic symbols then either A or ¬A is an axiom of PAω, and hence A∨¬A follows by the dilution rule.

归纳步骤。若 A 含有逻辑符号，则它形如 ¬A1、A1∨A2 或 (∀x)A(x)，其中 A1、A2 和 A(x) 的度都较低。因此，根据归纳假设，可以假定 A1∨¬A1 等语句是 PAω 的定理，再用 PAω 的规则证明 A∨¬A。

Induction step.If A has logic symbols then it has the form ¬A1,A1∨A2, or  (∀x)A(x),where A1,A2,and A(x) have lower degree. We can therefore assume, by induction, that A1∨¬A1 and the like are theorems of PAω. We can then use rules of PAω to prove A∨¬A.

例如，假定对于任意自由变量 x，A(x)∨¬A(x) 是定理，那么只需在证明中把 x 分别替换为 1、2、……，就能证明

For example, if we assume that A(x)∨¬A(x) is a theorem for any free variable x,thenwecanprove

A(1)∨¬A(1), A(2)∨¬A(2), …

接着，由 ¬∀ 规则可以证明

by replacing x in the proof by 1, 2, … . Next we can prove

A(1)∨¬(∀x)A(x), A(2)∨¬(∀x)A(x), …

最后，由 ω-规则推出 (∀x)A(x)∨¬(∀x)A(x)。

by the∀-rule, and finally (∀x)A(x)∨¬(∀x)A(x) follows by the ω-rule.

因此，PAω 能证明 PA 语言中在命题逻辑上有效的所有语句。

Thus PAω proves all sentences of PA valid in propositional logic.

由此可知，PAω 也能证明 PA 语言中在谓词逻辑上有效的所有语句。PAω 包含谓词逻辑的 ¬∀ 规则；而 ∀ 规则的应用，可以通过其在 PAω 中的替代规则，即 ω-规则实现。具体说，若能对自由变量 x 证明 A(x)，只需在证明中把字母 x 分别替换为 1、2、……，就能证明 A(1)、A(2)、……。随后，由 ω-规则推出 (∀x)A(x)，这正是通过 ∀ 规则从 A(x) 得到的结论。

It follows that PAω also proves all sentences of PA valid in predicate logic. PAω includes the ∀ rule of predicate logic, and we can effect applications of the ∀ rule by applications of its replacement in PAω, the ω-rule. Namely, if we can prove A(x) for a free variable x,then we can also prove A(1),A(2),…, simply by replacing the letter x in the proof by 1, 2, … . And then (∀x)A(x), the consequence of A(x) by the ∀ rule, follows by the ω-rule.

如何在 PAω 中证明 PA 的公理？

How do we prove the axioms of PA in PAω?

借助 ω-规则，PA 的前四条公理很容易在 PAω 中证明。例如，为证明第一条公理 (∀n)[1≠S(n)]，只需把 ω-规则应用于以下无限多个语句：

The first four axioms of PA are easily proved in PAω thanks to the ω-rule. For example, to prove the first axiom, (∀n)[1 ≠ S(n)],it suffices to apply the ω-rule to the infinitely many sentences

1≠S(1), 1≠S(2), 1≠S(3), …

它们全都是 PAω 的公理。

all of which are axioms of PAω.

最困难的情形是归纳公理

The most difficult case is the induction axiom

[Ƥ(1)∧(∀n)(Ƥ(n)⇒Ƥ(n+1))]⇒(∀n)Ƥ(n)　(n→n+1)

它在逻辑上等价于

which is logically equivalent to

Ƥ(1)⇒[(∀n)(Ƥ(n)⇒Ƥ(n+1))⇒(∀n)Ƥ(n)]

因而可以用 ¬、∨、∀ 写成

and hence can be written in terms of , ∨, ∀ as

¬Ƥ(1)∨¬(∀n)(¬Ƥ(n)∨Ƥ(n+1))∨(∀n)Ƥ(n)

为在 PAω 中证明这个归纳陈述，首先注意，以下语句在命题逻辑上有效，因此在 PAω 中可证。

To prove this statement of induction in PAω, first notice that the following sentences are valid in propositional logic (and hence provable in PAω).

¬Ƥ(1)∨Ƥ(1)¬Ƥ(1)∨¬[¬Ƥ(1)∨Ƥ(2)]∨Ƥ(2)⋮¬Ƥ(1)∨¬[¬Ƥ(1)∨Ƥ(2)]∨⋯∨¬[¬Ƥ(k)∨Ƥ(k+1)]∨Ƥ(k+1)

第一个显然成立；其余各个都容易由前一个推出，特别是把 ¬[¬Ƥ(i)∨Ƥ(i+1)] 翻译为 Ƥ(i)∧¬Ƥ(i+1) 时。

(The first is obvious, and each of the rest follows easily from its predecessor, particularly if one translates [Ƥ(i) ∧Ƥ(i + 1)] into Ƥ(i)∧ Ƥ (i + 1).)

每个方括号中的项都形如

Each bracketed term has the form

¬[¬Ƥ(i)∨Ƥ(i+1)]

由它们通过 ¬∀ 规则，得到相同的结论

from which we get thesameconsequence

¬(∀n)[¬Ƥ(n)∨Ƥ(n+1)]

把这些相同的项收缩后，得到定理

by the ∀-rule. Consolidating the latter identical terms, we get the theorem

¬Ƥ(1)∨¬(∀n)[¬Ƥ(n)∨Ƥ(n+1)]∨Ƥ(k+1)

对 k+1=2、3、……都能证明这个定理；事实上，利用定理 ¬Ƥ(1)∨Ƥ(1) 和弱化规则，对 k+1=1 也能证明。因此，可以对 Ƥ(k+1)=Ƥ(1)、Ƥ(2)、……应用 ω-规则，得到

We can prove this theorem for k + 1 = 2,3,…, and in fact also for k + 1 = 1(usingthe theorem (1) ∨(1) and dilution), so we can apply the ω-rule to Ƥ(k + 1) = Ƥ(1), Ƥ(2),… and get

¬Ƥ(1)∨¬(∀n)[¬Ƥ(n)∨Ƥ(n+1)]∨(∀n)Ƥ(n)

这就是归纳公理。

which is the induction axiom.

因此，PA 的所有公理都是 PAω 的定理。

Thus all the axioms of PA are theorems of PAω.

PA 的任意定理 S，都是有限多条公理，比如 A1、A2、……、Aₖ 的逻辑后果，因此

Any theorem S of PA is a logical consequence of finitely many axioms, say A1,A2,…,Ak, in which case

A1∧A2∧⋯∧Ak⇒S, 即 (¬A1)∨(¬A2)∨⋯∨(¬Ak)∨S

A1∧A2∧⋯∧Ak⇒S, that is,  (¬A1)∨(¬A2)∨⋯∨(¬Ak)∨S

在逻辑上有效。由谓词逻辑的完备性可知，语句 A1∧A2∧⋯∧Aₖ⇒S 可以通过谓词逻辑规则证明，因此根据上面的说明，也能在 PAω 中证明。

is logically valid. It follows, by the completeness of predicate logic, that the sentence A1∧A2∧⋯∧Ak⇒S can be proved by the rules for predicate logic, and hence it can be proved in PAω, by the remarks above.

最后，既然 A1、A2、……、Aₖ 是 PA 的公理，因而是 PAω 的定理，而 A1∧A2∧⋯∧Aₖ⇒S 也是定理，就能由切割规则得到 S 是 PAω 的定理。因此，PA 的每个定理都是 PAω 的定理。

Finally, given that A1,A2,…,Ak are axioms of PA, hence theorems of PA0,and A1∧A2∧⋯∧Ak⇒S is also a theorem, we get S as a theorem of PAω by the cut rule. Thus every theorem of PA is a theorem of PAω.

事实上，PAω 中的所有定理都可以不用切割规则证明，这容易给出 PAω 的一致性证明，从而也证明 PA 的一致性。不过，在上面把 PA 嵌入 PAω 的过程中，若不用切割，就很难看出为什么 PA 的定理也是 PAω 的定理。因此，一开始把切割列为 PAω 的规则，随后才说明所有定理都可以不用它来证明。下一节将概述这个过程，即 PAω 的切割消去。超限归纳和序数 ε0 正是在切割消去时登场的。

In PAω it is in fact possible to prove all theorems without using the cut rule, which gives an easy proof that PAω is consistent. However, as one can guess from the embedding of PA in PAω carried outabove, itishard to see why the theorems of PA are theorems of PAω without using cut. This is why we include cut among the rules of PAω in the beginning, and only later show that all theorems of PAω can be proved without it. This process—cut elimination for PAω—will be sketched in the next section. Cut elimination is where transfinite induction and the ordinal εö come into the story.

5.5　PAω 中的切割消去

5.5 Cut Elimination in PAω

PA 中的证明，与第 4.3 和 4.5 节的形式证明一样，可以看作有限树。各分支从公理开始，通向树根处的定理。第 5.4 节说明 PA 的定理也是 PAω 的定理时，实质上做了“树外科手术”，把 PA 中的证明树变为 PAω 中的证明树。在手术过程中，由于构造归纳公理的实例时使用 ω-规则，树可能变成无限的。然而，PAω 中证明树的每条分支都是有限的，2 这使我们能如下为树的每个顶点赋予一个可数序数。

Proofs in PA, like the formal proofs described in Sections 4.3 and 4.5, can be viewed as finite trees. The branches begin with axioms and lead towards the theorem at the root. In showing that theorems of PA are theorems of PAω in Section 5.4 we essentially performed “tree surgery,” converting proof-trees in PA to proof-trees in PAω .In the surgery, the tree may become infinite, due to use of the ω-rule in building instances of the induction axioms. However, the proof-tree in PAω has only finite branches,2 and this allows us to assign a countable ordinal to each vertex in the tree as follows.

设想把树放成分支末端在上、树根在下的样子。于是推理“向下”进行，推理规则的结论所在顶点，位于前提所在顶点的“下方”。给每个分支末端的公理赋予序数 1，给每个结论赋予严格大于所有前提序数的最小序数。事实上，这个过程为任何分支均有限的可数树的各顶点，唯一地赋予可数序数。图 5.1 给出一个例子。所有分支都有限，但由于长度无上界，它们的共同顶点得到序数 ω。

Imagine the tree positioned so that the ends of branches lie at the top and the root lies at the bottom. Thus inference proceeds “downwards,” with the conclusion of a rule of inference at the vertex “below” the vertices of the premises. We assign the ordinal 1 to each axiom at the end of a branch, and to each conclusion we assign the least ordinal greater than the ordinals of the premises. This procedure in fact assigns countable ordinals uniquely to the vertices of any countable tree with finite branches. Figure 5.1 shows an example. All the branches are finite but, because they are unbounded in length, their common vertex gets the ordinal ω.

任意一棵只有有限分支的可数树，其标记可以包含任意可数序数。PAω 的证明树受到某些约束，使其序数保持在 ε0 以下，不过现在还不尝试给这些序数定界。首要目标是如下证明：PAω 的每个定理都有一个无切割证明。

Arbitrary countable trees with only finite branches may contain arbitrary countable ordinals as labels. Proof-trees in PAω are subject to certain constraints that keep their ordinals below ε0, but we will not try to bound their ordinals yet. Our first goal is to show that every theorem of PAω has a cut-free proof, which we do as follows.

对 PAω 的每个定理 S，定义 S 的序数为所有 PAω 证明树中标记 S 的最小序数。若存在没有无切割证明的 PAω 定理，就在其中取序数最小的定理 T。假设在 T 的某个序数最小的证明中，T 由语句 U1、U2、……推出。那么 U1、U2、……的序数都小于 T 的序数，因此它们都有无切割证明。

For each theorem S of PAω,let the ordinal of S be the least ordinal labeling S in all proof-trees of PAω . If there are any theorems of PAω with no cut-free proof, let T be a theorem among them with least ordinal. Suppose that, in some proof of T with minimal ordinal, T is inferred from the sentences U1,U2,… Then U1,U2,… have ordinals smaller than the ordinal of T, and hence they have cut-free proofs.

把 U1、U2、……的无切割证明拼接起来，就得到 T 的一个证明，其中从 U1、U2、……推出 T 的步骤必定是唯一的切割。因此，实际上 T 是在 U1 与 U2 的无切割证明之后，通过切割规则从 U1 与 U2 推出的。若能消去这最后一次切割，就得到 T 的无切割证明，产生矛盾，因此可以断定 PAω 的所有定理都有无切割证明。

By putting cut-free proofs of U1,U2,… together, we obtain a proof of T in which the inference of T from U1,U2,… is necessarily the only cut. Thus in fact T is inferred from U1 and U2 by the cut rule, following cutfree proofs of U1 and U2. Therefore, if this last cut can be eliminated we have a cut-free proof of Ta contradiction—so we can conclude that all theorems of PAω have cut-free proofs.

如何消去一次切割

How to Eliminate a Cut

这涉及另一次归纳，这回是对所谓切割的度作归纳：

This involves another induction, this time on the so-called degree of the cut,

由 ℬ∨A 和 ¬A∨C 推出 ℬ∨C，

 from ℬ∨A and ¬A∨C infer ℬ∨C, 

其度定义为语句 ¬A 的度，即 ¬A 中逻辑符号的个数。

which is defined to be the degree of the sentence ¬A,that is, the number of logic symbols in ¬A.

假设有一个定理 T 的证明，其中只有最后一步出现切割。下面说明，如何用度较低的切割替换它，从而最终完全消去它；这些切割又可以替换为度更低的切割，如此继续，直到所有切割消失。根据 A 形如 ¬A1、A1∨A2 或 (∀x)A(x)，分为三种情形。

Suppose that we have a proof of a theorem T in which a cut occurs only at the very last step. We now show how to eliminate this cut altogether by replacing it by cuts of lower degree (which can then be replaced by cuts of still lower degree, and so on, until all cuts vanish). There are three cases, according as A has the form ¬A1,A1∨A2, or (∀x)A(x).

  1. 当 A=¬A₁ 时，切割为：

    When A=¬A1 the cut is

    由 ℬ∨¬A1 和 ¬¬A1∨C 推出 ℬ∨C，

     from ℬ∨¬A1 and ¬¬A1∨C infer ℬ∨C, 

    这是某个证明的最后一步，该证明包含 ℬ∨¬A1 和 ¬¬A1∨C 的无切割子证明。由第 4.3 节关于“圆满结尾”的讨论可知，可以安排 ¬¬A1∨C 的无切割证明，使其最后一步为

    and this is the last step in a proof that contains cut-free subproofs of ℬ∨¬A1 and ¬¬A1∨C. We know from the “happy ending” remarks of Section 4.3 that the cut-free proof of ¬¬A1∨C can be arranged so that its last step is

    由 A1∨C 推出 ¬¬A1∨C。

     from A1∨C infer ¬¬A1∨C. 

    这样，就能通过以下度较低的切割，推出定理 T=ℬ∨C：

    But then we can infer our theorem T=ℬ∨C by the lower-degree cut

    由 ℬ∨¬A1 和 A1∨C 推出 ℬ∨C，

     from ℬ∨¬A1 and A1∨C infer ℬ∨C, 

    其中 A1∨C 是 ¬¬A1∨C 的证明中倒数第二个语句。

    where A1∨C is the penultimate sentence in the proof of ¬¬A1∨C.

  2. 当 A=A₁∨A₂ 时，切割为：

    When A=A1∨A2 the cut is

    由 ℬ∨(A1∨A2) 和 ¬(A1∨A2)∨C 推出 ℬ∨C，

     from ℬ∨(A1∨A2) and ¬(A1∨A2)∨C infer ℬ∨C, 

    这是某个证明的最后一步，该证明包含 ℬ∨(A1∨A2) 和 ¬(A1∨A2)∨C 的无切割子证明。同样，由第 4.3 节关于“圆满结尾”的讨论可知，可以安排 ¬(A1∨A2)∨C 的无切割证明，使其最后一步为

    and this is the last step in a proof that contains cut-free subproofs of ℬ∨(A1∨A2) and ¬(A1∨A2)∨C. Again we know, from the “happy ending” remarks of Section 4.3, that the cut-free proof of ¬(A1∨A2)∨C can be arranged so that its last step is

    由 ¬A1∨C 和 ¬A2∨C 推出 ¬(A1∨A2)∨C。

     from ¬A1∨C and ¬A2∨C infer ¬(A1∨A2)∨C. 

    这样，就能通过两次度较低的切割，推出定理 T=ℬ∨C：

    But then we can infer our theorem T=ℬ∨C from two lower-degree cuts:

    由 ℬ∨A1∨A2 和 ¬A1∨C 推出 ℬ∨A2∨C；再由 ℬ∨A2∨C 和 ¬A2∨C 推出 ℬ∨C。

     from ℬ∨A1∨A2 and ¬A1∨C infer ℬ∨A2∨C,  from ℬ∨A2∨C and ¬A2∨C infer ℬ∨C. 

  3. 当 A=(∀x)A(x) 时，切割为：

    When A=(∀x)A(x) the cut is

    由 ℬ∨(∀x)A(x) 和 ¬(∀x)A(x)∨C 推出 ℬ∨C，

     from ℬ∨(∀x)A(x) and ¬(∀x)A(x)∨C infer ℬ∨C, 

    这是某个证明的最后一步，该证明包含 ℬ∨(∀x)A(x) 和 ¬(∀x)A(x)∨C 的无切割子证明。这一次，由第 4.6 节关于“圆满结尾”的讨论可知，可以安排 ¬(∀x)A(x)∨C 的无切割证明，使其最后一步为

    and this is the last step in a proof that contains cut-free subproofs of ℬ∨(∀x)A(x) and ¬(∀x)A(x)∨C. Yet again we know, this time from the “happy ending” remarks of Section 4.6, that the cut-free proof of ¬(∀x)A(x)∨C can be arranged so that its last step is

    由 ¬A(a)∨C 推出 ¬(∀x)A(x)∨C，

     from ¬A(a)∨C infer ¬(∀x)A(x)∨C, 

    其中 a 是某个正整数。另一方面，由类似的“圆满结尾”论证，也有 ℬ∨(∀x)A(x) 的无切割证明，其最后一步从把 (∀x)A(x) 分别替换为 A(1)、A(2)、A(3)、……所得到的全部语句推出结论。这些语句包含 ℬ∨A(a)，因此可以通过以下度较低的切割，得到定理 T=ℬ∨C：

    for some positive integer a. But we also have, by a similar “happy ending” argument, a cut-free proof of ℬ∨(∀x)A(x) in which the last step derives it from all the sentences in which (∀x)A(x) is replaced by A(1),A(2),A(3),…. These include ℬ∨A(a), so we can obtain our theorem T=ℬ∨C from the lower-degree cut

    由 ℬ∨A(a) 和 ¬A(a)∨C 推出 ℬ∨C。

     from ℬ∨A(a) and ¬A(a)∨C infer ℬ∨C. 

因此，在所有情形中，都能把 T 的证明中唯一的切割替换为一到两次度较低的切割。读者也许会短暂担心，随着度降低，切割的个数会无限增长；但只要总是替换树中最先出现的切割，就不会如此。因此，T 有一个无切割证明，从而 PAω 的所有定理也都有无切割证明。

So in all cases we can replace the single cut in the proof of T by one or two cuts of lower degree. The reader may feel momentary anxiety that the number of cuts may grow beyond all bounds as the degree is reduced, but this is not the case if one always replaces the first cut in the tree. Thus T has a cut-free proof, and hence so do all theorems of PAω.

PAω 与 PA 的一致性

Consistency of PAω and PA

逻辑的一条基本原理是，矛盾蕴涵任意命题；这在命题逻辑中可以证明。因此，若 PAω 能证明任何矛盾，它也能证明假命题 1=2。但如刚才所示，若 1=2 在 PAω 中有证明，就有一个无切割证明。而由 PAω 的非切割规则可清楚看出，1=2 只有在某条公理中出现时，才可能出现在无切割证明的结论中；实际上并没有这样的公理。

One of the basic principles of logic, provable in propositional logic, is that a contradiction implies any proposition. Thus, if PAω proves any contradiction, it also proves the false proposition 1 = 2. But if 1 = 2 has a proof in PAω it has a cut-free proof, as we have just shown. And it is clear from the non-cut rules of PAω that 1 = 2 can appear in the conclusion of a cut-free proof only if it appears in an axiom, which is not the case.

因此 PAω 一致；又因为 PA 的所有定理都是 PAω 的定理，PA 也一致。

Thus PAω is consistent and hence so is PA, since all theorems of PA are theorems of PAω.

5.6　这番宏伟论证的高度

5.6 The Height of This Great Argument

愿我攀上这番宏伟

That to the highth of this great

论证的高处，

Argument

以申明永恒的天意，并向世人阐明上帝行事之正当。

I may assert Eternal Providence, And justifie the wayes of God to men.

——弥尔顿

—Milton

《失乐园》，第 24–26 行。

Paradise Lost, lines 24-26.

PA 的一致性证明最终依赖于超限归纳，因为消去切割时，假定了最小序数的存在。PA 的关键成分是有限序数上的归纳，因此确实可以说，我们在用超限归纳为普通归纳辩护。通常，这种“辩护”会被一笑置之，但在这里可以如下为它辩护。

The consistency proof for PA depends ultimately on transfinite induction, since we assume the existence of least ordinals in order to eliminate cuts. The key ingredient in PA is induction over finite ordinals, so it may truly be said that we are using transfinite induction to justify ordinary induction. Ordinarily, this kind of “justification” would be laughed out of court, but we can defend it in this case as follows.

  • 由哥德尔第二不完备性定理可知，有限序数上的归纳，即“ω-归纳”，不能证明自身的一致性。因此，若 ω-归纳的强度可以度量，也只能用某个大于 ω 的序数来度量。
  • We know, from Gödel’s second incompleteness theorem, that induction over finite ordinals (“ω-induction”) cannot prove its own consistency. Thus the strength of ω-induction can be measured, if at all, only by some ordinal greater than ω.
  • 根岑（1943）证明，对于任意小于 ε0 的序数，直到该序数的归纳都可以在 PA 中证明。
  • It was shown by Gentzen (1943) that induction up to any ordinal less than ε0 canbe proved in PA.
  • 因此，若 PA 的一致性可以通过直到 ε0 的归纳证明，ε0 就是 ω-归纳强度的精确度量。这样，一致性证明的“高度”就度量了 PA 的强度。
  • Therefore, if the consistency of PA can be proved by induction up to ε0,then ε0 is a precise measure of the strength of ω-induction. Thus the “height” of the consistency proof measures the strength of PA.

要了解这一辩护的细节，需要查阅证明论教材，例如 Troelstra 与 Schwichtenberg（1996）。不过，我们可以概述其中的思想。

To see the details of this defence, one needs to consult a textbook on proof theory, such as Troelstra and Schwichtenberg (1996). However, we can sketch the ideas involved.

在算术中编码超限归纳

Encoding Transfinite Induction in Arithmetic

ω-归纳怎么可能蕴涵某些大于 ω 的序数 α 上的归纳？首先，需要用算术语言中的语句表达超限归纳；然后，需要用 ω-归纳证明这个语句。ω2-归纳的情形可以说明这两项任务。

How can it be that ω-induction implies induction up to (some) ordinals α greater than ω? First we need to express transfinite induction by a sentence in the language of arithmetic; then we need to prove the sentence by ω-induction. Both tasks may be illustrated by the case of ω2-induction.

首先，为正整数建立一个与序数 ω2 具有相同序型的次序。这意味着，要把正整数按照小于 ω2 的序数的模式排列：

We begin by setting up an ordering of the positive integers with the same order type as the ordinal ω2. This means finding an arrangement of positive integers in the pattern of the ordinals less than ω2:

1,2,3,…ω,ω+1,ω+2,…ω⋅2,ω⋅2+1,ω⋅2+2,…ω⋅3,ω⋅3+1     ω⋅3+2,…  .

也许最简单的排列如下：

Perhaps the simplest such arrangement is

1,3,5,…2,6,10,…4,12,20,…8,24,40,….

这个排列通过把每个正整数分解为 2 的幂与一个奇数的乘积 2m(2n+1) 得到。若两个整数所含的 2 的幂不同，则幂较小者排在左边；若两个不同整数所含的 2 的幂相同，则奇因子较小者排在左边。

We obtain this arrangement by factorizing each positive integer into a power of 2 times an odd number: 2m(2n + 1). When two integers contain different powers of 2, the one with the smaller power of 2 is further to the left. And when two different integers contain the same power of 2, the one with the smaller odd factor is further to the left.

稍微形式化地说，用公式 a<ω2b 表示“a 在 b 的左边”，对于正整数 a、b，它定义为

Putting this a little more formally, we denote “a is to the left of b”by the formula a <ω2 b, defined for positive integers a and b by

a<ω2b⇔(∃m)(∃n)(∃p)(∃q) [ a=2m(2n+1)∧b=2p(2q+1) ∧(m<p∨(m=p∧n<q))].

借助第 2.5 节给出的指数运算的归纳定义，可以用皮亚诺算术的语言表达这个次序。于是，ω2-归纳等价于以下陈述：对任意在某个正整数上成立的性质 Ƥ，都存在一个具有性质 Ƥ 的“最小”正整数，这里的最小是按次序 a<ω2b 而言。与 ω-归纳一样，只需对 PA 语言中可定义的性质 Ƥ 作出这个陈述。因此，给定 Ƥ 的公式，以及刚得到的 a<ω2b 的公式，就能如下表达 ω2-归纳：

With the help of the inductive definition of exponentiation (given in Section 2.5) we can express this ordering in the language of Peano arithmetic. Then ω2-induction is equivalent to the statement that, for any property Ƥ that holds for some positive integer, there is a “least” positive integer (in the sense of the ordering a <ω2 b with property Ƥ. As with ω-induction, we need to make this statement only for properties Ƥ definable in the language of PA. Thus, given a formula for Ƥ, and the formula for a <ω2 b just obtained, we can express ω2-induction as follows:

(∃x)Ƥ(x)⇒(∃y)[Ƥ(y)∧(∀z)(z<ω2y⇒¬Ƥ(z))]

对于每个 Ƥ，都能借助 ω-归纳证明这个 ω2-归纳陈述。为找到具有性质 Ƥ 的“最小” y，把每个具有性质 Ƥ 的 x 写成 2m(2n+1)。在这些 x 中，先考虑 m 最小的那些数，其存在性由 ω-归纳保证；再在其中取 n 最小的那个数，其存在性同样由 ω-归纳保证。这样，就找到了按次序 a<ω2b 而言具有性质 Ƥ 的“最小” x，从而通过两次应用 ω-归纳证明了 ω2-归纳。显然，这个论证可以在 PA 中形式化。

For each Ƥ, we can prove this statement of ω-induction with the help of ω-induction. To find the “least” y with property Ƥ,write each x with property Ƥ in the form 2m(2n + 1).Among these numbers x, consider those with the least value of m (which exists by ω-induction). Among the latter, consider the one with the least value of n (which likewise exists by ω-induction). In this way we find the “least” x with property Ƥ (in the sense of the ordering a <ω2 b), thereby proving ω2-induction by two applications of ω-induction. It is clear that the argument can be formalized in PA.

推广这个论证，可以在 PA 中表达并证明许多可数序数 α 上的 α-归纳，但并非所有。能够这样表达的 α 显然有某个上界，因为可数序数有 ℵ1 个，而 PA 的公式只有 ℵ0 个。更有趣的是，我们证明 α-归纳的能力，弱于表达它的能力。

By elaborating on this argument we can express and prove a-induction in PA for many countable ordinals a, but not all. There is clearly some upper bound to the α for which such expressions exist, since there are ℵ1 countable ordinals but only formulas of PA. More interestingly, our ability to prove a-induction falls short of our ability to express it.

如上所述，根岑证明了，对序数 α<ε0，α-归纳可以在 PA 中证明。他此前已用 ε0-归纳证明 PA 的一致性，也知道 ε0-归纳可以在 PA 中表达，因此可以断定：ε0-归纳在 PA 中可表达却不可证明，否则 PA 就能证明自身的一致性。

As mentioned above, Gentzen showed that a-induction can be proved in PA for the ordinals α < ε0. He had already proved the consistency of PA by ε0-induction, and he knew that ε0-induction can be expressed in PA, so he could conclude that ε0-induction is expressible but not provable in PA—otherwise PA would be able to prove its own consistency.

因此，根岑伟大一致性证明的“高度” ε0，精确确定了 PA 的一致性相对于 PA 各定理的位置。如果用那些使 α-归纳可证的序数 α 来度量定理的“高度”，那么一致性的高度就是各定理高度的最小上界。根岑的证明还提示了一种用算术语句表达 PA 一致性的漂亮方法，即用一个表达 ε0-归纳的语句。如何定义所需的正整数次序也许还不清楚，但事实上，第 2 章讨论古德斯坦定理时，已经涉及一种适当方法。下一章将回到这个思想；不过，先要再谈一点 ε0。

Thus ε0—the “height” of Gentzen’s great consistency proof—pinpoints the exact position of the consistency of PA relative to the theorems of PA. If we measure the “heights” of theorems by the ordinals α for which α-induction is provable, then the height of consistency is the least upper bound of the heights of theorems. Gentzen’s proof also suggests a nice way to express the consistency of PA by an arithmetic sentence; namely, by a sentence that expresses ε0-induction. It may not be clear how to define the requisite ordering of positive integers, but in fact we already touched on a suitable method in the section on Goodstein’s theorem in Chapter 2. We return to this idea in the next chapter. But first we should say a little more about ε0.

为什么高度是 ε0

Why the Height Is ε0

由第 2.1 节可知，ε0 是以下序列的最小上界：

We know from Section 2.1 that ε0 is the least upper bound of the sequence

ω, ωω, ωωω, ωωωω,….

因此，ε0 是具有以下性质的最小序数 β：若 α<β，则 ωα<β。稍微宽松地说，ε0 是“大于 ω 且对指数运算封闭的最小序数”。

It follows that ε0 is the least ordinal β with the property that, if α < β,then ωα < β. Speaking a little more loosely, ε0 is the “least ordinal greater than ω that is closed under exponentiation.”

第 5.5 节的切割消去过程涉及指数运算。从 PA 中的一个证明出发，把它翻译为 PAω 中的证明，得到一棵分支均有限、但顶点可能无限多的树。仔细分析 PA 中的证明，可以检验，相应 PAω 证明树的序数 α<ε0。随后，分析切割消去过程可知，存在一个序数小于 2α 的无切割证明 参见例如 Mendelson（1964）的附录。由于 ε0 对指数运算封闭，这个无切割证明的序数也小于 ε0。因此，为证明消去过程中每一步都存在一个“最小”切割，所需的超限归纳就是直到 ε0 的归纳。

Exponentiation is involved in the cut elimination process of Section 5.4. We start with a proof in PA, translate it into a proof in PAω, obtaining a tree with only finite branches but perhaps infinitely many vertices. By a careful analysis of proofs in PA, it can be checked that the corresponding proof-tree in PAω has ordinal α < ε0. Then an analysis of the cutelimination process shows that there is a cut-free proof with ordinal < 2α (see, for example, the appendix of Mendelson (1964)). Since ε0 is closed under exponentiation, it follows that the ordinal of the cut-free proof is also < ε0. Therefore, the transfinite induction we need, in order to prove the existence of a “least” cut at each step of the elimination process, is induction up to ε0.

这就是 ε0-归纳蕴涵 PA 一致性的原因。

This is why ε0-induction implies the consistency of PA.

5.7　通向无穷之路

5.7 Rüads to Infinity

因此，即使只是直到 ε0 的超限归纳，也已不能从其余数论推理形式中推出；这个事实从一个新角度揭示了数论形式体系的不完备性，而哥德尔此前已从另一角度揭示了它。

The fact that transfinite induction even up to the number ε0 is no longer derivable from the remaining number-theoretical forms of inference therefore reveals from a new angle the incompleteness of the number-theoretical formalism, which has already been exposed by Gödel from a different point of view.

——格哈德⋅根岑（1943），载于 Gentzen（1969），第 307–308 页。

—Gerhard Gentzen (1943), in Gentzen (1969), pp. 307-308.

集合论中的不可数性证明，与算术中的不可证明性证明之间，有一个非凡的平行关系。第 1 章介绍了第一种不可数性证明，通过对角线构造说明 2ℵ0 不可数，特别是正整数集的子集有不可数多个。第 2 章介绍了第二种证明，说明可数序数有不可数多个。第二种证明给出了最小的不可数基数 ℵ1，而我们至今无法判定是否 2ℵ0=ℵ1。对角线论证只说明 2ℵ0 不可数，却没有确定它“超出可数多远”。这当然就是连续统问题。

There is a remarkable parallel between the uncountability proofs in set theory and the unprovability proofs for arithmetic. In Chapter 1 we saw the first style of uncountability proof, showing that 2ℵ0 is uncountable by diagonalization (in particular, there are uncountably many sets of positive integers). In Chapter 2 we saw a second style, showing that there are uncountably many countable ordinals. The second style of proof gives us the smallest uncountable cardinal ℵ1, and we are as yet unable to decide whether 2ℵ0=ℵ1 The diagonal argument merely shows that 2ℵ0 is uncountable; it does not determine “how far beyond countable” 2ℵ0 is. This of course is the continuum problem.

第 3 章再次使用对角线论证，证明任何可靠的算术形式理论都不完备：有些真语句能表达却不能证明。而且，分析不完备性证明可知，表达皮亚诺算术一致性的语句 Con(PA)，就是这样一个真而不可证明的语句。然而，对角线论证仍然是相当粗糙的工具：它只说明 Con(PA) 在 PA 中不可证，却不给出其“不可证明性的层级”。

In Chapter 3 we again used the diagonal argument to prove that any sound formal theory for arithmetic is incomplete. There are true sentences that it can express but cannot prove. Moreover, an analysis of the incompleteness proof shows that Con(PA), a sentence expressing the consistency of Peano arithmetic, is one such true but unprovable sentence. However, the diagonal argument is again a rather blunt instrument. It merely shows that Con(PA) is unprovable in PA; it does not give its “level of unprovability.”

下面说明如何找到 Con(PA) 的“层级”。如第 5.5 和 5.6 节所见，ε0-归纳蕴涵 Con(PA)，而对每个 α<ε0，α-归纳在 PA 中可证。因此，ε0 是使 α-归纳在 PA 中不可证的最小序数 α。从这个意义上说，ε0 代表 PA 的不可证明语句的最低层级，而 ε0-归纳与 Con(PA) 都出现在这个层级。

Here is how we can find the “level” of Con(PA). As we saw in Sections 5.5 and 5.6, Con(PA) is implied by εo-induction, and α-induction is provable in PA for each α < ε0. Thus ε0 is the least ordinal α for which α-induction is not provable in PALn this sense, ε0 represents the lowest level of unprovable sentences of PA, and this is the level where ε0-induction and Con(PA) occur.

对 α<ε0，α-归纳的可证明性由根岑（1943）给出。在同一篇论文中，他还直接证明 ε0-归纳在 PA 中不可证，也就是不假定 Con(PA) 的不可证明性，不过必然仍须假定 PA 的一致性。

The provability of α-induction for α < ε0 was shown by Gentzei (1943). In the same paper he also showed directly—that is, without as suming the unprovability of Con(PA), though necessarily assuming th consistency of PA—that ε0-induction is not provable in PA.

根岑直接证明 ε0-归纳在 PA 中不可证，漂亮地完成了集合论与 PA 之间的平行关系，因为它模拟了“ℵ1 是最小不可数基数”的论证。请记住，ℵ1 是所有可数序数的最小上界，因此若 ℵ1 可数，它就小于自身。这也进一步支持了 ε0 是 PA 高度的正确“度量”。

Gentzen’s direct proof that ε0-induction is unprovable in PA beautifully completes the parallel between settheoryandPA,bysimulating the argument that ℵ1 is the smallest uncountable cardinal. (Remember: ℵ1 is the least upper bound of the countable ordinals, so if K1 is countable it is less than itself.) It also adds to the evidence that ε0 is the correct “measure” of the height of PA.

根岑不完备性定理

Gentzen’s incompleteness theorem

假定 PA 一致，则 ε0-归纳在 PA 中不可证明。

Assuming PA is consistent, ε0-induction is not provable in PA.

一方面，他说明，按其证明排序，PA 中一个 α-归纳证明的序数至少为 α。另一方面，其一致性证明的方法表明，PA 中任何证明的序数都小于 ε0。因此，若 ε0-归纳在 PA 中可证，ε0 就小于自身！这个矛盾说明 ε0-归纳在 PA 中不可证。

On the one hand, he shows that a proof of α-induction in PA has ordinal at least α in his ordering of proofs. On the other hand, the methods of his consistency proof show that any proof in PA has ordinal less than ε0. So, if ε0-induction is provable in PA, then ε0 is less than itself! This contradiction shows that ε0-induction is not provable in PA.

回顾一下：假定 PA 一致，现在已有两个 PA 中的不可证明语句，分别来自集合论论证的“微型化”。

To recapitulate: assuming consistency of PA, we now have two unprovable sentences of PA, arising from “miniaturization” of arguments from set theory.

  • 哥德尔关于 Con(PA) 在 PA 中不可证的证明，是集合论中“2ℵ0 不可数”论证的微型化。
  • Gödel’s proof that Con(PA) is unprovable in PA is a miniaturization of the argument in set theory that 2ℵ0 is uncountable.
  • 根岑关于 ε0-归纳在 PA 中不可证的证明，是“ℵ1 是最小不可数基数”论证的微型化。
  • Gentzen’s proof that ε0-induction is unprovable in PA is a miniaturization of the argument that ℵ1 is the least uncountable cardinal.

在根岑所揭示的 PA 与集合论的平行关系中，ε0 扮演 ℵ1 的角色，因为 ε0 是不能成为 PA 中某个证明高度的最小序数。

In Gentzen’s parallel between PA and set theory, ε0 plays the role of ℵ1,because ε0 is the least ordinal that is not the height of a proof in PA.

与集合论不平行的是，根岑定理说明 ε0-归纳蕴涵 Con(PA)。如已看到的，这意味着 Con(PA) 与 ε0-归纳都出现在 ε0 层级。因此，通过对角线构造得到不可证明语句，与通过序数构造得到不可证明语句，到达相同的不可证明性层级。在集合论中，我们仍不知道通向 2ℵ0 的道路与通向 ℵ1 的道路之间，层级差异若存在究竟是什么，这就是连续统问题。但在 PA 中，条条道路都通向 ε0！

What is not parallel to set theory is Gentzen’s theorem that ε0-induction implies Con(PA). This implies, as we have seen, that the sentences Con(PA) and ε0-induction both occur at level ε0. Thus, the diagonal construction of an unprovable sentence leads to the same level of unprovability as the ordinal construction. In set theory we still do not know the difference in level (if any) between the road to 2ℵ0 and the road to ℵ1—thisisthe continuum problem. But in PA all roads lead to ε0!

5.8　历史背景

5.8 Historical Background

皮亚诺算术

Peano Arithmetic

我大量借鉴了德国人 H. 格拉斯曼的工作，即 Grassmann（1861）。戴德金最近的著作（1888）也给了我极大帮助；其中敏锐地考察了关于数的基础问题。

For proofs in arithmetic, I used Grassmann (1861). The recent work of Dedekind (1888) was also most useful to me; in it, questions pertaining to the foundations of numbers are acutely examined.

——朱塞佩⋅皮亚诺

—Giuseppe Peano

《算术原理》（1889）序言，van Heijenoort（1967）英译。

Preface to Principles of Arithmetic (1889), translated by van Heijenoort (1967).

“皮亚诺算术”的最初几步，是由极富独创性的德国数学家赫尔曼⋅格拉斯曼迈出的，他当时是一名中学教师。1861 年，他出版了供学校使用的《算术教科书》。书中用归纳定义加法和乘法，并证明其基本性质。特别是，格拉斯曼证明了这两种运算满足交换律、结合律与分配律：

The first steps in “Peano arithmetic” were taken by Hermann Grassmann, a highly original German mathematician who worked as a high school teacher. In 1861 he published a Lehrbuch der Arithmetik (Textbook of Arithmetic), intended for use in schools. In it, the operations of addition and multiplication are defined, and their basic properties proved, by induction. In particular, Grassmann proves that these two operations satisfy the commutative, associative, and distributive laws:

a+b=b+a, ab=ba,a+(b+c)=(a+b)+c, a(bc)=(ab)c, a(b+c)=ab+ac

谁说“新数学”只是 20 世纪 60 年代的一场愚行？！格拉斯曼也许不理解学生的需要，但毫无疑问，他比同时代的数学家更理解算术基础。即使最伟大的同行，若肯为 ab=ba 这样的性质作辩护，给出的也只是天真解释。例如，狄利克雷 1867 年最前沿的《数论讲义》，要求读者考察一个长为 a、宽为 b 的矩形，以确信 ab=ba。相比之下，格拉斯曼清楚表明，归纳才是算术的关键思想，尽管他还没有把归纳称为公理。

Who says “new math” was a folly of the 1960s?! Grassmann may not have understood his pupils’ needs, but there is no doubt that he understood the foundations of arithmetic better than his mathematical contemporaries. Even the greatest of them offered only naive justifications of properties such as ab = ba, if they bothered to justify them at all. For example, Dirichlet’s cutting-edge Vorlesungen über Zahlentheorie (Lectures on Number Theory) of 1867 asks the reader to consider a rectangle of length a and width b in order to be convinced that ab = ba. Grassmann, in contrast, makes it clear that induction is the crucial idea in arithmetic, though without going so far as to describe induction as an axiom.

理查德⋅戴德金以编辑狄利克雷著作开始其职业生涯，似乎没有读过格拉斯曼。他独立认识到归纳是关键思想，并进一步尝试用集合解释自然数的归纳性质。其中包括在 1888 年《数是什么，应该是什么？》中，对无穷存在性所作的如下大胆证明尝试，参见 Dedekind（1901），第 64 页。

Richard Dedekind, who began his career as Dirichlet’s editor, does not seem to have read Grassmann. He independently realized that induction is the crucial idea, and went further, attempting an explanation of the inductive property of natural numbers in terms of sets. This included the following bold attempt to prove that infinity exists, in his 1888 Was sind und was sollen die Zahlen—see Dedekind (1901), p. 64.

定理。存在无限系统。

Theorem. There exist infinite systems.

证明。我的思想领域，即一切可以成为我思想对象的事物所组成的全体 S，是无限的。因为，若 s 表示 S 的一个元素，那么“s 可以成为我的思想对象”这个思想 s′，本身也是 S 的一个元素……因此 S 无限，证毕。

Proof. My own realm of thoughts, i.e., the totality S of all things which can be objects of my thought, is infinite. For if s signifies an element of S, then is the thought s’,that s canbe anobject of my thought, itself an element of S … Hence S is infinite, which was to be proved.

我略去了戴德金说明映射 s↦s′ 是 S 与其某个真子集之间一一对应的部分。这部分在数学上没有问题，确实蕴涵 S 无限。当然，问题在于，“可以成为我的思想对象的事物”这个概念完全不清楚，也不能免于悖论。因此，多数数学家认为戴德金的“证明”走得太远。不过无妨，我们可以退一步，把归纳取为公理；皮亚诺在 1889 年正是这样做的。

I have skipped the part where Dedekind shows that the map s ↦ s′ is a one-to-one correspondence between S and a proper subset of S.This part is mathematically sound and it does imply that S is infinite. The problem, of course, is that the concept of “things which can be objects of my thought” is not at all clear or safe from paradox. Because of this, most mathematicians regard Dedekind’s “proof” as a bridge too far. But no matter, we can take a step back and take induction as an axiom,which is what Peano did in 1889.

戴德金和皮亚诺都使用所谓二阶归纳公理，其中性质 Ƥ 是自然数的任意性质，不一定能用算术形式语言定义。二阶公理很方便，因为它可以写成单个公式：

Both Dedekind and Peano used the so-called second order induction axiom, in which the property Ƥ is an arbitrary property of natural numbers, not necessarily one definable in the formal language of arithmetic. The second order axiom is convenient because it can be written as a single formula,

(∀Ƥ)[[Ƥ(1)∧(∀n)(Ƥ(n)⇒Ƥ(n+1))]⇒(∀n)Ƥ(n)]

二阶归纳的问题，最初并未被认识到：其基础二阶逻辑不像谓词逻辑那样性质良好。二阶逻辑允许 ∀ 与 ∃ 不仅作用于个体，也作用于性质，这排除了完备性定理和紧致性定理等结果。

The problem with second order induction, not realized at first, is that the underlying second order logic is not as well-behaved as predicate logic. Second order logic allows ∀ and ∃ to apply to properties as well as individuals, and this rules out completeness and compactness theorems, among other things.

在 20 世纪 20 年代谓词逻辑的影响下，出现了归纳的一阶版本：Ƥ 必须能用公式表达，因此需要一个包含无限多条归纳公理的模式。谓词逻辑只允许量词 ∀ 与 ∃ 作用于个体，而不作用于性质，这带来许多优点。不过，直到哥德尔于 1929 年证明谓词逻辑的完备性与紧致性定理，这些优点才变得明显。

The idea (in Section 5.4) of cutting back to first order axioms, in which Ƥ is expressible by a formula and one needs a whole infinite schema of induction axioms, emerged under the influence of predicate logic in the 1920s. Predicate logic allows the quantifiers ∀ and ∃ to be applied only to individuals, not properties, and this brings many advantages. However, its advantages did not become apparent until Gödel proved the completeness and compactness theorems for predicate logic in 1929.

1930 年哥德尔的不完备性定理，蕴涵二阶逻辑的不完备性；再加上根岑对一阶算术的一致性证明（1936），进一步强化了这些优点。根岑实际上希望证明二阶算术的一致性，这也是希尔伯特最初想要的，但未能成功。若他成功了，也许我们仍会像皮亚诺那样定义“皮亚诺算术”！

The advantages were reinforced by his incompleteness theorems of 1930, which implies incompleteness of second order logic, and by Gentzen’s consistency proof for first order arithmetic, Gentzen (1936). Gentzen actually hoped to prove consistency of second order arithmetic (which was what Hilbert originally wanted), but did not succeed. If he had, perhaps we would still define “Peano arithmetic” as Peano did!

不过，这已不太可能发生。用根岑式方法，例如通过直到某个可数序数的归纳，证明二阶算术一致性的希望要小得多。无论如何，二阶算术远不止数论，它包含大量分析。能够谈论自然数的任意子集，就等价于能够谈论任意实数。许多经典分析定理，例如波尔查诺–魏尔斯特拉斯定理和海涅–博雷尔定理，在二阶算术相当小的片段中就能证明。关于二阶算术及其片段的全面研究，特别是分析方面，参见 Simpson（1999）。

However, this is no longer likely to happen. There is much less chance of a Gentzen-style consistency proof for second order arithmetic, say, using induction up to some countable ordinal. In any case, second order arithmetic is much more than number theory—it contains a great deal of analysis. Being able to talk about arbitrary sets of natural numbers is equivalent to being able to talk about arbitrary real numbers. Many classical theorems of analysis, such as the Bolzano-Weierstrass and Heine-Borel theorems, can be proved in quite small fragments of second order arithmetic. For a thorough study of second order arithmetic and its fragments, with special attention to analysis, see Simpson (1999).

序数与算术

Ordinals and Arithmetic

现在也清楚了，为什么超限归纳规则是一致性证明所需的关键规则……编号为 1 的证明毕竟显然正确；而一旦确立了某个证明之前所有证明的正确性，该证明也就正确，因为选择证明次序时，恰恰使一个证明的正确性依赖于某些更早证明的正确性。

Now it also becomes clear why it is the rule of transfinite induction that is needed as the crucial rule for the consistency proof … Proof number 1 is after all trivially correct; and once the correctness of all proofs preceding a particular proof has been established, the proof in question is also correct precisely because the ordering [of proofs] was chosen in such a way that the correctness of a proof depends on the correctness of certain earlier proofs.

——格哈德⋅根岑

—Gerhard Gentzen

《数学中的无穷概念》，载于 Gentzen（1969），第 232 页。

The Concept of Infinity in Mathematics, in Gentzen (1969), p. 232.

1900 年前后，博雷尔与哈代把序数同整数函数增长率联系起来的工作，最终被证明是极好的思想，但起初成果不多。如第 2.3 节所述，哈代错误地认为，所有可数序数都能以某种有效方式生成。策梅洛于 1904 年认识到选择公理在良序中的作用，也没有完全消除他的困惑。二十多年后，希尔伯特在《论无穷》中尝试证明连续统假设时，仍因对可数序数的混淆而受损。

The work of Borel and Hardy from around 1900, relating ordinals to the growth rate of integer functions, ultimately proved to be an excellent idea. But it did not yield much fruit at first. As mentioned in Section 2.3, Hardy erred in thinking that all countable ordinals can be generated in some effective way. His confusion was not completely dispelled by Zermelo’s recognition of the role of the axiom of choice in well-ordering in 1904. More than 20 years later, Hilbert’s attempt to prove the continuum hypothesis in his On the Infinite was marred by confusion about countable ordinals.

据我所知，根岑在 1936 年 PA 的一致性证明中引入序数，是全新的思想。他是在先尝试把 PA 归约到以布劳威尔“直觉主义”原则为基础的算术之后，才走上这条路的。实际上，他于 1933 年证明，若直觉主义算术一致，则 PA 也一致。这令人意外，因为直觉主义原则本应比经典数学更可靠；然而，它们竟与 PA 一样强，而 PA 的一致性不能在 PA 中证明。这意味着我们应该更信任 PA，还是更不信任直觉主义算术？

As far as I know, Gentzen’s introduction of ordinals in his 1936 consistency proof for PA was a completely new idea. He set off in this direction only after making an entirely different attempt to prove the consistency of PA by reducing it to an arithmetic based on the “intuitionist” principles of Brouwer. In effect, he proved in 1933 that if intuitionist arithmetic is consistent, then so is PA. This was a surprise, because intuitionist principles were supposed to be more reliable than classical mathematics. Yet, somehow they are just as strong as PA, whose consistency cannot be proved in PA. Does this mean we should have more faith in PA, or less faith in intuitionist arithmetic?

根岑的证明从未发表，因为哥德尔独立想到了同一思想，并于 1933 年发表。得知哥德尔的优先权后，根岑撤回了关于直觉主义算术的论文，作出了转向切割消去的重大决定。他于 1934 年成功从谓词逻辑中消去切割，并凭借对可数序数的杰出运用，于 1936 年证明 PA 的一致性。由于 PA 只需要直到 ε0 的序数，他得以避免处理所有可数序数。作为证明的副产品，他发现了一类新的 PA 不可证明语句，即 ε0-归纳。

Gentzen’s proof was never published, because Gödel had the same idea independently, and published it in 1933. When Gentzen learned of Gödel’s priority, he withdrew his own paper on intuitionist arithmetic and made the fateful turn towards cut elimination. He succeeded in eliminating cuts from predicate logic in 1934, and proved consistency of PA in 1936, thanks to his brilliant use of countable ordinals. He was able to avoid working with all the countable ordinals because PA calls only for ordinals up to ε0. As a byproduct of his proof, he discovered a new type of unprovable sentence of PA, namely, ε0-induction.

ε0-归纳虽是有趣的 PA 不可证明语句，却与哥德尔的不可证明语句 Con(PA) 面临同一种审美异议：这类语句并非自然产生于算术研究。古德斯坦（1944）的定理更接近“自然”不可证明语句的目标，因为它只涉及正整数上的加法、乘法与指数运算。如第 2.7 节所见，古德斯坦认识到，他的定理是 ε0-归纳的后果。下一章将给出古德斯坦定理的一种自然推广，它蕴涵 ε0-归纳，因此若 PA 一致，这个推广肯定不能在 PA 中证明。

While ε0-induction is an interesting unprovable sentence of PA, it is open to the same aesthetic objection as Gödel’s unprovable sentence Con(PA): such sentences do not arise naturally in the study of arithmetic. The theorem of Goodstein (1944) comes closer to the goal of a “natural” unprovable sentence, since it involves only the concepts of addition, multiplication, and exponentiation on positive integers. As we saw in Section 2.7, Goodstein realized that his theorem is a consequence of εo-induction. In the next chapter we give a natural generalization of Goodstein’s theorem that implies ε0-induction, hence the generalization is certainly not provable in PA (if PA is consistent).

原来的古德斯坦定理也不能在 PA 中证明，但这一事实更难确立。此后又经过三十年关于序数与 PA 关系的研究，人们才恰当理解古德斯坦定理。第一步由生于奥地利、在英国受教育的数学家格奥尔格⋅克赖泽尔于 1952 年迈出，他发现了可证可计算函数与序数递归函数之间的关系。

The original Goodstein theorem is not provable in PA either, but this fact is more difficult to establish. It took three further decades of research on the relation between ordinals and PA before Goodstein’s theorem was properly understood. The first step was taken by the Austrian-born (but English-educated) mathematician Georg Kreisel in 1952, who discovered a relationship between provably computable functions and ordinal recursive functions.

若 PA 证明，对每个自然数 m，f(m) 的计算都会停机，就称可计算函数 f 是可证可计算的。把所有形如“对所有 m，f(m) 的计算停机”的定理列出来，再作对角线构造，就能拼出一个并非可证可计算的可计算函数。然而，对角线论证并未告诉我们，可证可计算函数究竟有什么特别之处。为此，需要根岑对 PA 中证明的分析。

Acomputable function f is said to be provably computable if PA proves that the computation of f (m) halts for each natural number m. It is possible to concoct a computable function that is not provably computable by listing all the theorems of the form “the computation of f (m) halts for all m” and making a diagonal construction. However, the diagonal argument does not tell us what, if anything, makes the provably computable functions special. For that we need Gentzen’s analysis of proofs in PA.

与 PA 的任何可证语句一样，“对所有 m，f(m) 的计算停机”必然具有某个序数 α<ε0。可以预期，α 以某种方式限制 f 的“复杂性”，但如何度量复杂性？一种方法是，对可数序数 α，通过 α-归纳定义可计算函数。正如对 α<ε0 能在 PA 中表达 α-归纳，也能在 PA 中通过 α-归纳定义函数。假定定义中非归纳的部分在某种意义上简单，这样的函数 f 就可计算，称为序数递归函数。克赖泽尔发现，可证可计算函数，恰好是序数 α<ε0 对应的序数递归函数。

Like any provable sentence of PA, “the computation of f (m) halts for all m” necessarily has some ordinal α < ε0. It is to be expected that α somehow bounds how “complex” f can be, but how do we measure complexity? One way is to define computable functions by α-induction for countable ordinals α. Just as we can express α-induction in PA for α < ε0, we can define functions in PA by α-induction for α < ε0. Assuming that the non-inductive part of the definition is in some sense simple, such functions f are computable, in which case they are called ordinal recursive. Kreisel’s discovery was that the provably computable functions are precisely the ordinal recursive functions for ordinals α < ε0.

另一种度量可计算函数复杂性的方法是增长率。斯坦利⋅韦纳（1970）发现了这一点，漂亮地把可证明性与博雷尔、哈代早期的增长率思想联系起来。韦纳证明，可证可计算函数，恰好是那些增长率由所谓哈代层级中某个 Hα 所界定的可计算函数，其中 α<ε0。关于哈代层级，详见第 6.5 节。因此，ε0 再次充当皮亚诺算术中证明复杂性的最小上界。

Another way to measure complexity of computable functions is by rate of growth. This was discovered by Stanley Wainer (1970), elegantly connecting provability with the old growth-rate ideas of Borel and Hardy. Wainer showed that the provably computablefunctions areprecisely the computable functions whose growth rate is bounded by a function H in the so-called Hardy hierarchy,for some α < ε0.(For more on the Hardy hierarchy, see Section 6.5.) Thus ε0 again plays the role of least upper bound to the complexity of proofs in Peano arithmetic.

由韦纳定理可知，若可计算函数 f 比所有 α<ε0 对应的 Hα 都增长得更快，那么 f 在 PA 中不是可证可计算的。这使我们能够找到许多新的 PA 不可证明语句，下一章就会看到。

It follows from Wainer’s theorem that, if f is a computable function that grows faster than any Hu for α < ε0, then f is not provably computable in PA. This allows us to find many new examples of sentences not provable in PA,as wewill see in the next chapter.

1　皮亚诺与戴德金针对正整数的任意性质 Ƥ 陈述归纳 (n→n+1)。由第 1 章可知，这样的性质有不可数多个。这超过了我们的算术语言所能描述的范围，因为我们的语言，事实上任何人类可读的语言，都只包含可数多个符号串。这使完全一般的归纳陈述面临问题，因此通常只要求对能在一种表达能力适当丰富的语言中定义的性质使用归纳。毕竟，我们只想证明 PA 中可表达的语句，因此应当只需要 PA 中可表达的归纳实例。

1Peano and Dedekind stated induction (n → n + 1) for arbitrary properties Ƥ of the positive integers. As we know from Chapter 1, there are uncountably many such properties. This is more than can be described in our language for arithmetic, because our language (and indeed, any language readable by humans) contains only countably many strings of symbols. This makes a completely general statement of induction problematic, and it is usual to require induction only for properties that can be defined in a reasonably expressive language. After all, we wish to prove only sentences expressible in PA, so we should need only instances of induction expressible in PA.

2　这不与第 4.7 节提到的柯尼希无穷引理矛盾，因为证明树中可能存在与无限多条边相接的顶点。

2This does not contradict the König infinity lemma, mentioned in Section 4.7, because in a proof tree there may be vertices that meet an infinite number of edges.

第 6 章　自然的不可证明语句

- Chapter 6 - Natural Unprovable Sentences

概览

Preview

本章回到古德斯坦定理，即第 2 章借助 ε0-归纳证明的结果。我们将找到它的一种自然推广，这个推广不仅是 ε0-归纳的后果，而且与之等价。因此，广义古德斯坦定理蕴涵 PA 的一致性，从而不能在 PA 中证明。这给出了第一个不能在 PA 中证明的自然定理的例子。

In this chapter we return to Goodstein’s theorem, the result proved in Chapter 2 with the help of ε0-induction. We find a natural generalization of Goodstein’s theorem that is not only a consequence of ε0-induction, but also equivalent to it. It follows that the generalized Goodstein theorem implies the consistency of PA, and hence it is not provable in PA. This gives us our first example of a natural theorem not provable in PA.

普通古德斯坦定理本身也不能在 PA 中证明，但要说明这一点，需要对序数与证明作更精细的分析，其中涉及与可数序数相关的快速增长函数。我们将概述对古德斯坦定理如何进行这种分析，并介绍其他一些定理，其在 PA 中的不可证明性同样与快速增长函数相联系。

The ordinary Goodstein theorem is itself not provable in PA, but showing this requires a more delicate analysis of ordinals and proofs, involving fast-growing functions associated with countable ordinals. We outline how this is done for Goodstein’s theorem, and describe some other theorems whose unprovability in PA is similarly tied to fast-growing functions.

这些其他不可证明定理，来自组合数学中广受关注的领域：拉姆齐理论与图论。在两个领域中，我们都将展示涉及快速增长函数的自然问题。拉姆齐理论例子的增长率与古德斯坦函数相似，因此相应的不可证明定理，即帕里斯–哈林顿定理，与古德斯坦定理处于相似层级。

These other unprovable theorems lie in popular areas of combinatorics—Ramsey theory and graph theory. In both areas we exhibit natural problems involving fast-growing functions. The Ramsey theory example has a growth rate similar to that of the Goodstein function, so the corresponding unprovable theorem—the Paris-Harrington theorem—lies at a level similar to that of Goodstein’s theorem.

图论中有两个非凡的定理，克鲁斯卡尔定理与图子式定理，它们处于更高层级。因此，只有从远强于 ε0-归纳的无穷假设出发，才能证明这些定理。

In graph theory there are two remarkable theorems, Kruskal’s theorem and the graph minor theorem, lying at an even higher level. Thus the latter theorems are provable only from assumptions about infinity much stronger than ε0-induction.

6.1　广义古德斯坦定理

6.1 A Generalized Goodstein Theorem

回顾第 2.7 节介绍的古德斯坦过程。它从一个写成以 2 为底的康托尔标准形的正整数 m1 开始。例如，可以从下式开始：

Recall the Goodstein process introduced in Section 2.7. It starts with a positive integer m1 written in base 2 Cantor normal form. For example, we might start with

m1=27=24+23+2+1=222+22+1+2+1. 

接着，把每个 2 替换为 3，在这个例子中得到

Next, replace each 2 by a 3, obtaining (in this case)

n1=333+33+1+3+1,

然后减去 1。把所得的数写成以 3 为底的康托尔标准形，本例中为

and subtract 1. The resulting number is written in base 3 Cantor normal form, in this case

m2=333+33+1+3.

随后，对新底数 3 继续这一过程，把它替换为 4，再减去 1。简而言之，古德斯坦过程交替执行两种操作：把一个以 k 为底的数中的每个 k 替换为 k+1，再减去 1，从而产生一个分别以 2、3、4、5、……为底、写成康托尔标准形的数列。古德斯坦定理说，对任意初始数 m1，这个过程都会终止。

Then the process continues with the new base 3, replacing it by 4 and again subtracting 1. In a nutshell, the Goodstein process produces a sequence of numbers in Cantor normal form with respective bases 2, 3, 4, 5,…, by alternately replacing each k in a base k number by k + 1, and subtracting 1. Goodstein’s theorem states that the process terminates for any initial number m1.

如第 2.7 节所见，一旦发现古德斯坦过程背后潜藏的可数序数，证明就很容易了。对每个以 k 为底、写成康托尔标准形的数 mk−1，把其表达式中的每个 k 替换为 ω，就能对应一个康托尔标准形序数。例如，在当前例子中，

The proof, as we saw in Section 2.7, is easy once one spots the countable ordinals lurking in the shadows of the Goodstein process. We can associate each base k Cantor normal form number mk−1 with a Cantor normal form ordinal by replacing each k in the base k expression for mk−1 by ω. In the present case, for example,

m1=222+22+1+2+1,  so  α1=ωωω+ωω+1+ω+1.

因此，把 k 替换为 k+1 时，序数保持不变；减去 1 时，序数则减小。继续当前例子，得到

It follows that the ordinal remains the same when we replace k by k + 1, and the ordinal decreases when we subtract 1. Thus, continuing the present example, we have

m2=333+33+1+3, 并且 α2=ωωω+ωω+1+ω.

m2=333+33+1+3, and α2=ωωω+ωω+1+ω. 

由于任何严格递减的序数序列都是有限的，古德斯坦定理随即成立。事实上，证明中使用的康托尔标准形序数都小于 ε0，因此只需对小于 ε0 的序数假定这种递减序列性质。换言之，古德斯坦定理由所谓直到 ε0 的超限归纳推出。

Goodstein’s theorem follows because any decreasing sequence of ordinals is finite. In fact, since the Cantor normal form ordinals used in the proof are all less than ε0, we need assume the decreasing sequence property only for the ordinals less than ε0. In other words, Goodstein’s theorem follows by what may be called transfinite induction up to ε0.

一旦看到它与递减序数序列的联系，就清楚了：古德斯坦过程的许多变体，都因完全相同的理由而终止。不必把 k 替换为 k+1， 而可以把 k 替换为任意整数 k′>k，序数仍不改变。因此，只要增大底数与减去 1 交替进行，过程仍必定终止。把以下过程称为一般古德斯坦过程：交替地，把整数以 k 为底的康托尔标准形中的每个 k 替换为任意 k′≥k，从而得到以 k′ 为底的标准形整数，再减去 1。于是有：

As soon as one sees the connection with decreasing sequences of ordinals, it becomes clear that many variations of the Goodstein process terminate for exactly the same reason. Instead of replacing k with k + 1 one can replace k by any integer k′ > k and the ordinal does not change, so the process still must terminate if these base increases alternate with subtractions of 1. Let us call a process that alternates between replacing each k in the base k Cantor normal form of an integer by any k′ ≥ k (thus obtaining an integer in base k’ normal form) with subtraction of 1 a general Goodstein process.Then we have:

广义古德斯坦定理。对任意正整数施行一般古德斯坦过程，都会在有限步后终止。

Generalized Goodstein theorem. A general Goodstein process, applied to any positive integer, terminates in a finite number of steps.

证明：对直到 ε0 的序数作超限归纳。□

Proof : By transfinite induction up to ε0. □

6.2　通过自然数理解可数序数

6.2 Countable Ordinals via Natural Numbers

上一节的要点是，ε0-归纳蕴涵广义古德斯坦定理。事实上，也能证明广义古德斯坦定理蕴涵 ε0-归纳，因此二者在某种意义上“等价”。“等价”的确切含义，取决于证明两个蕴涵时需要作出多少假设，这个问题暂且搁置。首先要说明，广义古德斯坦定理蕴涵 ε0-归纳。有了某种证明之后，再仔细检查假设。

The gist of the previous section is that ε0-induction implies the generalized Goodstein theorem. In fact, we can also prove that the generalized Goodstein theorem implies ε0-induction, so generalized Goodstein and ε0-induction are “equivalent” in some sense. The exact meaning of “equivalent” depends on how much we need to assume in proving the two implications—a question we defer for the moment. First, we need to see that generalized Goodstein implies εo-induction. After we have some kind of proof, we can look more closely at our assumptions.

为找到从广义古德斯坦定理通向 ε0-归纳的路径，先考察一张列出所有正整数康托尔标准形的表。表 6.1 是其开头部分：最左列向上列出所有正整数，第二、第三、第四、……列，分别列出每个正整数以 2、3、4、……为底的康托尔标准形。

To find a route from the generalized Goodstein theorem to ε0-induction, we begin by looking at a table of Cantor normal forms of all the positive integers. 由这个次序的定义可清楚看出，康托尔标准形构成线序，也称全序。也就是说，两个不同标准形 φ 与 ψ，总有 φ≻ψ 或 ψ≻φ。事实上，次序 ≻ 的定义及其线序性质的证明，都可以在皮亚诺算术，即第 5.3 节的 PA 理论中完成。康托尔标准形可以用自然数编码，而线序性质可借助普通归纳，以及 PA 中可证的加法、乘法和指数运算性质来证明。

It is clear from the definition of this ordering that the Cantor normal forms are linearly, ortotally, ordered. That is, if φ and ψ are two forms then either φ ≻ ψ or ψ ≻ φ. In fact, the definition of the ordering y and the proof that it is linear can be carried out in Peano Arithmetic (the theory PA described in Section 5.3). The Cantor normal forms can be encoded by natural numbers, and the linear order properties can be proved with the help of ordinary induction and properties of addition, multiplication, and exponentiation provable in PA.

证明康托尔标准形构成良序，则是另一回事。这恰好就是 ε0 的良序性质，因此，由第 3 和第 5 章的理由可知，它不能在 PA 中证明。ε0 的良序性蕴涵 PA 的一致性，见第 5 章；而由哥德尔第二不完备性定理，PA 的一致性不能在 PA 中证明，见第 3 章。

It is a different matter to prove that Cantor normal forms are well ordered. This is precisely the well-ordering property of ε0,so it is not provable in PA for the reasons we saw in Chapters 3 and 5. The well-ordering of ε0 implies the consistency of PA(Chapter 5), which is not provable in PA by Gödel’s second incompleteness theorem (Chapter 3).

尽管如此，康托尔标准形的良序性，仍可从某些关于自然数的自然陈述推出。其中之一就是广义古德斯坦定理，下一节将说明这一点。

Nevertheless, it is possible to deduce the well-ordering of Cantor normal forms from certain natural statements about natural numbers. One of these is the generalized Goodstein theorem, as we will see in the next section.

6.3　从广义古德斯坦定理到良序性

6.3 From Generalized Goodstein to Well-Ordering

以 2、3、4、……为底的康托尔标准形，显然与经典康托尔标准形密切相关，因此，一般古德斯坦过程与经典康托尔标准形中的下降过程也相关。澄清这些关系之后，就能看出如何从广义古德斯坦定理推出 ε0 的良序性。

The Cantor normal forms of base 2, 3, 4, … obviously have a close relationship with the classical Cantor normal forms, and a general Goodstein process is thereby related to a process of descent through classical Cantor normal forms. When these relationships are clarified, a deduction of ε0 well-ordering from the generalized Goodstein theorem comes into view.

事实上，仔细看表 6.1 和 6.2，就能窥见这种关系。经典康托尔标准形可以视为以底数为自变量的“图像”，其点落在穿过表 6.2 的曲线上。例如，值 ω 位于一条从“底数 2”列开始、斜率为 1 的直线上；值 ω+1 位于另一条平行直线上，也从“底数 2”列开始；值 ω⋅2 位于一条从“底数 3”列开始、斜率为 2 的直线上；值 ω2 位于一条从“底数 3”列开始的抛物线上，依此类推。从两张表看，经典康托尔标准形的图像似乎按正确次序层层排列，而这个次序来自表 6.1 各列内部数的次序。图 6.1 显示部分标准形的图像及其排序。

In fact, one can catch a glimpse of the relationship by staring at Tables 6.1 and 6.2. The classical Cantor normal forms are “graphs” (functions of the base) visible as points on curves that can be drawn through Table 6.2. For example: the values ω lie on a line of slope 1 starting in the “base 2” column; the values ω + 1 lie on a parallel line, also starting in the”base 2” column; the values ω · 2 lie along a line of slope 2 starting in the “base 3” column; the values ω2 lie along a parabola starting in the “base 3” column; and so on. It appears, from Tables 6.1 and 6.2, that the graphs of the classical Cantor normal forms are stacked up in their correct order, and that this ordering arises from the ordering of numbers within the columns of Table 6.1. Figure 6.1 shows the graphs for some of the normal forms, and their ordering.

需要澄清的主要问题，是经典康托尔标准形的次序 ≻ 与自然数次序 > 之间的关系。为描述这种关系，用 α、β、……等希腊字母表示经典标准形，并用 α(k) 表示把 α 中的 ω 替换为 k 后得到的以 k 为底的康托尔标准形。例如，若

The main point to be clarified is the relationship between the ordering ≻ of classical Cantor normal forms and the ordering > of natural numbers. To describe this relationship we denote classical normal forms by Greek letters such as α,β,…, and let α(k) denote the base k Cantor normal form that results from α by replacing ω by k. For example, if

α=ωω+ω2+3

then

α(4)=44+42+3, α(5)=55+52+3, 并且 因此 on.

α(4)=44+42+3, α(5)=55+52+3,  and so on. 

为避免得到并非以 k 为底的康托尔标准形的表达式，只在 k 大于 α 中出现的所有正整数时，才定义 α(k)。于是有：

To avoid getting expressions that are not base k Cantor normal forms, we define α(k) only for k greater than the positive integers occurring in α. Then we have:

≻ 与 > 的相容性。若 α、β 是任意经典康托尔标准形，且正整数 k 大于 α、β 中出现的所有整数，那么 α≻β 当且仅当 α(k)>β(k)。

Compatibility of ≻ and >. If α and ß are any classical Cantor normal forms and k is a positive integer greater than the integers occurring in α and β, then α ≻ β if and only if α(k) > β(k).

这可以通过对高度作普通归纳来证明，思路与上一节定义 ≻ 时类似。由 ≻ 与 > 的相容性可知，若 α≻β，则表 6.1 中每个 α(k)，都位于对应 β(k) 的上方，前提是后者存在。因此，若 α(k) 是表 6.1 第 k 列中表示 α 的一个数，且 α≻β，就能如下从 α(k) 到达一个表示 β 的数 β(l)：

This is proved by an ordinary induction on height, along similar lines to the definition of y in the previous section. It follows from the compatibility of ≻ and > that, if α ≻ β, each occurrence of α(k) in Table 6.1 lies above the corresponding occurrence of β(k) (if it exists). Therefore, if α(k) is a number in column k of Table 6.1 representing a,and α ≻ β,then we can travel from α(k) to a number β(l) representing β as follows:

  • 把以 k 为底的标准形 α(k) 中的每个 k 替换为 l，其中 l 大于 k，也大于康托尔标准形 β 中的所有整数，以保证 β(l) 存在。
  • Replace each k in the base k form α(k) by l,where l is greater than k and all the integers in the Cantor normal form β (so that β(l) exists).
  • 对所得标准形 α(l)，保持底数 l 不变，连续减去 1 共 α(l)−β(l) 次，从而得到 β(l)。
  • Subtract 1 from the resulting form α(l) (keeping the base fixed at l) α(l) − β(l) times, thus obtaining β(l).

用图 6.1 的直观语言说，要从 α 的图像下降到 β<α 的图像，先沿 α 的图像向右，从底数 k 移到一个使 β 的图像有定义的底数 l，然后沿底数 l 那一列竖直下降。例如，若位于底数 2 处的 ω 图像上，想下降到 3 的图像，必须先把底数增至 4，再减去 1，就能在底数 4 那一列从 ω 的图像下降到 3 的图像。

In the more visual terms of Figure 6.1, we descend from the graph of α to the graph of β < α by first traveling to the right on the graph of α, from base k to a base l for which the graph of β is defined, then dropping vertically down the base l column. For example, if we are on the graph of ω at base 2 and want to descend to the graph of 3, we must first increase the base to 4. Then subtract 1 to drop from the graph of ω to the graph of 3 in the base 4 column.

连续进行这样的步骤，得到以下定理：

Making a series of such steps, we obtain the theorem:

广义古德斯坦定理蕴涵 ε0-归纳。任何经典康托尔标准形的严格下降序列，都确定一个一般古德斯坦过程。因此，任何这样的递减序列都是有限的。

Generalized Goodstein implies ε0-induction. Any descending sequence of classical Cantor normal forms determines a generalized Goodstein process. (So any decreasing sequence of such forms is finite).

证明：给定经典康托尔标准形的下降序列 α≻β≻γ≻⋯，找出正整数 k<l<m<⋯，使 α(k)、β(l)、γ(m)、……都有定义。具体地，取

Proof: Given a descending sequence α ≻ β ≻ γ ≻⋯ of classical Cantor normal forms, we find positive integers k < l < m < ⋯ so that α(k), β(l), γ(m),… are all defined. Namely, find

k> 标准形中的整数 α, l>k 并且 标准形中的整数 β, m>k,l 并且 标准形中的整数 γ, ⋮

k> the integers in the form α,  l>k and the integers in the form β, m>k,l and the integers in the form γ,     ⋮

于是得到以下一般古德斯坦过程：

Then we have the following generalized Goodstein process:

  • 把 α(k) 中的 k 替换为 l，得到 α(l)。
  • Replace k in α(k) by l, obtaining α(l).
  • 保持底数 l 不变，连续减去 1 共 α(l)−β(l) 次，得到 β(l)。
  • Subtract 1 (keeping the base l fixed) α(l) − β(l) times, obtaining β(l).
  • 把 β(l) 中的 l 替换为 m，得到 β(m)。
  • Replace l in β(l) by m, obtaining β(m).
  • 保持底数 m 不变，连续减去 1 共 β(m)−γ(m) 次，得到 γ(m)。
  • Subtract 1 (keeping the base m fixed) β(m) − γ(m) times, obtaining γ(m).
  • 依此类推。
  • And so on.

由广义古德斯坦定理，这个过程终止。因此，康托尔标准形序列 α≻β≻γ≻⋯ 必须有限。

By the generalized Goodstein theorem, this process terminates. Therefore, the sequence α ≻ β ≻ γ y≻ ⋯ of Cantor normal forms must be finite.

最后，由此可知，康托尔标准形的任意非空集合都有最小元素，因此 ε0 构成良序。因为，在任何没有最小元素的无限标准形集合中，都能反复选择更小的元素，构造出一个无限下降序列。□

It follows, finally, that any set of Cantor normal forms has a least member, and hence ε0 is well-ordered. Because, in any infinite set of forms without least member we can construct an infinite descending sequence, by repeatedly choosing smaller members. □

6.4　广义与普通古德斯坦定理

6.4 Generalized and Ordinary Goodstein

上一节讨论的广义古德斯坦定理，不能在 PA 中证明。理由是，它蕴涵 ε0-归纳；由根岑的一致性证明，后者蕴涵 PA 的一致性；而哥德尔第二不完备性定理说明，PA 的一致性不能在 PA 中证明。不过，广义古德斯坦定理甚至不能用 PA 的语言表达，因为它涉及对正整数的任意序列作量化，而 PA 的变量只表示单个整数，不表示整数序列。也许更好的说法是，广义古德斯坦定理比 PA 更强。

The generalized Goodstein theorem, discussed in the last section, is not provable in PA. This can be seen from the fact that it implies ε0-induction, which implies the consistency of PA by Gentzen’s consistency proof, and we know that consistency of PA is not provable in PA by Gödel’s second incompleteness theorem. However, the generalized Goodstein theorem is not even expressible in the language of PA, because it involves quantification over arbitrary sequences of positive integers, and PA has variables only for individual integers, not for sequences of them. Perhaps it would be better to say that the generalized Goodstein theorem is stronger than PA.

另一种做法，是把广义古德斯坦定理缩减为 PA 语言中可表达的形式：把其陈述中任意的底数序列 k≤k′≤k″≤⋯，替换为一个定义正整数非递减序列的任意 PA 公式。这样，表达广义古德斯坦定理的单个语句，就被一个古德斯坦公理模式取代；它包含该定理所有能在 PA 中表达的实例。

Alternatively, we can cut down the generalized Goodstein theorem to one expressible in the language of PA by replacing the arbitrary sequence of bases k ≤ kk′ ≤ k″ ≤ ⋯ in the statement of the generalized Goodstein theorem by an arbitrary formula of PA defining a nondecreasing sequence of positive integers. Thus the single sentence expressing the generalized Goodstein theorem is replaced by a Goodstein axiom schema that includes all instances of the generalized Goodstein theorem expressible in PA.

由上一节的论证可知，古德斯坦公理模式蕴涵 PA 中可表达的全部 ε0-归纳实例。根据第 5 章的论证，这些实例足以证明 PA 的一致性。而且，这些蕴涵本身也能在 PA 中证明。因此，在 PA 中可以证明，古德斯坦公理模式蕴涵 PA 的一致性。再次由哥德尔第二定理可知，古德斯坦公理模式不能在 PA 中证明。

It follows, by the argument in the previous section, that the Goodstein axiom schema implies all instances of ε0-induction expressible in PA. The latter instances suffice to prove consistency of PA by the argument of Chapter 5. Moreover, the implications can also be proved in PA. Thus it can be proved in PA that the Goodstein axiom schema implies the consistency of PA. This shows, by Gödel’s second theorem again, that the Goodstein axiom schema is not provable in PA.

若一开始只假定普通古德斯坦定理，即底数递增序列固定为 2、3、4、5、……，事情就困难得多。此时，只能对一类受限制的康托尔标准形下降序列 α≻β≻γ≻⋯ 证明其有限性。这个受限制的性质碰巧也不能在 PA 中证明，但原因不是哥德尔第二定理那样的熟知结果，因此最好另找研究 PA 中不可证明性的方法。下一节将概述一种很有用的方法，即研究可证可计算函数。这种方法不仅能说明古德斯坦定理，还能说明其他几个有趣语句在 PA 中不可证。可证可计算函数本身也值得研究，因为它们为序数与增长率的关系提供了新的认识。

We have a harder row to hoe if we start by assuming only the ordinary Goodstein theorem, where the ascending sequence of bases is 2, 3, 4, 5, … . In this case we can prove finiteness only for a restricted class of descending sequences α ≻ β ≻ γ ≻ ⋯ of Cantor normal forms. This restricted property of Cantor normal forms happens to be unprovable in PA, but not for well-known reasons like Gödel’s second theorem, so it is desirable to find another approach to unprovability in PA. One very useful approach, which we outline in the next section, is via the study of provably computable functions. This approach allows us to show unprovability in PA of several interesting sentences, not just Goodstein’s theorem. Provably computable functions are also interesting for their own sake, because they throw new light on the relationship between ordinals and growth-rate.

6.5　可证可计算函数

6.5 Provably Computable Functions

普通古德斯坦定理说明，以下函数有良好定义：

The ordinary Goodstein theorem says that we have a well-defined function

G(n)=从 n 开始的古德斯坦过程停机前所需的步数。

G(n) = number of steps before the Goodstein process on n halts.

函数 G(n) 显然可计算，只需运行古德斯坦过程并计数步数即可。但除非能证明古德斯坦过程总会停机，否则就不能在 PA 中证明，对每个正整数 n，G(n) 都存在。若普通古德斯坦定理在 PA 中可证，则 G(n) 在 PA 中可证地有良好定义；此时称 G(n) 是可证可计算的。

The function G(n) is obviously computable, simply by letting the Goodstein process run and counting the steps. But we cannot prove in PA that G(n) exists for each positive integer n unless we can prove that the Goodstein process always halts. If the ordinary Goodstein theorem is provable in PA then G(n) is what is known as a provably computable function.

研究可证可计算函数，是探究 PA 中可证明性的一个非常有用的途径。

These functions were already discussed in Section 5.8. But, to recapitulate, we call a function f provably computable if f is computable and PA proves that the computation of f (m) halts for each m.

这些函数具有共同特征：增长率有一个可数层级，它们的增长率均受其界定。因此，任何增长快到“超出这个尺度”的可计算函数，都不是可证可计算的。由此可知，任何蕴涵某个超出尺度的可计算函数存在的语句，都不能在 PA 中证明。

Provably computable functions turn out to be interesting and useful because their growth rates can be measured on a “scale” of functions labelled by ordinals < ε0. Any provably computable function has growth rate less than some member of the scale; therefore, any computable function that grows so fast as to be “off the scale” is not provably computable. It follows that any sentence implying the existence of a computable function off the scale is not provable in PA.

下面的小节将概述这个尺度，以及它为何存在。事实表明，古德斯坦函数 G(n) 超出了尺度，因此古德斯坦定理不能在 PA 中证明。
