For example

f(0)=0，因为 0 是唯一的空集；
f(1)=1，因为 1 是 0 的唯一后继；
⋮
f(ω)=ω，因为 ω 是唯一一个以 0、1、2、……为元素的集合。

f(0)=0, because 0 is the unique empty set, f(1)=1, because 1 is the unique successor of 0,         ⋮f(ω)=ω because ω is the unique set with members 0,1,2,….

事实上，可以证明，不被 f 固定的最小序数，大于无限多个伍丁基数，因此，存在自相似的 Vα 是一条大基数公理，甚至强于无限多个伍丁基数的存在。

In fact, it can be shown that the least ordinal not fixed by f is greater than infinitely many Woodin cardinals, so the existence of a self-similar Vα is a large cardinal axiom, even stronger than the existence of infinitely many Woodin cardinals.

如前所述，这条特定的大基数公理之所以有趣，是因为它导向了辫排序的发现。如今我们知道，辫排序可以从 ZF 等较弱假设证明。不过，关于有限对象的定理，并不总能消去其中的大基数假设。在一项仍在进行的研究计划中，哈维·弗里德曼找到了极大的基数公理，它们具有极其有限、且以其他方式无法证明的后果。他找到了许多后果属于 PA 的例子。这些例子是否像辫排序一样“自然”，尚可争论；但它们仍说明，即使在有限数学中，也有必须使用无穷的地方。

As we have said, this particular large cardinal axiom is interesting because it led to the discovery of the braid ordering. We now know that braid ordering can be proved from weaker assumptions, such as ZF. However, it is not always possible to eliminate large cardinal assumptions from theorems about finite objects. In a research program that is still under way, Harvey Friedman has found very large cardinal axioms with very finite consequences that are not otherwise provable. He has found many examples where the consequences are in PA. It is debatable whether his examples are as “natural” as the braid ordering, but they nevertheless make the point that there are necessary uses of infinity, even in finite mathematics.

7.6　历史背景

7.6 Historical Background

无穷公理

Axioms of infinity

这样一个数，即不可达基数，的存在……至少看来是可疑的；不过，在下文中必须把它作为一种可能性考虑。

The existence of one such number [an inaccessible cardinal] … seems at least problematic; however, it must be considered as a possibility in what follows.

——费利克斯·豪斯多夫（1908），第 444 页。

—Felix Hausdorff (1908), p. 444.

ZF−无穷 本质上就是 PA 这一观察，归功于希尔伯特的学生威廉·阿克曼。1937 年，他把 ZF−无穷 编码到 PA 中，再诉诸根岑对 PA 的一致性证明，从而证明 ZF−无穷 的一致性。他还说明，PA 也可以编码到 ZF−无穷 中，因此这两个理论等一致。

The observation that ZF — Infinity is essentially PA is due to Hilbert’s student Wilhelm Ackermann. In 1937 he proved the consistency of ZF — Infinity by encoding it in PA, then appealing to Gentzen’s consistency proof for PA. He also showed that PA may be encoded in ZF — Infinity, so the two theories are equiconsistent.

不可达基数最早由费利克斯·豪斯多夫于 1908 年考虑，随后保罗·马洛于 1911–1913 年作了推广。马洛考虑不可达基数递增序列的极限，如今称为马洛基数。豪斯多夫与马洛实际考虑的概念，如今称为弱不可达性；在所谓广义连续统假设 2^{ℵα}=ℵα+1 下，它与通常的不可达性一致。这个假设也是豪斯多夫在 1908 年的论文中引入的，因此在某种意义上，他也考虑了通常的不可达性。

Inaccessible cardinals were first considered by Felix Hausdorff in 1908, and studied more thoroughly by Paul Mahlo in 1911–1913. Mahlo considered limits of increasing sequences of inaccessibles, now known as Mahlo cardinals. Hausdorff and Mahlo actually considered a concept now called weak inaccessibility, which agrees with ordinary inaccessibility under the so-called generalized continuum hypothesis:2ℵα=ℵα+1. This hypothesis was also introduced by Hausdorff in his 1908 paper, so in a way he considered ordinary inaccessibility too.

更强的不可达性概念，涉及对替换与幂集运算都封闭，由谢尔平斯基与塔尔斯基于 1930 年引入。他们还为这个概念引入“不可达”一词，并把这个术语归于库拉托夫斯基。在一篇非凡的论文中，Kuratowski（1924）指出，不可达基数的存在不是 ZF＋AC 的定理；他未给证明，并假定一致性。也就是说，如果不可达基数存在，它们的存在就不能在 ZF＋AC 中证明，这是一种绝妙的神学式困境。不过，库拉托夫斯基使用的是豪斯多夫的弱不可达概念，因此当时若不假定广义连续统假设，就无法证明他的主张。Kanamori（2003）第 18 页指出了这个障碍。金森把第一个证明不可达基数存在性不可证的结果，归于 Zermelo（1930）。

The stronger concept of inaccessibility, involving closure under both the replacement and power operations, was introduced by Sierpiński and Tarski in 1930. They also introduced the term “inaccessible” for the concept, attributing it to Kuratowski. In a remarkable paper, Kuratowski (1924) pointed out (without proof, and assuming consistency) that the existence of inaccessibles is not a theorem of ZF + AC. Namely, if inaccessibles exist, then their existence is not provable in ZF + AC—an exquisitely theological predicament. However, Kuratowski was using the weak inaccessible concept of Hausdorff, so his claim could not have been proved at that time without assuming the generalized continuum hypothesis. This obstacle was pointed out by Kanamori (2003), p. 18. Kanamori credits the first proof that the existence of inaccessibles is unprovable to Zermelo (1930).

事实上，策梅洛于 1928 年 2 月 2 日在弗赖堡的一次报告中介绍了这个结果，Baer（1928）第 383 页对此有报道。按今天的标准，策梅洛的证明不算严格，但其思想极其简单，因此很容易重写为符合现代标准的证明。它不涉及哥德尔不完备性定理那样复杂的内容，尽管其中第二定理也说明，不可达基数的存在不能在 ZF＋AC 中证明。²

In fact, Zermelo presented his result in a talk at Freiburg on February 2, 1928, and it was reported in Baer (1928), p. 383. Zermelo’s proof would not be considered rigorous today, but his idea is so exquisitely simple that the proof can be easily rewritten to comply with current standards. It does not involve anything as sophisticated as Gödel’s incompleteness theorems, the second of which also shows that the existence of inaccessibles cannot be proved in ZF + AC.2

策梅洛不完备性定理

Zermelo’s incompleteness theorem

若不可达的 κ 存在，这一事实就不能在 ZF＋AC 中证明。这是因为 Vκ 是 ZF＋AC 的一个模型。因此，若 κ 是具有这一性质的最小序数，则 Vκ 满足

If inaccessible κ exist, then this fact is not provable in ZF + AC. This is because Vκ is a model of ZF+AC. So, if κ is the smallest ordinal with this property, then Vκ satisfies

ZF＋AC＋“不存在不可达基数”，

ZF+AC+ "there is no inaccessible," 

因为 Vκ 中的序数 α 都满足 α<κ，因此都不是不可达的。

because the a in Vκ are such that α < κ, hence they are not inaccessible.

同样在 1930 年，库拉托夫斯基的学生斯坦尼斯瓦夫·乌拉姆发现，可测基数是不可达的。因此，库拉托夫斯基称乌拉姆为“我最伟大的发现”。但直到 1960 年，塔尔斯基与学生威廉·汉夫才发现，可测基数大于最小不可达基数，因而具有独立的研究价值。³ 由此可知，若可测基数存在，即使在 ZF＋AC＋不可达基数 中，也不能证明它们的存在。这是因为存在一个最小可测基数 κ，于是 Vκ 不仅满足 ZF＋AC＋不可达基数，也满足“不存在可测基数”，因为 Vκ 中的所有基数都小于 κ。从 Vκ 的观点看，其中的基数也都不可测，不过这一点并不显然。

Also in 1930, Kuratowski’s student Stanisław Ulam found that measurable cardinals are inaccessible. (Because of this, Kuratowski described Ulam as “my greatest discovery.”) But it was not until 1960 that measurable cardinals were found to be larger than the smallest inaccessible cardinal—by Tarski and his student William Hanf—and hence of independent interest.3 It follows that, if measurable cardinals exist, one cannot prove their existence even in ZF + AC + Inaccessible. This is because there is a smallest measurable cardinal κ,and then Vκ satisfies not only ZF + AC + Inaccessible but also “there is no measurable cardinal,” since all the cardinals in Vκ are less than κ. (The cardinals in Vκ are also non-measurable from the viewpoint of κ, though this not obvious.)

此后，大基数世界迅速扩张。Kanamori（2003）对这个世界及其历史作了精彩介绍。真正无畏的读者，也许愿意查阅 Jech（2003），了解更多技术细节，例如索洛韦关于“所有实数集都勒贝格可测”一致性的定理。

After this, the world of large cardinals expanded rapidly. A fine account of this world, and its history, is given in Kanamori (2003). Really intrepid readers may wish to consult Jech (2003) for further technical details, such as Solovay’s theorem on the consistency of “all sets of reals are Lebesgue measurable.”

描述集合论

Descriptive Set Theory

勒贝格那个微不足道的错误，我是这样称呼它的，竟然极其有用：它引发了新概念与新定理的雪崩。

Lebesgue’s trivial (as I have called it) mistake proved to be very useful: it unleashed an avalanche of new concepts and theorems.

——卡齐米日·库拉托夫斯基（1980），第 70 页。

—Kazimierz Kuratowski (1980), p. 70.

起初，集合论主要是一门“基础性”学科，旨在澄清分析的基本概念：数、函数、极限、测度。当然，康托尔很快就遇到了分析学家未曾想到的问题，即连续统假设（CH）。但有理由相信，CH 可以通过分析似乎也需要的同一个思想解决：按定义的复杂性对实数集分类。为研究这个分类问题而发展的理论，后来称为描述集合论。

In the beginning, set theory was mainly a “foundational” discipline that aimed to clarify the basic concepts of analysis: numbers, functions, limits, measure. Of course, Cantor quickly encountered a problem that the analysts had not thought of—the continuum hypothesis (CH). But there was reason to suppose that CH would be solved by the same idea that analysis seemed to need: a classification of sets of real numbers in terms of the complexity of their definitions. The theory developed to attack this classification problem came to be known as descriptive set theory.

第 2.9 节已经看到，到 1905 年，博雷尔、贝尔与勒贝格已把博雷尔集分为 ℵ₁ 个层级，部分目的是描述可测集。这是描述集合论中第一个实质性结果。康托尔本人对实数集的分类并未走得很远，但他引入的一种集合性质，极大影响了描述集合论此后的发展，即完全集性质。

We saw in Section 2.9 that by 1905 Borel, Baire, and Lebesgue had developed a classification of the Borel sets into ℵ1 levels, partly as a means to describe the measurable sets. This was the first substantial result in descriptive set theory. Cantor himself did not get far in classifying sets of reals, but he introduced a property of sets that greatly influenced the future evolution of descriptive set theory—the perfect set property.

若一个集合非空、闭合且不含孤立点，就称它为完全集。例如，区间 [0,1] 是完全集，但整数点集不是。很容易说明，任意完全集的基数都是 2ℵ0。Cantor（1883）证明，每个不可数闭集都包含一个完全集，因此任意不可数闭集的基数都是 2ℵ0。如今，我们把康托尔的结果表述为：闭集类具有完全集性质。更一般地，若实数集的一个类 S 中，每个不可数集合 X 都包含一个完全集，就称 S 具有完全集性质。由此可知，“S 满足 CH”，意思是 S 中任意不可数元素 X 的基数都是 2ℵ0。

A set is called perfect if it is nonempty, closed, and contains no isolated points. For example, the interval [0,1] is a perfect set, but the set of integer points is not. It is quite easy to show that any perfect set has cardinality 2N0. Cantor (1883) proved that every uncountable closed set contains a perfect set, so any uncountable closed set has cardinality 2N0.. We now express Cantor’s result by saying that the class ofclosed sets has the perfect set property. More generally, we say that aclass S of sets of reals has the perfect set property if any uncountable set X in S contains a perfect set. It follows that “S satisfies CH,” in the sense that any uncountable member X of S has cardinality 2N0..

闭集位于博雷尔层级的最底部，因此康托尔的结果距离证明 CH 还很远。不过，可以希望证明，完全集性质与可测性一样，延伸到整个博雷尔层级。事实上，所有博雷尔集确实都有完全集性质，但这直到 1916 年才由帕维尔·亚历山德罗夫确立；他属于尼古拉·卢津领导的俄罗斯学派。

The closed sets lie at the very bottom of the Borel hierarchy, so Cantor’s result is a long way from a proof of CH. However, one might hope to show that the perfect set property extends all the way up the Borel hierarchy, just as measurability extends all the way. In fact, all Borel sets d0 have the perfect set property, but this was established only in 1916, by Pavel Aleksandrov, a member of the Russian school headed by Nikolai Luzin.

卢津于 1905 年在巴黎学习，受到博雷尔与勒贝格影响。起初，他的兴趣在分析，但到 1916 年，他意识到自己真正的志业是描述集合论。他的学派因学生米哈伊尔·苏斯林的一项发现而声名鹊起：博雷尔集的投影不一定是博雷尔集，这正是勒贝格 1905 年论文中的错误。由此，一个全新的集合类浮出水面：博雷尔集的投影，后来称为解析集。随之而来的挑战，是把博雷尔集的已知结果，例如可测性与完全集性质，推广到它们。

Luzin studied in Paris in 1905 and was influenced by Borel and Lebesgue. At first his interests were in analysis, but by 1916 he had realized that his true calling was in descriptive set theory. His school gained fame through the discovery of his student, Mikhael Suslin, that the projections of Borel sets are not always Borel (the mistake in Lebesgue’s 1905 paper). This brought to light a whole new class of sets: the projections of Borel sets, later known as the analytic sets. With them came the challenge of extending the results already known for Borel sets, such as measurability and the perfect set property.

1917 年，卢津证明解析集可测，苏斯林证明它们具有完全集性质，因此，康托尔迈向连续统假设的漫长征程又前进一步。下一步是什么？1925 年，卢津与瓦茨瓦夫·谢尔平斯基考虑了由任意维数的博雷尔集通过投影与取补得到的全部集合，预示着向解析集类之外的推进；他们把这些集合称为射影集。

In 1917 Luzin proved that analytic sets are measurable, and Suslin proved that they have the perfect set property, so Cantor’s long march towards the continuum hypothesis was taken a step further. What was next? In 1925, Luzin and Wacław Sierpiński foreshadowed a move beyond the class of analytic sets by considering all sets obtainable from Borel sets (of any dimension) by projection and complementation—what they called the projective sets.

射影集构成一个具有 ω 个层级的层级结构，最初称为

The projective sets form a hierarchy of ω levels, originally called

A 与 CA，即解析集及其补集；PCA 与 CPCA，即 CA 集的投影及其补集；

  A and CA (analytic sets, and their complements),  PCA and CPCA (projections of CA sets, and their complements), 

依此类推。今天有一种更简短的记号，但解释起来更费时间。每个层级都有新集合，但即使在第二层，证明可测性与完全集性质的任务也似乎无法克服。事实上，Luzin（1925）作出了大胆而富有预见性的宣言：对于所有射影集是否都可测、是否都具有完全集性质，“人们不知道，也永远不会知道”。Luzin（1930）第 323 页进一步阐述：

and so on. (Today there is a shorter notation, but it takes longer to explain.) There are new sets in each level, but the task of proving measurability and the perfect set property seems insuperable even at the second level. Indeed, Luzin (1925) made the bold and prophetic declaration that “one does not know and one will never know” whether all projective sets are measurable and have the perfect set property. Luzin (1930), p. 323, elaborated:

……作者认为，判断所有射影集是否可测的问题不可解，因为在他看来，射影集与勒贝格可测性的定义不可比较，因此在逻辑上没有联系。

… the author considers the question of knowing whether all projective sets are measurable to be insoluble, because in his view the definitions of projective set and Lebesgue measurability are incomparable and hence not logically related.

后来的发展表明，卢津的预言相当接近事实。ZF 公理不能判定所有射影集是否都可测，也不能判定它们是否都具有完全集性质；采用不同的附加公理，会得到不同答案。

Luzin’s prophecy was close to the mark, as later developments showed. The ZF axioms do not decide whether all the projective sets are measurable, or whether they all have the perfect set property—and one gets different answers depending on which additional axioms are used.

若像哥德尔于 1938 年证明选择公理的一致性时那样，取“所有集合都可构造”为公理，见第 2.9 节，就得到实数集 ℝ 的一个可定义良序，并由此得到一个可定义的不可测集。哥德尔注意到，显然得到过乌拉姆的一些帮助，这个定义把不可测集放在射影层级的第二层。此外，还会得到一个不具有完全集性质的 CA 集。另一方面，如第 7.3 节所见，假定存在无限多个伍丁基数，就能证明所有射影集都具有决定性，因而可测。同一假设也蕴涵所有射影集都有完全集性质，因为完全集性质是决定性的另一个良好后果。

If one takes the axiom that all sets are constructible, as Gödel did in 1938 when proving the consistency of the axiom of choice (see Section 2.9), then one gets a definable well-ordering of R,and with it a definable nonmeasurable set. Gödel noticed (apparently with some help from Ulam) that the definition puts the nonmeasurable set in the second level of the projective hierarchy. Moreover, one gets a CA set without the perfect set property. On the other hand, as we saw in Section 7.3, assuming the existence of infinitely many Woodin cardinals allows us to prove that all projective sets are determined, and hence measurable. The same assumption implies that all projective sets have the perfect set property, because the perfect set property is another of the nice consequences of determinacy.

集合论中当前的一种看法是，大基数公理这样的“包容性”公理，比哥德尔可构造性公理这样的“限制性”公理更可信。例如，由选择公理得到的集合，似乎理应尽可能远离“可定义”，而大基数公理似乎做到了这一点。但基数越大，我们离可证明性就越远。也许我们已经越过界线，进入矛盾。人们不知道，也许永远不会知道。

Current thinking in set theory is that “inclusive” axioms, such as the large cardinal axioms, are more plausible than “restrictive” axioms such as Gödel’s axiom of constructibility. It seems right, for example, that sets obtained by the axiom of choice should be as far from “definable” as possible, and large cardinal axioms seem to achieve this. But the larger the cardinal, the further we are from provability. Perhaps we have already crossed the line into contradiction. One does not know, and one may never know.

无穷公理能解决一切吗？

Do Axioms of Infinity Settle Everything?

并非不可能……存在某种完备性定理，断言每个可用集合论表达的命题，都能由现有公理加上某个关于集合宇宙之“大”的真断言来判定。

It is not impossible that … some completeness theorem would hold which would say that every proposition expressible in set theory is decidable from the present axioms plus some true assertion about the largeness of the universe of sets.

——库尔特·哥德尔

—Kurt Gödel

1946 年普林斯顿大学二百周年纪念会议前的评论，载于 Gödel（1990），第 151 页。

Remarks before the Princeton bicentennial conference, 1946, in Gödel (1990), p. 151.

1930 年证明不完备性定理后不久，哥德尔就开始思考，这些定理所蕴涵的对更强新公理的无尽需求。我们无法以任何可计算方式枚举一个完备的公理序列，但也许可以说明，公理不断增长的“强度”应如何用数学描述。集合论似乎是检验哥德尔“纲领”的好场所，因为它善于通过序数与基数度量无尽的复杂性，而且有大量未获证明的定理。大基数的历史似乎印证了这一点：索洛韦、马丁、斯蒂尔与伍丁使用越来越大的基数，导出关于实数集的越来越强的定理。

Soon after he proved his incompleteness theorems in 1930, Gödel began to think about the endless need for new and stronger axioms that his theorems imply. We cannot enumerate a complete sequence of such axioms in any computable way, but perhaps it is possible to say how increasing “strength” of axioms might be described mathematically. Set theory looks like a good arena for testing Gödel’s “program,” because it is good at measuring endless complexity—by ordinals and cardinals— and it is rich in unproved theorems. The history of large cardinals seems to bear this out, with Solovay, Martin, Steel, and Woodin using larger and larger cardinals to derive stronger and stronger theorems about sets of real numbers.

确实，可以理解：若基数 κ 大到使 Vκ 成为 ZF 的模型，而 λ>κ 且 Vλ 也是 ZF 的模型，那么 λ 的存在所蕴涵的内容，比 κ 的存在更多。这是因为 Vκ 是 ZF＋“κ 不存在”的模型，因为 κ 不在 Vκ 中；而 Vλ 是 ZF＋“κ 存在”的模型，因为 κ<λ，故 κ 在 Vλ 中。因此，人们也许开始希望，ZF 公理无法解决的任何语句，都能由适当的大基数公理解决。

Indeed, it makes sense that if κ is a cardinal so large that that Vκ is a model of ZF and λ > κ is a cardinal such that Vλ is also a model of ZF, then the existence of λ implies everything and more than is implied by the existence of κ. This is because Vκ is a model of ZF + “κ does not exist” (since κ is not in ), whereas Vλ is a model of ZF + “κ exists” (since κ < λ and hence κ is in Vλ). Thus one might begin to hope that any sentence not settled by the ZF axioms might be settled by a suitable large cardinal axiom.

哥德尔也知道，无穷公理可以判定 PA 中不可证明的整数语句。例如，Con(PA) 在 PA 中不可证，因而在 ZF−无穷 中也不可证；但在 ZF 中，通过展示 PA 公理的一个模型，例如 Vω，就能证明 Con(PA)。因此，ZF 通常的无穷公理，已经足以证明 Con(PA)。更强的无穷公理能证明更多。例如，由哥德尔第二定理，Con(ZF) 在 ZF 中不可证，但它在 ZF＋不可达基数 中可证，因为对于不可达的 κ，Vκ 是 ZF 的模型，依此类推。

Gödel was also aware that axioms of infinity decide sentences about integers that are unprovable in PA. For example, Con(PA) is not provable in PA and hence not in ZF — Infinity either, but in ZF we can prove Con(PA) by exhibiting a model for the PA axioms, such as Vω .Thus the ordinary ZF axiom of infinity is strong enough to prove Con(PA). Stronger axioms of infinity can prove more. For example, Con(ZF) is not provable in ZF, by Gödel’s second theorem, but it is provable in ZF + Inaccessible because, for inaccessible κ, is a model of ZF, and so on.

如上一节所述，大基数公理可以证明关于整数的新定理，例如 Con(ZF)，超出 ZF 无穷公理这样“小”基数公理所能证明的范围。这些新定理包括形如“p(x₁,x₂,…,xn)=0 没有整数解”的语句，其中 p 是整系数多项式。这由第 3.8 节提到的马季亚谢维奇关于多项式方程的工作推出。因此，大基数的长臂一直伸到基本算术。

As mentioned in the previous section, large cardinal axioms can prove new theorems about integers, such as Con(ZF), beyond those provable from “small” cardinal axioms such as the ZF axiom of infinity. The new theorems include some of the form “p(x1, x2,…, xn)= 0 has no integer solution,” where p is a polynomial with integer coefficients. This follows from the Matiyasevich work on polynomial equations mentioned in Section 3.8. Thus the long arm of large cardinals reaches all the way down to basic arithmetic.

我们也知道，某些“微型”无穷公理会影响 PA：ε₀-归纳证明 Con(PA) 与古德斯坦定理，而 Γ-归纳证明弗里德曼的克鲁斯卡尔定理有限形式，其中 Γ 是一个远大于 ε₀ 的特定可数序数。这里，ε₀-归纳类似 ZF 通常的无穷公理，而 Γ-归纳也许类似某种不可达基数公理。归纳公理及其后果的理论，不如大基数公理及其后果的理论发达，但未来值得期待。通向无穷的道路，不应只有两条，而应有三条、四条、许多条。

We also know that certain “miniature” axioms of infinity have an influence on PA: ε0-induction proves Con(PA) and Goodstein’s theorem, while Γ-induction proves Friedman’s finite form of Kruskal’s theorem, where Γ is a particular countable ordinal much larger than ε0.Here ε0-induction is analogous to the ordinary ZF axiom of infinity, and Γ-induction is perhaps the analogue of some axiom of inaccessibles. The theory of induction axioms and their consequences is not as developed as the theory of large cardinal axioms and their consequences, but we can expect more from it in the future. There should be not just two, but three, four, many roads to infinity.

尽管无穷公理取得了种种成功，我们仍须承认，它们迄今未能解决集合论最大的难题：连续统假设。1947 年，哥德尔写了一篇题为《什么是康托尔的连续统问题？》的论文，以类似上面引文的形式，表达了他对无穷公理的希望，但也对当时已知的公理有所怀疑，参见 Gödel（1990），第 182 页。

Nevertheless, for all the successes of axioms of infinity, we must admit that they have thus far failed to settle the biggest question of set theory: the continuum hypothesis. In 1947, Gödel wrote a paper called What is Cantor’s Continuum Problem? that expressed his hopes for axioms of infinity in a form similar to the quote above, but tempered with doubts about the axioms then known (see Gödel (1990), p. 182).

至于连续统问题，几乎没有希望借助那些可以在今日已知原则基础上建立的无穷公理来解决……但也许存在其他公理，建立在迄今未知的原则之上……

As for the continuum problem, there is little hope of solving it by means of those axioms of infinity which can be set up on the basis of principles known today …But probably there exist others based on hitherto unknown principles …

20 世纪 60 年代，汉夫与塔尔斯基发现，可测基数强于单纯的不可达基数，随后又发现许多更强基数，一度重新燃起希望。但到 1967 年，由莱维与索洛韦的一个结果已清楚可见，科恩的方法可以构造集合论模型，使连续统假设不受这些新大基数的影响。

In the 1960s, hopes were temporarily raised by the discovery of Hanf and Tarski that measurable cardinals are stronger than mere inaccessibles, and the subsequent discovery of many stronger cardinals. But by 1967 it was clear (from a result of Levy and Solovay) that Cohen’s methods could be used to build models of set theory in which the continuum hypothesis was not affected by the new large cardinals.

如今，我们知道更多无穷公理，但它们似乎仍不能解决连续统假设。另一方面，据我们所知，其他合理公理也都不能。我们只能与希尔伯特一起希望：“我们必须知道，我们终将知道。”

Today, we know more axioms of infinity, but they still do not appear to settle the continuum hypothesis. On the other hand, neither do any other reasonable axioms, as far as we know. We can only hope, with Hilbert, that “we must know, we shall know.”

1　金森图表最上面的“公理”是“0=1”，反映了某些曾被提出的大基数公理后来被证明为假这一事实。追求能够蕴涵越来越多 ZF 语句的公理，就要承担这种风险。一个假公理在能够蕴涵每个语句的意义上，是“强”到极致的，但我们并不希望公理强到这种程度！

1The top “axiom” on Kanamori’s chart is “0 = 1,” reflecting the fact that some proposed large cardinal axioms have turned out to be false. This is a risk one runs when pursuing axioms that imply more and more sentences of ZF. A false axiom is maximally “strong” in the sense that it implies every sentence, but one does not want axioms to be this strong!

2　事实上，策梅洛未能理解哥德尔对对角线论证的运用，也不相信哥德尔的定理正确。即使哥德尔于 1931 年给他写了一封长信，他仍未领会其中思想；这封信见 Gödel（2003），第 423 页。这也许证实了策梅洛的不完备性定理比哥德尔的更简单。

2Indeed, Zermelo failed to understand Gödel’s use of the diagonal argument and did not believe that Gödel’s theorems were correct. He still did not get the idea even after Gödel wrote him a long letter in 1931, which may be found in Gödel (2003), p. 423. This perhaps confirms that Zermelo’s incompleteness theorem is simpler than Gödel’s.

3　这次轮到哥德尔不理解了。他于 1961 年 8 月起草了一封给塔尔斯基的信，但大概没有寄出，其中写道，见 Gödel（2003），第 273 页：

3This time it was Gödel’s turn not to understand. In a letter to Tarski that he drafted, but probably did not send, in August 1961 he wrote (see Gödel (2003), p. 273),

我听说，已经证明第一个不可达数上不存在二值可数可加测度。我仍然不能相信这是真的……。

I have heard it has been proved that there is no two valued denumerably additive measure for the first inacc. number. I still can’t believe that this is true ….
